-- An empty layout, for maps built from Studio parts (MapMarks).
function MapLayout.blank(name: string, title: string): Layout
	return newLayout(name, title)
end

-- Adds a map built in Studio. One named like a built-in map replaces it.
function MapLayout.register(layout: Layout)
	if not MapLayout.maps[layout.name] then
		table.insert(MapLayout.names, layout.name)
	end
	if not table.find(MapLayout.custom, layout.name) then
		table.insert(MapLayout.custom, layout.name)
	end
	MapLayout.maps[layout.name] = layout
	if current.name == layout.name then
		current = layout
	end
end

-- The maps to take turns on: new maps built in Studio first (so pressing
-- Play shows yours), then `configured` (Config.MAP_ROTATION).
function MapLayout.rotation(configured: { string }): { string }
	local out = {}
	for _, name in MapLayout.custom do
		if not table.find(configured, name) then
			table.insert(out, name)
		end
	end
	for _, name in configured do
		if MapLayout.maps[name] then
			table.insert(out, name)
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- Built-in maps get their clutter the first time they're used (see
-- `clutter` below), so loading this module stays instant.
local prepare: (Layout) -> Layout = function(layout)
	return layout
end

function MapLayout.current(): Layout
	return prepare(current)
end

function MapLayout.get(name: string): Layout?
	local layout = MapLayout.maps[name]
	return if layout then prepare(layout) else nil
end

function MapLayout.use(name: string): Layout
	current = prepare(MapLayout.maps[name] or MapLayout.maps.Neighborhood)
	return current
end

-- Derived geometry ------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Splits a wall into solid pieces no longer than MAX_WALL_PIECE, skipping the
-- doorway gaps and splitting at window edges so each piece is fully a window
-- or fully plain wall.
function MapLayout.wallPieces(w: Wall): { WallPiece }
	local h = T / 2
	local a = (if w.horizontal then w.x1 else w.z1) - h
	local b = (if w.horizontal then w.x2 else w.z2) + h
	local across = if w.horizontal then w.z1 else w.x1

	local spans: { Range } = {}
	local cursor = a
	for _, gap in w.gaps do
		if gap[1] > cursor then
			table.insert(spans, { cursor, gap[1] })
		end
		cursor = math.max(cursor, gap[2])
	end
	if cursor < b then
		table.insert(spans, { cursor, b })
	end

	local cuts: { number } = {}
	for _, list in { w.windows, w.secrets } do
		for _, r in list do
			table.insert(cuts, r[1])
			table.insert(cuts, r[2])
		end
	end

	local pieces: { WallPiece } = {}
	for _, span in spans do
		local stops = { span[1] }
		for _, c in cuts do
			if c > span[1] + 0.01 and c < span[2] - 0.01 then
				table.insert(stops, c)
			end
		end
		table.insert(stops, span[2])
		table.sort(stops)
		for i = 1, #stops - 1 do
			local s, e = stops[i], stops[i + 1]
			local mid = (s + e) / 2
			local isWindow, isSecret = false, false
			for _, win in w.windows do
				if mid > win[1] and mid < win[2] then
					isWindow = true
				end
			end
			for _, secret in w.secrets do
				if mid > secret[1] and mid < secret[2] then
					isSecret = true
				end
			end
			local count = math.max(1, math.ceil((e - s) / MapLayout.MAX_WALL_PIECE - 0.001))
			local step = (e - s) / count
			for k = 0, count - 1 do
				local p1, p2 = s + step * k, s + step * (k + 1)
				local r = if w.horizontal
					then rect(p1, across - h, p2, across + h)
					else rect(across - h, p1, across + h, p2)
				table.insert(pieces, {
					rect = r,
					window = isWindow,
					secret = isSecret,
					house = w.house,
					horizontal = w.horizontal,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	return pieces
end

function MapLayout.allWallPieces(layout: Layout): { WallPiece }
	local out = {}
	for _, w in layout.walls do
		for _, p in MapLayout.wallPieces(w) do
			table.insert(out, p)
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- Every doorway, at the center of its gap.
function MapLayout.doors(layout: Layout): { Door }
	local out = {}
	for _, w in layout.walls do
		local house: House? = nil
		for _, hs in layout.houses do
			if hs.id == w.house then
				house = hs
			end
		end
		for _, gap in w.gaps do
			local mid = (gap[1] + gap[2]) / 2
			local exterior = false
			if house then
				local r = house.rect
				exterior = if w.horizontal
					then (w.z1 == r.z1 or w.z1 == r.z2)
					else (w.x1 == r.x1 or w.x1 == r.x2)
			end
			table.insert(out, {
				x = if w.horizontal then mid else w.x1,
				z = if w.horizontal then w.z1 else mid,
				horizontal = w.horizontal,
				width = gap[2] - gap[1],
				house = w.house,
				exterior = exterior,
			})
		end
	end
	return out
end

function MapLayout.footprint(spot: FurnitureSpot, width: number, depth: number): Rect
	return rect(spot.x - width / 2, spot.z - depth / 2, spot.x + width / 2, spot.z + depth / 2)
end

-- The walkable inside of a room (wall centerlines pulled in by half a wall).
function MapLayout.roomInterior(r: Room): Rect
	local h = T / 2
	return rect(r.rect.x1 + h, r.rect.z1 + h, r.rect.x2 - h, r.rect.z2 - h)
end

-- Areas where grass decorations must not go.
function MapLayout.noDecorRects(layout: Layout): { Rect }
	local out: { Rect } = {}
	for _, hs in layout.houses do
		local r = hs.rect
		table.insert(out, rect(r.x1 - 3, r.z1 - 3, r.x2 + 3, r.z2 + 3))
	end
	for _, list in { layout.road.sidewalks, layout.paths, layout.patios, layout.pools } do
		for _, r in list do
			table.insert(out, r)
		end
	end
	for _, b in layout.bushes do
		table.insert(out, rect(b.x - b.r - 1, b.z - b.r - 1, b.x + b.r + 1, b.z + b.r + 1))
	end
	return out
end

function MapLayout.inRect(r: Rect, x: number, z: number, margin: number?): boolean
	local m = margin or 0
	return x >= r.x1 - m and x <= r.x2 + m and z >= r.z1 - m and z <= r.z2 + m
end

function MapLayout.rectsOverlap(a: Rect, b: Rect, margin: number?): boolean
	local m = margin or 0
	return a.x1 < b.x2 + m and b.x1 < a.x2 + m and a.z1 < b.z2 + m and b.z1 < a.z2 + m
end

-- Park-Miller: plain arithmetic, the same everywhere (no Roblox Random).
local function numbers(seed: number): () -> number
	local state = seed % 2147483646 + 1
	return function(): number
		state = (state * 16807) % 2147483647
		return (state - 1) / 2147483646
	end
end

-- fit along: a flood fill on a 1-stud grid (walls, furniture, bushes and
-- pools grown by their body radius), then each spot's path back to the
-- start. Returns `blocks(rect)`: would furniture there block one of them?
local function itemPaths(layout: Layout, pieces: { WallPiece }): (Rect) -> boolean
	local B = layout.bounds
	local width, height = math.floor(B.x2 - B.x1), math.floor(B.z2 - B.z1)
	local radius = Config.CHARACTER.MaxRootWidth / 2
	local blocked: { [number]: boolean } = {}
	local function block(r: Rect)
		for cz = math.max(0, math.floor(r.z1 - radius - B.z1)), math.min(height - 1, math.ceil(r.z2 + radius - B.z1)) do
			for cx = math.max(0, math.floor(r.x1 - radius - B.x1)), math.min(width - 1, math.ceil(r.x2 + radius - B.x1)) do
				local x, z = B.x1 + cx + 0.5, B.z1 + cz + 0.5
				if x > r.x1 - radius and x < r.x2 + radius and z > r.z1 - radius and z < r.z2 + radius then
					blocked[cz * width + cx] = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, piece in pieces do
		if not piece.secret then
			block(piece.rect)
		end
	end
	for _, spot in layout.furniture do
		if not FurnitureSpecs.get(spot.kind).decor then
			local w, d = FurnitureSpecs.footprint(spot.kind, spot.rot)
			block(rect(spot.x - w / 2, spot.z - d / 2, spot.x + w / 2, spot.z + d / 2))
		end
	end
	for _, b in layout.bushes do
		block(rect(b.x - b.r, b.z - b.r, b.x + b.r, b.z + b.r))
	end
	for _, pool in layout.pools do
		block(pool)
	end

	local from: { [number]: number } = {}
	local spawn = layout.zombieSpawns[1]
	local first = math.floor(spawn.z - B.z1) * width + math.floor(spawn.x - B.x1)
	from[first] = first
	local queue, head = { first }, 1
	while head <= #queue do
		local index = queue[head]
		head += 1
		local cx, cz = index % width, index // width
		for _, step in { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } } do
			local nx, nz = cx + step[1], cz + step[2]
			if nx >= 0 and nx < width and nz >= 0 and nz < height then
				local n = nz * width + nx
				if from[n] == nil and not blocked[n] then
					from[n] = index
					table.insert(queue, n)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local path: { [number]: boolean } = {}
	for _, p in layout.itemSpots do
		local index = math.floor(p.z - B.z1) * width + math.floor(p.x - B.x1)
		while from[index] ~= nil and not path[index] do
			path[index] = true
			if from[index] == index then
				break
			end
			index = from[index]
		end
	end

	return function(r: Rect): boolean
		local grow = radius + 0.5
		for cz = math.max(0, math.floor(r.z1 - grow - B.z1)), math.min(height - 1, math.ceil(r.z2 + grow - B.z1)) do
			for cx = math.max(0, math.floor(r.x1 - grow - B.x1)), math.min(width - 1, math.ceil(r.x2 + grow - B.x1)) do
				if path[cz * width + cx] then
					local x, z = B.x1 + cx + 0.5, B.z1 + cz + 0.5
					if x > r.x1 - grow and x < r.x2 + grow and z > r.z1 - grow and z < r.z2 + grow then
						return true
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end
end

local function clutter(layout: Layout, seed: number)
	local random = numbers(seed)
	local function around(x: number, z: number, r: number): Rect
		return rect(x - r, z - r, x + r, z + r)
	end
	local function spotRect(kind: string, x: number, z: number, rot: number): Rect
		local w, d = FurnitureSpecs.footprint(kind, rot)
		return rect(x - w / 2, z - d / 2, x + w / 2, z + d / 2)
	end
	local function hits(r: Rect, list: { Rect }, margin: number): boolean
		for _, other in list do
			if MapLayout.rectsOverlap(r, other, margin) then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local placed: { Rect } = {}
	for _, spot in layout.furniture do
		if not FurnitureSpecs.get(spot.kind).decor then
			table.insert(placed, spotRect(spot.kind, spot.x, spot.z, spot.rot))
		end
	end
	local zones: { Rect } = {}
	local reach = T / 2 + 4
	for _, w in layout.walls do
		for _, list in { w.gaps, w.secrets } do
			for _, g in list do
				table.insert(
					zones,
					if w.horizontal
						then rect(g[1] - 0.6, w.z1 - reach, g[2] + 0.6, w.z1 + reach)
						else rect(w.x1 - reach, g[1] - 0.6, w.x1 + reach, g[2] + 0.6)
				)
			end
		end
	end
	for _, list in { layout.itemSpots, layout.humanSpawns, layout.zombieSpawns, layout.wizardSpots } do
		for _, p in list do
			table.insert(zones, around(p.x, p.z, 4.5))
		end
	end
	table.insert(zones, around(layout.start.x, layout.start.z, 18))
	for _, b in layout.bushes do
		table.insert(zones, around(b.x, b.z, b.r + 2))
	end
	for _, pool in layout.pools do
		table.insert(zones, rect(pool.x1 - 2, pool.z1 - 2, pool.x2 + 2, pool.z2 + 2))
	end
	local pieces = MapLayout.allWallPieces(layout)
	local onPath = itemPaths(layout, pieces)
	-- Furniture belongs to the smallest house around it (as MapMarks reads it).
	local function houseAt(x: number, z: number): string
		local best, bestArea = "", math.huge
		for _, house in layout.houses do
			if MapLayout.inRect(house.rect, x, z) then
				local area = (house.rect.x2 - house.rect.x1) * (house.rect.z2 - house.rect.z1)
				if area < bestArea then
					best, bestArea = house.id, area
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	-- Off the walls: many of the pieces you can push (not fixtures like
	-- toilets and bookshelves, not the massive ones) start a few studs out
	-- from the wall, so people and bots can get behind them and shove them
	-- into a doorway.
	local wallRects: { Rect } = {}
	for _, piece in pieces do
		if not piece.secret then
			table.insert(wallRects, piece.rect)
		end
	end
	local rects: { [number]: Rect } = {}
	for i, spot in layout.furniture do
		if not FurnitureSpecs.get(spot.kind).decor then
			rects[i] = spotRect(spot.kind, spot.x, spot.z, spot.rot)
		end
	end
	-- The sides of a footprint with a wall too close to squeeze in behind
	-- (closer than NO_SQUEEZE studs).
	local function wallSides(here: Rect): { { number } }
		local out: { { number } } = {}
		local g = NO_SQUEEZE
		for _, d in { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } } do
			local side = if d[1] == 1
				then rect(here.x2, here.z1 + 0.3, here.x2 + g, here.z2 - 0.3)
				elseif d[1] == -1 then rect(here.x1 - g, here.z1 + 0.3, here.x1, here.z2 - 0.3)
				elseif d[2] == 1 then rect(here.x1 + 0.3, here.z2, here.x2 - 0.3, here.z2 + g)
				else rect(here.x1 + 0.3, here.z1 - g, here.x2 - 0.3, here.z1)
			if hits(side, wallRects, 0) then
				table.insert(out, d)
			end
		end
		return out
	end
	for i, spot in layout.furniture do
		local here = rects[i]
		if not here or FurnitureSpecs.get(spot.kind).weight == "Massive" or FIXTURES[spot.kind] then
			continue
		end
		local touching = wallSides(here)
		-- Pieces in a corner always try; along one wall, most of them do.
		if #touching == 0 or (#touching < 2 and random() > OFF_WALL_SHARE) then
			continue
		end
		local inner: Rect? = nil
		for _, room in layout.rooms do
			local r = MapLayout.roomInterior(room)
			if here.x1 >= r.x1 and here.x2 <= r.x2 and here.z1 >= r.z1 and here.z2 <= r.z2 then
				inner = r
				break
			end
		end
		if not inner then
			continue
		end
		local room = inner :: Rect
		-- Directions to try: straight out of a corner first, then away from
		-- each wall it's against, each as far as fits.
		local tries: { { number } } = {}
		if #touching >= 2 then
			local sx, sz = 0, 0
			for _, d in touching do
				sx -= d[1]
				sz -= d[2]
			end
			if sx ~= 0 or sz ~= 0 then
				table.insert(tries, { sx, sz })
			end
		end
		for _, d in touching do
			table.insert(tries, { -d[1], -d[2] })
		end
		for _, dir in tries do
			local moved: Rect? = nil
			for _, gap in OFF_WALLS do
				local dx, dz = dir[1] * gap, dir[2] * gap
				local candidate = rect(here.x1 + dx, here.z1 + dz, here.x2 + dx, here.z2 + dz)
				local fits = candidate.x1 >= room.x1 + 0.2
					and candidate.x2 <= room.x2 - 0.2
					and candidate.z1 >= room.z1 + 0.2
					and candidate.z2 <= room.z2 - 0.2
					and not hits(candidate, wallRects, 0.3)
					and not hits(candidate, zones, 0)
					and not onPath(candidate)
				if fits then
					for j, other in rects do
						if j ~= i and MapLayout.rectsOverlap(candidate, other, 1.2) then
							fits = false
							break
						end
					end
				end
				if fits then
					spot.x += dx
					spot.z += dz
					moved = candidate
					break
				end
			end
			if moved then
				rects[i] = moved
				break
			end
		end
	end
	-- A small box still wedged in a corner can never be pulled out (nobody
	-- can pull): leave it out rather than have it stuck there all round.
	local keepList: { FurnitureSpot } = {}
	for i, spot in layout.furniture do
		local here = rects[i]
		if here and LOOSE[spot.kind] and #wallSides(here) >= 2 then
			rects[i] = nil
			continue
		end
		table.insert(keepList, spot)
	end
	layout.furniture = keepList
	table.clear(placed)
	for _, r in rects do
		table.insert(placed, r)
	end

	for _, room in layout.rooms do
		local yard = room.house == ""
		local r = room.rect
		local inner = MapLayout.roomInterior(room)
		local w, d = inner.x2 - inner.x1, inner.z2 - inner.z1
		if w < 9 or d < 9 then
			continue
		end
		local walls: { Rect } = {}
		for _, piece in pieces do
			if MapLayout.rectsOverlap(piece.rect, r, 1) then
				table.insert(walls, piece.rect)
			end
		end
		-- Keep a way in: from each doorway (and secret wall) to the room's
		-- item spot or middle, in through the door and then across.
		local tx, tz = (inner.x1 + inner.x2) / 2, (inner.z1 + inner.z2) / 2
		for _, p in layout.itemSpots do
			if MapLayout.inRect(inner, p.x, p.z) then
				tx, tz = p.x, p.z
			end
		end
		local keep: { Rect } = { around(tx, tz, 4) }
		local L = CLUTTER_LANE
		if string.find(string.lower(room.name), "hall") then
			local cx, cz = (inner.x1 + inner.x2) / 2, (inner.z1 + inner.z2) / 2
			table.insert(
				keep,
				if w >= d
					then rect(inner.x1, cz - L, inner.x2, cz + L)
					else rect(cx - L, inner.z1, cx + L, inner.z2)
			)
		end
		for _, wall in layout.walls do
			for _, list in { wall.gaps, wall.secrets } do
				for _, g in list do
					local mid = (g[1] + g[2]) / 2
					local dx, dz, alongX
					if
						wall.horizontal
						and mid > r.x1
						and mid < r.x2
						and (math.abs(wall.z1 - r.z1) < 0.01 or math.abs(wall.z1 - r.z2) < 0.01)
					then
						dx, dz, alongX = mid, wall.z1, false
					elseif
						not wall.horizontal
						and mid > r.z1
						and mid < r.z2
						and (math.abs(wall.x1 - r.x1) < 0.01 or math.abs(wall.x1 - r.x2) < 0.01)
					then
						dx, dz, alongX = wall.x1, mid, true
					end
					if dx then
						local bx, bz = if alongX then tx else dx, if alongX then dz else tz
						table.insert(
							keep,
							rect(
								math.min(dx, bx) - L,
								math.min(dz, bz) - L,
								math.max(dx, bx) + L,
								math.max(dz, bz) + L
							)
						)
						table.insert(
							keep,
							rect(
								math.min(bx, tx) - L,
								math.min(bz, tz) - L,
								math.max(bx, tx) + L,
								math.max(bz, tz) + L
							)
						)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local count = if yard
			then math.clamp(math.floor(w * d / 200), 1, 10)
			else math.clamp(math.floor(w * d / 90), 1, 8)
		for i = 1, count do
			local list = if yard
				then CLUTTER_YARD[layout.theme] or CLUTTER_YARD.Other
				elseif i <= 2 and w * d >= 360 then CLUTTER_BIG
				else CLUTTER_SMALL
			local kind = list[math.floor(random() * #list) + 1]
			for _ = 1, 60 do
				local rot = if random() < 0.5 then 0 else 90
				local fw, fd = FurnitureSpecs.footprint(kind, rot)
				if fw + 1 > w or fd + 1 > d then
					continue
				end
				local x = inner.x1 + fw / 2 + 0.4 + random() * (w - fw - 0.8)
				local z = inner.z1 + fd / 2 + 0.4 + random() * (d - fd - 0.8)
				x, z = math.floor(x * 4 + 0.5) / 4, math.floor(z * 4 + 0.5) / 4
				local box = spotRect(kind, x, z, rot)
				if
					box.x1 < inner.x1 + 0.2
					or box.x2 > inner.x2 - 0.2
					or box.z1 < inner.z1 + 0.2
					or box.z2 > inner.z2 - 0.2
				then
					continue
				end
				if
					hits(box, placed, CLUTTER_GAP)
					or hits(box, zones, 0)
					or hits(box, keep, 0)
					or hits(box, walls, 2) -- off the walls, so you can get behind it
					or onPath(box)
				then
					continue
				end
				table.insert(placed, box)
				table.insert(
					layout.furniture,
					{ kind = kind, x = x, z = z, rot = rot, house = houseAt(x, z) }
				)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

local unprepared: { [Layout]: number } = {} -- built-in layout -> its clutter seed
for i, name in MapLayout.names do
	local seed = 7919 * i
	for c = 1, #name do
		seed = (seed * 31 + string.byte(name, c)) % 1000003
	end
	unprepared[MapLayout.maps[name]] = seed
end
prepare = function(layout: Layout): Layout
	local seed = unprepared[layout]
	if seed then
		unprepared[layout] = nil
		clutter(layout, seed)
	end
	return layout
end

return MapLayout

scripts.name: MapMarks
scripts.source:
--!strict
-- Maps you build in Roblox Studio, as plain data. Every part in a map folder
-- is a "mark": its name says what it is (Wall, Door, Floor, HumanSpawn,
-- Couch...) and its footprint seen from above says where. toLayout turns
-- marks into a Layout (what the built-in maps are made of), fromLayout does
-- the reverse so a built-in map can be copied into Studio and edited.
-- Reading and making the actual parts is the server's MapStudio; README
-- "Making your own maps" explains it all for map makers.

local FurnitureSpecs = require(script.Parent.FurnitureSpecs)
local MapLayout = require(script.Parent.MapLayout)

type Layout = MapLayout.Layout
type Rect = MapLayout.Rect
type Range = MapLayout.Range
type Point = MapLayout.Point

local MapMarks = {}

export type Mark = {
	kind: string,
	x: number, -- center of the footprint
	z: number,
	w: number, -- footprint size along X
	d: number, -- footprint size along Z
	rot: number, -- furniture: degrees turned about the vertical
	id: string?, -- House: its name; Floor: the room's name
	floor: string?, -- Floor: Brick, Tile, Wood, Concrete or Dirt
	outline: string?, -- House: Blue or Orange wall trim
	color: string?, -- Bush: Green, Orange or Cobweb; House: its wall color (hex)
}

-- Every kind of mark besides furniture (any furniture name is a mark too).
MapMarks.KINDS = {
	{ kind = "Bounds", about = "The play area. A brick wall goes around it. One per map." },
	{
		kind = "House",
		about = "A house's outline: walls inside get its trim color (Outline: Blue or Orange).",
	},
	{ kind = "Wall", about = "A wall. Long and thin; it is always rebuilt 3 studs thick." },
	{ kind = "Door", about = "Put it on a wall to cut a doorway as wide as the part." },
	{ kind = "Window", about = "Put it on a wall: that stretch becomes a (breakable) window." },
	{
		kind = "SecretWall",
		about = "Put it on a wall: that stretch looks solid but anyone walks through (bots don't know).",
	},
	{ kind = "Floor", about = "A room's floor (Floor attribute: Brick, Tile, Wood, Concrete or Dirt)." },
	{ kind = "HumanSpawn", about = "Where humans appear after the first spawn." },
	{ kind = "ZombieSpawn", about = "Where zombies appear (a red pit)." },
	{ kind = "Start", about = "Where everyone starts the round, together." },
	{ kind = "ItemSpot", about = "Where an item can lie on the ground." },
	{ kind = "WizardSpot", about = "Where the wizard can show up." },
	{ kind = "Bush", about = "A bush to hide in (Color attribute: Green, Orange or Cobweb for indoors)." },
	{ kind = "Road", about = "Asphalt." },
	{ kind = "Sidewalk", about = "Pale pavement." },
	{ kind = "CenterLine", about = "Yellow road line." },
	{ kind = "EdgeLine", about = "White road line." },
	{ kind = "Path", about = "A dirt path." },
	{ kind = "Patio", about = "Stone paving." },
	{ kind = "Pool", about = "A swimming pool." },
	{ kind = "IslandWalk", about = "A raised pavement island." },
	{ kind = "IslandGrass", about = "Grass on top of an island." },
}

local KNOWN: { [string]: boolean } = {}
for _, entry in MapMarks.KINDS do
	KNOWN[entry.kind] = true
end

MapMarks.FLOORS = { "Brick", "Tile", "Wood", "Concrete", "Dirt" }

local T = MapLayout.WALL_THICKNESS

-- True for any name the game turns into map data (marks and furniture).
function MapMarks.isKind(name: string): boolean
	return KNOWN[name] == true or MapMarks.isFurniture(name)
end

function MapMarks.isFurniture(name: string): boolean
	return FurnitureSpecs.specs[name] ~= nil
end

local function rectOf(m: Mark): Rect
	return { x1 = m.x - m.w / 2, z1 = m.z - m.d / 2, x2 = m.x + m.w / 2, z2 = m.z + m.d / 2 }
end

local function pointOf(m: Mark): Point
	return { x = m.x, z = m.z }
end

local function merged(ranges: { Range }): { Range }
	table.sort(ranges, function(a, b)
		return a[1] < b[1]
	end)
	local out: { Range } = {}
	for _, r in ranges do
		local last = out[#out]
		if last and r[1] <= last[2] then
			last[2] = math.max(last[2], r[2])
		else
			table.insert(out, { r[1], r[2] })
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- Marks -> a layout. Errors make the map unplayable (it is skipped);
-- warnings are worth fixing but the map still loads.
function MapMarks.toLayout(name: string, title: string, marks: { Mark }): (Layout, { string }, { string })
	local errors: { string } = {}
	local warnings: { string } = {}
	local layout = MapLayout.blank(name, title)
	local function where(m: Mark): string
		return string.format("%s at (%.0f, %.0f)", m.kind, m.x, m.z)
	end

	local byKind: { [string]: { Mark } } = {}
	for _, m in marks do
		if not MapMarks.isKind(m.kind) then
			table.insert(warnings, "Unknown kind " .. m.kind .. " (left out)")
			continue
		end
		local list = byKind[m.kind] or {}
		byKind[m.kind] = list
		table.insert(list, m)
	end
	local function all(kind: string): { Mark }
		return byKind[kind] or {}
	end

	local bounds = all("Bounds")
	if #bounds == 0 then
		table.insert(errors, "No Bounds part: add one under the whole play area")
	else
		layout.bounds = rectOf(bounds[1])
		if #bounds > 1 then
			table.insert(warnings, "More than one Bounds part: using the first")
		end
	end

	-- Houses: walls, rooms and furniture inside one belong to it.
	for i, m in all("House") do
		table.insert(layout.houses, {
			id = m.id or ("House" .. i),
			rect = rectOf(m),
			outline = if m.outline == "Orange" then "Orange" else "Blue",
			size = "Large",
			wall = m.color,
		})
	end
	local function houseAt(x: number, z: number, margin: number): string
		local best, bestArea = "", math.huge
		for _, house in layout.houses do
			if MapLayout.inRect(house.rect, x, z, margin) then
				local area = (house.rect.x2 - house.rect.x1) * (house.rect.z2 - house.rect.z1)
				if area < bestArea then
					best, bestArea = house.id, area
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	-- Walls, by their centerline (the part's thickness doesn't matter).
	for _, m in all("Wall") do
		local horizontal = m.w >= m.d
		local length = math.max(0, (if horizontal then m.w else m.d) - T)
		local a = (if horizontal then m.x else m.z) - length / 2
		table.insert(layout.walls, {
			x1 = if horizontal then a else m.x,
			z1 = if horizontal then m.z else a,
			x2 = if horizontal then a + length else m.x,
			z2 = if horizontal then m.z else a + length,
			horizontal = horizontal,
			gaps = {},
			windows = {},
			secrets = {},
			house = houseAt(m.x, m.z, T),
		})
	end

	-- Doors, windows and secret walls cut into the wall they sit on.
	local function cut(m: Mark, into: string)
		local best: MapLayout.Wall? = nil
		local bestScore = math.huge
		local long = m.w >= m.d
		for _, w in layout.walls do
			local along = if w.horizontal then m.x else m.z
			local off = math.abs(if w.horizontal then m.z - w.z1 else m.x - w.x1)
			local a = (if w.horizontal then w.x1 else w.z1) - T / 2
			local b = (if w.horizontal then w.x2 else w.z2) + T / 2
			if off <= T and along >= a - 0.01 and along <= b + 0.01 then
				-- Prefer the wall the part lies along (a doorway near a corner).
				local score = off + (if long ~= w.horizontal and math.abs(m.w - m.d) > 0.5 then 2 else 0)
				if score < bestScore then
					best, bestScore = w, score
				end
			end
		end
		if not best then
			table.insert(warnings, where(m) .. " isn't on a wall (left out)")
			return
		end
		local half = (if best.horizontal then m.w else m.d) / 2
		local along = if best.horizontal then m.x else m.z
		local list = if into == "Door"
			then best.gaps
			elseif into == "Window" then best.windows
			else best.secrets
		table.insert(list, { along - half, along + half })
	end
	for _, kind in { "Door", "Window", "SecretWall" } do
		for _, m in all(kind) do
			cut(m, kind)
		end
	end
	for _, w in layout.walls do
		w.gaps = merged(w.gaps)
		w.windows = merged(w.windows)
		w.secrets = merged(w.secrets)
	end

	for i, m in all("Floor") do
		local floor = if m.floor and table.find(MapMarks.FLOORS, m.floor) then m.floor else "Wood"
		-- Dirt floors are yards (a graveyard, a corn maze): no house, no roof.
		table.insert(layout.rooms, {
			name = m.id or ("Room" .. i),
			floor = floor :: string,
			rect = rectOf(m),
			house = if floor == "Dirt" then "" else houseAt(m.x, m.z, 0),
		})
	end

	for _, m in marks do
		if MapMarks.isFurniture(m.kind) then
			table.insert(layout.furniture, {
				kind = m.kind,
				x = m.x,
				z = m.z,
				rot = math.round(m.rot) % 360,
				house = houseAt(m.x, m.z, 0),
			})
		end
	end

	for _, m in all("HumanSpawn") do
		table.insert(layout.humanSpawns, pointOf(m))
	end
	for _, m in all("ZombieSpawn") do
		table.insert(layout.zombieSpawns, pointOf(m))
	end
	for _, m in all("ItemSpot") do
		table.insert(layout.itemSpots, pointOf(m))
	end
	for _, m in all("WizardSpot") do
		table.insert(layout.wizardSpots, pointOf(m))
	end
	if #layout.humanSpawns == 0 then
		table.insert(errors, "No HumanSpawn: add at least one")
	end
	if #layout.zombieSpawns == 0 then
		table.insert(errors, "No ZombieSpawn: add at least one")
	end
	if #layout.itemSpots == 0 then
		layout.itemSpots = table.clone(layout.humanSpawns)
		table.insert(warnings, "No ItemSpot: items will lie at the human spawns")
	end
	if #layout.wizardSpots == 0 then
		layout.wizardSpots = table.clone(layout.humanSpawns)
		table.insert(warnings, "No WizardSpot: the wizard will show up at the human spawns")
	end
	local start = all("Start")[1]
	layout.start = if start then pointOf(start) else (layout.humanSpawns[1] or { x = 0, z = 0 })

	for _, m in all("Bush") do
		table.insert(layout.bushes, {
			x = m.x,
			z = m.z,
			r = math.max(m.w, m.d) / 2,
			color = if m.color == "Orange" or m.color == "Cobweb" then m.color :: string else "Green",
		})
	end

	local road = layout.road
	for kind, list in
		{
			Road = road.asphalt,
			Sidewalk = road.sidewalks,
			CenterLine = road.centerLines,
			EdgeLine = road.edgeLines,
			Path = layout.paths,
			Patio = layout.patios,
			Pool = layout.pools,
		} :: { [string]: { Rect } }
	do
		for _, m in all(kind) do
			table.insert(list, rectOf(m))
		end
	end

	-- Islands: each walk with the grass on it (or a grass edge of its own).
	local grasses = all("IslandGrass")
	local used: { [Mark]: boolean } = {}
	for _, m in all("IslandWalk") do
		local walk = rectOf(m)
		local grass: Rect? = nil
		for _, g in grasses do
			if not used[g] and MapLayout.inRect(walk, g.x, g.z) then
				used[g] = true
				grass = rectOf(g)
				break
			end
		end
		table.insert(layout.islands, {
			walk = walk,
			grass = grass or { x1 = walk.x1 + 3, z1 = walk.z1 + 3, x2 = walk.x2 - 3, z2 = walk.z2 - 3 },
		})
	end
	for _, g in grasses do
		if not used[g] then
			table.insert(layout.islands, { walk = rectOf(g), grass = rectOf(g) })
		end
	end

	-- Things that would never be reached.
	local b = layout.bounds
	for _, kind in { "HumanSpawn", "ZombieSpawn", "Start", "ItemSpot", "WizardSpot" } do
		for _, m in all(kind) do
			if #bounds > 0 and not MapLayout.inRect(b, m.x, m.z) then
				table.insert(warnings, where(m) .. " is outside the Bounds")
			end
		end
	end
	return layout, errors, warnings
end

-- A layout -> marks (to copy a built-in map into Studio).
function MapMarks.fromLayout(layout: Layout): { Mark }
	local marks: { Mark } = {}
	local function add(kind: string, r: Rect): Mark
		local m: Mark = {
			kind = kind,
			x = (r.x1 + r.x2) / 2,
			z = (r.z1 + r.z2) / 2,
			w = r.x2 - r.x1,
			d = r.z2 - r.z1,
			rot = 0,
		}
		table.insert(marks, m)
		return m
	end
	local function addPoint(kind: string, p: Point)
		add(kind, { x1 = p.x - 2, z1 = p.z - 2, x2 = p.x + 2, z2 = p.z + 2 })
	end

	add("Bounds", layout.bounds)
	for _, house in layout.houses do
		local m = add("House", house.rect)
		m.id, m.outline, m.color = house.id, house.outline, house.wall
	end
	for _, room in layout.rooms do
		local m = add("Floor", room.rect)
		m.id, m.floor = room.name, room.floor
	end
	local h = T / 2
	for _, w in layout.walls do
		local function span(a: number, b: number): Rect
			return if w.horizontal
				then { x1 = a, z1 = w.z1 - h, x2 = b, z2 = w.z1 + h }
				else { x1 = w.x1 - h, z1 = a, x2 = w.x1 + h, z2 = b }
		end
		add(
			"Wall",
			span((if w.horizontal then w.x1 else w.z1) - h, (if w.horizontal then w.x2 else w.z2) + h)
		)
		for _, gap in w.gaps do
			add("Door", span(gap[1], gap[2]))
		end
		for _, window in w.windows do
			add("Window", span(window[1], window[2]))
		end
		for _, secret in w.secrets do
			add("SecretWall", span(secret[1], secret[2]))
		end
	end
	for _, spot in layout.furniture do
		local spec = FurnitureSpecs.get(spot.kind)
		local m = add(spot.kind, {
			x1 = spot.x - spec.w / 2,
			z1 = spot.z - spec.d / 2,
			x2 = spot.x + spec.w / 2,
			z2 = spot.z + spec.d / 2,
		})
		m.rot = spot.rot
	end
	for kind, list in
		{
			HumanSpawn = layout.humanSpawns,
			ZombieSpawn = layout.zombieSpawns,
			ItemSpot = layout.itemSpots,
			WizardSpot = layout.wizardSpots,
		} :: { [string]: { Point } }
	do
		for _, p in list do
			addPoint(kind, p)
		end
	end
	addPoint("Start", layout.start)
	for _, bush in layout.bushes do
		local m = add(
			"Bush",
			{ x1 = bush.x - bush.r, z1 = bush.z - bush.r, x2 = bush.x + bush.r, z2 = bush.z + bush.r }
		)
		m.color = bush.color
	end
	local road = layout.road
	for kind, list in
		{
			Road = road.asphalt,
			Sidewalk = road.sidewalks,
			CenterLine = road.centerLines,
			EdgeLine = road.edgeLines,
			Path = layout.paths,
			Patio = layout.patios,
			Pool = layout.pools,
		} :: { [string]: { Rect } }
	do
		for _, r in list do
			add(kind, r)
		end
	end
	for _, island in layout.islands do
		add("IslandWalk", island.walk)
		add("IslandGrass", island.grass)
	end
	return marks
end

-- A map to start from (320 x 300, about the size of the built-in maps): a
-- road, a house with two rooms, a cabin, a shed, spawns, items, bushes.
function MapMarks.starter(): { Mark }
	local marks: { Mark } = {}
	local function add(kind: string, x1: number, z1: number, x2: number, z2: number): Mark
		local m: Mark = {
			kind = kind,
			x = (x1 + x2) / 2,
			z = (z1 + z2) / 2,
			w = math.abs(x2 - x1),
			d = math.abs(z2 - z1),
			rot = 0,
		}
		table.insert(marks, m)
		return m
	end
	local function point(kind: string, x: number, z: number)
		add(kind, x - 2, z - 2, x + 2, z + 2)
	end
	local function piece(kind: string, x: number, z: number, rot: number?)
		local spec = FurnitureSpecs.get(kind)
		add(kind, x - spec.w / 2, z - spec.d / 2, x + spec.w / 2, z + spec.d / 2).rot = rot or 0
	end
	local function wallH(z: number, x1: number, x2: number)
		add("Wall", x1 - 1.5, z - 1.5, x2 + 1.5, z + 1.5)
	end
	local function wallV(x: number, z1: number, z2: number)
		add("Wall", x - 1.5, z1 - 1.5, x + 1.5, z2 + 1.5)
	end

	add("Bounds", -160, -150, 160, 150)
	add("Sidewalk", -160, 102, 160, 112)
	add("Road", -160, 112, 160, 140)
	add("CenterLine", -160, 125.5, 160, 126.5)
	add("Sidewalk", -160, 140, 160, 150)

	-- The house: living room (left) and kitchen (right), front door on the
	-- road side, a back door, windows.
	local house = add("House", -60, -40, 20, 20)
	house.id, house.outline = "House", "Blue"
	local living = add("Floor", -60, -40, -10, 20)
	living.id, living.floor = "Living room", "Wood"
	local kitchen = add("Floor", -10, -40, 20, 20)
	kitchen.id, kitchen.floor = "Kitchen", "Tile"
	wallH(-40, -60, 20)
	wallH(20, -60, 20)
	wallV(-60, -40, 20)
	wallV(20, -40, 20)
	wallV(-10, -40, 20)
	add("Door", -40, 18.5, -32, 21.5) -- front door
	add("Door", -11.5, -15, -8.5, -7) -- between the rooms
	add("Door", 18.5, -30, 21.5, -22) -- back door
	add("Window", -56, -41.5, -44, -38.5)
	add("Window", -2, 18.5, 12, 21.5)
	piece("Couch", -48, 8)
	piece("CoffeeTable", -48, -2)
	piece("Bookshelf", -40, -36)
	piece("Plant", -56, -36)
	piece("Fridge", 15, -36)
	piece("Stove", 6, -36)
	piece("Sink", -3, -36)
	piece("Table", 4, 0)
	piece("Chair", -2, 0, 90)
	piece("Chair", 10, 0, 270)

	-- A shed in the yard.
	local shed = add("House", 50, -60, 90, -30)
	shed.id, shed.outline = "Shed", "Orange"
	local shedFloor = add("Floor", 50, -60, 90, -30)
	shedFloor.id, shedFloor.floor = "Shed", "Concrete"
	wallH(-60, 50, 90)
	wallH(-30, 50, 90)
	wallV(50, -60, -30)
	wallV(90, -60, -30)
	add("Door", 64, -31.5, 72, -28.5)
	piece("Box", 58, -52)
	piece("Box", 82, -52, 90)

	-- A one-room cabin with a front and a back door.
	local cabin = add("House", 70, 10, 120, 50)
	cabin.id, cabin.outline = "Cabin", "Orange"
	local cabinFloor = add("Floor", 70, 10, 120, 50)
	cabinFloor.id, cabinFloor.floor = "Cabin", "Wood"
	wallH(10, 70, 120)
	wallH(50, 70, 120)
	wallV(70, 10, 50)
	wallV(120, 10, 50)
	add("Door", 90, 48.5, 98, 51.5) -- front door
	add("Door", 68.5, 20, 71.5, 27) -- back door
	add("Window", 80, 8.5, 92, 11.5)
	add("Window", 118.5, 22, 121.5, 38)
	piece("Bed", 112, 18)
	piece("Dresser", 100, 13.2)
	piece("Armchair", 78, 42)
	piece("Lamp", 74, 14)
	piece("Bookshelf", 117.3, 40, 270)
	piece("Box", 84, 14)

	for _, p in
		{
			{ -130, 60 },
			{ -60, 60 },
			{ 0, 75 },
			{ 50, 80 },
			{ 135, 75 },
			{ 135, -80 },
			{ -130, -100 },
			{ 0, -110 },
			{ -110, -40 },
		}
	do
		point("HumanSpawn", p[1], p[2])
	end
	point("ZombieSpawn", 140, 126)
	point("Start", -20, 55)
	for _, p in { { -45, -20 }, { 5, -25 }, { 70, -45 }, { 95, 30 } } do
		point("ItemSpot", p[1], p[2])
	end
	point("WizardSpot", -140, -130)
	point("WizardSpot", 100, 90)
	local function bush(x: number, z: number, r: number, color: string)
		add("Bush", x - r, z - r, x + r, z + r).color = color
	end
	bush(-140, -20, 5, "Green")
	bush(145, -130, 4, "Green")
	bush(-20, -120, 5, "Orange")
	bush(145, 0, 4, "Orange")
	bush(-140, 90, 4, "Green")
	return marks
end

return MapMarks

-- Color schemes and lighting for maps. A layout names its theme (Classic if
-- none); MapBuilder paints the ground, floors, walls and bushes with the
-- theme's colors and sets the lighting. On a dark theme your own client
-- hangs a lantern on you (DarknessController): you only see what's near you,
-- other people's name tags show only up close, and bots can't see far either.
-- Maps built in Studio pick one with the folder attribute Theme.

local MapLayout = require(script.Parent.MapLayout)

local MapThemes = {}

export type Lighting = {
	ambient: string,
	outdoor: string,
	brightness: number,
	clock: number,
	tint: string?, -- ColorCorrection tint
	saturation: number?,
	contrast: number?,
}

export type Lantern = { range: number, brightness: number, color: string }

export type Theme = {
	name: string,
	about: string,
	colors: { [string]: string }, -- overrides of MapLayout.COLORS
	lighting: Lighting,
	dark: boolean?,
	sight: number?, -- dark themes: how far you (and bots) can see others, studs
	lantern: Lantern?,
}

-- green, foggy swamp forest.

	for key, value in colors do

function MapThemes.get(name: string?): Theme
	return THEMES[name or "Classic"] or THEMES.Classic
end

function MapThemes.exists(name: string): boolean
	return THEMES[name] ~= nil
end

-- MapLayout.COLORS with the theme's colors laid over it.
function MapThemes.palette(name: string?): typeof(MapLayout.COLORS)
	local out = table.clone(MapLayout.COLORS) :: any
	for key, value in MapThemes.get(name).colors do
		out[key] = value
	end
	return out
end

return MapThemes

scripts.name: Parts
scripts.source:
-- Part factory with Brain Tag's flat cartoon defaults: SmoothPlastic, no
-- shadows, smooth surfaces, anchored unless told otherwise.

export type PartProps = {
	name: string?,
	size: Vector3,
	cframe: CFrame,
	color: string | Color3,
	shape: Enum.PartType?,
	material: Enum.Material?,
	anchored: boolean?,
	canCollide: boolean?,
	canQuery: boolean?,
	transparency: number?,
	parent: Instance?,
}

local Parts = {}

local UPRIGHT = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)) -- cylinder axis X -> Y
local ALONG_Z = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0) -- cylinder axis X -> Z

Parts.UPRIGHT = UPRIGHT
Parts.ALONG_Z = ALONG_Z

local function toColor(c: string | Color3): Color3
	if typeof(c) == "Color3" then
		return c
	end
	return Color3.fromHex(c :: string)
end

function Parts.make(props: PartProps): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = props.name or "Part"
	part.Shape = props.shape or Enum.PartType.Block
	part.Size = props.size
	part.CFrame = props.cframe
	part.Color = toColor(props.color)
	part.Material = props.material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Anchored = props.anchored ~= false
	part.CanCollide = props.canCollide ~= false
	part.CanQuery = props.canQuery ~= false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.Transparency = props.transparency or 0
	if props.parent then
		part.Parent = props.parent
	end
	return part
end

-- An upright cylinder, which reads as a circle from the top-down camera.
-- `center` is the middle of the cylinder.
function Parts.disc(
	name: string,
	center: Vector3,
	diameter: number,
	height: number,
	color: string | Color3,
	parent: Instance?
): Part
	return Parts.make({
		name = name,
		shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
		size = Vector3.new(height, diameter, diameter),
		cframe = CFrame.new(center) * UPRIGHT,
		color = color,
		parent = parent,
	})
end

-- A flat slab covering a map rectangle, with its top surface at `topY`.
function Parts.slab(
	name: string,
	x1: number,
	z1: number,
	x2: number,
	z2: number,
	topY: number,
	thickness: number,
	color: string | Color3,
	parent: Instance?
): Part
	return Parts.make({
		name = name,
		size = Vector3.new(x2 - x1, thickness, z2 - z1),
		cframe = CFrame.new((x1 + x2) / 2, topY - thickness / 2, (z1 + z2) / 2),
		color = color,
		parent = parent,
	})
end

-- Turns a part into a weightless, non-colliding decoration of an assembly.
function Parts.makeVisual(part: BasePart)
	part.Anchored = false
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.Massless = true
end

-- Welds `part` to `base` at its current relative placement.
function Parts.weldInPlace(base: BasePart, part: BasePart): Weld
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name = "Weld"
	weld.Part0 = base
	weld.Part1 = part
	weld.C0 = base.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
	weld.Parent = part
	return weld
end

return Parts

scripts.name: Remotes
scripts.source:
-- Every RemoteEvent and RemoteFunction the game uses. The server creates them
-- at startup; clients wait for them.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local EVENTS = {
	-- client -> server
	"UseItem", -- (action: "start" | "stop", aim: Vector3)
	"PickUp",
	"DropItem",
	"SelectSlot", -- (slot: number) which inventory slot is in your hand
	"ZombieReturn",
	"TutorialDone",
	"Grab", -- (model: Model, on: boolean) holding a piece of furniture
	-- server -> client
	"Knockback", -- (velocity: Vector3, seconds: number)
	"Announce", -- (text, hexColor?)
	"Fx", -- (kind, data)
	"Toast", -- (text, hexColor?)
}

-- Unreliable: frequent, small, fine to lose one now and then.
local UNRELIABLE = {
	"PushClaim", -- client -> server: { Model } of furniture it is pushing
	"Aim", -- client -> server: flat aim direction, about 10 times a second
}

local FUNCTIONS = {
	"BuyItem", -- (itemId, fromWizard) -> (ok, message)
	"BuySkin", -- (skinId) -> (status, message)
	"Admin", -- (action, data) -> (ok, message); admins only, see AdminService
}

local Remotes = {}

local folder: Instance
if RunService:IsServer() then
	local existing = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	folder = existing or Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Remotes"
	for _, name in EVENTS do
		if not folder:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
			remote.Name = name
			remote.Parent = folder
		end
	end
	for _, name in UNRELIABLE do
		if not folder:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local remote = Instance.new("UnreliableRemoteEvent")
			remote.Name = name
			remote.Parent = folder
		end
	end
	for _, name in FUNCTIONS do
		if not folder:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local remote = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
			remote.Name = name
			remote.Parent = folder
		end
	end
	folder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
else
	folder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
end

function Remotes.event(name: string): RemoteEvent
	return folder:WaitForChild(name) :: RemoteEvent
end

function Remotes.unreliable(name: string): UnreliableRemoteEvent
	return folder:WaitForChild(name) :: UnreliableRemoteEvent
end

function Remotes.func(name: string): RemoteFunction
	return folder:WaitForChild(name) :: RemoteFunction
end

return Remotes

scripts.name: Roofs
scripts.source:
-- Roofs over the rooms of roofed maps (the haunted house). Shared so bots
-- (server) and your screen (client) agree on who can see whom: from outside
-- a room you can't see in, and from inside a room you see only that room.

local Roofs = {}

local cachedFolder: Instance? = nil
local cached: { BasePart } = {}
local dirty = true

-- Every roof on the current map (none on most maps).
function Roofs.all(): { BasePart }
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local folder = map and map:FindFirstChild("Roofs")
	if folder ~= cachedFolder then
		cachedFolder = folder
		dirty = true
		if folder then
			folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
				dirty = true
			end)
		end
	end
	if dirty then
		dirty = false
		cached = {}
		if folder then
			for _, part in folder:GetChildren() do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name == "Roof" then -- not the door panels
					table.insert(cached, part)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return cached
end

-- The roof over a point, if it's inside a room.
function Roofs.over(position: Vector3): BasePart?
	for _, roof in Roofs.all() do
		local offset = position - roof.Position
		if math.abs(offset.X) <= roof.Size.X / 2 and math.abs(offset.Z) <= roof.Size.Z / 2 then
			return roof
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Can someone at `from` see someone at `to`? Yes when both stand under the
-- same roof (or both outdoors), or they're right next to each other.
function Roofs.canSee(from: Vector3, to: Vector3): boolean
	if #Roofs.all() == 0 then
		return true
	end
	local offset = to - from
	if Vector3.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Z).Magnitude <= 5 then
		return true
	end
	return Roofs.over(from) == Roofs.over(to)
end

return Roofs

scripts.name: RoundRules
scripts.source:
--!strict
-- Pure round rules: who becomes a zombie, who won, and how much score a reward
-- is worth. No Roblox APIs, so tests/ can run this outside Studio.

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local RoundRules = {}

-- How many first zombies to pick from `count` humans. Always leaves at least
-- one human so a round can't start already lost.
function RoundRules.firstZombieCount(count: number): number
	if count < 2 then
		return 0
	end
	local wanted = math.max(1, math.floor(count * Config.ZOMBIE_RATIO))
	return math.min(wanted, count - 1)
end

-- Weight for being picked as a first zombie. Never zero, so when everyone is
-- immune, pill-takers can still be chosen.
function RoundRules.zombieWeight(immunity: number): number
	local clamped = math.clamp(immunity, 0, Config.IMMUNITY_MAX)
	return 1 - clamped / Config.IMMUNITY_MAX * Config.IMMUNITY_WEIGHT
end

-- Weighted pick of `count` entries without replacement. `random` returns a
-- number in [0, 1).
function RoundRules.weightedPick<T>(
	entries: { T },
	weightOf: (T) -> number,
	count: number,
	random: () -> number
): { T }
	local pool = table.clone(entries)
	local picked = {}
	for _ = 1, math.min(count, #pool) do
		local total = 0
		for _, entry in pool do
			total += math.max(0, weightOf(entry))
		end
		local index = #pool
		if total <= 0 then
			index = math.clamp(math.floor(random() * #pool) + 1, 1, #pool)
		else
			local roll = random() * total
			for i, entry in pool do
				roll -= math.max(0, weightOf(entry))
				if roll < 0 then
					index = i
					break
				end
			end
		end
		table.insert(picked, table.remove(pool, index) :: T)
	end
	return picked
end

export type Winner = "Survivors" | "Zombies"

-- "Zombies" when no humans remain, "Survivors" when the timer ran out with any
-- human standing, otherwise nil (round continues).
function RoundRules.outcome(humans: number, secondsLeft: number): Winner?
	if humans <= 0 then
		return "Zombies"
	end
	if secondsLeft <= 0 then
		return "Survivors"
	end
	return nil
end

export type RewardBonuses = {
	drumstick: number?, -- 0.4 or 0.8 while holding one
	vip: boolean?,
	doubleScore: boolean?,
	boosted: boolean?,
}

-- Bonuses add together: a VIP holding a drumstick earns 1 + 0.4 + 0.2 = 1.6x.
function RoundRules.rewardMultiplier(bonuses: RewardBonuses): number
	local m = 1 + (bonuses.drumstick or 0)
	local money = Config.MONETIZATION
	if bonuses.vip then
		m += money.VIP_SCORE_BONUS
	end
	if bonuses.doubleScore then
		m += money.DOUBLE_SCORE_BONUS
	end
	if bonuses.boosted then
		m += money.BOOST_SCORE_BONUS
	end
	return m
end

function RoundRules.reward(base: number, bonuses: RewardBonuses): number
	return math.floor(base * RoundRules.rewardMultiplier(bonuses) + 0.5)
end

function RoundRules.scaleForScore(score: number): number
	return Config.SIZE_MULTIPLIER(score)
end

-- Pushing strength of one player: grows with the square of their size, and
-- zombies are stronger (Config.ZOMBIE_STRENGTH).
function RoundRules.pushStrength(scale: number, zombie: boolean?): number
	return scale * scale * (if zombie then Config.ZOMBIE_STRENGTH else 1)
end

-- Fraction of walk speed a piece of `mass` moves at under `strength` (the
-- summed strength of everyone pushing it). 0 means it won't budge.
function RoundRules.pushFraction(mass: number, strength: number): number
	if strength <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	return math.clamp(1 - mass / strength, 0, Config.PUSH_MAX_FRACTION)
end

function RoundRules.walkSpeed(score: number, isZombie: boolean): number
	local speed = Config.BASE_WALKSPEED * Config.SPEED_MULTIPLIER(score)
	if isZombie then
		speed *= Config.ZOMBIE_SPEED_FACTOR
	end
	return speed
end

return RoundRules

scripts.name: Util
scripts.source:
-- Small helpers shared by server and client.

local Util = {}

function Util.flat(v: Vector3): Vector3
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
end

-- Unit vector on the ground plane, or nil when there is no horizontal part.
function Util.flatUnit(v: Vector3): Vector3?
	local f = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
	local m = f.Magnitude
	-- `m ~= m` catches NaN; huge catches infinity (both can come from exploiters).
	if m ~= m or m == math.huge or m < 1e-4 then
		return nil
	end
	return f.Unit
end

function Util.flatDistance(a: Vector3, b: Vector3): number
	local dx, dz = a.X - b.X, a.Z - b.Z
	return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
end

function Util.color(hex: string): Color3
	return Color3.fromHex(hex)
end

-- 6729 -> "6,729"
function Util.commas(n: number): string
	local s = tostring(math.floor(n))
	local sign = ""
	if string.sub(s, 1, 1) == "-" then
		sign, s = "-", string.sub(s, 2)
	end
	local out = s
	while true do
		local replaced, count = string.gsub(out, "^(%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
		out = replaced
		if count == 0 then
			break
		end
	end
	return sign .. out
end

-- 151 -> "2:31"
function Util.clock(seconds: number): string
	local s = math.max(0, math.ceil(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", s // 60, s % 60)
end

return Util

scripts.name: AdminService
scripts.source:
-- The admin panel's server side. Every request is checked here: only admins
-- (Studio testers, the experience owner, Config.ADMIN_USER_IDS) get through,
-- and every argument is validated before it touches the game.
--
-- Admins can also type chat commands:
--   /map Haunted     next round plays that map (part of a name is enough)
--   /map Haunted now ...and end this round to go there right away
--   /endround        end this round now; the next one starts
--   /maps            list the maps
--   /addbot 5        add 5 Mario Clones (1 if no number)
--   /removebots      remove all Mario Clones (/removebots 2: the last two)
--   /bots            how many bots are playing

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local Announcer = require(script.Parent.Announcer)
local BotService = require(script.Parent.BotService)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local FurnitureService = require(script.Parent.FurnitureService)
local ItemService = require(script.Parent.ItemService)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local RoundManager = require(script.Parent.RoundManager)
local ShopService = require(script.Parent.ShopService)
local Skins = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Skins)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

type Participant = Participants.Participant

local AdminService = {}

local MAX_SPEED_FACTOR = 5
local C = Config.CHARACTER

-- Where to stand someone of `scale` at a spot, feet on the floor (like spawns).
local function standAt(position: Vector3, scale: number): CFrame
	local y = MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor + C.HipHeight + C.RootHeight / 2 * scale + 0.3
	return CFrame.new(position.X, y, position.Z)
end
local MAX_POINTS = 10_000_000

function AdminService.isAdmin(player: Player): boolean
	if RunService:IsStudio() then
		return true
	end
	if table.find(Config.ADMIN_USER_IDS, player.UserId) then
		return true
	end
	if game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.User then
		return player.UserId == game.CreatorId
	end
	local ok, rank = pcall(function()
		return player:GetRankInGroup(game.CreatorId)
	end)
	return ok and rank >= 254
end

-- "*" means everyone; otherwise one participant id.
local function targets(data: { [string]: any }): { Participant }
	local id = data.target
	if id == "*" then
		return Participants.all()
	end
	local p = if typeof(id) == "string" then Participants.get(id) else nil
	return if p then { p } else {}
end

local function number(value: any, low: number, high: number): number?
	if typeof(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value then
		return nil
	end
	return math.clamp(value, low, high)
end

local function names(list: { Participant }): string
	if #list == 1 then
		return list[1].name
	end
	return #list .. " players"
end

type Handler = (admin: Participant, data: { [string]: any }) -> (boolean, string)

local ACTIONS: { [string]: Handler } = {}

-- Items ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function ACTIONS.give(admin, data)
	local item = Items.get(if typeof(data.item) == "string" then data.item else nil)
	if not item then
		return false, "Unknown item"
	end
	if data.ground == true then
		local root = Participants.body(admin)
		if not root then
			return false, "You need a character to drop items"
		end
		ItemService.spawnGround(item.id, root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * 5)
		return true, item.name .. " dropped in front of you"
	end
	local list = targets(data)
	local given = 0
	for _, p in list do
		if p.team == "Human" then
			ItemService.give(p, item.id)
			given += 1
		end
	end
	if given == 0 then
		return false, "Only humans can hold items"
	end
	return true, string.format("Gave %s to %s", item.name, names(list))
end

-- Skins ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function ACTIONS.skin(_admin, data)
	local skin = Skins.get(if typeof(data.skin) == "string" then data.skin else nil)
	if not skin then
		return false, "Unknown skin"
	end
	local list = targets(data)
	for _, p in list do
		ShopService.grantSkin(p, skin.id) -- theirs to keep
		ShopService.equipSkin(p, skin)
	end
	return #list > 0, string.format("%s skin for %s", skin.name, names(list))
end

-- Players -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function ACTIONS.speed(_admin, data)
	local factor = number(data.factor, 0, MAX_SPEED_FACTOR)
	if not factor then
		return false, "Bad speed"
	end
	local list = targets(data)
	for _, p in list do
		p.adminSpeed = factor
		CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	end
	return #list > 0, string.format("Speed x%.2g for %s", factor, names(list))
end

function ACTIONS.points(_admin, data)
	local add = number(data.add, -MAX_POINTS, MAX_POINTS)
	local set = number(data.set, 0, MAX_POINTS)
	if not add and not set then
		return false, "Bad points"
	end
	local list = targets(data)
	for _, p in list do
		Participants.setScore(p, if set then set else p.score + (add or 0))
		CharacterService.refreshSize(p)
		CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	end
	local what = if set then "set to " .. Util.commas(set) else string.format("%+d", add or 0)
	return #list > 0, string.format("Points %s for %s", what, names(list))
end

function ACTIONS.immunity(_admin, data)
	local value = number(data.value, 0, Config.IMMUNITY_MAX)
	if not value then
		return false, "Bad immunity"
	end
	local list = targets(data)
	for _, p in list do
		Participants.setImmunity(p, value)
	end
	return #list > 0, string.format("Immunity %d for %s", value, names(list))
end

function ACTIONS.team(_admin, data)
	local team = data.team
	if team ~= "Human" and team ~= "Zombie" then
		return false, "Bad team"
	end
	local list = targets(data)
	for _, p in list do
		RoundManager.setTeam(p, team)
	end
	return #list > 0, string.format("%s now %s", names(list), if team == "Zombie" then "zombie" else "human")
end

function ACTIONS.bring(admin, data)
	local root = Participants.body(admin)
	if not root then
		return false, "You need a character"
	end
	local list = targets(data)
	for i, p in list do
		if p ~= admin then
			local angle = i / math.max(1, #list) * math.pi * 2
			local offset = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * 6
			CharacterService.place(p, standAt(root.Position + offset * math.max(1, p.scale), p.scale))
		end
	end
	return #list > 0, "Brought " .. names(list)
end

function ACTIONS.goTo(admin, data)
	local list = targets(data)
	local target = list[1]
	local root = target and Participants.body(target)
	if not target or target == admin or not root then
		return false, "Pick one other player"
	end
	CharacterService.place(
		admin,
		standAt(root.Position + Vector3.new(6 * math.max(1, target.scale), 0, 0), admin.scale)
	)
	return true, "Went to " .. target.name
end

function ACTIONS.respawn(_admin, data)
	local list = targets(data)
	for _, p in list do
		RoundManager.respawn(p)
	end
	return #list > 0, "Respawned " .. names(list)
end

-- Round ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function ACTIONS.skip()
	if RoundManager.skipPhase() then
		return true, "Skipped to the next phase"
	end
	return false, "Nothing to skip right now"
end

function ACTIONS.time(_admin, data)
	local seconds = number(data.seconds, -600, 600)
	if not seconds then
		return false, "Bad time"
	end
	if RoundManager.addTime(seconds) then
		return true, string.format("%+d seconds", seconds)
	end
	return false, "No timer to change right now"
end

function ACTIONS.nextMap()
	if RoundManager.queueNextMap() then
		return true, "Next round loads the next map"
	end
	return false, "Only one map is in the rotation"
end

function ACTIONS.map(_admin, data)
	local name = if typeof(data.map) == "string" then data.map else ""
	if not RoundManager.queueMap(name) then
		return false, "No map called " .. name
	end
	if data.now == true and RoundManager.endRound() then
		return true, "Going to " .. name .. " now"
	end
	return true, "Next round plays " .. name
end

function ACTIONS.endRound()
	if RoundManager.endRound() then
		return true, "Round ended: the next one starts now"
	end
	return false, "No round is running"
end

function ACTIONS.resetFurniture()
	FurnitureService.resetAll()
	return true, "Furniture put back"
end

function ACTIONS.clearItems()
	ItemService.clearGround()
	return true, "Ground items removed"
end

-- Bots ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function botSummary(): string
	local bots = 0
	for _, p in Participants.all() do
		if p.isBot then
			bots += 1
		end
	end
	return string.format("%d bots playing (%d Mario Clones)", bots, BotService.cloneCount())
end

function ACTIONS.addBots(_admin, data)
	local count = number(data.count, 1, 20) or 1
	local added = BotService.addClones(count)
	if added == 0 then
		return false, "The server is full (" .. Config.MAX_PARTICIPANTS .. " players and bots)"
	end
	return true,
		string.format("Added %d Mario Clone%s. %s", added, if added == 1 then "" else "s", botSummary())
end

function ACTIONS.removeBots(_admin, data)
	local removed = BotService.removeClones(number(data.count, 1, 40))
	if removed == 0 then
		return false, "No Mario Clones to remove"
	end
	return true,
		string.format("Removed %d Mario Clone%s. %s", removed, if removed == 1 then "" else "s", botSummary())
end

function ACTIONS.removeBot(_admin, data)
	local p = if typeof(data.target) == "string" then Participants.get(data.target) else nil
	if not p or not p.isBot then
		return false, "Pick a bot as the target first"
	end
	local name = p.name
	if not BotService.remove(p.id) then
		return false, "That bot can't be removed"
	end
	return true, "Removed " .. name .. ". " .. botSummary()
end

local function handle(player: Player, action: unknown, data: unknown): (boolean, string)
	if not AdminService.isAdmin(player) then
		return false, "Not an admin"
	end
	local admin = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
	local handler = if typeof(action) == "string" then ACTIONS[action] else nil
	if not admin or not handler then
		return false, "Unknown command"
	end
	local args: { [string]: any } = if typeof(data) == "table" then data :: any else {}
	local ok, success, message = pcall(handler, admin, args)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Admin] " .. tostring(action) .. " failed: " .. tostring(success))
		return false, "That failed (see server output)"
	end
	return success, message
end

-- A map by name, title or the start of either (any case).
local function findMap(text: string): string?
	local wanted = string.lower(text)
	for _, exact in { true, false } do
		for _, name in RoundManager.mapNames() do
			local layout = MapLayout.get(name)
			for _, label in { string.lower(name), string.lower(if layout then layout.title else name) } do
				local plain = string.gsub(label, "^the ", "")
				if
					(exact and (label == wanted or plain == wanted))
					or (
						not exact
						and (string.find(label, wanted, 1, true) or string.find(plain, wanted, 1, true))
					)
				then
					return name
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function chatCommand(alias: string, run: (player: Player, admin: Participant, args: { string }) -> ())
	local command = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
	command.Name = "BrainTag" .. string.sub(alias, 2)
	command.PrimaryAlias = alias
	command.Parent = TextChatService
	command.Triggered:Connect(function(source: TextSource, text: string)
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(source.UserId)
		local admin = player and Participants.fromPlayer(player)
		if not player or not admin or not AdminService.isAdmin(player) then
			return
		end
		local words = string.split(text, " ")
		table.remove(words, 1)
		local args = {}
		for _, word in words do
			if word ~= "" then
				table.insert(args, word)
			end
		end
		run(player, admin, args)
	end)
end

local function setupChatCommands()
	chatCommand("/maps", function(player, _admin, _args)
		Announcer.toast(player, "Maps: " .. table.concat(RoundManager.mapNames(), ", "))
	end)
	chatCommand("/endround", function(player, admin, _args)
		local _, message = ACTIONS.endRound(admin, {})
		Announcer.toast(player, message)
	end)
	chatCommand("/addbot", function(player, admin, args)
		local _, message = ACTIONS.addBots(admin, { count = tonumber(args[1] or "1") or 1 })
		Announcer.toast(player, message)
	end)
	chatCommand("/removebots", function(player, admin, args)
		local _, message = ACTIONS.removeBots(admin, { count = tonumber(args[1] or "") })
		Announcer.toast(player, message)
	end)
	chatCommand("/bots", function(player, _admin, _args)
		Announcer.toast(player, botSummary())
	end)
	chatCommand("/map", function(player, admin, args)
		local now = args[#args] ~= nil and string.lower(args[#args]) == "now"
		if now then
			table.remove(args)
		end
		local name = findMap(table.concat(args, " "))
		if not name then
			Announcer.toast(
				player,
				"No such map. Maps: " .. table.concat(RoundManager.mapNames(), ", "),
				"E0303A"
			)
			return
		end
		local _, message = ACTIONS.map(admin, { map = name, now = now })
		Announcer.toast(player, message)
	end)
end

function AdminService.init()
	Remotes.func("Admin").OnServerInvoke = handle
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		setupChatCommands()
		return true
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Admin] chat commands unavailable: " .. tostring(err))
	end
	Participants.onAdded(function(p)
		if p.player and AdminService.isAdmin(p.player) then
			p.state:SetAttribute("Admin", true)
		end
	end)
end

return AdminService

scripts.name: Announcer
scripts.source:
-- Server -> client messages: yellow system lines in chat, short on-screen
-- toasts, and visual/sound effects that every client plays locally.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)

local Announcer = {}

local announce = Remotes.event("Announce")
local toast = Remotes.event("Toast")
local fx = Remotes.event("Fx")

function Announcer.chat(text: string, hex: string?)
	announce:FireAllClients(text, hex or Config.COLORS.SystemMessage)
end

function Announcer.toast(player: Player?, text: string, hex: string?)
	if player then
		toast:FireClient(player, text, hex)
	else
		toast:FireAllClients(text, hex)
	end
end

function Announcer.fx(kind: string, data: { [string]: any })
	fx:FireAllClients(kind, data)
end

return Announcer

scripts.name: BotService
scripts.source:
-- Bots that fill every round (Config.BOTS_MIN to BOTS_MAX of them, fewer
-- when real players join). They count as participants for every rule and
-- wear random skins. Each has a level from 3 to 6; Mario Robles is a 6 and
-- most of the roster is 5 or 6:
--   * zombies spread out over different humans, lead their target,
--     remember where a human hid, and circle round a weapon held out at
--     them instead of walking into it. A human they can't reach (barricaded in)
--     draws a crowd: the pack picks one door, lines up outside it and
--     shoves through together (pushers in a line add their strength)
--   * zombies with nobody in sight hunt: they split up to check bushes (and
--     rooms on roofed maps), and a second zombie on the same human cuts it
--     off from the side instead of trailing behind
--   * every round each human bot takes a role. Builders team up in one room
--     (a fort), split its doors between them, shove furniture into the
--     doorways (two get behind a piece too heavy for one) and lean on the
--     barricade when a zombie knocks. Hiders each pick their own bush before
--     the outbreak and keep still in it. Runners keep away from the zombies.
--   * humans grab the odd item (some start with one), hold weapons out
--     toward close zombies (weapons are solid; a few can swing), flee
--     toward open ground or through doorways away from every zombie, juke
--     sideways when one is about to grab them, and hide in bushes
--   * on dark maps (MapThemes) nobody sees far and walls block the view; on
--     roofed maps nobody sees into a room they aren't in
-- Movement never aims through walls: straight lines are checked with a
-- body-wide sweep, everything else uses pathfinding, and a bot that stops
-- making progress steps sideways and replans.

local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Bushes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Bushes)
local BushService = require(script.Parent.BushService)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local Combat = require(script.Parent.Combat)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local FurniturePush = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.FurniturePush)
local FurnitureService = require(script.Parent.FurnitureService)
local ItemService = require(script.Parent.ItemService)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local MapThemes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapThemes)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Roofs = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Roofs)
local RoundManager = require(script.Parent.RoundManager)
local RoundRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RoundRules)
local Skins = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Skins)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

type Participant = Participants.Participant

local BotService = {}

type Level = {
	think: number, -- seconds between decisions
	speed: number, -- walk speed multiplier
	sight: number, -- zombie: how far away it notices humans
	lead: number, -- zombie: seconds of target movement it predicts
	memory: number, -- zombie: seconds it keeps hunting where a human vanished
	stuck: number, -- zombie: seconds without progress before pressing Z
	flee: number, -- human: zombie distance that starts a run
	directions: number, -- human: escape directions considered
	hide: number, -- human: chance to be a bush hider
	dodge: number, -- human: juke when a zombie closes in this near (0 = never)
	flank: boolean, -- zombie: circle round a held-out weapon
}

-- Kept a bit dim on purpose: they don't see across the map, guess only a
-- little of where you're heading, forget you soon, and react a moment late,
-- so hiding and juking work.
local LEVELS: { [number]: Level } = {
	[3] = {
		think = 0.3,
		speed = 0.97,
		sight = 60,
		lead = 0.15,
		memory = 2,
		stuck = 5,
		flee = 32,
		directions = 6,
		hide = 0.45,
		dodge = 0,
		flank = false,
	},
	[4] = {
		think = 0.25,
		speed = 1,
		sight = 75,
		lead = 0.3,
		memory = 3,
		stuck = 4,
		flee = 38,
		directions = 8,
		hide = 0.5,
		dodge = 5,
		flank = true,
	},
	[5] = {
		think = 0.21,
		speed = 1.02,
		sight = 90,
		lead = 0.4,
		memory = 3.5,
		stuck = 3.5,
		flee = 45,
		directions = 8,
		hide = 0.55,
		dodge = 6,
		flank = true,
	},
	[6] = {
		think = 0.17,
		speed = 1.04,
		sight = 105,
		lead = 0.5,
		memory = 4.5,
		stuck = 3,
		flee = 52,
		directions = 10,
		hide = 0.6,
		dodge = 7,
		flank = true,
	},
}

-- Name and level. Bots join in this order.
local ROSTER: { { name: string, level: number } } = {
	{ name = "Mario Robles", level = 6 },
	{ name = "Fart Butt", level = 5 },
	{ name = "Poop Face", level = 5 },
	{ name = "Fat Guy", level = 4 },
	{ name = "Booger Bob", level = 6 },
	{ name = "Stinky Pete", level = 5 },
	{ name = "Captain Wedgie", level = 4 },
	{ name = "Toilet Ted", level = 3 },
	{ name = "Sir Toots-a-Lot", level = 6 },
	{ name = "Sweaty Steve", level = 5 },
	{ name = "Moldy Cheese", level = 4 },
	{ name = "Burp Master", level = 5 },
	{ name = "Snot Rocket", level = 6 },
	{ name = "Diaper Dan", level = 3 },
	{ name = "Barf Bag", level = 5 },
	{ name = "Lord Stinkbottom", level = 6 },
	{ name = "Cheesy Feet", level = 4 },
	{ name = "Greasy Gary", level = 5 },
	{ name = "Wet Sock", level = 3 },
	{ name = "Professor Poot", level = 6 },
	{ name = "Nacho Breath", level = 4 },
	{ name = "Big Nose Ned", level = 5 },
	{ name = "Soggy Waffle", level = 3 },
	{ name = "Chunky Monkey", level = 4 },
	{ name = "Gassy Gus", level = 5 },
	{ name = "Pickle Pants", level = 4 },
	{ name = "Smelly Kelly", level = 5 },
	{ name = "Belly Flop Bob", level = 3 },
	{ name = "Turbo Toot", level = 6 },
	{ name = "Stinkerbell", level = 5 },
}

-- Cheap, common weapons a bot may start a round with (never rare ones).
local STARTER_WEAPONS = { "Stick", "RubberChicken", "PoolNoodle", "Bat", "Baguette" }

local rng = Random.new()

-- Shared view of the world, refreshed at most 10 times a second -------------------------

type Seen = { p: Participant, position: Vector3, velocity: Vector3, hidden: boolean }

local seenAt = 0
local seenHumans: { Seen } = {}
local seenZombies: { Seen } = {}
local chasing: { [string]: Participant } = {} -- bot id -> the human it hunts

local function look()
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - seenAt < 0.1 then
		return
	end
	seenAt = now
	table.clear(seenHumans)
	table.clear(seenZombies)
	for _, p in Participants.all() do
		local root = Participants.body(p)
		if root then
			local entry = {
				p = p,
				position = root.Position,
				velocity = Util.flat(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity),
				hidden = BushService.hidden(p),
			}
			-- Someone turning into a zombie is as good as one already.
			table.insert(if p.team == "Zombie" or p.turning then seenZombies else seenHumans, entry)
		end
	end
end

-- Barricades ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A human the zombies can't reach is "fortified" for a few seconds: zombies
-- rally on them instead of spreading out, and break in through one door.
local fortified: { [Participant]: number } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any -- human -> until
local sieging: { [string]: { [string]: number } } = {} -- door -> bot id -> last push
local leaning: { [Participant]: number } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any -- bot -> last shove
local doorsOf = ""
local doorList: { MapLayout.Door } = {}

-- Teams of human bots, reset every round. A fort is a room builders share:
-- who is in it, which doors are done, and the pieces being pushed into
-- doorways (with whoever is pushing each one).
type Job = {
	body: BasePart,
	target: Vector3,
	key: string,
	startedAt: number,
	pushers: { [string]: number }, -- bot id -> last push
	done: boolean,
}
type Fort = {
	members: { [string]: number },
	barricaded: { [string]: boolean },
	jobs: { Job },
	bad: { [BasePart]: boolean }, -- pieces nobody could get behind
}
local forts: { [MapLayout.Room]: Fort } = {}
local bushTaken: { [BasePart]: string } = {} -- leaves -> the hider bot that picked it
local cornerTaken: { [string]: string } = {} -- room corner "x,z" -> the hider bot hiding there
local bushChecked: { [BasePart]: number } = {} -- leaves -> when a zombie last went to look
local teamsRound = -1

local function teamsFor(round: number)
	if teamsRound ~= round then
		teamsRound = round
		table.clear(forts)
		table.clear(bushTaken)
		table.clear(bushChecked)
		table.clear(cornerTaken)
	end
end

local function fortOf(room: MapLayout.Room): Fort
	local fort = forts[room]
	if not fort then
		fort = { members = {}, barricaded = {}, jobs = {}, bad = {} }
		forts[room] = fort
	end
	return fort
end

local function count(list: { [string]: number }, now: number, within: number): number
	local n = 0
	for _, seen in list do
		if now - seen < within then
			n += 1
		end
	end
	return n
end

local function doors(): { MapLayout.Door }
	local layout = MapLayout.current()
	if doorsOf ~= layout.name then
		doorsOf = layout.name
		doorList = MapLayout.doors(layout)
		table.clear(sieging)
	end
	return doorList
end

local function doorKey(door: MapLayout.Door): string
	return string.format("%d,%d", math.floor(door.x + 0.5), math.floor(door.z + 0.5))
end

-- Unit vector across a door, toward the side `toward` is on.
local function across(door: MapLayout.Door, toward: Vector3): Vector3
	if door.horizontal then
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, if toward.Z >= door.z then 1 else -1)
	end
	return Vector3.new(if toward.X >= door.x then 1 else -1, 0, 0)
end

-- Zombies pushing on this door right now.
local function pushingDoor(key: string, now: number): number
	local count = 0
	local pushers: { [string]: number } = sieging[key] or {}
	for _, seen in pushers do
		if now - seen < 1 then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

local function chasers(target: Participant, except: string): number
	local count = 0
	for id, p in chasing do
		if p == target and id ~= except then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

-- Pathfinding is the expensive part: share a budget across all bots.
local PATHS_PER_SECOND = 30
local tokens, tokensAt = PATHS_PER_SECOND, os.clock()

local function takePathToken(): boolean
	local now = os.clock()
	tokens = math.min(PATHS_PER_SECOND, tokens + (now - tokensAt) * PATHS_PER_SECOND)
	tokensAt = now
	if tokens >= 1 then
		tokens -= 1
		return true
	end
	return false
end

local function inBounds(v: Vector3, margin: number): boolean
	return MapLayout.inRect(MapLayout.current().bounds, v.X, v.Z, -margin)
end

local function randomSpot(): Vector3
	local layout = MapLayout.current()
	local list = if rng:NextNumber() < 0.6 then layout.itemSpots else layout.humanSpawns
	local spot = list[rng:NextInteger(1, #list)]
	return Vector3.new(spot.x, 2, spot.z)
end

local function nearestBush(from: Vector3, range: number): Vector3?
	local best: Vector3? = nil
	local bestDistance = range
	for _, leaves in Bushes.leaves() do
		local d = Util.flatDistance(leaves.Position, from)
		if d < bestDistance then
			best, bestDistance = Vector3.new(leaves.Position.X, from.Y, leaves.Position.Z), d
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- The nearest bush no other hider has picked, away from the zombies.
-- How many other people stand within `radius` of a spot.
local function crowdAt(spot: Vector3, radius: number, except: Participant): number
	local n = 0
	for _, list in { seenHumans, seenZombies } do
		for _, entry in list do
			if entry.p ~= except and Util.flatDistance(entry.position, spot) < radius then
				n += 1
			end
		end
	end
	return n
end

local function freeBush(p: Participant, from: Vector3): BasePart?
	local best: BasePart? = nil
	local bestScore = 160
	for _, leaves in Bushes.leaves() do
		local owner = bushTaken[leaves]
		if owner and owner ~= p.id then
			continue
		end
		local d = Util.flatDistance(leaves.Position, from)
		-- A bush with people standing round it gives you away.
		local score = d + 30 * crowdAt(leaves.Position, 12, p)
		if score >= bestScore then
			continue
		end
		local safe = true
		for _, zombie in seenZombies do
			if Util.flatDistance(zombie.position, leaves.Position) < 25 then
				safe = false
				break
			end
		end
		if safe then
			best, bestScore = leaves, score
		end
	end
	if best then
		bushTaken[best] = p.id
	end
	return best
end

-- No bush to be had: a quiet corner of a room, away from its doorways and
-- from everyone else (on dark maps, a dark room is as good as a bush).
local function quietCorner(p: Participant, from: Vector3): Vector3?
	local best: Vector3? = nil
	local bestScore = math.huge
	local inset = 2.5 * p.scale + 1.5
	for _, room in MapLayout.current().rooms do
		if room.house == "" then
			continue
		end
		local r = MapLayout.roomInterior(room)
		if r.x2 - r.x1 < inset * 2 + 2 or r.z2 - r.z1 < inset * 2 + 2 then
			continue
		end
		for _, c in
			{
				{ r.x1 + inset, r.z1 + inset },
				{ r.x2 - inset, r.z1 + inset },
				{ r.x1 + inset, r.z2 - inset },
				{ r.x2 - inset, r.z2 - inset },
			}
		do
			local spot = Vector3.new(c[1], from.Y, c[2])
			local key = string.format("%d,%d", math.floor(c[1]), math.floor(c[2]))
			if cornerTaken[key] and cornerTaken[key] ~= p.id then
				continue
			end
			local nearDoor = false
			for _, door in doors() do
				if Util.flatDistance(Vector3.new(door.x, from.Y, door.z), spot) < 8 then
					nearDoor = true
					break
				end
			end
			if nearDoor or #FurnitureService.findInBox(CFrame.new(spot), Vector3.new(3, 4, 3)) > 0 then
				continue
			end
			local score = Util.flatDistance(spot, from) + 40 * crowdAt(spot, 14, p)
			if score < bestScore then
				best, bestScore = spot, score
			end
		end
	end
	if best then
		cornerTaken[string.format("%d,%d", math.floor(best.X), math.floor(best.Z))] = p.id
	end
	return best
end

-- The nearest bush no zombie has looked in lately (zombies hunting).
local function bushToCheck(from: Vector3, now: number): BasePart?
	local best: BasePart? = nil
	local bestDistance = 60
	for _, leaves in Bushes.leaves() do
		local d = Util.flatDistance(leaves.Position, from)
		if d < bestDistance and now - (bushChecked[leaves] or -math.huge) > 40 then
			best, bestDistance = leaves, d
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- Item spot ("x,z") -> { bot id, when }: each bot heads for a different item.
local itemClaims: { [string]: { id: string, at: number } } = {}

local function nearestItem(from: Vector3, range: number, botId: string): Vector3?
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("GroundItems")
	if not folder then
		return nil
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local best: Vector3? = nil
	local bestKey = ""
	local bestDistance = range
	for _, model in folder:GetChildren() do
		local x, z = model:GetAttribute("SpotX"), model:GetAttribute("SpotZ")
		local item = Items.get(model:GetAttribute("ItemId") :: string?)
		-- Bots leave the good stuff for players: only cheap, common items.
		local common = item ~= nil
			and not item.isRare
			and (item.price or math.huge) <= Config.BOT_MAX_ITEM_PRICE
