		if common and typeof(x) == "number" and typeof(z) == "number" then
			local key = string.format("%d,%d", math.floor(x + 0.5), math.floor(z + 0.5))
			local claim = itemClaims[key]
			if claim and claim.id ~= botId and now - claim.at < 4 then
				continue -- another bot is already on its way
			end
			local spot = Vector3.new(x, from.Y, z)
			local d = Util.flatDistance(spot, from)
			if d < bestDistance then
				best, bestKey, bestDistance = spot, key, d
			end
		end
	end
	if best then
		itemClaims[bestKey] = { id = botId, at = now }
	end
	return best
end

-- Can a zombie at `from` see this human?
local function visible(entry: Seen, from: Vector3): boolean
	return not entry.hidden or Util.flatDistance(entry.position, from) <= Config.BUSH_REVEAL_DISTANCE
end

-- On a dark map nobody sees far and walls block the view; on a roofed map
-- nobody sees into a room they aren't in.
local function inSight(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, distance: number): boolean
	if not Roofs.canSee(from, to) then
		return false
	end
	local theme = MapThemes.get(MapLayout.current().theme)
	if not theme.dark then
		return true
	end
	return distance <= (theme.sight or 40) + 6 and Combat.canSee(from, to)
end

-- A human holding a weapon out at us: a spot round the side it isn't
-- pointing (the shaft only blocks straight ahead), or nil if we're already
-- beside or behind it. `wary` (just got hit or pushed off it): swing wider,
-- right round the back, out of reach.
local function flankAround(target: Seen, here: Vector3, wary: boolean?): Vector3?
	local item = Items.get(target.p.heldItem)
	if not item or item.kind ~= "Melee" then
		return nil
	end
	local aim = Util.flatUnit(target.p.aim)
	if not aim then
		return nil
	end
	local rel = Util.flat(here - target.position)
	local d = rel.Magnitude
	local reach = (item.reach or 5) * Items.reachScale(target.p.scale)
	local front = if d > 0.5 then (rel / d):Dot(aim) else 0
	if d < 0.5 or d > reach + (if wary then 14 else 8) or front < (if wary then -0.2 else 0.35) then
		return nil
	end
	local side = Vector3.new(-aim.Z, 0, aim.X)
	local sign = if rel:Dot(side) >= 0 then 1 else -1
	if wary then
		-- Out of reach, round to the back.
		local around = (side * sign - aim * 0.9).Unit
		return target.position + around * (reach + 3)
	end
	local around = (side * sign - aim * 0.35).Unit
	return target.position + around * (reach * 0.75 + 2)
end

-- Rooms (inside houses, not yards) and their doorways ---------------------------------------

local function roomAt(x: number, z: number): MapLayout.Room?
	for _, room in MapLayout.current().rooms do
		if room.house ~= "" and MapLayout.inRect(room.rect, x, z) then
			return room
		end
	end
	return nil
end

type RoomDoor = { door: MapLayout.Door, center: Vector3, inward: Vector3 }

-- Each doorway of a room, with the unit vector pointing into the room.
local function doorsOfRoom(room: MapLayout.Room): { RoomDoor }
	local r = room.rect
	local out: { RoomDoor } = {}
	for _, door in doors() do
		local center = Vector3.new(door.x, 2, door.z)
		if door.horizontal and door.x > r.x1 and door.x < r.x2 then
			if math.abs(door.z - r.z1) < 0.6 then
				table.insert(out, { door = door, center = center, inward = Vector3.zAxis })
			elseif math.abs(door.z - r.z2) < 0.6 then
				table.insert(out, { door = door, center = center, inward = -Vector3.zAxis })
			end
		elseif not door.horizontal and door.z > r.z1 and door.z < r.z2 then
			if math.abs(door.x - r.x1) < 0.6 then
				table.insert(out, { door = door, center = center, inward = Vector3.xAxis })
			elseif math.abs(door.x - r.x2) < 0.6 then
				table.insert(out, { door = door, center = center, inward = -Vector3.xAxis })
			end
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- A room worth holing up in: walls round it, one or two doors, not a hallway.
local function goodHideout(room: MapLayout.Room): boolean
	local r = room.rect
	local doorsIn = #doorsOfRoom(room)
	return doorsIn >= 1
		and doorsIn <= 2
		and (r.x2 - r.x1) >= 14
		and (r.z2 - r.z1) >= 14
		and not string.find(string.lower(room.name), "hall")
end

-- Where each bot was last told to walk, and when. The drive loop below moves
-- bots toward it at full speed, so it doesn't depend on what the Humanoid
-- reports while walking.
local walkGoal: { [Humanoid]: Vector3 } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any
local walkAt: { [Humanoid]: number } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any
local stopped: { [Humanoid]: boolean } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any -- arrived and standing

local function moveTo(humanoid: Humanoid, point: Vector3)
	walkAt[humanoid] = os.clock()
	local old = walkGoal[humanoid]
	if old and stopped[humanoid] and Util.flatDistance(old, point) < 0.8 then
		return -- already standing there: stay put instead of twitching
	end
	humanoid:MoveTo(point)
	walkGoal[humanoid] = point
	stopped[humanoid] = nil
end

-- One bot ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function brain(p: Participant, level: Level, seed: number)
	local random = Random.new(seed)
	local pathScale = 0
	local path: Path? = nil
	local waypoints: { PathWaypoint } = {}
	local waypointIndex = 1
	local pathGoal: Vector3? = nil
	local computedAt = 0
	local wanderGoal: Vector3? = nil
	local wanderUntil = 0
	local progressAt = os.clock()
	local progressFrom = Vector3.zero
	local detour: Vector3? = nil
	local detourUntil = 0
	local lastSeen: Vector3? = nil
	local lastSeenAt = 0
	local armedRound = -1
	local hider = random:NextNumber() < level.hide
	local pathFailed = false -- the last path asked for doesn't reach its goal
	local leanFrom = 0 -- when we started leaning on furniture that won't give
	type Siege = {
		door: MapLayout.Door,
		key: string,
		across: Vector3, -- unit, from outside the door toward the human
		center: Vector3,
		goal: Vector3,
		committed: boolean,
		startedAt: number,
		movedAt: number,
		from: Vector3,
	}
	local siege: Siege? = nil
	local badDoors: { [string]: number } = {} -- doors that wouldn't give -> until
	local dodgeSpot: Vector3? = nil
	local dodgeUntil, nextDodge = 0, 0
	-- A role for each round (human): Builders team up in a fort, Hiders take a
	-- bush of their own, Runners keep away from the zombies.
	local role: "Builder" | "Hider" | "Runner" = "Runner"
	local roleRound = -1
	local myBush: BasePart? = nil
	local myCorner: Vector3? = nil -- a quiet room corner, when there's no bush
	local crowdedSince = 0 -- squeezed in with two or more others since then
	local relocate: Vector3? = nil -- stepping out of a crowd to here
	local relocateUntil = 0
	local home: MapLayout.Room? = nil
	local homeRound = -1
	local barricade: Job? = nil
	local waryOf: Participant? = nil
	local waryUntil = 0
	-- What the bot is up to, for the admin panel's bot list.
	local lastDoing = ""
	local function doing(text: string)
		if text ~= lastDoing then
			lastDoing = text
			p.state:SetAttribute("BotDoing", text)
		end
	end
	-- Zombies chasing alongside another zombie cut in from this side.
	local cutSide = if random:NextNumber() < 0.5 then 1 else -1
	-- People react a moment after they notice someone, each at their own
	-- pace, and sometimes stop to look around.
	local reaction = random:NextNumber(0.3, 0.8) * (if level.flank then 0.9 else 1.25)
	local noticedAt: { [Participant]: number } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any
	local lastLookAt: { [Participant]: number } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any
	local function noticed(other: Participant, now: number): boolean
		if now - (lastLookAt[other] or -math.huge) > 1 then
			noticedAt[other] = now -- just (re)noticed them
		end
		lastLookAt[other] = now
		return now - (noticedAt[other] or now) >= reaction
	end
	local startRound = -1
	local pauseUntil = 0
	local approachJob: Job? = nil -- the barricade piece we're walking round to
	local approachSince = 0

	local function radius(): number
		return math.min(0.9 * p.scale, Config.CHARACTER.MaxRootWidth / 2)
	end

	-- A short step in the open direction closest to `toward` (unsticking).
	local function sidestep(root: BasePart, toward: Vector3): Vector3?
		local want = Util.flatUnit(toward - root.Position) or Vector3.xAxis
		local best: Vector3? = nil
		local bestScore = -math.huge
		for i = 0, 7 do
			local angle = i / 8 * math.pi * 2 + random:NextNumber(-0.2, 0.2)
			local dir = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle))
			local spot = root.Position + dir * 7
			if inBounds(spot, 3) and Combat.clearWide(root.Position, spot, radius()) then
				local score = dir:Dot(want) + random:NextNumber(0, 0.6)
				if score > bestScore then
					best, bestScore = spot, score
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	local function followPath(goal: Vector3, root: BasePart, humanoid: Humanoid, pushThrough: boolean)
		local now = os.clock()
		if not path or math.abs(p.scale - pathScale) > 0.2 then
			pathScale = p.scale
			path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
				AgentRadius = math.min(1.4 * p.scale, Config.CHARACTER.MaxRootWidth / 2 + 0.3),
				AgentHeight = 4,
				AgentCanJump = false,
				WaypointSpacing = 4,
			})
			pathGoal = nil
		end
		local stale = not pathGoal or now - computedAt > 1.2 or (goal - (pathGoal :: Vector3)).Magnitude > 6
		if stale and takePathToken() then
			pathGoal, computedAt = goal, now
			local ok = pcall(function()
				(path :: Path):ComputeAsync(root.Position, goal)
			end)
			if ok and (path :: Path).Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
				waypoints = (path :: Path):GetWaypoints()
				waypointIndex = math.min(2, #waypoints)
				pathFailed = false
			else
				waypoints = {}
				pathFailed = true
			end
		end
		-- Skip ahead to the farthest waypoint we can walk straight to.
		local ahead = math.min(#waypoints, waypointIndex + 4)
		while ahead > waypointIndex do
			if Combat.clearWide(root.Position, waypoints[ahead].Position, radius()) then
				waypointIndex = ahead
				break
			end
			ahead -= 1
		end
		local waypoint = waypoints[waypointIndex]
		if
			waypoint
			-- Next waypoint well before reaching this one, so a bot never
			-- arrives (and stops) between two decisions.
			and Util.flatDistance(waypoint.Position, root.Position) < math.max(
				2,
				humanoid.WalkSpeed * level.think * 1.6
			)
			and waypointIndex < #waypoints
		then
			waypointIndex += 1
			waypoint = waypoints[waypointIndex]
		end
		if waypoint then
			moveTo(humanoid, waypoint.Position)
		elseif pushThrough and Combat.clearWide(root.Position, goal, radius(), true) then
			moveTo(humanoid, goal) -- only furniture in the way: shove through it
		else
			local step = sidestep(root, goal)
			if step then
				moveTo(humanoid, step)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Straight there when the way is open for our whole body, else a path.
	local function goTo(goal: Vector3, root: BasePart, humanoid: Humanoid, pushThrough: boolean)
		local now = os.clock()
		if detour and now < detourUntil then
			moveTo(humanoid, detour)
			return
		end
		detour = nil
		local distance = Util.flatDistance(goal, root.Position)
		if distance < 45 and Combat.clearWide(root.Position, goal, radius()) then
			moveTo(humanoid, goal)
			pathGoal = nil
		elseif pushThrough and distance < 18 and Combat.clearWide(root.Position, goal, radius(), true) then
			moveTo(humanoid, goal) -- a barricade, not a wall: lean on it
		else
			followPath(goal, root, humanoid, pushThrough)
		end
	end

	-- What we're leaning on, if anything can give: furniture right where
	-- we're walking (in reach of body or arms), or the back of another
	-- zombie that is leaning on something (a queue: our strength adds to
	-- theirs). Returns the piece (nil for a queue) and whether other zombies
	-- are shoving with us.
	local function leaningOn(root: BasePart, humanoid: Humanoid): (boolean, BasePart?, boolean)
		local dir = Util.flatUnit(humanoid.MoveDirection)
		if not dir then
			return false, nil, false
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		local helped = false
		for _, entry in seenZombies do
			if
				entry.p ~= p
				and now - (leaning[entry.p] or 0) < 1
				and Util.flatDistance(entry.position, root.Position) < 9 * p.scale
			then
				helped = true
			end
		end
		local probe, size = FurniturePush.moverProbe(root, dir, p.scale)
		local found = FurnitureService.findInBox(probe, size + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1.5 * p.scale))
		if #found > 0 then
			return true, found[1], helped
		end
		for _, entry in seenZombies do
			if entry.p ~= p and now - (leaning[entry.p] or 0) < 1 then
				local rel = Util.flat(entry.position - root.Position)
				local along = rel:Dot(dir)
				if along > 0.5 and along < 4 * p.scale and (rel - dir * along).Magnitude < 2.5 * p.scale then
					return true, nil, true
				end
			end
		end
		return false, nil, false
	end

	-- A spot just past the side of a piece that won't give, on the side
	-- nearer the goal: walk round it instead of into it.
	local function roundPiece(body: BasePart, root: BasePart, goal: Vector3): Vector3?
		local here = root.Position
		local dir = Util.flatUnit(goal - here)
		if not dir then
			return nil
		end
		local side = Vector3.new(-dir.Z, 0, dir.X)
		local reach = FurniturePush.extent(body, side) + FurniturePush.bumperRadius(p.scale) + 1
		local center = Vector3.new(body.Position.X, here.Y, body.Position.Z)
		local best: Vector3? = nil
		local bestDistance = math.huge
		for _, sign in { 1, -1 } do
			local spot = center + side * sign * reach + dir * 1.5
			if inBounds(spot, 3) and Combat.clearWide(here, spot, radius()) then
				local d = Util.flatDistance(spot, goal)
				if d < bestDistance then
					best, bestDistance = spot, d
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	-- No progress for a moment while trying to move: step aside, then
	-- replan. A zombie leaning on furniture keeps shoving for a while
	-- instead (the others are on their way to help).
	local function checkProgress(root: BasePart, goal: Vector3?, humanoid: Humanoid)
		local now = os.clock()
		if (root.Position - progressFrom).Magnitude > 1.2 then
			progressFrom, progressAt = root.Position, now
			leanFrom = 0
			return
		end
		if goal and now - progressAt > 0.9 and not (detour and now < detourUntil) then
			local leant, piece, helped = false, nil, false
			if p.team == "Zombie" then
				leant, piece, helped = leaningOn(root, humanoid)
			end
			if leant then
				if leanFrom == 0 then
					leanFrom = now
				end
				-- Keep shoving while the pack is on it with us (or on its way);
				-- alone against a piece that won't budge, go round it soon.
				if now - leanFrom < (if helped then 6 else 2) then
					progressAt = now
					leaning[p] = now
					local target = chasing[p.id]
					if target then
						fortified[target] = now + 8
					end
					return
				end
			end
			leanFrom = 0
			detour = (if piece then roundPiece(piece, root, goal) else nil) or sidestep(root, goal)
			detourUntil = now + (if piece then 1 else 0.7)
			pathGoal = nil
			progressAt = now
		end
	end

	-- Breaking in. When no path reaches `goal` and walls stand between us,
	-- furniture is blocking every way in: walk to just outside the door
	-- closest to it (the door the other zombies already use, if any), then
	-- shove straight through. Returns false when there's nothing to break.
	local function breach(goal: Vector3, root: BasePart, humanoid: Humanoid): boolean
		local now = os.clock()
		local here = root.Position
		local r = radius()
		local s = siege
		if s and Util.flatDistance(s.goal, goal) > 15 then
			s = nil
		end
		if not s then
			local failed = pathFailed
				and pathGoal ~= nil
				and Util.flatDistance(pathGoal :: Vector3, goal) < 10
			if not failed or Combat.clearWide(here, goal, r, true) then
				siege = nil
				return false
			end
			local best: MapLayout.Door? = nil
			local bestScore = math.huge
			for _, door in doors() do
				local key = doorKey(door)
				if (badDoors[key] or 0) > now or door.width < r * 2 + 0.6 then
					continue
				end
				local center = Vector3.new(door.x, here.Y, door.z)
				local d = Util.flatDistance(center, goal)
				if d > 70 then
					continue
				end
				local n = across(door, goal)
				if not Combat.clearWide(center + n * 2.5, goal, r * 0.8, true) then
					continue -- this door doesn't lead to them
				end
				local outside = center - n * (4 + r)
				local score = d + 0.5 * Util.flatDistance(outside, here) - 12 * pushingDoor(key, now)
				if score < bestScore then
					best, bestScore = door, score
				end
			end
			if not best then
				return false
			end
			s = {
				door = best,
				key = doorKey(best),
				across = across(best, goal),
				center = Vector3.new(best.x, here.Y, best.z),
				goal = goal,
				committed = false,
				startedAt = now,
				movedAt = now,
				from = here,
			}
		end
		assert(s, "siege")
		siege = s
		s.goal = goal
		local target = chasing[p.id]
		if target then
			fortified[target] = now + 8
		end

		local rel = Util.flat(here - s.center)
		local into = rel:Dot(s.across)
		local side = (rel - s.across * into).Magnitude
		if into > 1 + r and into < 10 and side < s.door.width / 2 + 2 then
			siege = nil -- through the door: go get them
			return false
		end
		if not s.committed then
			local outside = s.center - s.across * (4 + r)
			-- Close enough to join the line (zombies already queued there are
			-- in the way of the exact spot): lean in behind them.
			local near = Util.flatDistance(outside, here) < 8 + 2 * r
				or (into > -(5 + r) and into < 1 and side < s.door.width / 2)
			if near and Combat.clearWide(here, s.center, r * 0.8, true) then
				s.committed, s.movedAt, s.from = true, now, here
			else
				goTo(outside, root, humanoid, true)
				checkProgress(root, outside, humanoid)
				if now - s.startedAt > 20 then
					badDoors[s.key] = now + 10 -- can't get to that door
					siege = nil
				end
				return true
			end
		end
		-- Lined up: lean straight in through the doorway, no sidestepping.
		local pushers = sieging[s.key] or {}
		sieging[s.key] = pushers
		pushers[p.id] = now
		leaning[p] = now
		detour = nil
		moveTo(humanoid, s.center + s.across * (5 + r))
		progressAt = now
		if (here - s.from).Magnitude > 1 then
			s.from, s.movedAt = here, now
		end
		if now - s.movedAt > 8 then
			badDoors[s.key] = now + 12 -- it won't give: try another way
			siege = nil
		end
		return true
	end

	local function face(root: BasePart, humanoid: Humanoid, direction: Vector3?)
		if direction then
			humanoid.AutoRotate = false
			root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + direction)
			p.aim = direction
		else
			humanoid.AutoRotate = true
			local facing = Util.flatUnit(root.CFrame.LookVector)
			if facing then
				p.aim = facing
			end
		end
	end

	while Participants.get(p.id) == p do
		task.wait(level.think * random:NextNumber(0.7, 1.45)) -- uneven, so bots don't move as one
		local root, humanoid = Participants.body(p)
		if not root or not humanoid then
			continue
		end
		look()
		local now = os.clock()
		local here = root.Position
		local phase = RoundManager.phase()
		teamsFor(RoundManager.roundNumber())
		-- Each bot gets going at its own moment when a round starts.
		if RoundManager.roundNumber() ~= startRound then
			startRound = RoundManager.roundNumber()
			pauseUntil = now + random:NextNumber(0, 5)
		end
		if phase == "Prep" and now < pauseUntil then
			doing("Getting ready")
			moveTo(humanoid, here)
			continue
		end

		-- Distance from a spot to the nearest zombie we can see.
		local function zombieGap(spot: Vector3): number
			local gap = math.huge
			for _, zombie in seenZombies do
				gap = math.min(gap, Util.flatDistance(zombie.position, spot))
			end
			return gap
		end

		local function wander()
			if now < pauseUntil then
				moveTo(humanoid, here) -- looking around
				return
			end
			local arrived = wanderGoal ~= nil and Util.flatDistance(wanderGoal, here) < 4
			if arrived and random:NextNumber() < 0.35 then
				pauseUntil = now + random:NextNumber(0.6, 2.4)
				wanderGoal = nil
				moveTo(humanoid, here)
				return
			end
			local due = not wanderGoal or now > wanderUntil or arrived
			-- A human heading somewhere a zombie now stands picks again.
			if
				not due
				and p.team == "Human"
				and phase == "Infection"
				and zombieGap(wanderGoal :: Vector3) < 20
			then
				due = true
			end
			if due then
				wanderGoal = randomSpot()
				wanderUntil = now + random:NextNumber(6, 12)
				if p.team == "Zombie" then
					-- Hunting: zombies split up to check the bushes, and on roofed
					-- maps (nobody can see into rooms) they go and look in rooms.
					local roofed = MapLayout.current().roofs
					local bush = if random:NextNumber() < (if roofed then 0.2 else 0.3)
						then bushToCheck(here, now)
						else nil
					if bush then
						bushChecked[bush] = now
						wanderGoal = Vector3.new(bush.Position.X, 2, bush.Position.Z)
						wanderUntil = now + random:NextNumber(6, 10)
					elseif roofed then
						local rooms = {}
						for _, room in MapLayout.current().rooms do
							if room.house ~= "" then
								table.insert(rooms, room)
							end
						end
						if #rooms > 0 then
							local r = rooms[random:NextInteger(1, #rooms)].rect
							wanderGoal = Vector3.new((r.x1 + r.x2) / 2, 2, (r.z1 + r.z2) / 2)
							wanderUntil = now + random:NextNumber(5, 9)
						end
					end
				elseif phase == "Prep" then
					-- Before the outbreak people scatter: of a few spots, the one
					-- with the fewest others around it.
					local function crowd(spot: Vector3): number
						local n = 0
						for _, entry in seenHumans do
							if entry.p ~= p and Util.flatDistance(entry.position, spot) < 25 then
								n += 1
							end
						end
						return n
					end
					local best, bestCrowd = wanderGoal, crowd(wanderGoal :: Vector3)
					for _ = 1, 4 do
						local spot = randomSpot()
						local n = crowd(spot)
						if n < bestCrowd then
							best, bestCrowd = spot, n
						end
					end
					wanderGoal = best
				elseif phase == "Infection" then
					-- Runners: of a few spots, the one farthest from the zombies.
					local best, bestGap = wanderGoal, zombieGap(wanderGoal :: Vector3)
					for _ = 1, 4 do
						local spot = randomSpot()
						local gap = zombieGap(spot)
						if gap > bestGap then
							best, bestGap = spot, gap
						end
					end
					wanderGoal = best
				end
			end
			goTo(wanderGoal :: Vector3, root, humanoid, false)
			checkProgress(root, wanderGoal, humanoid)
		end

		if p.team == "Zombie" then
			face(root, humanoid, nil)
			-- Pick a human: close ones first, but spread out so the pack
			-- surrounds people instead of queueing behind each other.
			local best: Seen? = nil
			local bestScore = math.huge
			-- A barricaded human pulls the pack together instead (up to 6).
			for _, entry in seenHumans do
				local d = Util.flatDistance(entry.position, here)
				if
					d <= level.sight
					and visible(entry, here)
					and inSight(here, entry.position, d)
					and noticed(entry.p, now)
				then
					local others = chasers(entry.p, p.id)
					local rally = (fortified[entry.p] or 0) > now and others < 6
					local score = d
						+ (if rally then -15 - 10 * others else 14 * others)
						- (if chasing[p.id] == entry.p then 8 else 0)
					if score < bestScore then
						best, bestScore = entry, score
					end
				end
			end
			if best then
				chasing[p.id] = best.p
				doing("Chasing " .. best.p.name)
				local d = Util.flatDistance(best.position, here)
				local lead = best.velocity * level.lead * math.clamp(d / 25, 0, 1)
				local goal = best.position + lead
				lastSeen, lastSeenAt = goal, now
				-- Another zombie is already on them: cut in from the side ahead
				-- of them instead of trailing behind it.
				if chasers(best.p, p.id) > 0 and d > 10 and d < 70 and best.velocity.Magnitude > 4 then
					local ahead = best.velocity.Unit
					local side = Vector3.new(-ahead.Z, 0, ahead.X) * cutSide
					local cut = best.position
						+ best.velocity * (level.lead * 1.6)
						+ side * math.min(12, d * 0.4)
					if inBounds(cut, 3) and Combat.clearWide(here, cut, radius()) then
						goal = cut
					end
				end
				-- Just got hit, or held off a weapon? Be wary of that human for a
				-- while: no more running straight back into it.
				if now < p.knockedUntil + 0.3 or now < p.pressedUntil then
					waryOf, waryUntil = best.p, now + 5
				end
				local wary = waryOf == best.p and now < waryUntil
				-- Holding a weapon out at us? Go round it.
				local around = if level.flank or wary then flankAround(best, here, wary) else nil
				if around and inBounds(around, 3) then
					goal = around
				end
				if not breach(best.position, root, humanoid) then
					goTo(goal, root, humanoid, true)
					checkProgress(root, goal, humanoid)
				end
			elseif lastSeen and now - lastSeenAt < level.memory then
				chasing[p.id] = nil
				doing("Searching where they saw someone")
				if not breach(lastSeen, root, humanoid) then
					goTo(lastSeen, root, humanoid, true)
					checkProgress(root, lastSeen, humanoid)
				end
			else
				chasing[p.id] = nil
				lastSeen = nil
				siege = nil
				doing("Hunting")
				wander()
			end
			if now - progressAt > level.stuck then
				RoundManager.zombieReturn(p)
				progressAt = now
			end
			continue
		end
		chasing[p.id] = nil

		-- Human ----------------------------------------------------------------------
		local round = RoundManager.roundNumber()
		if roleRound ~= round then
			roleRound = round
			local roll = random:NextNumber()
			local builders = if level.flank then 0.6 else 0.35
			role = if roll < builders
				then "Builder"
				elseif roll < builders + level.hide * 0.7 then "Hider"
				else "Runner"
			p.state:SetAttribute("BotRole", role)
			myBush = nil
			myCorner = nil
		end
		if phase == "Prep" and armedRound ~= round then
			armedRound = round -- one roll per round: only some bots start armed
			if not p.heldItem and random:NextNumber() < Config.BOT_WEAPON_CHANCE then
				ItemService.give(p, STARTER_WEAPONS[random:NextInteger(1, #STARTER_WEAPONS)])
			end
		end
		local item = Items.get(p.heldItem)

		-- The zombies this bot can see, and the closest one.
		local threats: { Seen } = {}
		local closest: Seen? = nil
		local closestDistance = math.huge
		for _, entry in seenZombies do
			if entry.p == p then
				continue -- ourselves, while turning
			end
			local d = Util.flatDistance(entry.position, here)
			local seen = not entry.hidden or d <= Config.BUSH_REVEAL_DISTANCE
			if seen and inSight(here, entry.position, d) and noticed(entry.p, now) then
				if d <= level.flee then
					table.insert(threats, entry)
				end
				if d < closestDistance then
					closest, closestDistance = entry, d
				end
			end
		end

		-- Armed: hold the weapon out toward a close zombie (it's solid) and swing.
		local guarding = false
		if closest and item then
			-- (Thrown explosives wait until the zombie is in range; a broom,
			-- cloak or blood box is for when one is right on top of us.)
			local reach = if item.kind == "Projectile"
				then (if item.effect == "Explode" then item.projectileRange or 30 else 45)
				else (item.reach or 5) * Items.reachScale(p.scale) + 3
			if closestDistance <= reach then
				local aim = Util.flatUnit(closest.position + closest.velocity * 0.15 - here)
				if aim then
					guarding = item.kind == "Melee"
					face(root, humanoid, aim)
					ItemService.botUse(p, aim)
				end
			end
		end
		if not guarding then
			face(root, humanoid, nil)
		end

		-- A zombie about to grab us: juke sideways so it overshoots (then a
		-- moment before the next juke, or nobody could ever be caught).
		if dodgeSpot and now < dodgeUntil then
			moveTo(humanoid, dodgeSpot)
			continue
		end
		dodgeSpot = nil
		if
			closest
			and level.dodge > 0
			and now >= nextDodge
			and closestDistance < level.dodge + p.scale * 1.5
		then
			local rel = Util.flat(here - closest.position)
			local away = if rel.Magnitude > 0.1 then rel.Unit else Vector3.xAxis
			if closest.velocity:Dot(away) > 6 then
				local side = Vector3.new(-away.Z, 0, away.X)
				local first = if random:NextNumber() < 0.5 then 1 else -1
				local order: { number } = { first, -first }
				for _, sign in order do
					local spot = here + side * sign * 8 + away * 2
					if inBounds(spot, 4) and Combat.clearWide(here, spot, radius()) then
						dodgeSpot, dodgeUntil, nextDodge = spot, now + 0.4, now + 1.6
						break
					end
				end
				if dodgeSpot then
					doing("Juking a zombie")
					moveTo(humanoid, dodgeSpot)
					pathGoal = nil
					continue
				end
			end
		end

		-- Squeezed in with others for a couple of seconds (and no zombie
		-- about)? Step out of the crowd; a builder in a room with too many
		-- teammates goes and finds another one.
		if #threats == 0 then
			if relocate and now < relocateUntil then
				doing("Getting out of a crowd")
				goTo(relocate, root, humanoid, false)
				continue
			end
			relocate = nil
			local near, centroid = 0, Vector3.zero
			for _, entry in seenHumans do
				if entry.p ~= p and Util.flatDistance(entry.position, here) < 5.5 * p.scale then
					near += 1
					centroid += entry.position
				end
			end
			if near < 2 or FurnitureService.holding(p.id) then
				crowdedSince = 0
			elseif crowdedSince == 0 then
				crowdedSince = now
			elseif now - crowdedSince > 1.8 then
				crowdedSince = 0
				local away = Util.flatUnit(here - centroid / near)
					or Vector3.new(
						math.cos(random:NextNumber(0, 6.28)),
						0,
						math.sin(random:NextNumber(0, 6.28))
					)
				for _ = 1, 6 do
					local dir = CFrame.Angles(0, random:NextNumber(-1, 1), 0):VectorToWorldSpace(away)
					local spot = here + dir * random:NextNumber(9, 16)
					if inBounds(spot, 4) and Combat.clearWide(here, spot, radius()) then
						relocate, relocateUntil = spot, now + 2.5
						break
					end
				end
				local myHome = home
				if myHome and count(fortOf(myHome).members, now, 3) > 2 then
					fortOf(myHome).members[p.id] = nil
					home, barricade = nil, nil
				end
				if relocate then
					goTo(relocate, root, humanoid, false)
					continue
				end
			end
		end

		-- Builders team up in a fort: they hole up in one room, split its
		-- doorways, shove furniture into them (two get behind a piece too
		-- heavy for one), and lean on the barricade when a zombie knocks.
		if role == "Builder" and (phase == "Prep" or phase == "Infection") then
			doing(
				if FurnitureService.holding(p.id) then "Dragging furniture to the fort" else "Building a fort"
			)
			if homeRound ~= round then
				homeRound, home, barricade = round, nil, nil
			end
			local threatInside = closest ~= nil
				and closestDistance < 16
				and home ~= nil
				and roomAt(closest.position.X, closest.position.Z) == home
			if not home and phase == "Prep" then
				-- The nearest good room, but join a teammate already holing up
				-- somewhere close (two to a room, about three to a house, so
				-- they spread out). Claimed at once, so the builders picking
				-- right after us see it.
				local best: MapLayout.Room? = nil
				local bestScore = math.huge
				for _, room in MapLayout.current().rooms do
					local r = room.rect
					local d =
						Util.flatDistance(Vector3.new((r.x1 + r.x2) / 2, here.Y, (r.z1 + r.z2) / 2), here)
					if room.house ~= "" and d < 160 and goodHideout(room) then
						local mates = count(fortOf(room).members, now, 3)
						local houseMates = 0
						for other, fort in forts do
							if other.house == room.house then
								houseMates += count(fort.members, now, 3)
							end
						end
						local score = d
							- (if mates == 1 then 30 else 0)
							+ (if mates >= 2 then 400 else 0)
							+ (if houseMates >= 3 then 250 else 0)
						if score < bestScore then
							best, bestScore = room, score
						end
					end
				end
				home = best
				if best then
					fortOf(best).members[p.id] = now
				end
			end
			local myHome = home
			if myHome and not threatInside then
				local fort = fortOf(myHome)
				fort.members[p.id] = now
				local r = myHome.rect
				local middle = Vector3.new((r.x1 + r.x2) / 2, here.Y, (r.z1 + r.z2) / 2)
				local inside = roomAt(here.X, here.Z) == myHome
				local roomDoors = doorsOfRoom(myHome)
				local handled = false
				if not inside then
					if not closest or closestDistance > 20 then
						goTo(middle, root, humanoid, false)
						checkProgress(root, middle, humanoid)
						handled = true
					end
				else
					-- A zombie at one of our doors: everyone leans on that barricade.
					for _, entry in roomDoors do
						if closest and Util.flatDistance(closest.position, entry.center) < 12 then
							moveTo(humanoid, entry.center)
							handled = true
							break
						end
					end
					-- Otherwise finish the barricades.
					if not handled and (not closest or closestDistance > 18) then
						local job = barricade
						if job and job.done then
							job = nil
						end
						if not job then
							-- Help a teammate behind a piece too heavy to push alone.
							local alone = RoundRules.pushStrength(p.scale)
							for _, other in fort.jobs do
								if
									not other.done
									and other.body.Parent
									and count(other.pushers, now, 1) == 1
									and RoundRules.pushFraction(FurniturePush.mass(other.body), alone)
										< 0.45
								then
									job = other
									break
								end
							end
						end
						if not job then
							-- Our own doorway: one no teammate is already blocking.
							local busy: { [string]: boolean } = {}
							local used: { [BasePart]: boolean } = {}
							for _, other in fort.jobs do
								if not other.done then
									busy[other.key] = true
									used[other.body] = true
								end
							end
							for _, entry in roomDoors do
								local key = doorKey(entry.door)
								if fort.barricaded[key] or busy[key] then
									continue
								end
								-- A doorway into a teammate's fort is ours to share,
								-- not to wall up from both sides.
								local beyond = entry.center - entry.inward * 4
								local nextRoom = roomAt(beyond.X, beyond.Z)
								local nextFort = nextRoom and forts[nextRoom]
								if nextFort and count(nextFort.members, now, 3) > 0 then
									fort.barricaded[key] = true
									continue
								end
								-- Already blocked: pieces just inside cover most of it.
								local along = if entry.door.horizontal then Vector3.xAxis else Vector3.zAxis
								local half = entry.door.width / 2
								local zone = if entry.door.horizontal
									then Vector3.new(entry.door.width + 1, 4, 4)
									else Vector3.new(4, 4, entry.door.width + 1)
								local spans: { { number } } = {}
								for _, body in
									FurnitureService.findInBox(
										CFrame.new(entry.center + entry.inward * 3),
										zone
									)
								do
									local c = (body.Position - entry.center):Dot(along)
									local e = FurniturePush.extent(body, along)
									table.insert(spans, { math.max(-half, c - e), math.min(half, c + e) })
								end
								table.sort(spans, function(a, c)
									return a[1] < c[1]
								end)
								local covered, upTo = 0, -half
								for _, span in spans do
									if span[2] > upTo then
										covered += span[2] - math.max(span[1], upTo)
										upTo = span[2]
									end
								end
								if covered >= entry.door.width * 0.6 then
									fort.barricaded[key] = true
									continue
								end
								-- Close pieces that cover the doorway well (not the
								-- immovable ones, not one a teammate is using). First
								-- only ones with room to stand behind; failing that,
								-- any we could get round to.
								local piece: BasePart? = nil
								local pieceScore = math.huge
								for _, strict in { true, false } do
									if piece then
										break
									end
									for _, body in FurnitureService.piecesNear(entry.center, 30) do
										local d = Util.flatDistance(body.Position, entry.center)
										if
											used[body]
											or fort.bad[body]
											or FurnitureService.weightOf(body) == "Massive"
											or d <= 4
											or not MapLayout.inRect(r, body.Position.X, body.Position.Z)
										then
											continue
										end
										-- We have to get behind it (on the far side from the
										-- door): skip pieces backed against a wall or another piece.
										local to = Util.flat(entry.center + entry.inward * 3)
											- Util.flat(body.Position)
										local push = Util.flatUnit(to)
										if not push then
											continue
										end
										local behind = Util.flat(body.Position)
											- push
												* (FurniturePush.extent(body, push) + FurniturePush.bumperRadius(
													p.scale
												) + 0.6)
										local stand = Vector3.new(behind.X, here.Y, behind.Z)
										if
											not MapLayout.inRect(r, stand.X, stand.Z, -1.2)
											or (strict and #FurnitureService.findInBox(
												CFrame.new(stand),
												Vector3.new(3, 4, 3)
											) > 0)
											or not Combat.clearWide(
												Vector3.new(body.Position.X, here.Y, body.Position.Z),
												stand,
												0.5,
												true
											)
										then
											continue
										end
										local cover = FurniturePush.extent(body, along) * 2 / entry.door.width
										local score = d - 8 * math.min(cover, 1.2)
										if score < pieceScore then
											piece, pieceScore = body, score
										end
									end
								end
								if piece then
									local depth = FurniturePush.extent(piece, entry.inward)
									local made: Job = {
										body = piece,
										target = Util.flat(entry.center + entry.inward * (depth + 1.6)),
										key = key,
										startedAt = now,
										pushers = {},
										done = false,
									}
									table.insert(fort.jobs, made)
									job = made
									break
								end
								fort.barricaded[key] = true -- nothing to block it with
							end
						end
						barricade = job
						if job then
							job.pushers[p.id] = now
							local body = job.body
							local at = Util.flat(body.Position)
							local toTarget = job.target - at
							local holder = FurnitureService.heldBy(body)
							if body.Parent == nil or toTarget.Magnitude < 1.8 or now - job.startedAt > 20 then
								if holder == p.id then
									FurnitureService.release(p.id) -- in place: let go
								end
								job.done = true
								fort.barricaded[job.key] = true
								barricade = nil
							elseif holder == p.id then
								-- Carrying it: walk so that it lands in the doorway. If that
								-- would take us out of the room (we grabbed it from the
								-- wrong side), let go and come round behind it.
								local _, offset = FurnitureService.holding(p.id)
								local goal = job.target - offset
								if MapLayout.inRect(r, goal.X, goal.Z, -1) then
									goTo(Vector3.new(goal.X, here.Y, goal.Z), root, humanoid, false)
								else
									FurnitureService.release(p.id)
								end
								handled = true
							else
								-- Get behind it (on the far side from the doorway; a helper
								-- beside us), grab it, then carry it there.
								local push = toTarget.Unit
								local side = Vector3.new(-push.Z, 0, push.X)
								local offset = 0
								if count(job.pushers, now, 1) >= 2 then
									local first = true
									for id, seen in job.pushers do
										if now - seen < 1 and id < p.id then
											first = false
										end
									end
									offset = (if first then -1 else 1) * 1.4 * p.scale
								end
								local behind = at
									- push * (FurniturePush.extent(body, push) + FurniturePush.bumperRadius(
										p.scale
									) + 0.6)
									+ side * offset
								if Util.flatDistance(behind, here) > 2.5 then
									-- Can't get round to it? Someone picks another piece.
									if approachJob ~= job then
										approachJob, approachSince = job, now
									end
									if now - approachSince > 7 then
										fort.bad[body] = true
										job.done = true
										barricade = nil
									end
									goTo(Vector3.new(behind.X, here.Y, behind.Z), root, humanoid, false)
								elseif holder == nil then
									approachJob = nil
									if not FurnitureService.grab(p, body) then
										moveTo(humanoid, Vector3.new(at.X, here.Y, at.Z)) -- step in closer
									end
								else
									-- A teammate is carrying it: push alongside.
									approachJob = nil
									moveTo(
										humanoid,
										Vector3.new(job.target.X, here.Y, job.target.Z)
											+ push * 2
											+ side * offset
									)
								end
								handled = true
							end
						end
					end
					if not handled then
						-- Wait well back from the doors, each in our own spot.
						local away = Vector3.zero
						for _, entry in roomDoors do
							away += entry.inward
						end
						local ids = {}
						for id, seen in fort.members do
							if now - seen < 3 then
								table.insert(ids, id)
							end
						end
						table.sort(ids)
						local index = table.find(ids, p.id) or 1
						local angle = index / math.max(1, #ids) * math.pi * 2
						local ring = if #ids > 1 then 4 * p.scale else 0
						local spot = middle
							+ (if away.Magnitude > 0.1 then away.Unit else Vector3.zero) * 4
							+ Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * ring
						if not MapLayout.inRect(r, spot.X, spot.Z, -2) then
							spot = middle
						end
						moveTo(humanoid, spot)
						handled = true
					end
				end
				if handled then
					continue
				end
			end
		end

		-- Not building right now: don't keep dragging a piece around.
		if FurnitureService.holding(p.id) then
			FurnitureService.release(p.id)
		end
		local hidden = BushService.hidden(p)
		-- Hiders take a bush of their own just before the outbreak and keep
		-- still in it; one a zombie flushed them out of is given up.
		if role == "Hider" then
			if #threats > 0 and not hidden then
				myBush = nil
				myCorner = nil
			elseif
				not hidden
				and (phase == "Infection" or (phase == "Prep" and RoundManager.secondsLeft() < 15))
			then
				local bush = myBush
				if not bush or bush.Parent == nil then
					bush = freeBush(p, here)
					myBush = bush
				end
				if bush then
					doing("Heading for a bush")
					local spot = Vector3.new(bush.Position.X, here.Y, bush.Position.Z)
					goTo(spot, root, humanoid, false)
					checkProgress(root, spot, humanoid)
					continue
				end
				local corner = myCorner or quietCorner(p, here)
				myCorner = corner
				if corner then
					doing("Hiding in a corner")
					goTo(corner, root, humanoid, false)
					checkProgress(root, corner, humanoid)
					continue
				end
			end
		end
		if hidden and (not closest or closestDistance > Config.BUSH_REVEAL_DISTANCE + 4) then
			doing("Hiding")
			moveTo(humanoid, here) -- stay still and hope
		elseif #threats > 0 then
			doing("Running from zombies")
			local bush = if hider and not hidden then nearestBush(here, 30) else nil
			if bush and closest and Util.flatDistance(bush, here) < closestDistance * 0.8 then
				goTo(bush, root, humanoid, false)
				checkProgress(root, bush, humanoid)
			else
				-- Escape: try directions, keep the ones our body fits through,
				-- and pick the spot farthest from where the zombies are going,
				-- preferring open ground over dead ends.
				local stride = 12 + p.scale * 2
				local candidates: { { spot: Vector3, score: number } } = {}
				for i = 0, level.directions - 1 do
					local angle = i / level.directions * math.pi * 2 + random:NextNumber(-0.15, 0.15)
					local spot = here + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * stride
					if inBounds(spot, 5) and Combat.clearWide(here, spot, radius()) then
						local score = math.huge
						for _, zombie in threats do
							local future = zombie.position + zombie.velocity * 0.6
							score = math.min(score, Util.flatDistance(spot, future))
						end
						table.insert(candidates, { spot = spot, score = score })
					end
				end
				-- Doorways too: straight through one into the room (or out of it),
				-- which zombies have to funnel through after us.
				for _, door in doors() do
					local center = Vector3.new(door.x, here.Y, door.z)
					if Util.flatDistance(center, here) < 28 then
						local beyond = center + across(door, center * 2 - here) * 7
						if inBounds(beyond, 5) and Combat.clearWide(here, beyond, radius()) then
							local score = math.huge
							for _, zombie in threats do
								local future = zombie.position + zombie.velocity * 0.6
								score = math.min(score, Util.flatDistance(beyond, future))
							end
							table.insert(candidates, { spot = beyond, score = score + 4 })
						end
					end
				end
				table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
					return a.score > b.score
				end)
				local best: Vector3? = nil
				local bestScore = -math.huge
				for i = 1, math.min(3, #candidates) do
					local c = candidates[i]
					local open = 0
					for j = 0, 3 do
						local angle = j / 4 * math.pi * 2
						if
							Combat.clearWide(
								c.spot,
								c.spot + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * 10,
								radius()
							)
						then
							open += 1
						end
					end
					local score = c.score + open * 3
					if score > bestScore then
						best, bestScore = c.spot, score
					end
				end
				if best then
					moveTo(humanoid, best)
					pathGoal = nil
				elseif closest then
					local step = sidestep(root, here + (here - closest.position))
					if step then
						moveTo(humanoid, step)
					end
				end
			end
		elseif phase == "Prep" and not p.heldItem then
			local spot = nearestItem(here, 90, p.id)
			doing(if spot then "Getting an item" else "Exploring")
			if spot then
				if Util.flatDistance(spot, here) < Config.PICKUP_RADIUS then
					ItemService.pickUp(p)
				else
					goTo(spot, root, humanoid, false)
					checkProgress(root, spot, humanoid)
				end
			else
				wander()
			end
		else
			doing(
				if role == "Runner" and phase == "Infection" then "Keeping away from zombies" else "Wandering"
			)
			wander()
		end
	end
	chasing[p.id] = nil
end

-- Roster ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Bots playing now: "R<roster index>" for the regular roster, "C<n>" for
-- the Mario Clones an admin adds.
local active: { [string]: Participant } = {}
local nextId = 0

local function randomSkin(team: Skins.Team): string
	local list = Skins.forTeam(team)
	return list[rng:NextInteger(1, #list)].id
end

-- Only a few bots dress up (Config.BOTS_WITH_SKINS); the rest look classic.
local function dressedUp(): number
	local count = 0
	for _, p in active do
		if p.humanSkin ~= Skins.DEFAULT_HUMAN then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

local function addBot(key: string, name: string, levelNumber: number)
	local level = LEVELS[levelNumber] or LEVELS[5]
	nextId += 1
	local p = Participants.add({
		id = "B" .. nextId,
		name = name,
		isBot = true,
	})
	if dressedUp() < Config.BOTS_WITH_SKINS and rng:NextNumber() < 0.35 then
		repeat
			p.humanSkin = randomSkin("Human")
		until p.humanSkin ~= Skins.DEFAULT_HUMAN
	end
	p.adminSpeed = level.speed
	p.state:SetAttribute("BotLevel", levelNumber)
	p.state:SetAttribute("BotDoing", "Joining")
	Participants.publish(p)
	if p.character then
		CharacterService.applyLook(p)
	end
	CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	active[key] = p
	-- A bot whose brain hits an error says so and starts thinking again,
	-- instead of standing still for the rest of the game.
	local seed = nextId * 97 + os.time()
	task.spawn(function()
		while Participants.get(p.id) == p do
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				brain(p, level, seed)
			end)
			if ok then
				break
			end
			warn(string.format("[Bots] %s: %s", p.name, tostring(err)))
			seed += 1
			task.wait(1)
		end
	end)
end

-- Sharp movement, like players get from their own client: full speed the
-- instant a bot walks, a dead stop the instant it arrives, and it turns on
-- the spot (a Humanoid alone eases in and out and slides on the floors).
-- A shove (KnockbackForce) plays out untouched.
local function drive()
	for _, p in active do
		local root, humanoid = Participants.body(p)
		if not root or not humanoid or root:FindFirstChild("KnockbackForce") then
			continue
		end
		-- Never left inside a piece of furniture: out the shortest way.
		local radius = Config.rootWidth(p.scale) / 2 * 0.9
		local here = Util.flat(root.Position)
		local around = Vector3.new(radius * 2 + 2, root.Size.Y + 2, radius * 2 + 2)
		for _, body in FurnitureService.findInBox(CFrame.new(root.Position), around) do
			local depth, out = FurniturePush.overlapOut(here, here, radius, body)
			if out then
				root.CFrame += out * math.min(depth, 1)
			end
		end
		local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		-- Toward the spot the bot was last sent to (bots re-aim several times
		-- a second, so a goal older than that means: stand still).
		local goal: Vector3? = walkGoal[humanoid]
		local toGoal = Vector3.zero
		if goal and os.clock() - (walkAt[humanoid] or 0) < 1.5 then
			toGoal = Util.flat(goal - root.Position)
		end
		local move = if toGoal.Magnitude > 0.6 then toGoal.Unit else nil
		local speed = humanoid.WalkSpeed * FurnitureService.dragFactor(p)
		-- Personal space (humans): ease away from anyone we're pressed
		-- against, so bots slide past each other instead of jamming. Zombies
		-- don't: a queue of them leaning on each other is how they shove.
		local apart = Vector3.zero
		if p.team == "Human" then
			local mine = Config.CHARACTER.ShellDiameter / 2 * p.scale
			for _, other in Participants.all() do
				local oRoot = if other ~= p and other.team == "Human" then Participants.body(other) else nil
				if oRoot then
					local rel = Util.flat(root.Position - oRoot.Position)
					local gap = rel.Magnitude - (mine + Config.CHARACTER.ShellDiameter / 2 * other.scale + 1)
					if gap < 0 and rel.Magnitude > 0.05 then
						apart += rel.Unit * math.min(-gap * 5, 8)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if move and speed > 0 then
			stopped[humanoid] = nil
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(move.X * speed + apart.X, v.Y, move.Z * speed + apart.Z)
			-- Not aiming a weapon: turn quickly toward where we walk. A spin,
			-- not a teleport of the rotation, so it replicates smoothly.
			local look = Util.flatUnit(root.CFrame.LookVector)
			if humanoid.AutoRotate and look then
				local angle = math.atan2(look.Z * move.X - look.X * move.Z, look:Dot(move))
				root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.clamp(angle * 14, -24, 24), 0)
			end
		elseif not stopped[humanoid] then
			-- Arrived (or nothing new for a while): stop dead, and tell the
			-- Humanoid too so it doesn't keep nudging toward the old spot.
			stopped[humanoid] = true
			humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position)
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(apart.X, v.Y, apart.Z)
			root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		elseif apart.Magnitude > 0.3 then
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(apart.X, v.Y, apart.Z) -- standing: make room
		elseif math.abs(v.X) + math.abs(v.Z) > 0.05 then
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, v.Y, 0)
		end
	end
end

-- The numbers of the Mario Clones playing, lowest first.
local function cloneNumbers(): { number }
	local out = {}
	for key in active do
		if string.sub(key, 1, 1) == "C" then
			table.insert(out, tonumber(string.sub(key, 2)) :: number)
		end
	end
	table.sort(out)
	return out
end

local driving = false
local function startDriving()
	if not driving then
		driving = true
		RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(drive)
	end
end

-- How many regular bots this round: a random count in range, leaving room
-- for real players and the admin's clones.
local function wanted(): number
	local players = #Players:GetPlayers()
	local room = math.max(0, Config.MAX_PARTICIPANTS - players - #cloneNumbers())
	return math.min(rng:NextInteger(Config.BOTS_MIN, Config.BOTS_MAX), room, #ROSTER)
end

local function rebalance()
	local target = wanted()
	local count = 0
	for index = 1, #ROSTER do
		if active["R" .. index] then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	-- Add in roster order (Mario Robles first), remove from the end.
	for index = 1, #ROSTER do
		if count >= target then
			break
		end
		if not active["R" .. index] then
			local entry = ROSTER[index]
			addBot("R" .. index, entry.name, entry.level)
			count += 1
		end
	end
	for index = #ROSTER, 2, -1 do
		if count <= target then
			break
		end
		local p = active["R" .. index]
		if p then
			active["R" .. index] = nil
			Participants.remove(p)
			count -= 1
		end
	end
end

-- Admin: add `count` more Mario Clones (Mario Clone 1, Mario Clone 2...),
-- as smart as Mario Robles. They stay until removed, round after round.
-- Returns how many joined (the server holds Config.MAX_PARTICIPANTS).
function BotService.addClones(count: number): number
	startDriving()
	local added = 0
	for _ = 1, math.clamp(math.floor(count), 0, 40) do
		if #Participants.all() >= Config.MAX_PARTICIPANTS then
			break
		end
		local n = 1 -- the lowest free number
		while active["C" .. n] do
			n += 1
		end
		addBot("C" .. n, "Mario Clone " .. n, 6)
		added += 1
	end
	return added
end

-- Admin: remove the newest `count` Mario Clones (all of them if nil).
function BotService.removeClones(count: number?): number
	local numbers = cloneNumbers()
	local removed = 0
	for i = #numbers, 1, -1 do
		if count and removed >= count then
			break
		end
		local key = "C" .. numbers[i]
		local p = active[key]
		active[key] = nil
		if p then
			Participants.remove(p)
			removed += 1
		end
	end
	return removed
end

-- Admin: remove one bot by participant id (a clone or a regular bot; Mario
-- Robles too, until the next round brings the roster back).
function BotService.remove(id: string): boolean
	for key, p in active do
		if p.id == id then
			active[key] = nil
			Participants.remove(p)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function BotService.cloneCount(): number
	return #cloneNumbers()
end

function BotService.start()
	if not Config.BOTS then
		return
	end
	rebalance()
	startDriving()
	print("[Bots] bots are playing. Set Config.BOTS = false to turn them off.")
	-- A fresh mix of bots for every round.
	local state = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BrainTagState")
	state:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Phase"):Connect(function()
		if state:GetAttribute("Phase") == "Prep" then
			rebalance()
		end
	end)
end

return BotService

scripts.name: BushService
scripts.source:
-- Flags characters standing in a bush, or wearing the Magic Cloak (character
-- attribute "InBush"), so bots can't see them. Clients work out the visual side (name tags, see-through
-- canopy) themselves from the same shared geometry.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Bushes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Bushes)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

type Participant = Participants.Participant

local BushService = {}

local INTERVAL = 0.1

function BushService.hidden(p: Participant): boolean
	local character = p.character
	return character ~= nil and character:GetAttribute(Bushes.ATTRIBUTE) == true
end

-- Whether someone at `from` can spot `p`: always, unless `p` is in a bush
-- and the looker is farther than the reveal distance.
function BushService.visibleFrom(p: Participant, from: Vector3): boolean
	if not BushService.hidden(p) then
		return true
	end
	local root = Participants.body(p)
	return root ~= nil and Util.flatDistance(root.Position, from) <= Config.BUSH_REVEAL_DISTANCE
end

function BushService.init()
	local elapsed = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		elapsed += dt
		if elapsed < INTERVAL then
			return
		end
		elapsed = 0
		for _, p in Participants.all() do
			local character = p.character
			if character then
				local root = Participants.body(p)
				local cloak = character:GetAttribute(Bushes.CLOAK_ATTRIBUTE)
				local cloaked = typeof(cloak) == "number" and cloak > workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
				local hidden = root ~= nil and (cloaked or Bushes.coverAt(root.Position) ~= nil)
				if character:GetAttribute(Bushes.ATTRIBUTE) ~= hidden then
					character:SetAttribute(Bushes.ATTRIBUTE, hidden)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return BushService

scripts.name: CharacterService
scripts.source:
-- Spawns and dresses characters. Every player and bot uses the same custom
-- rig: an invisible collision box (HumanoidRootPart) with a Humanoid, wearing
-- the flat blob look from CharacterLook. Avatars, clothes and accessories are
-- never loaded.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local StarterPlayer = game:GetService("StarterPlayer")

local CharacterLook = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.CharacterLook)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Parts = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Parts)
local RoundRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RoundRules)
local Skins = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Skins)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)

local C = Config.CHARACTER

local CharacterService = {}

type Participant = Participants.Participant

-- Called when a character died or vanished and needs a new one. RoundManager
-- sets this so it can choose the right spawn for the current phase.
CharacterService.onNeedRespawn = function(_p: Participant) end

-- Called after a participant's size changed, so the held item can be
-- re-attached at the new grip. ItemService sets this.
CharacterService.onResized = function(_p: Participant) end

local template: Model

function CharacterService.buildTemplate()
	local existing = StarterPlayer:FindFirstChild("StarterCharacter")
	if existing then
		existing:Destroy()
	end
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "StarterCharacter"

	local root = Parts.make({
		name = "HumanoidRootPart",
		size = Vector3.new(C.RootWidth, C.RootHeight, C.RootWidth),
		cframe = CFrame.new(0, 5, 0),
		color = "FFFFFF",
		transparency = 1,
		anchored = false,
		parent = model,
	})
	root.CanQuery = true -- the hitbox for potatoes and line-of-sight checks
	model.PrimaryPart = root

	local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
	humanoid.RigType = Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
	humanoid.HipHeight = C.HipHeight
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.BASE_WALKSPEED
	humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
	humanoid.JumpPower = 0
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	humanoid.RequiresNeck = false
	humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
	humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
	humanoid.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
	humanoid.Parent = model

	CharacterLook.apply(model, root, nil, "Human", 1)
	model.Parent = StarterPlayer
	template = model
end

local function nameColor(p: Participant): Color3
	if p.turning then
		return Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.ZombieText) -- about to turn: red for everyone
	end
	if p.passes.VIP then
		return Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.VipName)
	end
	return Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.OtherName)
end

local function updateNameTag(p: Participant)
	local character = p.character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
	if not head then
		return
	end
	local tag = head:FindFirstChild("NameTag") :: BillboardGui?
	if not tag then
		local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		gui.Name = "NameTag"
		gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 24)
		gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
		gui.LightInfluence = 0
		gui.MaxDistance = 1000
		gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = "Label"
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		label.Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSansBold
		label.TextSize = 16
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35
		label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
		label.Parent = gui
		gui.Parent = head
		tag = gui
	end
	assert(tag, "tag")
	tag.Adornee = head
	-- World offset toward -Z = "up" on the top-down screen.
	tag.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 1, -(C.BodyWidth * 0.5 + 0.7) * p.scale)
	tag:SetAttribute("ParticipantId", p.id)
	local label = tag:FindFirstChild("Label") :: TextLabel
	label.Text = (if p.passes.VIP then "[VIP] " else "") .. p.name
	label.TextColor3 = nameColor(p)
end

function CharacterService.skinFor(p: Participant): string
	-- Every zombie looks the same, except the round's alpha.
	if p.team == "Zombie" then
		return if p.alpha or p.zombieSkin == "Alpha" then "Alpha" else Skins.DEFAULT_ZOMBIE
	end
	return p.humanSkin
end

-- An invisible cylinder the size of the drawn body. Only other characters'
-- shells collide with it (see WorldSetup), so characters bump into each
-- other while the narrow root box still decides what fits through doors.
-- Furniture hits the wider bumper instead.
local function addShell(character: Model, root: BasePart, scale: number)
	local old = character:FindFirstChild("Shell")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local diameter = C.ShellDiameter * scale
	local shell = Instance.new("Part")
	shell.Name = "Shell"
	shell.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	shell.Size = Vector3.new(C.RootHeight * scale, diameter, diameter)
	shell.CFrame = root.CFrame * Parts.UPRIGHT
	shell.Transparency = 1
	shell.Massless = true
	shell.CanCollide = true
	shell.CanQuery = false
	shell.CanTouch = true -- your client plays a bump sound on contact
	shell.CastShadow = false
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = root
	weld.Part1 = shell
	weld.Parent = shell
	shell.Parent = character
	shell.CollisionGroup = "CharacterShells"
end

-- A wider invisible cylinder only furniture collides with (see WorldSetup):
-- it keeps a little space between you and what you push.
local function addBumper(character: Model, root: BasePart, scale: number)
	local old = character:FindFirstChild("Bumper")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local diameter = Config.bumperRadius(scale) * 2
	local bumper = Instance.new("Part")
	bumper.Name = "Bumper"
	bumper.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	bumper.Size = Vector3.new(C.RootHeight * scale, diameter, diameter)
	bumper.CFrame = root.CFrame * Parts.UPRIGHT
	bumper.Transparency = 1
	bumper.Massless = true
	bumper.CanCollide = true
	bumper.CanQuery = false
	bumper.CanTouch = false
	bumper.CastShadow = false
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = root
	weld.Part1 = bumper
	weld.Parent = bumper
	bumper.Parent = character
	bumper.CollisionGroup = "Bumpers"
end

-- Rebuilds the look for the participant's team, skin and size.
function CharacterService.applyLook(p: Participant)
	local character = p.character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	local width = Config.rootWidth(p.scale)
	root.Size = Vector3.new(width, C.RootHeight * p.scale, width)
	-- Hip height stays fixed while the body grows, so even giant players keep
	-- their collision box low enough to bump into benches and coffee tables.
	humanoid.HipHeight = C.HipHeight
	CharacterLook.apply(character, root, CharacterService.skinFor(p), p.team, p.scale)
	for _, part in character:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CollisionGroup = "Characters"
		end
	end
	addShell(character, root, p.scale)
	addBumper(character, root, p.scale)
	character:SetAttribute("Team", p.team)
	updateNameTag(p)
end

function CharacterService.refreshNameTag(p: Participant)
	updateNameTag(p)
end

-- Size follows score live: call after a participant's score changes. Only
-- rebuilds the look when the size really changed.
function CharacterService.refreshSize(p: Participant)
	local scale = RoundRules.scaleForScore(p.score)
	if math.abs(scale - p.scale) < 0.01 then
		return
	end
	p.scale = scale
	p.state:SetAttribute("Scale", scale)
	CharacterService.applyLook(p)
	CharacterService.onResized(p)
end

function CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p: Participant)
	local _, humanoid = Participants.body(p)
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < p.stunUntil then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
		return
	end
	local speed = RoundRules.walkSpeed(p.score, p.team == "Zombie") * p.adminSpeed
	if now < p.boostUntil then
		speed *= p.boostFactor
	end
	if now < p.slowUntil then
		speed *= p.slowFactor
	end
	if p.turning then
		speed *= Config.TURNING_SLOW
	end
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed
end

-- Speeds a participant up (energy drink) or down (snowball) for a while.
function CharacterService.speedEffect(p: Participant, factor: number, seconds: number)
	local untilTime = os.clock() + seconds
	if factor >= 1 then
		p.boostFactor, p.boostUntil = factor, math.max(p.boostUntil, untilTime)
	else
		p.slowFactor, p.slowUntil = factor, math.max(p.slowUntil, untilTime)
	end
	CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	task.delay(seconds + 0.05, function()
		CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	end)
end

local function setup(p: Participant, character: Model)
	p.character = character
	character:SetAttribute("ParticipantId", p.id)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	assert(humanoid, "character has no Humanoid")
	humanoid.AutoRotate = p.isBot -- players face the mouse from their client
	humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
	CharacterService.applyLook(p)
	CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		task.delay(2, function()
			if Participants.get(p.id) == p and p.character == character then
				CharacterService.onNeedRespawn(p)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

local function spawnBot(p: Participant, at: CFrame): Model
	local character = template:Clone()
	character.Name = p.name
	character:PivotTo(at)
	character.Parent = workspace:WaitForChild("Bots")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart
	pcall(function()
		root:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	end)
	setup(p, character)
	return character
end

local function spawnPlayer(p: Participant, at: CFrame): Model?
	local player = p.player
	if not player or player.Parent ~= Players then
		return nil
	end
	player:LoadCharacter()
	local character = player.Character
	if not character or Participants.get(p.id) ~= p then
		return nil
	end
	setup(p, character)
	character:PivotTo(at)
	return character
end

-- Gives the participant a fresh character standing at `at`.
function CharacterService.spawn(p: Participant, at: CFrame): Model?
	if p.spawning then
		return nil -- a spawn is already in progress (LoadCharacter yields)
	end
	p.spawning = true
	local ok, result = pcall(function(): Model?
		if p.isBot then
			if p.character then
				p.character:Destroy()
			end
			return spawnBot(p, at)
		end
		return spawnPlayer(p, at)
	end)
	p.spawning = false
	if not ok then
		warn("[Characters] spawn failed for " .. p.name .. ": " .. tostring(result))
		return nil
	end
	return result
end

-- Moves an existing living character, or spawns one if there is none.
function CharacterService.place(p: Participant, at: CFrame)
	if p.spawning then
		return
	end
	local root = Participants.body(p)
	if not root or not p.character then
		CharacterService.spawn(p, at)
		return
	end
	p.character:PivotTo(at)
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

function CharacterService.init()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		player.CanLoadCharacterAppearance = false
	end)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		player.CanLoadCharacterAppearance = false
	end
end

return CharacterService

scripts.name: Combat
scripts.source:
-- Shoves and stuns. Weapons never kill: they push zombies away and freeze
-- them for a moment. Players' characters are simulated by their own clients,
-- so their shove is sent to them; bots are shoved right here.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Knockback = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Knockback)
local MapBuilder = require(script.Parent.MapBuilder)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

type Participant = Participants.Participant

local Combat = {}

local knockbackRemote = Remotes.event("Knockback")
local wallParams = RaycastParams.new()
wallParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
local solidParams = RaycastParams.new()
solidParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
local sightParams = RaycastParams.new()
sightParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

function Combat.init()
	wallParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { MapBuilder.wallsFolder() }
	solidParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { MapBuilder.wallsFolder(), workspace:WaitForChild("Furniture") }
	sightParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { MapBuilder.wallsFolder() }
end

-- Can someone at `from` see `to`? Walls (fake ones too) block the view (bots
-- on dark maps use this).
function Combat.canSee(from: Vector3, to: Vector3): boolean
	local y = MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor + 3
	local a = Vector3.new(from.X, y, from.Z)
	local b = Vector3.new(to.X, y, to.Z)
	return workspace:Raycast(a, b - a, sightParams) == nil
end

-- Like lineOfSight, but furniture blocks too (used for infection, so a
-- barricade always protects the people behind it).
function Combat.clearPath(from: Vector3, to: Vector3): boolean
	-- Low enough to hit every piece of furniture, whatever the players' size.
	local y = MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor + 1.4
	local a = Vector3.new(from.X, y, from.Z)
	local b = Vector3.new(to.X, y, to.Z)
	return workspace:Raycast(a, b - a, solidParams) == nil
end

-- Like clearPath, but for a body `radius` wide, so bots never try to squeeze
-- past a wall corner. With `wallsOnly`, furniture doesn't count (a zombie
-- may shove through a barricade).
function Combat.clearWide(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, radius: number, wallsOnly: boolean?): boolean
	local y = MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor + 1.4
	local a = Vector3.new(from.X, y, from.Z)
	local direction = Vector3.new(to.X, y, to.Z) - a
	if direction.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		return true
	end
	return workspace:Spherecast(a, radius, direction, if wallsOnly then wallParams else solidParams) == nil
end

-- True when no (unbroken) wall stands between the two points.
function Combat.lineOfSight(from: Vector3, to: Vector3): boolean
	local y = math.max(from.Y, to.Y)
	local a = Vector3.new(from.X, y, from.Z)
	local b = Vector3.new(to.X, y, to.Z)
	return workspace:Raycast(a, b - a, wallParams) == nil
end

function Combat.wallParams(): RaycastParams
	return wallParams
end

-- `gentle` shoves (a zombie leaning on a held weapon) never cut short a
-- real hit that is still sending the zombie flying.
function Combat.knockback(
	target: Participant,
	velocity: Vector3,
	stun: number,
	seconds: number?,
	gentle: boolean?
)
	local root = Participants.body(target)
	local character = target.character
	if not root or not character then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if gentle and now < target.knockedUntil then
		return
	end
	if stun > 0 then
		target.stunUntil = math.max(target.stunUntil, os.clock() + stun)
		CharacterService.refreshSpeed(target)
		task.delay(stun + 0.05, function()
			CharacterService.refreshSpeed(target)
		end)
	end
	local duration = seconds or Config.KNOCKBACK_SECONDS
	if not gentle then
		target.knockedUntil = now + duration
	end
	if target.player then
		knockbackRemote:FireClient(target.player, velocity, duration)
	else
		Knockback.apply(character, velocity, duration)
	end
end

-- Area blast (duck launcher): shoves everyone within `radius` away from the
-- center, with a classic (harmless) Roblox explosion for show.
function Combat.explode(at: Vector3, radius: number, knockback: number, stun: number)
	local boom = Instance.new("Explosion")
	boom.Position = at
	boom.BlastRadius = radius
	boom.BlastPressure = 0
	boom.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
	boom.ExplosionType = Enum.ExplosionType.NoCraters
	boom.Parent = workspace
	for _, person in Participants.all() do
		local root = Participants.body(person)
		if root then
			local offset = Util.flat(root.Position - at)
			if offset.Magnitude <= radius and Combat.lineOfSight(at, root.Position) then
				local away = if offset.Magnitude > 0.1 then offset.Unit else Vector3.xAxis
				local falloff = 1 - offset.Magnitude / radius * 0.5
				Combat.knockback(person, away * knockback * falloff, stun)
			end
		end
	end
end

export type Hit = { target: Participant, direction: Vector3, distance: number }

-- Everyone else (zombies and humans) inside a cone in front of `attacker`,
-- not behind walls: weapons push people on both teams.
function Combat.peopleInCone(attacker: Participant, aim: Vector3, reach: number, arcDegrees: number): { Hit }
	local root = Participants.body(attacker)
	local hits = {}
	if not root then
		return hits
	end
	local cosHalf = math.cos(math.rad(arcDegrees / 2))
	local myRadius = root.Size.X / 2
	for _, other in Participants.all() do
		local zRoot = if other ~= attacker then Participants.body(other) else nil
		if zRoot then
			local offset = Util.flat(zRoot.Position - root.Position)
			local distance = offset.Magnitude
			local zRadius = zRoot.Size.X / 2
			if distance > 0.01 and distance <= reach + zRadius then
				local direction = offset.Unit
				local touching = distance <= myRadius + zRadius + 0.6
				if
					(touching or direction:Dot(aim) >= cosHalf)
					and Combat.lineOfSight(root.Position, zRoot.Position)
				then
					table.insert(hits, { target = other, direction = direction, distance = distance })
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return hits
end

return Combat

scripts.name: DataService
scripts.source:
-- Saves each player's points, best score, stats, skins and purchases with
-- DataStoreService. Coming back costs a little: you rejoin with
-- Config.REJOIN_KEEP of your points (Participants). BestScore keeps the most
-- you ever had.
--
-- Safety rules:
--  * Every DataStore call is wrapped in pcall and retried with backoff.
--  * If a player's data fails to load, the session uses defaults and is NEVER
--    saved, so a hiccup can't overwrite real progress with zeros.
--  * In Studio without "Enable Studio Access to API Services" (Game Settings >
--    Security), saving is off for the session and a single warning explains why.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Skins = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Skins)

local DataService = {}

local VERSION = 1
local MAX_RECEIPTS = 100

export type Profile = {
	Version: number,
	Score: number, -- points right now
	BestScore: number, -- most points ever; the all-time board
	Wins: number,
	Infections: number,
	RoundsPlayed: number,
	OwnedSkins: { [string]: boolean },
	HumanSkin: string,
	ZombieSkin: string,
	SeenTutorial: boolean,
	BoostEndsAt: number,
	PendingItems: { string },
	Receipts: { [string]: number },
}

type Session = {
	data: Profile,
	loaded: boolean, -- false = defaults after a failed load; never saved
	saving: boolean,
}

local sessions: { [Player]: Session } = {}
local store: DataStore? = nil
local orderedStore: OrderedDataStore? = nil
local available = false
local warned = false

local function defaults(): Profile
	return {
		Version = VERSION,
		Score = 0,
		BestScore = 0,
		Wins = 0,
		Infections = 0,
		RoundsPlayed = 0,
		OwnedSkins = { [Skins.DEFAULT_HUMAN] = true, [Skins.DEFAULT_ZOMBIE] = true },
		HumanSkin = Skins.DEFAULT_HUMAN,
		ZombieSkin = Skins.DEFAULT_ZOMBIE,
		SeenTutorial = false,
		BoostEndsAt = 0,
		PendingItems = {},
		Receipts = {},
	}
end

-- Fills in any fields added after a player's data was first saved.
local function reconcile(saved: any): Profile
	local data = defaults()
	if type(saved) ~= "table" then
		return data
	end
	for key, value in saved do
		if (data :: any)[key] ~= nil and type(value) == type((data :: any)[key]) then
			(data :: any)[key] = value
		end
	end
	data.OwnedSkins[Skins.DEFAULT_HUMAN] = true
	data.OwnedSkins[Skins.DEFAULT_ZOMBIE] = true
	return data
end

local function warnOnce(message: string)
	if not warned then
		warned = true
		warn("[Data] " .. message)
	end
end

local function retry<T>(label: string, fn: () -> T): (boolean, T?)
	local lastError
	for attempt = 1, 4 do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		lastError = result
		task.wait(attempt * 1.5)
	end
	warn(string.format("[Data] %s failed: %s", label, tostring(lastError)))
	return false, nil
end

local function key(player: Player): string
	return "u_" .. player.UserId
end

function DataService.init()
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DATASTORE_NAME)
	end)
	if ok then
		store = result
		local okOrdered, ordered = pcall(function()
			return DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore(Config.LEADERBOARD_STORE_NAME)
		end)
		if okOrdered then
			orderedStore = ordered
		end
		-- A cheap read tells us whether DataStores actually work here.
		local probe = pcall(function()
			(store :: DataStore):GetAsync("__probe")
		end)
		available = probe
	end
	if not available then
		if RunService:IsStudio() then
			warnOnce(
				"Saving is OFF in this test. To save in Studio: publish the place (File > Publish to Roblox), then Game Settings > Security > Enable Studio Access to API Services."
			)
		else
			warnOnce("DataStores are unavailable right now; this server will not save.")
		end
	end

	game:BindToClose(function()
		local threads = {}
		for player in sessions do
			table.insert(
				threads,
				task.spawn(function()
					DataService.save(player)
				end)
			)
		end
		-- Give saves time to finish (BindToClose allows about 30 seconds).
		local deadline = os.clock() + 25
		while os.clock() < deadline do
			local busy = false
			for _, session in sessions do
				if session.saving then
					busy = true
				end
			end
			if not busy then
				break
			end
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(Config.AUTOSAVE_SECONDS)
			for player in sessions do
				task.spawn(DataService.save, player)
			end
		end
	end)
end

function DataService.isAvailable(): boolean
	return available
end

-- Loads (yields). Always returns a profile; check `isSaved` to know whether
-- it came from the DataStore.
function DataService.load(player: Player): Profile
	local session: Session = { data = defaults(), loaded = false, saving = false }
	if available and store then
		local ok, saved = retry("load " .. player.UserId, function()
			return (store :: DataStore):GetAsync(key(player))
		end)
		if ok then
			session.data = reconcile(saved)
			session.loaded = true
		end
	end
	if player.Parent ~= Players then
		-- They left while we were loading: never register (or autosave) this
		-- stale copy, or it could overwrite progress made in another server.
		return session.data
	end
	sessions[player] = session
	return session.data
end

function DataService.get(player: Player): Profile?
	local session = sessions[player]
	return session and session.data
end

function DataService.isSaved(player: Player): boolean
	local session = sessions[player]
	return session ~= nil and session.loaded
end

-- Keeps the receipt log small: drops the oldest entries past MAX_RECEIPTS.
local function trimReceipts(data: Profile)
	local list = {}
	for id, at in data.Receipts do
		table.insert(list, { id = id, at = at })
	end
	if #list <= MAX_RECEIPTS then
		return
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return a.at > b.at
	end)
	for i = MAX_RECEIPTS + 1, #list do
		data.Receipts[list[i].id] = nil
	end
end

-- Writes the player's profile. Returns true when it reached the DataStore.
function DataService.save(player: Player): boolean
	local session = sessions[player]
