	if not session or not session.loaded or not available or not store then
		return false
	end
	while session.saving do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	session.saving = true
	trimReceipts(session.data)
	local snapshot = table.clone(session.data)
	local ok = retry("save " .. player.UserId, function()
		(store :: DataStore):UpdateAsync(key(player), function()
			return snapshot
		end)
		return true
	end)
	if ok and orderedStore then
		pcall(function()
			(orderedStore :: OrderedDataStore):SetAsync(
				tostring(player.UserId),
				math.floor(snapshot.BestScore)
			)
		end)
	end
	session.saving = false
	return ok
end

function DataService.release(player: Player)
	DataService.save(player)
	sessions[player] = nil
end

-- Top scores across all servers, best first: { { userId, score } }.
function DataService.topScores(count: number): { { userId: number, score: number } }
	local result = {}
	if not available or not orderedStore then
		return result
	end
	local ok, page = pcall(function()
		return (orderedStore :: OrderedDataStore):GetSortedAsync(false, count):GetCurrentPage()
	end)
	if ok and page then
		for _, entry in page do
			local id = tonumber(entry.key)
			if id then
				table.insert(result, { userId = id, score = entry.value })
			end
		end
	end
	return result
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	if sessions[player] then
		DataService.release(player)
	end
end)

return DataService

scripts.name: FurnitureBuilder
scripts.source:
-- Builds one furniture piece: an invisible-to-physics stack of colored details
-- welded onto a single "Body" part that carries all the mass and collision.
-- Details are designed to read clearly from straight above.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local FurnitureSpecs = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.FurnitureSpecs)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Parts = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Parts)

local FurnitureBuilder = {}

-- Context passed to each design: adds parts relative to the body center.
type Ctx = {
	w: number,
	d: number,
	h: number,
	body: Part,
	model: Model,
	-- Block whose top sits `raise` studs above the body's top.
	top: (
		self: Ctx,
		x: number,
		z: number,
		sx: number,
		sz: number,
		raise: number,
		thickness: number,
		color: string,
		yaw: number?
	) -> Part,
	disc: (
		self: Ctx,
		x: number,
		z: number,
		diameter: number,
		raise: number,
		thickness: number,
		color: string
	) -> Part,
	ball: (self: Ctx, x: number, y: number, z: number, diameter: number, color: string) -> Part,
}

local function newCtx(model: Model, body: Part, w: number, d: number, h: number): Ctx
	local ctx = { w = w, d = d, h = h, body = body, model = model } :: any

	function ctx.top(self: Ctx, x, z, sx, sz, raise, thickness, color, yaw)
		local y = self.h / 2 + raise - thickness / 2
		local part = Parts.make({
			name = "Detail",
			size = Vector3.new(sx, thickness, sz),
			cframe = self.body.CFrame * CFrame.new(x, y, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw or 0, 0),
			color = color,
			parent = self.model,
		})
		return part
	end

	function ctx.disc(self: Ctx, x, z, diameter, raise, thickness, color)
		local y = self.h / 2 + raise - thickness / 2
		return Parts.make({
			name = "Detail",
			shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
			size = Vector3.new(thickness, diameter, diameter),
			cframe = self.body.CFrame * CFrame.new(x, y, z) * Parts.UPRIGHT,
			color = color,
			parent = self.model,
		})
	end

	function ctx.ball(self: Ctx, x, y, z, diameter, color)
		return Parts.make({
			name = "Detail",
			shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
			size = Vector3.one * diameter,
			cframe = self.body.CFrame * CFrame.new(x, y, z),
			color = color,
			parent = self.model,
		})
	end

	return ctx :: Ctx
end

local UPRIGHT_FRAME = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.zAxis) -- X axis points up

export type Built = {
	model: Model,
	body: Part,
	kind: string,
	weight: FurnitureSpecs.Weight,
	decor: boolean,
	home: CFrame,
}

-- The piece's parts, posed at its spot (body first, no physics yet).
local function draw(spot: MapLayout.FurnitureSpot): (Model, Part, CFrame)
	local spec = FurnitureSpecs.get(spot.kind)
	local design = DESIGNS[spot.kind]
	local floorTop = MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor
	local decor = spec.decor == true
	local baseY = if decor then MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Rug - spec.h / 2 else floorTop + spec.h / 2 + 0.02
	local home = CFrame.new(spot.x, baseY, spot.z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(spot.rot), 0)

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = spot.kind
	local body = Parts.make({
		name = "Body",
		size = Vector3.new(spec.w, spec.h, spec.d),
		cframe = home,
		color = design.body,
		transparency = if design.transparentBody then 1 else 0,
		parent = model,
	})
	model.PrimaryPart = body

	design.draw(newCtx(model, body, spec.w, spec.d, spec.h))

	if not design.transparentBody and not decor then
		-- A darker, slightly bigger copy just under the top: from above it
		-- draws the thick outline the original's furniture has.
		local base = Color3.fromHex(design.body)
		Parts.make({
			name = "Outline",
			size = Vector3.new(spec.w + 0.4, spec.h - 0.04, spec.d + 0.4),
			cframe = home * CFrame.new(0, -0.02, 0),
			color = Color3.new(base.R * 0.55, base.G * 0.55, base.B * 0.55),
			parent = model,
		})
	end
	return model, body, home
end

-- A still, anchored copy for editing maps in Studio (MapStudio). Its pivot
-- is the spot: move or turn it and the map follows.
function FurnitureBuilder.preview(spot: MapLayout.FurnitureSpot, parent: Instance): Model
	local model = draw(spot)
	for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Anchored = true
		end
	end
	model.Parent = parent
	return model
end

function FurnitureBuilder.build(spot: MapLayout.FurnitureSpot, parent: Instance): Built
	local spec = FurnitureSpecs.get(spot.kind)
	local decor = spec.decor == true
	local model, body, home = draw(spot)

	if decor then
		for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.CanCollide = false
				part.CanQuery = false
			end
		end
		model.Parent = parent
		return {
			model = model,
			body = body,
			kind = spot.kind,
			weight = spec.weight,
			decor = true,
			home = home,
		}
	end

	for _, part in model:GetChildren() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= body then
			Parts.makeVisual(part)
			Parts.weldInPlace(body, part)
		end
	end

	body.Anchored = false
	body.CollisionGroup = "Furniture"
	-- Low friction with weight 1: floors (friction 0, weight 100) let pieces
	-- glide at exactly the speed FurnitureService sets, while walls (friction
	-- 1, weight 100) grip them, so a barricade pressed into a doorway holds.
	body.CustomPhysicalProperties =
		PhysicalProperties.new(Config.FURNITURE_DENSITY[spec.weight], 0.3, 0, 1, 1)

	-- Stay upright but spin freely around the vertical axis.
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = "Upright"
	attachment.CFrame = UPRIGHT_FRAME
	attachment.Parent = body
	local align = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
	align.Name = "KeepUpright"
	align.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	align.AlignType = Enum.AlignType.PrimaryAxisParallel
	align.Attachment0 = attachment
	align.CFrame = UPRIGHT_FRAME
	align.MaxTorque = 1e7
	align.Responsiveness = 40
	align.Parent = body

	model:SetAttribute("Weight", spec.weight)
	model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", 0)
	model.Parent = parent
	return { model = model, body = body, kind = spot.kind, weight = spec.weight, decor = false, home = home }
end

return FurnitureBuilder

scripts.name: FurnitureService
scripts.source:
-- Owns every furniture piece: builds them, decides who simulates each one,
-- and resets them each round.
--
-- Responsiveness: when you push a piece, your client asks for it ("claim")
-- and the server hands you its physics, so it moves the instant you push
-- and stops the instant you stop, with no network lag. If anyone else pushes
-- the same piece (a zombie on the other side of a barricade, another player,
-- a bot), the server takes it back and resolves everyone's pushes itself, so
-- a barricade standoff is fair. Pieces nobody pushes stand perfectly still.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CharacterLook = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.CharacterLook)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local FurnitureBuilder = require(script.Parent.FurnitureBuilder)
local FurniturePush = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.FurniturePush)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local RoundRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RoundRules)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

local FurnitureService = {}

type Piece = FurnitureBuilder.Built & {
	owner: Player?,
	lastClaim: number,
	pushers: { [string]: number }, -- participant id -> last time seen pushing
	contestedUntil: number,
	tugOfWar: boolean, -- contestedUntil came from two pushers, not a shove
	burst: Vector3,
	burstUntil: number,
	burstLength: number,
	lastGood: CFrame, -- last position that passed the anti-cheat checks
	lastGoodAt: number, -- when the piece last moved to lastGood
}

-- A piece someone is holding (grabbed): it stays at `offset` from them.
type Hold = { piece: Piece, offset: Vector3 }

-- Someone who can push furniture. `reach` is set while they hold a melee
-- weapon, whose shaft (along `aim`) pushes too.
export type Mover = {
	root: BasePart,
	humanoid: Humanoid,
	id: string,
	scale: number,
	aim: Vector3,
	firmness: number?, -- held weapon's Items.firmness
	guard: number?, -- held weapon's Items.guard
	reach: number?,
	zombie: boolean?, -- a zombie's arms push furniture too
}

local OWNER = FurniturePush.OWNER_ATTRIBUTE
local CONTEST_SECONDS = 0.8

local pieces: { Piece } = {}
local holds: { [string]: Hold } = {} -- participant id -> the piece they hold
local byBody: { [BasePart]: Piece } = {}
local byModel: { [Instance]: Piece } = {}
local folder: Folder
local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

local getMovers: () -> { Mover } = function()
	return {}
end

local function serverOwns(piece: Piece)
	piece.owner = nil
	pcall(function()
		piece.body:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	end)
	piece.model:SetAttribute(OWNER, 0)
end

local function stop(piece: Piece)
	local v = piece.body.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	piece.body.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.min(v.Y, 0), 0)
	piece.body.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

-- Takes a piece back from a client (optionally blocking new claims for a
-- bit). In a tug of war the piece keeps moving: the server writes the
-- resolved velocity the same frame, so stopping it would only cause a snap.
local function revoke(piece: Piece, blockSeconds: number, halt: boolean?)
	if piece.owner then
		serverOwns(piece)
		if halt ~= false then
			stop(piece)
		end
	end
	piece.contestedUntil = math.max(piece.contestedUntil, os.clock() + blockSeconds)
end

-- True if anyone other than `id` pushed the piece in the last moment.
local function othersPushing(piece: Piece, id: string, now: number): boolean
	for other, seen in piece.pushers do
		if other ~= id and now - seen <= 0.3 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function grant(piece: Piece, player: Player)
	local ok = pcall(function()
		piece.body:SetNetworkOwner(player)
	end)
	if ok then
		piece.owner = player
		piece.model:SetAttribute(OWNER, player.UserId)
	end
end

local function register(built: FurnitureBuilder.Built): Piece
	local piece = built :: Piece
	piece.owner = nil
	piece.lastClaim = 0
	piece.pushers = {}
	piece.contestedUntil = 0
	piece.tugOfWar = false
	piece.burst = Vector3.zero
	piece.burstUntil = 0
	piece.burstLength = 1
	piece.lastGood = built.home
	piece.lastGoodAt = 0
	table.insert(pieces, piece)
	byBody[built.body] = piece
	byModel[built.model] = piece
	serverOwns(piece)
	return piece
end

local function unregister(piece: Piece)
	local index = table.find(pieces, piece)
	if index then
		table.remove(pieces, index)
	end
	byBody[piece.body] = nil
	byModel[piece.model] = nil
	for id, hold in holds do
		if hold.piece == piece then
			holds[id] = nil
		end
	end
	piece.model:Destroy()
end

-- Summoned pieces (the Blood Staff's boxes), oldest first per summoner.
local summoned: { [string]: { Piece } } = {}
local SUMMON_LIMIT = 3

function FurnitureService.build(layout: MapLayout.Layout)
	folder = workspace:WaitForChild("Furniture") :: Folder
	folder:ClearAllChildren()
	table.clear(pieces)
	table.clear(byBody)
	table.clear(byModel)
	table.clear(summoned)
	for _, spot in layout.furniture do
		local built = FurnitureBuilder.build(spot, folder)
		if not built.decor then
			register(built)
		end
	end
	overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = { folder }
end

-- A new piece of furniture appears at (x, z), pushable like any other. Each
-- summoner keeps at most SUMMON_LIMIT; a new one replaces their oldest. They
-- all vanish when the furniture resets (next round).
function FurnitureService.summon(kind: string, x: number, z: number, rot: number, by: string): BasePart
	local mine = summoned[by] or {}
	summoned[by] = mine
	if #mine >= SUMMON_LIMIT then
		unregister(table.remove(mine, 1) :: Piece)
	end
	local piece =
		register(FurnitureBuilder.build({ kind = kind, x = x, z = z, rot = rot, house = "" }, folder))
	piece.model:SetAttribute("Summoned", true)
	table.insert(mine, piece)
	return piece.body
end

-- A sudden shove (shotgun blast, potato hit): the server takes the piece and
-- moves it at `velocity`, easing to a stop over `seconds`.
function FurnitureService.shove(body: BasePart, velocity: Vector3, seconds: number)
	local piece = byBody[body]
	if not piece then
		return
	end
	revoke(piece, seconds + 0.2)
	piece.burst = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
	piece.burstLength = seconds
	piece.burstUntil = os.clock() + seconds
end

function FurnitureService.pieceOf(part: BasePart): FurnitureBuilder.Built?
	return byBody[part]
end

-- Every movable piece within `radius` of a point (bots barricading).
function FurnitureService.piecesNear(position: Vector3, radius: number): { BasePart }
	local out: { BasePart } = {}
	for _, piece in pieces do
		if piece.body.Parent and Util.flatDistance(piece.body.Position, position) <= radius then
			table.insert(out, piece.body)
		end
	end
	return out
end

function FurnitureService.weightOf(body: BasePart): string?
	local piece = byBody[body]
	return piece and piece.weight
end

function FurnitureService.findInBox(cframe: CFrame, size: Vector3): { BasePart }
	local found = {}
	for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cframe, size, overlap) do
		if byBody[part] then
			table.insert(found, part)
		end
	end
	return found
end

-- Grabbing (players through the Grab remote, bots directly): a human holds
-- the piece next to them, which then comes with them.
function FurnitureService.grab(p: Participants.Participant, body: BasePart): boolean
	local piece = byBody[body]
	local root = Participants.body(p)
	if not piece or not root or p.team ~= "Human" then
		return false
	end
	local reach = body.Size.Magnitude / 2 + FurniturePush.bumperRadius(p.scale) + Config.GRAB_REACH + 2
	if Util.flatDistance(body.Position, root.Position) > reach then
		return false
	end
	holds[p.id] = { piece = piece, offset = Util.flat(body.Position - root.Position) }
	return true
end

function FurnitureService.release(id: string)
	holds[id] = nil
end

-- The piece someone holds, and where it stays relative to them.
function FurnitureService.holding(id: string): (BasePart?, Vector3)
	local hold = holds[id]
	if hold and hold.piece.body.Parent then
		return hold.piece.body, hold.offset
	end
	return nil, Vector3.zero
end

-- Who holds this piece, if anyone.
function FurnitureService.heldBy(body: BasePart): string?
	for id, hold in holds do
		if hold.piece.body == body then
			return id
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- How fast someone can walk while dragging (1 when not holding anything).
function FurnitureService.dragFactor(p: Participants.Participant): number
	local body = FurnitureService.holding(p.id)
	if not body then
		return 1
	end
	return FurniturePush.dragFactor(body, RoundRules.pushStrength(p.scale))
end

function FurnitureService.resetAll()
	table.clear(holds)
	for _, list in summoned do
		for _, piece in list do
			unregister(piece)
		end
	end
	table.clear(summoned)
	for _, piece in pieces do
		serverOwns(piece)
		piece.contestedUntil = 0
		piece.tugOfWar = false
		piece.burstUntil = 0
		table.clear(piece.pushers)
		piece.model:PivotTo(piece.home)
		piece.lastGood = piece.home
		piece.body.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		piece.body.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
end

-- A client asks to drive the pieces it is pushing.
local function onClaim(player: Player, list: unknown)
	if typeof(list) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local claims = list :: { unknown }
	if #claims > 16 then
		return
	end
	local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
	local root = p and Participants.body(p)
	if not p or not root then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, model in claims do
		local piece = if typeof(model) == "Instance" then byModel[model] else nil
		if not piece or now < piece.contestedUntil or now < piece.burstUntil then
			continue
		end
		if piece.owner and piece.owner ~= player then
			revoke(piece, CONTEST_SECONDS, false) -- two players fighting over it: server decides
			continue
		end
		if othersPushing(piece, p.id, now) then
			continue -- someone else is on it too: the server settles that
		end
		-- Only pieces you could actually be touching (body or longest weapon).
		local range = piece.body.Size.Magnitude / 2 + root.Size.X / 2 + 12 * math.max(1, p.scale) + 3
		if Util.flatDistance(piece.body.Position, root.Position) > range then
			continue
		end
		piece.lastClaim = now
		if piece.owner ~= player then
			grant(piece, player)
		end
	end
end

-- Pushers in a line add up: someone walking into the back of another mover
-- heading the same way leans on them and lends them their strength (a
-- little less per link), so a queue of zombies at a barricade shoves as one.
type Lean = { dir: Vector3?, own: number, leaners: { number } }

local function leanGraph(movers: { Mover }): { Lean }
	local shell = Config.CHARACTER.ShellDiameter / 2
	local leans: { Lean } = {}
	for i, mover in movers do
		local move = mover.humanoid.MoveDirection
		local flat = Vector3.new(move.X, 0, move.Z)
		local moving = flat.Magnitude > 0.1 and mover.humanoid.WalkSpeed > 0
		leans[i] = {
			dir = if moving then flat.Unit else nil,
			own = RoundRules.pushStrength(mover.scale, mover.zombie),
			leaners = {},
		}
	end
	for i, a in leans do
		local dir = a.dir
		if not dir then
			continue
		end
		local ra = shell * movers[i].scale
		local here = movers[i].root.Position
		local best, bestAlong = nil, math.huge
		for j, b in leans do
			local bDir = b.dir
			if j == i or not bDir or bDir:Dot(dir) < 0.3 then
				continue
			end
			local rb = shell * movers[j].scale
			local rel = movers[j].root.Position - here
			rel = Vector3.new(rel.X, 0, rel.Z)
			local along = rel:Dot(dir)
			local side = (rel - dir * along).Magnitude
			if along > 0.2 and along < ra + rb + 0.8 and side < (ra + rb) * 0.9 and along < bestAlong then
				best, bestAlong = j, along
			end
		end
		if best then
			table.insert(leans[best].leaners, i)
		end
	end
	return leans
end

-- Strength of mover `i` plus everyone leaning on it (and on them...); adds
-- every helper's id to `helpers`.
local function chained(
	movers: { Mover },
	leans: { Lean },
	i: number,
	helpers: { string },
	seen: { [number]: boolean }
): number
	seen[i] = true
	local total = leans[i].own
	for _, j in leans[i].leaners do
		if not seen[j] then
			table.insert(helpers, movers[j].id)
			total += chained(movers, leans, j, helpers, seen) * Config.PUSH_CHAIN_SHARE
		end
	end
	return total
end

local function collectPushes(now: number): FurniturePush.Pushes
	local pushes: FurniturePush.Pushes = {}
	local movers = getMovers()
	local leans = leanGraph(movers)
	for i, mover in movers do
		local humanoid, root = mover.humanoid, mover.root
		local walk = humanoid.WalkSpeed
		if walk <= 0 then
			continue
		end
		local dir = leans[i].dir
		local moving = dir ~= nil
		local strength = leans[i].own
		local helpers: { string } = {}
		if moving and #leans[i].leaners > 0 then
			strength = chained(movers, leans, i, helpers, {})
		end
		local touched: { [BasePart]: boolean } = {}
		local function pushing(piece: Piece)
			piece.pushers[mover.id] = now
			for _, id in helpers do
				piece.pushers[id] = now
			end
		end
		-- The piece they hold comes with them; they let go if it gets stuck.
		local hold = holds[mover.id]
		if hold then
			local body = hold.piece.body
			if body.Parent == nil or mover.zombie then
				holds[mover.id] = nil
			else
				local desired, lag = FurniturePush.holdVelocity(root, hold.offset, body)
				if lag > Config.GRAB_BREAK then
					holds[mover.id] = nil
				else
					touched[body] = true
					pushing(hold.piece)
					FurniturePush.add(pushes, body, desired, leans[i].own, nil)
				end
			end
		end
		if dir then
			local probe, size = FurniturePush.moverProbe(root, dir, mover.scale)
			for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(probe, size, overlap) do
				local piece = byBody[part]
				if piece then
					touched[part] = true
					pushing(piece)
					FurniturePush.add(pushes, part, dir * walk, strength, probe.Position)
				end
			end
		end
		-- A zombie's arms are solid: walking, they push what they touch along
		-- with the body; standing or turning, they shove it out of the way.
		if mover.zombie then
			local probe, size = FurniturePush.armsProbe(
				root,
				mover.scale,
				CharacterLook.ZOMBIE_ARM_REACH,
				CharacterLook.ZOMBIE_ARM_SPAN
			)
			for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(probe, size, overlap) do
				local piece = byBody[part]
				if piece and not touched[part] then
					touched[part] = true
					if dir then
						pushing(piece)
						FurniturePush.add(pushes, part, dir * walk, strength, probe.Position)
					else
						local exit = FurniturePush.shaftExit(root.Position, probe.LookVector, part)
						FurniturePush.add(
							pushes,
							part,
							exit * walk * Config.SHAFT_FURNITURE_FACTOR,
							strength,
							nil
						)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		-- A held weapon's shaft is solid, same as on the client: it pushes
		-- what it touches along your path, or out of its way when you stand
		-- still or turn.
		if mover.reach then
			local grip = CharacterLook.grip(mover.scale)
			local hand = (root.CFrame * grip).Position
			local shaft, shaftSize = FurniturePush.itemProbe(root, grip, mover.aim, mover.reach, mover.guard)
			local firm = leans[i].own * (mover.firmness or 1)
			for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(shaft, shaftSize, overlap) do
				local piece = byBody[part]
				if piece and not touched[part] then
					if dir then
						-- Only walking counts as pushing for ownership: someone just
						-- standing near a piece with a weapon out shouldn't take it
						-- away from the player driving it.
						piece.pushers[mover.id] = now
						FurniturePush.add(pushes, part, dir * walk, firm, part.Position + mover.aim * 0.5)
					else
						local exit = FurniturePush.shaftExit(hand, mover.aim, part)
						FurniturePush.add(
							pushes,
							part,
							exit * walk * Config.SHAFT_FURNITURE_FACTOR,
							firm,
							nil
						)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	-- A pushed piece pushes whatever it runs into, so a shove moves a whole
	-- barricade (two links deep).
	for _ = 1, 2 do
		for body, push in table.clone(pushes) do
			local velocity = FurniturePush.resolve(body, push)
			local ahead = Util.flatUnit(velocity)
			if ahead and velocity.Magnitude > 0.5 then
				local center = body.Position + ahead * (FurniturePush.extent(body, ahead) + 0.6)
				local side = Vector3.new(-ahead.Z, 0, ahead.X)
				local width = FurniturePush.extent(body, side) * 2 * 0.9
				local probe = CFrame.lookAt(center, center + ahead)
				for _, other in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(probe, Vector3.new(width, 2, 1.2), overlap) do
					if other ~= body and byBody[other] and not pushes[other] then
						FurniturePush.add(pushes, other, velocity, push.strength, center)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return pushes
end

-- Is a client-driven piece somewhere a legitimate push could have put it?
local function plausible(piece: Piece, now: number): boolean
	local body = piece.body
	local owner = piece.owner
	local p = owner and Participants.fromPlayer(owner)
	local root = p and Participants.body(p)
	if not p or not root then
		return false
	end
	local v = body.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	if Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude > Config.FURNITURE_MAX_SPEED * 1.5 or v.Y > 8 then
		return false
	end
	if body.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > 3 then
		return false
	end
	-- Client positions arrive in bursts, so compare against the time since
	-- the piece last moved, not one server frame (capped so a piece that sat
	-- still for a while can't jump far).
	local moved = Util.flatDistance(body.Position, piece.lastGood.Position)
	local elapsed = math.clamp(now - piece.lastGoodAt, 1 / 60, 0.3)
	if moved > Config.FURNITURE_MAX_SPEED * 1.6 * elapsed + 1.5 then
		return false -- teleported
	end
	local range = body.Size.Magnitude / 2 + root.Size.X / 2 + 14 * math.max(1, p.scale) + 6
	return Util.flatDistance(body.Position, root.Position) <= range
end

local function step(dt: number)
	local now = os.clock()
	local pushes = collectPushes(now)
	for _, piece in pieces do
		local body = piece.body
		if body.Parent == nil then
			continue
		end

		-- Who is pushing this piece right now (seen by the server)?
		local owner = piece.owner
		local ownerId = if owner then "P" .. owner.UserId else ""
		local active, someoneElse = 0, false
		for id, seen in piece.pushers do
			if now - seen > 0.3 then
				piece.pushers[id] = nil
			else
				active += 1
				if owner and id ~= ownerId then
					someoneElse = true
				end
			end
		end
		if now >= piece.contestedUntil then
			piece.tugOfWar = false
		end
		if active >= 2 or someoneElse then
			-- A tug of war: the server simulates it so both sides count.
			piece.tugOfWar = true
			revoke(piece, CONTEST_SECONDS, false)
		elseif not owner and piece.tugOfWar and now < piece.contestedUntil and active >= 1 then
			-- Keep the server in charge until the tug of war is really over.
			piece.contestedUntil = now + CONTEST_SECONDS
		elseif owner then
			if owner.Parent ~= Players or now - piece.lastClaim > Config.FURNITURE_RELEASE_SECONDS then
				revoke(piece, 0)
			elseif not plausible(piece, now) then
				-- Moved in a way no push could: put it back and take it away.
				revoke(piece, 1.5)
				piece.model:PivotTo(piece.lastGood)
			end
		end
		if piece.owner then
			-- Only advance when a new position has arrived (see plausible).
			if (body.Position - piece.lastGood.Position).Magnitude > 0.01 then
				piece.lastGood, piece.lastGoodAt = body.CFrame, now
			end
		end

		if piece.owner == nil then
			piece.lastGood, piece.lastGoodAt = body.CFrame, now
			local v = body.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			if now < piece.burstUntil then
				local k = (piece.burstUntil - now) / piece.burstLength
				body.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
					Vector3.new(piece.burst.X * k, math.min(v.Y, 0), piece.burst.Z * k)
			else
				local push = pushes[body]
				if push then
					local velocity, spin = FurniturePush.resolve(body, push)
					body.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, math.min(v.Y, 0), velocity.Z)
					body.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, spin, 0)
				elseif
					math.abs(v.X) + math.abs(v.Z) > 0.02 or body.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > 0.02
				then
					stop(piece) -- no sliding
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function FurnitureService.start(movers: () -> { Mover })
	getMovers = movers
	Remotes.unreliable("PushClaim").OnServerEvent:Connect(onClaim)
	Remotes.event("Grab").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, model: unknown, on: unknown)
		local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
		if not p then
			return
		end
		local piece = if typeof(model) == "Instance" then byModel[model] else nil
		if on == true and piece then
			FurnitureService.grab(p, piece.body)
		else
			holds[p.id] = nil
		end
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		for _, piece in pieces do
			if piece.owner == player then
				revoke(piece, 0)
			end
		end
	end)
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step)
end

return FurnitureService

scripts.name: ItemService
scripts.source:
-- Held items and items lying on the ground. Each human holds at most one
-- item (shown in their right hand). E picks up the nearest ground item, G
-- drops, left click uses. Becoming a zombie drops whatever you held.
-- Every use is validated and resolved here on the server.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Announcer = require(script.Parent.Announcer)
local Bushes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Bushes)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local CharacterLook = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.CharacterLook)
local Combat = require(script.Parent.Combat)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local FurniturePush = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.FurniturePush)
local FurnitureService = require(script.Parent.FurnitureService)
local FurnitureSpecs = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.FurnitureSpecs)
local ItemModels = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.ItemModels)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local MapBuilder = require(script.Parent.MapBuilder)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Parts = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Parts)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Projectiles = require(script.Parent.Projectiles)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local Traps = require(script.Parent.Traps)
local RoundRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RoundRules)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

type Participant = Participants.Participant

local ItemService = {}

local groundFolder: Folder
local rng = Random.new()

-- Hand models -------------------------------------------------------------------

local function attachHeld(p: Participant)
	local character = p.character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local old = character:FindFirstChild("HeldItem")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	if not p.heldItem or p.team ~= "Human" then
		return
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local model = ItemModels.build(p.heldItem, Items.reachScale(p.scale))
	model.Name = "HeldItem"
	model:SetAttribute("ItemId", p.heldItem) -- clients read it for weapon force fields
	local handle = model.PrimaryPart :: BasePart
	local s = p.scale
	local grip = CharacterLook.grip(s)
	model:PivotTo(root.CFrame * grip)
	for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			Parts.makeVisual(part)
		end
	end
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name = "GripWeld"
	weld.Part0 = root
	weld.Part1 = handle
	weld.C0 = grip
	weld.Parent = handle
	model.Parent = character
end

function ItemService.refreshHand(p: Participant)
	attachHeld(p)
end

local function setStreaming(p: Participant, itemId: string?)
	p.streaming = itemId ~= nil
	if p.character then
		p.character:SetAttribute("Spraying", itemId) -- clients draw the spray
	end
end

-- Inventory ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Config.INVENTORY_SLOTS slots; the active one is in your hand. p.heldItem and
-- p.heldCharges mirror the active slot, so everything else just reads those.

local function publishSlots(p: Participant)
	for i = 1, Config.INVENTORY_SLOTS do
		local slot = p.slots[i]
		p.state:SetAttribute("Slot" .. i, if slot then slot.id else "")
		p.state:SetAttribute("Slot" .. i .. "Charges", if slot then slot.charges or 0 else 0)
	end
	p.state:SetAttribute("ActiveSlot", p.slot)
end

-- Puts the active slot's item in the hand.
local function equipActive(p: Participant)
	local slot = p.slots[p.slot]
	p.heldItem = if slot then slot.id else nil
	p.heldCharges = if slot then slot.charges else nil
	setStreaming(p, nil)
	p.state:SetAttribute("HeldItem", p.heldItem or "")
	p.state:SetAttribute("HeldCharges", p.heldCharges or 0)
	publishSlots(p)
	attachHeld(p)
end

-- Sets (or empties) the active slot.
local function setHeld(p: Participant, itemId: string?, charges: number?)
	if itemId then
		local item = Items.get(itemId)
		p.slots[p.slot] = { id = itemId, charges = charges or (item and item.charges) }
	else
		p.slots[p.slot] = nil
	end
	equipActive(p)
end

-- Charges left on the item in hand (peels, water, fuel).
local function setCharges(p: Participant, charges: number)
	p.heldCharges = charges
	local slot = p.slots[p.slot]
	if slot then
		slot.charges = charges
	end
	p.state:SetAttribute("HeldCharges", charges)
	publishSlots(p)
end

function ItemService.hasFreeSlot(p: Participant): boolean
	for i = 1, Config.INVENTORY_SLOTS do
		if not p.slots[i] then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function ItemService.carries(p: Participant, itemId: string): boolean
	for _, slot in p.slots do
		if slot.id == itemId then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Switches which slot is in your hand.
function ItemService.select(p: Participant, slot: number)
	if slot >= 1 and slot <= Config.INVENTORY_SLOTS and slot ~= p.slot then
		p.slot = slot
		equipActive(p)
	end
end

-- Ground items -----------------------------------------------------------------------

function ItemService.spawnGround(itemId: string, position: Vector3, charges: number?): Model
	local model = ItemModels.build(itemId)
	model.Name = itemId
	-- Built at the origin, so the bounding box center is the offset to undo.
	local center = model:GetBoundingBox().Position
	local y = MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor + 0.55
	local spin = CFrame.Angles(0, rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2), 0)
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position.X, y, position.Z) * spin * CFrame.new(-center.X, 0, -center.Z))
	local ring = Parts.disc(
		"Ring",
		Vector3.new(position.X, MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor + 0.05, position.Z),
		4,
		0.06,
		"FFFFFF",
		model
	)
	ring.Transparency = 0.55
	ring.CanCollide = false
	ring.CanQuery = false
	model:SetAttribute("ItemId", itemId)
	model:SetAttribute("Charges", charges)
	model:SetAttribute("SpotX", position.X)
	model:SetAttribute("SpotZ", position.Z)
	model.Parent = groundFolder
	return model
end

local function groundSpot(model: Model): Vector3
	return Vector3.new(model:GetAttribute("SpotX") :: number, 0, model:GetAttribute("SpotZ") :: number)
end

function ItemService.clearGround()
	groundFolder:ClearAllChildren()
end

function ItemService.scatter()
	local count = rng:NextInteger(Config.GROUND_ITEMS_MIN, Config.GROUND_ITEMS_MAX)
	local spots = table.clone(MapLayout.current().itemSpots)
	local pool = Items.groundTable()
	local total = 0
	for _, entry in pool do
		total += entry.weight
	end
	for _ = 1, math.min(count, #spots) do
		local spot = table.remove(spots, rng:NextInteger(1, #spots)) :: MapLayout.Point
		local roll = rng:NextNumber() * total
		local chosen = pool[#pool].id
		for _, entry in pool do
			roll -= entry.weight
			if roll < 0 then
				chosen = entry.id
				break
			end
		end
		ItemService.spawnGround(chosen, Vector3.new(spot.x, 0, spot.z))
	end
end

-- Holding ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Adds an item: into your hand if it's empty, else into the first free
-- slot. With every slot full, the item in your hand is dropped for it.
function ItemService.give(p: Participant, itemId: string, charges: number?)
	if p.slots[p.slot] then
		for i = 1, Config.INVENTORY_SLOTS do
			if not p.slots[i] then
				local item = Items.get(itemId)
				p.slots[i] = { id = itemId, charges = charges or (item and item.charges) }
				publishSlots(p)
				return
			end
		end
		ItemService.drop(p)
	end
	setHeld(p, itemId, charges)
end

function ItemService.drop(p: Participant)
	local itemId = p.heldItem
	if not itemId then
		return
	end
	local root = Participants.body(p)
	if root then
		local spot = root.Position + p.aim * (root.Size.X / 2 + 2)
		ItemService.spawnGround(itemId, spot, p.heldCharges)
	end
	setHeld(p, nil)
end

function ItemService.take(p: Participant)
	setHeld(p, nil)
end

function ItemService.pickUp(p: Participant)
	if p.team ~= "Human" then
		return
	end
	local root = Participants.body(p)
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local best: Model? = nil
	local bestDistance = Config.PICKUP_RADIUS * math.max(1, p.scale)
	for _, model in groundFolder:GetChildren() do
		if model:IsA("Model") then
			local d = Util.flatDistance(groundSpot(model), root.Position)
			if d <= bestDistance then
				best, bestDistance = model, d
			end
		end
	end
	if not best then
		return
	end
	local itemId = best:GetAttribute("ItemId") :: string
	local charges = best:GetAttribute("Charges")
	best:Destroy()
	ItemService.give(p, itemId, if typeof(charges) == "number" then charges else nil)
	Announcer.fx("Pickup", { position = root.Position })
end

-- Getting eaten loses everything you carry (items should be rare: mostly bought).
function ItemService.onInfected(p: Participant)
	table.clear(p.slots)
	equipActive(p)
end

-- Melee weapons without `hits` only keep zombies away while held; a click
-- does nothing.
local function canUse(item: Items.Item): boolean
	return item.kind ~= "Melee" or item.hits == true
end

-- Using ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function breakWallAhead(p: Participant, aim: Vector3, reach: number): boolean
	local root = Participants.body(p)
	if not root then
		return false
	end
	for _, angle in { 0, 0.18, -0.18 } do
		local direction = (CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0) * aim) * reach
		local result = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, direction, Combat.wallParams())
		if result then
			local segment = MapBuilder.segmentOf(result.Instance)
			if segment and MapBuilder.breakSegment(segment) then
				local wall = segment.PrimaryPart
				if wall then
					Announcer.fx("WallBreak", { cframe = wall.CFrame, size = wall.Size })
				end
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- The Blood Staff: a box appears in front of you, if there's room for it
-- (not in a wall, other furniture or someone). No room: the cooldown is
-- refunded.
local function summon(p: Participant, item: Items.Item, aim: Vector3)
	local root = Participants.body(p)
	local kind = item.summon
	if not root or not kind then
		return
	end
	local spec = FurnitureSpecs.get(kind)
	local half = math.max(spec.w, spec.d) / 2
	local gap = root.Size.X / 2 + half + 0.8
	local wall = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, aim * (gap + half), Combat.wallParams())
	if wall then
		gap = (wall.Position - root.Position).Magnitude - half - 0.3 -- up against the wall
	end
	local center = root.Position + aim * gap
	local floor = MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor
	local box = CFrame.new(center.X, floor + spec.h / 2 + 0.05, center.Z)
	local blocked = gap < root.Size.X / 2 + half * 0.7
	if not blocked then
		-- Lifted off the floor, so only walls, furniture and people count.
		local params = OverlapParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local ignored: { Instance } = { groundFolder }
		if p.character then
			table.insert(ignored, p.character)
		end
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
		for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(box, Vector3.new(spec.w, spec.h - 0.3, spec.d), params) do
			if part.CanCollide then
				blocked = true
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if blocked then
		p.itemReadyAt = os.clock() + 0.3
		if p.player then
			Announcer.toast(p.player, "No room for a Blood Box here")
		end
		return
	end
	local body = FurnitureService.summon(kind, center.X, center.Z, math.deg(math.atan2(-aim.X, -aim.Z)), p.id)
	Announcer.fx("Summon", { position = body.Position })
end

local function use(p: Participant, item: Items.Item, aim: Vector3)
	local root = Participants.body(p)
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local kind = item.kind
	if kind == "Melee" or kind == "Blast" then
		local reach = (item.reach or 5) * Items.reachScale(p.scale)
		for _, hit in Combat.peopleInCone(p, aim, reach, item.arc or 90) do
			local direction = if item.straight then aim else hit.direction
			Combat.knockback(hit.target, direction * (item.knockback or 50), item.stun or 0.3)
			local zRoot = Participants.body(hit.target)
			if zRoot and item.fx then
				Announcer.fx("Hit", { position = zRoot.Position, fx = item.fx })
			end
			if item.effect == "Plunge" then
				Announcer.fx(
					"Plunged",
					{ character = hit.target.character, seconds = item.effectSeconds or 1.5 }
				)
			end
		end
		if kind == "Blast" then
			Announcer.fx("Blast", { origin = root.Position, direction = aim, reach = reach, item = item.id })
			if item.breaksWalls then
				breakWallAhead(p, aim, reach)
			end
			-- The blast also throws furniture around (heavier pieces less).
			local center = root.Position + aim * (reach / 2)
			for _, body in
				FurnitureService.findInBox(
					CFrame.lookAt(center, center + aim),
					Vector3.new(reach * 0.9, 4, reach)
				)
			do
				local away = Util.flatUnit(body.Position - root.Position) or aim
				local mass = (Config.FURNITURE_MASS :: { [string]: number })[FurnitureService.weightOf(body) or "Medium"]
					or 0.45
				FurnitureService.shove(body, away * 28 * math.clamp(1 - mass / 1.6, 0.15, 1), 0.35)
			end
		else
			Announcer.fx("Swing", { character = p.character, item = item.id })
		end
	elseif kind == "Projectile" then
		Projectiles.fire(p, item, aim)
		Announcer.fx("Shoot", { character = p.character, item = item.id })
		if item.charges then -- dynamite and grenades run out
			setCharges(p, (p.heldCharges or 1) - 1)
			if (p.heldCharges or 0) <= 0 then
				ItemService.take(p)
			end
		end
	elseif kind == "Summon" then
		summon(p, item, aim)
	elseif kind == "Trap" then
		Traps.place(root.Position - aim * (root.Size.X / 2 + 0.6), item, p)
		Announcer.fx("Drop", { position = root.Position })
		setCharges(p, (p.heldCharges or 1) - 1)
		if (p.heldCharges or 0) <= 0 then
			ItemService.take(p)
		end
	elseif kind == "Consumable" and item.speedBoost then
		CharacterService.speedEffect(p, item.speedBoost, item.boostSeconds or 8)
		if not item.reusable then
			ItemService.take(p)
		end
		local message = "Zoom! Faster for " .. (item.boostSeconds or 8) .. " seconds"
		if item.effect == "Cloak" then
			local seconds = item.effectSeconds or 5
			if p.character then
				-- Everyone's screen hides you until then (BushController);
				-- bots and the server treat you as hidden (BushService).
				p.character:SetAttribute(Bushes.CLOAK_ATTRIBUTE, workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + seconds)
			end
			Announcer.fx("Cloak", { position = root.Position })
			message = "You vanished! Invisible for " .. seconds .. " seconds"
		elseif item.id == "Broom" then
			Announcer.fx("Ride", { position = root.Position })
			message = "Riding the broom! Faster for " .. (item.boostSeconds or 8) .. " seconds"
		else
			Announcer.fx("Gulp", { position = root.Position, character = p.character })
		end
		if p.player then
			Announcer.toast(p.player, message, Config.COLORS.Good)
		end
	elseif kind == "Consumable" then
		local before = p.immunity
		Participants.setImmunity(p, p.immunity + (item.immunity or 0))
		ItemService.take(p)
		Announcer.fx("Eat", { position = root.Position })
		if p.player then
			Announcer.toast(
				p.player,
				string.format("Immunity %d -> %d / %d", before, p.immunity, Config.IMMUNITY_MAX),
				Config.COLORS.Good
			)
		end
	elseif kind == "Passive" then
		if p.player then
			Announcer.toast(
				p.player,
				string.format("Hold this when the round ends: +%d%% score", (item.rewardBonus or 0) * 100)
			)
		end
	end
end

local function onUse(player: Player, action: unknown, aim: unknown)
	local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
	if not p or typeof(aim) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end
	local direction = Util.flatUnit(aim :: Vector3)
	if not direction then
		return
	end
	p.aim = direction
	if action == "stop" then
		setStreaming(p, nil)
		return
	end
	if action ~= "start" or p.team ~= "Human" then
		return
	end
	local item = Items.get(p.heldItem)
	if not item then
		return
	end
	if item.kind == "Stream" then
		setStreaming(p, item.id) -- sprays until "stop" (see streamStep)
		return
	end
	if not canUse(item) then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < p.itemReadyAt then
		return
	end
	p.itemReadyAt = now + (item.cooldown or 0.5)
	use(p, item, direction)
end

-- Bots use their held item with the same rules and cooldowns as players
-- (streams spray for a moment).
function ItemService.botUse(p: Participant, aim: Vector3)
	local direction = Util.flatUnit(aim)
	local item = Items.get(p.heldItem)
	if not direction or not item or p.team ~= "Human" then
		return
	end
	p.aim = direction
	if item.kind == "Stream" then
		setStreaming(p, item.id)
		task.delay(0.6, function()
			if p.heldItem == item.id then
				setStreaming(p, nil)
			end
		end)
		return
	end
	if not canUse(item) then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < p.itemReadyAt then
		return
	end
	p.itemReadyAt = now + (item.cooldown or 0.5)
	use(p, item, direction)
end

-- Held melee weapons are solid to people too: anyone else (zombie or human)
-- touching the shaft (within the item's `guard`) is shoved off it in short
-- pulses, so a stick held across a doorway keeps zombies out. Firm weapons
-- (bat, pan) hold people completely; soft ones (pool noodle) give, so they
-- squeeze past. A bigger holder holds harder, a bigger person pushes
-- through easier.
-- Held melee weapons are solid but not bouncy. Someone pressing on the
-- shaft is held off it, and leans on the holder in turn, shared by strength
-- (size squared; a firm bat counts for more than a pool noodle): equal sizes
-- share the push, so a zombie can walk you backwards and slide round the
-- end, while a much bigger holder doesn't budge. Bots are moved here;
-- players feel it on their own screen (client ForceField).
local function shaftStep(dt: number)
	local people = Participants.all()
	local rate = math.min(1, dt * Config.SHAFT_SOFTNESS)
	for _, p in Participants.onTeam("Human") do
		local item = Items.get(p.heldItem)
		local root = Participants.body(p)
		if not item or item.kind ~= "Melee" or not root then
			continue
		end
		local reach = (item.reach or 5) * Items.reachScale(p.scale)
		local guard = item.guard or 0.5
		local hand = (root.CFrame * CharacterLook.grip(p.scale)).Position
		local start = Vector3.new(hand.X, 0, hand.Z)
		local hold = p.scale * p.scale * (item.firmness or 1)
		if not p.player then
			-- Furniture is solid to the weapon: a bot whose weapon is pressed
			-- into a piece gets pushed back off it (players' own screens do
			-- this for them, see ForceField).
			local grip = CharacterLook.grip(p.scale)
			local frame, size = FurniturePush.itemProbe(root, grip, p.aim, reach, guard)
			local held = FurnitureService.holding(p.id)
			for _, body in FurnitureService.findInBox(frame, size + Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)) do
				if body == held then
					continue -- it moves with them
				end
				local depth, out = FurniturePush.overlapOut(start, start + p.aim * reach, guard, body)
				if out then
					root.CFrame += out * (math.min(depth, 2) * rate)
				end
			end
		end
		for _, other in people do
			local oRoot = if other ~= p then Participants.body(other) else nil
			if not oRoot or (other.player and p.player) then
				continue -- two players: their own screens handle it
			end
			local o = Vector3.new(oRoot.Position.X, 0, oRoot.Position.Z)
			local along = math.clamp((o - start):Dot(p.aim), 0, reach)
			local offset = o - (start + p.aim * along)
			local radius = Config.CHARACTER.ShellDiameter / 2 * other.scale
			local overlap = radius + guard - offset.Magnitude
			if overlap > 0 and Combat.lineOfSight(root.Position, oRoot.Position) then
				local push = RoundRules.pushStrength(other.scale, other.team == "Zombie")
				local away = Util.flatUnit(offset) or p.aim
				local step = math.min(overlap, 2) * rate
				if not other.player then
					oRoot.CFrame += away * (step * hold / (hold + push))
					other.pressedUntil = os.clock() + 0.4 -- bots learn to go round
				end
				if not p.player then
					root.CFrame -= away * (step * push / (hold + push))
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Water gun and leaf blower: while held, push everyone in the cone a
-- little, many times a second. The leaf blower also blows light furniture.
local function streamStep()
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, p in Participants.onTeam("Human") do
		if not p.streaming then
			continue
		end
		local item = Items.get(p.heldItem)
		local root = Participants.body(p)
		if not item or item.kind ~= "Stream" or not root then
			setStreaming(p, nil)
			continue
		end
		if now < p.nextStreamTick then
			continue
		end
		p.nextStreamTick = now + (item.tick or 0.12)
		if item.charges then
			setCharges(p, (p.heldCharges or 1) - 1)
			if (p.heldCharges or 0) <= 0 then
				ItemService.take(p) -- out of water
			end
		end
		local reach = (item.reach or 14) * Items.reachScale(p.scale)
		for _, hit in Combat.peopleInCone(p, p.aim, reach, item.arc or 30) do
			local falloff = 1 - hit.distance / (reach * 1.5)
			Combat.knockback(hit.target, p.aim * (item.knockback or 15) * falloff, item.stun or 0.1)
		end
		if item.fx == "Leaves" then
			local center = root.Position + p.aim * (reach / 2)
			local box = CFrame.lookAt(center, center + p.aim)
			for _, body in FurnitureService.findInBox(box, Vector3.new(reach * 0.6, 4, reach)) do
				local weight = FurnitureService.weightOf(body)
				if weight == "Light" or weight == "Medium" then
					FurnitureService.shove(body, p.aim * (if weight == "Light" then 12 else 6), 0.18)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function ItemService.init()
	groundFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("GroundItems") :: Folder
	CharacterService.onResized = attachHeld -- the grip moves with your size

	Remotes.event("UseItem").OnServerEvent:Connect(onUse)
	Remotes.unreliable("Aim").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, aim)
		local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
		local direction = if p and typeof(aim) == "Vector3" then Util.flatUnit(aim) else nil
		if p and direction then
			p.aim = direction
		end
	end)

	local lastAction: { [Player]: number } = {}
	local function throttled(player: Player): boolean
		local now = os.clock()
		if lastAction[player] and now - lastAction[player] < 0.2 then
			return true
		end
		lastAction[player] = now
		return false
	end

	Remotes.event("PickUp").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
		if p and not throttled(player) then
			ItemService.pickUp(p)
		end
	end)
	Remotes.event("DropItem").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
		if p and p.team == "Human" and not throttled(player) then
			ItemService.drop(p)
		end
	end)
	Remotes.event("SelectSlot").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, slot)
		local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
		if p and typeof(slot) == "number" and slot == math.floor(slot) then
			ItemService.select(p, slot)
		end
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastAction[player] = nil
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(shaftStep)
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(streamStep)
end

return ItemService

scripts.name: Main
scripts.source:
-- Server entry point: builds the world, starts every service, and turns
-- joining players into participants.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Remotes")) -- creates the remotes

local WorldSetup = require(script.Parent.WorldSetup)
WorldSetup.run()

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)

local AdminService = require(script.Parent.AdminService)
local BotService = require(script.Parent.BotService)
local BushService = require(script.Parent.BushService)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local Combat = require(script.Parent.Combat)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local FurnitureService = require(script.Parent.FurnitureService)
local ItemService = require(script.Parent.ItemService)
local MapBuilder = require(script.Parent.MapBuilder)
local MapStudio = require(script.Parent.MapStudio)
local MonetizationService = require(script.Parent.MonetizationService)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Projectiles = require(script.Parent.Projectiles)
local RoundManager = require(script.Parent.RoundManager)
local ShopService = require(script.Parent.ShopService)
local TopScores = require(script.Parent.TopScores)
local Traps = require(script.Parent.Traps)

-- Maps built in Studio (Workspace.BrainTagMaps) join the rotation, first.
MapStudio.loadAll()
MapBuilder.setDecor(MapStudio.decor)
local firstMap = MapLayout.use(MapLayout.rotation(Config.MAP_ROTATION)[1] or "Neighborhood")
MapBuilder.build(firstMap)
FurnitureService.build(firstMap)
CharacterService.buildTemplate()
CharacterService.init()

FurnitureService.start(function()
	local movers = {}
	for _, p in Participants.all() do
		local root, humanoid = Participants.body(p)
		if root and humanoid then
			local item = Items.get(p.heldItem)
			local melee = p.team == "Human" and item and item.kind == "Melee"
			table.insert(movers, {
				root = root,
				humanoid = humanoid,
				id = p.id,
				scale = p.scale,
				aim = p.aim,
				reach = if melee and item then (item.reach or 5) * Items.reachScale(p.scale) else nil,
				firmness = if melee and item then item.firmness else nil,
				guard = if melee and item then item.guard else nil,
				zombie = p.team == "Zombie",
			})
		end
	end
	return movers
end)

Combat.init()
Projectiles.init()
Traps.init()
BushService.init()
ItemService.init()
ShopService.init()
DataService.init()
MonetizationService.init()
TopScores.start()
RoundManager.start()
AdminService.init()

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	player.CanLoadCharacterAppearance = false
	local profile = DataService.load(player) -- yields
	local passes = MonetizationService.ownedPasses(player) -- yields
	if player.Parent ~= Players then
		return
	end
	local p = Participants.add({
		id = Participants.playerId(player),
		name = player.DisplayName,
		player = player,
		isBot = false,
		profile = profile,
		passes = passes,
	})
	MonetizationService.applyPasses(p)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
	if p then
		Participants.remove(p)
	end
end)

BotService.start()
print("[Brain Tag] server ready")

scripts.name: MapBuilder
scripts.source:
-- Builds a map from MapLayout: grass with little details, dirt paths, the
-- road, house floors with patterns, outlined walls split into breakable
-- segments, windows, bushes and an invisible boundary, all in the map's
-- theme colors (MapThemes), with its lighting. Fake (secret) wall pieces
-- look like the rest but people walk through them. Roofed maps put a roof
-- over every room, hiding it except on the screen of whoever is inside
-- (RoofController).

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local MapThemes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapThemes)
local Parts = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Parts)

local MapBuilder = {}

local COLORS = MapLayout.COLORS -- the current map's theme palette (set in build)
local H = MapLayout.HEIGHTS
local WALL_HEIGHT = MapLayout.WALL_HEIGHT

type Rect = MapLayout.Rect
type Layout = MapLayout.Layout

local mapFolder: Folder
local wallsFolder: Folder? = nil
local brokenSegments: { Model } = {}

local function sub(name: string, parent: Instance): Folder
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = name
	f.Parent = parent
	return f
end

-- Thin detail lying on a surface whose top is `surfaceY`.
local function detail(
	name: string,
	x: number,
	z: number,
	sx: number,
	sz: number,
	surfaceY: number,
	color: string,
	parent: Instance,
	yaw: number?
): Part
	local part = Parts.make({
		name = name,
		size = Vector3.new(sx, 0.04, sz),
		cframe = CFrame.new(x, surfaceY + 0.015, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw or 0, 0),
		color = color,
		canCollide = false,
		canQuery = false,
		parent = parent,
	})
	return part
end

local function flatDisc(
	name: string,
	x: number,
	z: number,
	diameter: number,
	surfaceY: number,
	color: string,
	parent: Instance
)
	local part = Parts.disc(name, Vector3.new(x, surfaceY + 0.02, z), diameter, 0.05, color, parent)
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	return part
end

local function slab(name: string, r: Rect, topY: number, color: string, parent: Instance): Part
	return Parts.slab(name, r.x1, r.z1, r.x2, r.z2, topY, 0.4, color, parent)
end

-- Ground, decorations, paths -----------------------------------------------------

local function speckle(
	r: Rect,
	surfaceY: number,
	color: string,
	perArea: number,
	rng: Random,
	parent: Instance
)
	local count = math.floor((r.x2 - r.x1) * (r.z2 - r.z1) / perArea)
	for _ = 1, count do
		flatDisc(
			"Speck",
			rng:NextNumber(r.x1 + 0.4, r.x2 - 0.4),
			rng:NextNumber(r.z1 + 0.4, r.z2 - 0.4),
			rng:NextNumber(0.25, 0.5),
			surfaceY,
			color,
			parent
		)
	end
end

local function buildGround(parent: Instance, layout: Layout)
	-- Outside the brick wall: a darker field, far bigger than the playable
	-- area so the camera never sees past it (beyond it you'd see the sky).
	local outside = Parts.slab("Outside", -900, -900, 900, 900, H.Grass - 0.05, 4, COLORS.Outside, parent)
	outside.Name = "Outside"
	local b = layout.bounds
	local ground = Parts.slab("Grass", b.x1, b.z1, b.x2, b.z2, H.Grass, 4, COLORS.Grass, parent)
	ground.Name = "Ground"

	local decor = sub("GrassDetails", parent)
	local rng = Random.new(1337)
	local blocked = MapLayout.noDecorRects(layout)
	local bounds = layout.bounds
	local function isFree(x: number, z: number): boolean
		for _, r in blocked do
			if MapLayout.inRect(r, x, z, 1) then
				return false
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	local placed = 0
	local tries = 0
	while placed < 460 and tries < 6000 do
		tries += 1
		local x = rng:NextNumber(bounds.x1 + 3, bounds.x2 - 3)
		local z = rng:NextNumber(bounds.z1 + 3, bounds.z2 - 3)
		if isFree(x, z) then
			placed += 1
			local roll = rng:NextNumber()
			if roll < 0.5 then
				-- Tuft: three dark blades fanned out.
				for _, angle in { -0.5, 0, 0.5 } do
					detail("Tuft", x + angle * 0.5, z, 0.25, 1.1, H.Grass, COLORS.GrassTuft, decor, angle)
				end
			elseif roll < 0.7 then
				flatDisc("Flower", x, z, 1.0, H.Grass, COLORS.Flower, decor)
				flatDisc("FlowerCenter", x, z, 0.35, H.Grass + 0.03, COLORS.FlowerCenter, decor)
			elseif roll < 0.88 then
				flatDisc("Pebble", x, z, rng:NextNumber(0.5, 0.9), H.Grass, COLORS.Pebble, decor)
				if rng:NextNumber() < 0.5 then
					flatDisc(
						"Pebble",
						x + 0.8,
						z + 0.3,
						rng:NextNumber(0.35, 0.6),
						H.Grass,
						COLORS.Pebble,
						decor
					)
				end
			else
				local yaw = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi)
				detail("Twig", x, z, 0.16, 1.5, H.Grass, COLORS.Twig, decor, yaw)
				detail("Twig", x + 0.3, z + 0.2, 0.12, 0.6, H.Grass, COLORS.Twig, decor, yaw + 0.8)
			end
		end
	end

	local paths = sub("Paths", parent)
	for _, r in layout.paths do
		slab("Dirt", r, H.Dirt, COLORS.Dirt, paths)
		speckle(r, H.Dirt, COLORS.DirtSpeck, 14, rng, paths)
	end

	local patios = sub("Patios", parent)
	for _, r in layout.patios do
		slab("Patio", r, H.Patio, COLORS.Concrete, patios)
		speckle(r, H.Patio, COLORS.ConcreteSpeck, 30, rng, patios)
	end
end

-- Pools: a white rim, blue water with light ripples, and an invisible wall
-- so nobody walks across the water.
local function buildPools(parent: Instance, layout: Layout)
	for _, r in layout.pools do
		local rim = { x1 = r.x1 - 1.5, z1 = r.z1 - 1.5, x2 = r.x2 + 1.5, z2 = r.z2 + 1.5 }
		slab("PoolRim", rim, H.PoolRim, COLORS.PoolRim, parent)
		slab("PoolWater", r, H.PoolRim + 0.02, COLORS.PoolWater, parent)
		local z = r.z1 + 3
		while z < r.z2 - 2 do
			detail(
				"Ripple",
				(r.x1 + r.x2) / 2 + math.sin(z) * 4,
				z,
				(r.x2 - r.x1) * 0.6,
				0.3,
				H.PoolRim + 0.02,
				"8FD3F5",
				parent
			)
			z += 5
		end
		Parts.make({
			name = "PoolWall",
			size = Vector3.new(r.x2 - r.x1 + 2, 6, r.z2 - r.z1 + 2),
			cframe = CFrame.new((r.x1 + r.x2) / 2, 3, (r.z1 + r.z2) / 2),
			color = "000000",
			transparency = 1,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = parent,
		})
	end
end

local function buildRoad(parent: Instance, layout: Layout)
	local road = layout.road
	local rng = Random.new(99)
	for _, r in road.sidewalks do
		slab("Sidewalk", r, H.Sidewalk, COLORS.Sidewalk, parent)
		speckle(r, H.Sidewalk, COLORS.SidewalkSpeck, 40, rng, parent)
	end
	for _, r in road.asphalt do
		slab("Asphalt", r, H.Asphalt, COLORS.Asphalt, parent)
	end
	for _, r in road.centerLines do
		slab("CenterLine", r, H.RoadLine, COLORS.CenterLine, parent)
	end
	for _, r in road.edgeLines do
		slab("EdgeLine", r, H.RoadLine, COLORS.EdgeLine, parent)
	end
	for _, island in layout.islands do
		slab("IslandWalk", island.walk, H.IslandWalk, COLORS.Sidewalk, parent)
		slab("IslandGrass", island.grass, H.IslandGrass, COLORS.Grass, parent)
	end

	for _, spawn in layout.zombieSpawns do
		flatDisc("ZombiePit", spawn.x, spawn.z, 11, H.RoadLine, COLORS.ZombiePit, parent)
		flatDisc("ZombiePitInner", spawn.x, spawn.z, 7, H.RoadLine + 0.03, "4A1C1C", parent)
	end
end

-- Floors ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function brickFloor(r: Rect, parent: Instance)
	slab("Brick", r, H.Floor, COLORS.Brick, parent)
	local row = 0
	local z = r.z1
	while z < r.z2 - 0.5 do
		local nextZ = math.min(z + 2.5, r.z2)
		if nextZ < r.z2 then
			detail("Mortar", (r.x1 + r.x2) / 2, nextZ, r.x2 - r.x1, 0.22, H.Floor, COLORS.BrickMortar, parent)
		end
		local x = r.x1 + (if row % 2 == 0 then 5 else 2.5)
		while x < r.x2 - 0.5 do
			detail("Joint", x, (z + nextZ) / 2, 0.22, nextZ - z, H.Floor, COLORS.BrickMortar, parent)
			x += 5
		end
		z = nextZ
		row += 1
	end
end

local function tileFloor(r: Rect, parent: Instance)
	slab("Tile", r, H.Floor, COLORS.Tile, parent)
	local size = 4
	local i = 0
	local x = r.x1
	while x < r.x2 - 0.01 do
		local x2 = math.min(x + size, r.x2)
		local j = 0
		local z = r.z1
		while z < r.z2 - 0.01 do
			local z2 = math.min(z + size, r.z2)
			if (i + j) % 2 == 1 then
				detail("TileAlt", (x + x2) / 2, (z + z2) / 2, x2 - x, z2 - z, H.Floor, COLORS.TileAlt, parent)
			end
			z = z2
			j += 1
		end
		x = x2
		i += 1
	end
end

local function woodFloor(r: Rect, parent: Instance, rng: Random)
	slab("Wood", r, H.Floor, COLORS.Wood, parent)
	local z = r.z1 + 2.5
	while z < r.z2 - 0.5 do
		detail("Plank", (r.x1 + r.x2) / 2, z, r.x2 - r.x1, 0.18, H.Floor, COLORS.WoodLine, parent)
		local x = r.x1 + rng:NextNumber(3, 12)
		while x < r.x2 - 2 do
			detail("PlankEnd", x, z - 1.25, 0.18, 2.5, H.Floor, COLORS.WoodLine, parent)
			x += rng:NextNumber(11, 17)
		end
		z += 2.5
	end
end

local function concreteFloor(r: Rect, parent: Instance, rng: Random)
	slab("Concrete", r, H.Floor, COLORS.Concrete, parent)
	speckle(r, H.Floor, COLORS.ConcreteSpeck, 12, rng, parent)
end

local function buildFloors(parent: Instance, layout: Layout)
	local rng = Random.new(7)
	for _, room in layout.rooms do
		local folder = sub(room.house .. " " .. room.name, parent)
		if room.floor == "Brick" then
			brickFloor(room.rect, folder)
		elseif room.floor == "Dirt" then
			slab("Dirt", room.rect, H.Floor, COLORS.Dirt, folder)
			speckle(room.rect, H.Floor, COLORS.DirtSpeck, 30, rng, folder)
		elseif room.floor == "Tile" then
			tileFloor(room.rect, folder)
		elseif room.floor == "Concrete" then
			concreteFloor(room.rect, folder, rng)
		else
			woodFloor(room.rect, folder, rng)
		end
	end
end

-- Walls ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function outlineColor(layout: Layout, houseId: string): string
	for _, house in layout.houses do
		if house.id == houseId then
			return if house.outline == "Orange" then COLORS.OutlineOrange else COLORS.OutlineBlue
		end
	end
	return COLORS.OutlineBlue
end

local function wallColor(layout: Layout, houseId: string): string
	for _, house in layout.houses do
		if house.id == houseId and house.wall then
			return house.wall
		end
	end
	return COLORS.Wall
end

local function buildWalls(parent: Instance, layout: Layout)
	for i, piece in MapLayout.allWallPieces(layout) do
		local r = piece.rect
		local sx, sz = r.x2 - r.x1, r.z2 - r.z1
		local cx, cz = (r.x1 + r.x2) / 2, (r.z1 + r.z2) / 2
		local segment = Instance.new("Model")
		segment.Name = "WallSegment" .. i

		local wall = Parts.make({
			name = "Wall",
			size = Vector3.new(sx, WALL_HEIGHT, sz),
			cframe = CFrame.new(cx, WALL_HEIGHT / 2, cz),
			color = wallColor(layout, piece.house),
			parent = segment,
		})
		-- A slightly bigger, slightly lower slab: from above only its edge shows,
		-- which draws a colored outline around the whole wall shape.
		Parts.make({
			name = "Outline",
			size = Vector3.new(sx + 1, WALL_HEIGHT - 0.1, sz + 1),
			cframe = CFrame.new(cx, (WALL_HEIGHT - 0.1) / 2, cz),
			color = outlineColor(layout, piece.house),
			canCollide = false, -- keeps doorways at their designed width
			canQuery = false,
			parent = segment,
		})
		if piece.window then
			Parts.make({
				name = "Window",
				size = if piece.horizontal then Vector3.new(sx, 0.1, 1.2) else Vector3.new(1.2, 0.1, sz),
				cframe = CFrame.new(cx, WALL_HEIGHT + 0.05, cz),
				color = COLORS.Window,
				canCollide = false,
				canQuery = false,
				parent = segment,
			})
		end
		if piece.secret then
			-- Looks like any other wall and blocks furniture, shots and the bots'
			-- view (and their pathfinding), but people walk straight through.
			wall.CollisionGroup = "SecretWalls"
			segment:SetAttribute("Secret", true)
		end
		segment.PrimaryPart = wall
		segment:SetAttribute("House", piece.house)
		CollectionService:AddTag(segment, "Breakable")
		segment.Parent = parent
	end
end

-- Bushes and boundary -------------------------------------------------------------

-- Tall leaf cylinders you can walk into. Seen from the top-down camera they
-- cover anyone standing inside (see Bushes.luau).
-- A lighter (k > 1) or darker (k < 1) version of a hex color.
local function shade(hex: string, k: number): string
	local c = Color3.fromHex(hex)
	if k >= 1 then
		local t = k - 1
		return Color3.new(c.R + (1 - c.R) * t, c.G + (1 - c.G) * t, c.B + (1 - c.B) * t):ToHex()
	end
	return Color3.new(c.R * k, c.G * k, c.B * k):ToHex()
end

local function buildBushes(parent: Instance, layout: Layout)
	local height = Config.BUSH_HEIGHT
	local classic = layout.theme == "Classic"
	for _, bush in layout.bushes do
		local orange = bush.color == "Orange"
		local cobweb = bush.color == "Cobweb" -- an indoor hiding spot: a big clump of webs
		local base = if cobweb then "C3C9CF" elseif orange then COLORS.BushOrange else COLORS.BushGreen
		-- Classic keeps its hand-picked shades; other themes derive them.
		local light = if classic and not cobweb
			then (if orange then "F2AC62" else "5CBF67")
			else shade(base, 1.3)
		local model = Instance.new("Model")
		model.Name = "Bush"
		local blobs = {
			{ 0, 0, bush.r * 2 },
			{ math.cos(0.7) * bush.r * 0.6, math.sin(0.7) * bush.r * 0.6, bush.r * 1.4 },
			{ math.cos(3.5) * bush.r * 0.6, math.sin(3.5) * bush.r * 0.6, bush.r * 1.3 },
		}
		local outline = if classic and not cobweb
			then (if orange then "B5651E" else "2E7D3E")
			else shade(base, 0.65)
		for _, blob in blobs do
			-- A darker, slightly bigger, slightly lower disc draws the outline.
			Parts.disc(
				"Outline",
				Vector3.new(bush.x + blob[1], (height - 0.1) / 2, bush.z + blob[2]),
				blob[3] + 0.7,
				height - 0.1,
				outline,
				model
			)
		end
		for _, blob in blobs do
			Parts.disc(
				"Leaves",
				Vector3.new(bush.x + blob[1], height / 2, bush.z + blob[2]),
				blob[3],
				height,
				base,
				model
			)
			Parts.disc(
				"Highlight",
				Vector3.new(bush.x + blob[1] - 0.2, height + 0.03, bush.z + blob[2] - 0.2),
				blob[3] * 0.6,
				0.06,
				light,
				model
			)
		end
		if cobweb then
			-- Strands across the top.
			for k = 0, 3 do
				local strand = Parts.make({
					name = "Strand",
					size = Vector3.new(bush.r * 2.2, 0.05, 0.12),
					cframe = CFrame.new(bush.x, height + 0.08, bush.z) * CFrame.Angles(0, k * math.pi / 4, 0),
					color = "F4F6F8",
					parent = model,
				})
				strand.Transparency = 0.3
			end
		end
		-- Walk-through and shoot-through: bushes only hide what's inside.
		for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.CanCollide = false
				part.CanQuery = false
				part.CanTouch = false
			end
		end
		model.Parent = parent
	end
end

-- A brick wall around the playable area so it's obvious where the map ends:
-- brick-textured tops with a dark cap line on the inside edge, plus an
-- invisible tall barrier on top so nothing is ever knocked over it.
local BOUNDARY_THICKNESS = 3
local BOUNDARY_HEIGHT = 8

type Side = { cx: number, cz: number, sx: number, sz: number, inward: Vector3 }

local function buildBoundary(parent: Instance, layout: Layout)
	local b = layout.bounds
	local t = BOUNDARY_THICKNESS
	local w, d = b.x2 - b.x1, b.z2 - b.z1
	local sides: { Side } = {
		{ cx = (b.x1 + b.x2) / 2, cz = b.z1 - t / 2, sx = w + t * 2, sz = t, inward = Vector3.zAxis },
		{ cx = (b.x1 + b.x2) / 2, cz = b.z2 + t / 2, sx = w + t * 2, sz = t, inward = -Vector3.zAxis },
		{ cx = b.x1 - t / 2, cz = (b.z1 + b.z2) / 2, sx = t, sz = d, inward = Vector3.xAxis },
		{ cx = b.x2 + t / 2, cz = (b.z1 + b.z2) / 2, sx = t, sz = d, inward = -Vector3.xAxis },
	}
	for _, side in sides do
		local cx, cz, sx, sz, inward = side.cx, side.cz, side.sx, side.sz, side.inward
		Parts.make({
			name = "BrickWall",
			size = Vector3.new(sx, BOUNDARY_HEIGHT, sz),
			cframe = CFrame.new(cx, BOUNDARY_HEIGHT / 2, cz),
			color = COLORS.BoundaryBrick,
			material = Enum.Material.Brick,
			parent = parent,
		})
		-- Dark line along the inside edge, like the outline on house walls.
		local edge = Vector3.new(cx, 0, cz) + inward * (t / 2 - 0.25)
		Parts.make({
			name = "WallCap",
			size = if inward.X == 0 then Vector3.new(sx, 0.1, 0.5) else Vector3.new(0.5, 0.1, sz),
			cframe = CFrame.new(edge.X, BOUNDARY_HEIGHT + 0.05, edge.Z),
			color = COLORS.BoundaryCap,
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = parent,
		})
		Parts.make({
			name = "Boundary",
			size = Vector3.new(sx, 40, sz),
			cframe = CFrame.new(cx, BOUNDARY_HEIGHT + 20, cz),
			color = "000000",
			transparency = 1,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = parent,
		})
	end
end

-- Public ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Surface physics for furniture (see FurnitureBuilder): the weight-100 side
-- of a contact decides its friction.
local SLIPPERY = PhysicalProperties.new(0.7, 0, 0, 100, 1)
local GRIPPY = PhysicalProperties.new(0.7, 1, 0, 100, 1)

local function setPhysics(folder: Instance, properties: PhysicalProperties)
	for _, part in folder:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
			part.CustomPhysicalProperties = properties
		end
	end
end

-- Builds `layout`, replacing whatever map was there. The Walls folder is
-- kept (only emptied) so raycast filters that point at it stay valid.
-- Extra parts a map built in Studio brought along (anything not named as a
-- map part: statues, trees, signs...), by map name. Main wires this to
-- MapStudio.
local decorFor: (string) -> Instance? = function()
	return nil
end

function MapBuilder.setDecor(lookup: (string) -> Instance?)
	decorFor = lookup
end

local function collides(instance: Instance): boolean
	if instance:IsA("BasePart") and instance.CanCollide then
		return true
	end
	for _, d in instance:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.CanCollide then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Solid ones go with the walls (bots see them as walls; they never break).
local function buildDecor(layout: Layout, walls: Folder)
	local template = decorFor(layout.name)
	if not template then
		return
	end
	local open = sub("Custom", mapFolder)
	local solid = sub("Custom", walls)
	for _, child in template:GetChildren() do
		child:Clone().Parent = if collides(child) then solid else open
	end
end

-- Roofs: one over every room of every house, just under the wall tops so
-- the walls still draw the floor plan. Each player's RoofController hides
-- the roof of the room they stand in, so you see inside only once you're in.
local function buildRoofs(parent: Folder, layout: Layout)
	for _, room in layout.rooms do
		if room.house == "" then
			continue -- yards (a graveyard, a pumpkin patch) stay open
		end
		local r = room.rect
		local roof = Parts.make({
			name = "Roof",
			size = Vector3.new(r.x2 - r.x1, 0.3, r.z2 - r.z1),
			cframe = CFrame.new((r.x1 + r.x2) / 2, WALL_HEIGHT - 0.2, (r.z1 + r.z2) / 2),
			color = COLORS.Roof,
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = parent,
		})
		roof.CanTouch = false
		roof.CastShadow = false
		roof:SetAttribute("Room", room.house .. " " .. room.name)
	end
	-- A shut-looking door in every doorway, poking up through the roofs. It's
	-- only a look: walk straight through.
	for _, door in MapLayout.doors(layout) do
		local length = door.width - 0.2
		local height = WALL_HEIGHT + 0.1
		local panel = Parts.make({
			name = "Door",
			size = if door.horizontal
				then Vector3.new(length, height, 0.8)
				else Vector3.new(0.8, height, length),
			cframe = CFrame.new(door.x, height / 2, door.z),
			color = COLORS.Door,
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = parent,
		})
		panel.CanTouch = false
	end
end

-- Sky and light for the map's theme.
local function applyLighting(theme: MapThemes.Theme)
	local l = theme.lighting
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromHex(l.ambient)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromHex(l.outdoor)
	Lighting.Brightness = l.brightness
	Lighting.ClockTime = l.clock
	-- Dark maps need shadows so walls stop your lantern.
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = theme.dark == true
	local tint = Lighting:FindFirstChild("ThemeColor") :: ColorCorrectionEffect?
	if not tint then
		local made = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
		made.Name = "ThemeColor"
		made.Parent = Lighting
		tint = made
	end
	assert(tint, "tint")
	tint.TintColor = Color3.fromHex(l.tint or "FFFFFF")
	tint.Saturation = l.saturation or 0
	tint.Contrast = l.contrast or 0
end

function MapBuilder.build(layout: Layout)
	mapFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("Map") :: Folder
	local theme = MapThemes.get(layout.theme)
	COLORS = MapThemes.palette(layout.theme)
	applyLighting(theme)
	local walls = wallsFolder or sub("Walls", mapFolder)
	wallsFolder = walls
	for _, child in mapFolder:GetChildren() do
		if child ~= walls then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	walls:ClearAllChildren()
	table.clear(brokenSegments)

	local ground = sub("Ground", mapFolder)
	buildGround(ground, layout)
	local road = sub("Road", mapFolder)
	buildRoad(road, layout)
	local pools = sub("Pools", mapFolder)
	buildPools(pools, layout)
	local floors = sub("Floors", mapFolder)
	buildFloors(floors, layout)
	buildWalls(walls, layout)
	local bushes = sub("Bushes", mapFolder)
	buildBushes(bushes, layout)
	buildBoundary(sub("Boundary", mapFolder), layout)
	buildDecor(layout, walls)
	if layout.roofs then
		buildRoofs(sub("Roofs", mapFolder), layout)
	end
	for _, folder in { ground, road, floors } do
		setPhysics(folder, SLIPPERY)
	end
	setPhysics(walls, GRIPPY)
	setPhysics(pools, GRIPPY)
	mapFolder:SetAttribute("MapName", layout.name)
	mapFolder:SetAttribute("Theme", theme.name) -- clients light dark maps (DarknessController)
end

function MapBuilder.wallsFolder(): Folder
	assert(wallsFolder, "MapBuilder.build has not run yet")
	return wallsFolder
end

-- Shotgun hit: hide a wall segment until the next round.
function MapBuilder.breakSegment(segment: Model): boolean
	if segment:GetAttribute("Broken") or not CollectionService:HasTag(segment, "Breakable") then
		return false
	end
	segment:SetAttribute("Broken", true)
	for _, part in segment:GetChildren() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part:SetAttribute("WasCollide", part.CanCollide)
			part:SetAttribute("WasQuery", part.CanQuery)
			part.Transparency = 1
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.CanQuery = false
		end
	end
	table.insert(brokenSegments, segment)
	return true
end

function MapBuilder.restoreWalls()
	for _, segment in brokenSegments do
		segment:SetAttribute("Broken", nil)
		for _, part in segment:GetChildren() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.Transparency = 0
				part.CanCollide = part:GetAttribute("WasCollide") ~= false
				part.CanQuery = part:GetAttribute("WasQuery") ~= false
			end
		end
	end
	table.clear(brokenSegments)
end

-- Finds the breakable segment a part belongs to.
function MapBuilder.segmentOf(part: Instance): Model?
	local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	if model and CollectionService:HasTag(model, "Breakable") then
		return model
	end
	return nil
end

return MapBuilder

scripts.name: MapStudio
scripts.source:
-- Maps you build in Roblox Studio (README "Making your own maps").
--
-- Workspace.BrainTagMaps holds one folder per map, made of parts named for
-- what they are: Bounds, Wall, Door, Window, Floor, House, HumanSpawn,
-- ZombieSpawn, Start, ItemSpot, WizardSpot, Bush, Road... and any furniture
-- name (Couch, PoolTable...). Anything else you add (a statue, a tree, a
-- sign) is kept as scenery: solid scenery counts as wall for the bots and
-- never breaks. When the game starts it reads every map folder (see
-- MapMarks), adds it to the rotation and tucks the folder away. A map named
-- like a built-in one (Neighborhood, Mansion) replaces it.
--
-- Command Bar helpers (in Studio, while not playing):
--   local Maps = require(game.ServerScriptService.Server.MapStudio)
--   Maps.copy("Neighborhood")         -- edit a built-in map
--   Maps.copy("Mansion", "Castle")    -- start a new map from a built-in one
--   Maps.new("MyMap")                 -- a small starter map
--   Maps.new("Spooky", "Haunted")     -- ...in a theme (MapThemes: Classic,
--                                        Haunted, Winter, Lab, Desert)
--   Maps.resize("MyMap", 400, 300)    -- make the play area bigger (studs)
--   Maps.palette()                    -- one of every part, to copy from
--   Maps.check()                      -- what each map has, and any mistakes
--   Maps.unlock()                     -- unlock parts made by older versions
--
-- Map folder attributes: Title, Enabled, Theme (see MapThemes) and Roofs
-- (every room gets a pitch black roof hiding it, except on the screen of
-- whoever is inside, plus a shut-looking door in each doorway).

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local FurnitureBuilder = require(script.Parent.FurnitureBuilder)
