local FurnitureSpecs = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.FurnitureSpecs)
local MapLayout = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.MapLayout)
local MapMarks = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.MapMarks)
local MapThemes = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.MapThemes)

type Mark = MapMarks.Mark
type Rect = MapLayout.Rect

local MapStudio = {}

local FOLDER = "BrainTagMaps"
local H = MapLayout.HEIGHTS
local WALL_H = MapLayout.WALL_HEIGHT

-- How each kind looks while you edit (top = height of its top above the
-- ground, which is the top of the Bounds part). `color` is a theme palette
-- name (MapLayout.COLORS) or a hex color.
type Look = {
	color: string,
	top: number,
	height: number,
	transparency: number?,
	disc: boolean?,
	label: boolean?,
	group: string,
}

local LOOKS: { [string]: Look } = {
	Bounds = { color = "Grass", top = 0, height = 1, group = "Ground" },
	Road = { color = "Asphalt", top = H.Asphalt, height = 0.1, group = "Ground" },
	Sidewalk = { color = "Sidewalk", top = H.Sidewalk, height = 0.1, group = "Ground" },
	CenterLine = { color = "CenterLine", top = H.RoadLine, height = 0.05, group = "Ground" },
	EdgeLine = { color = "EdgeLine", top = H.RoadLine, height = 0.05, group = "Ground" },
	Path = { color = "Dirt", top = H.Dirt, height = 0.05, group = "Ground" },
	Patio = { color = "Concrete", top = H.Patio, height = 0.05, group = "Ground" },
	Pool = { color = "PoolWater", top = H.PoolRim, height = 0.3, group = "Ground" },
	IslandWalk = { color = "Sidewalk", top = H.IslandWalk, height = 0.1, group = "Ground" },
	IslandGrass = { color = "Grass", top = H.IslandGrass, height = 0.05, group = "Ground" },
	House = {
		color = "OutlineBlue",
		top = 0.06,
		height = 0.05,
		transparency = 0.3,
		group = "Buildings",
	},
	Floor = { color = "Wood", top = H.Floor, height = 0.2, group = "Buildings" },
	Wall = { color = "Wall", top = WALL_H, height = WALL_H, group = "Buildings" },
	Door = {
		color = "39D353",
		top = WALL_H + 1,
		height = WALL_H + 1,
		transparency = 0.3,
		group = "Buildings",
	},
	Window = { color = "Window", top = WALL_H + 0.5, height = WALL_H + 0.5, group = "Buildings" },
	SecretWall = {
		color = "B05CFF",
		top = WALL_H + 1.2,
		height = WALL_H + 1.2,
		transparency = 0.35,
		group = "Buildings",
	},
	HumanSpawn = { color = "3B82F6", top = 0.9, height = 0.5, disc = true, label = true, group = "Spawns" },
	ZombieSpawn = { color = "E0303A", top = 0.9, height = 0.5, disc = true, label = true, group = "Spawns" },
	Start = { color = "FFFFFF", top = 0.9, height = 0.5, disc = true, label = true, group = "Spawns" },
	ItemSpot = { color = "F5C542", top = 0.9, height = 0.5, disc = true, label = true, group = "Spawns" },
	WizardSpot = { color = "9B59B6", top = 0.9, height = 0.5, disc = true, label = true, group = "Spawns" },
	Bush = { color = "BushGreen", top = 6, height = 6, disc = true, group = "Bushes" },
}

local FLOOR_LOOKS: { [string]: { color: string, material: Enum.Material } } = {
	Dirt = { color = "Dirt", material = Enum.Material.Ground },
	Brick = { color = "Brick", material = Enum.Material.Brick },
	Tile = { color = "Tile", material = Enum.Material.Slate },
	Wood = { color = "Wood", material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks },
	Concrete = { color = "Concrete", material = Enum.Material.Concrete },
}

-- Reading parts ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function attr(instance: Instance, name: string): string?
	local value = instance:GetAttribute(name)
	return if typeof(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then value else nil
end

-- Size of a box seen from above, along world X and Z (any rotation).
local function extents(cf: CFrame, size: Vector3): (number, number, number)
	local r, u, l = cf.RightVector, cf.UpVector, cf.LookVector
	local w = math.abs(r.X) * size.X + math.abs(u.X) * size.Y + math.abs(l.X) * size.Z
	local h = math.abs(r.Y) * size.X + math.abs(u.Y) * size.Y + math.abs(l.Y) * size.Z
	local d = math.abs(r.Z) * size.X + math.abs(u.Z) * size.Y + math.abs(l.Z) * size.Z
	return w, d, h
end

-- Degrees turned about the vertical (CFrame.Angles(0, a, 0) gives a).
local function yawOf(cf: CFrame): number
	local look = cf.LookVector
	return math.deg(math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z))
end

local function floorOf(part: BasePart): string
	local m = part.Material
	if m == Enum.Material.Brick then
		return "Brick"
	elseif
		m == Enum.Material.Concrete
		or m == Enum.Material.Asphalt
		or m == Enum.Material.Cobblestone
		or m == Enum.Material.Pavement
	then
		return "Concrete"
	elseif m == Enum.Material.Ground or m == Enum.Material.Mud or m == Enum.Material.Sand then
		return "Dirt"
	elseif
		m == Enum.Material.Slate
		or m == Enum.Material.Marble
		or m == Enum.Material.Granite
		or m == Enum.Material.Basalt
	then
		return "Tile"
	end
	return "Wood"
end

local function orange(instance: Instance): boolean
	if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
		local c = instance.Color
		return c.R > c.G + 0.1
	end
	return false
end

-- Map coordinates start at the middle of the Bounds part's top.
local function originOf(bounds: BasePart): Vector3
	local _, _, h = extents(bounds.CFrame, bounds.Size)
	return Vector3.new(bounds.Position.X, bounds.Position.Y + h / 2, bounds.Position.Z)
end

local function markOf(child: Instance, kind: string, origin: Vector3): Mark
	local cf: CFrame, w: number, d: number
	if child:IsA("Model") then
		if MapMarks.isFurniture(kind) then
			cf, w, d = child:GetPivot(), 0, 0
		else
			local box, size = child:GetBoundingBox()
			cf = box
			w, d = extents(box, size)
		end
	else
		local part = child :: BasePart
		cf = part.CFrame
		w, d = extents(part.CFrame, part.Size)
	end
	local m: Mark = { kind = kind, x = cf.X - origin.X, z = cf.Z - origin.Z, w = w, d = d, rot = yawOf(cf) }
	m.id = attr(child, "Id")
	if kind == "Floor" then
		m.floor = attr(child, "Floor") or (if child:IsA("BasePart") then floorOf(child) else nil)
	elseif kind == "House" then
		m.outline = attr(child, "Outline") or (if orange(child) then "Orange" else "Blue")
		m.color = attr(child, "WallColor")
	elseif kind == "Bush" then
		m.color = attr(child, "Color") or (if orange(child) then "Orange" else "Green")
	end
	return m
end

local function holdsKinds(instance: Instance): boolean
	for _, d in instance:GetDescendants() do
		if MapMarks.isKind(attr(d, "Kind") or d.Name) and (d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Model")) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- A map folder -> its layout (nil if it can't be played), the problems, and
-- its scenery (moved so the map's origin is at 0, 0, 0).
function MapStudio.read(folder: Instance): (MapLayout.Layout?, { string }, { string }, Model)
	local decor = Instance.new("Model")
	decor.Name = folder.Name .. " scenery"
	local bounds = folder:FindFirstChild("Bounds", true)
	if not (bounds and bounds:IsA("BasePart")) then
		return nil, { "No Bounds part: add a part named Bounds under the whole play area" }, {}, decor
	end
	local origin = originOf(bounds)
	local marks: { Mark } = {}
	local function visit(parent: Instance)
		for _, child in parent:GetChildren() do
			local kind = attr(child, "Kind") or child.Name
			local shape = child:IsA("BasePart") or child:IsA("Model")
			if shape and MapMarks.isKind(kind) then
				table.insert(marks, markOf(child, kind, origin))
			elseif child:IsA("Folder") or (child:IsA("Model") and holdsKinds(child)) then
				visit(child)
			elseif shape then
				local copy = child:Clone()
				if copy then
					for _, part in copy:GetDescendants() do
						if part:IsA("BasePart") then
							part.Anchored = true
						end
					end
					if copy:IsA("BasePart") then
						copy.Anchored = true
						copy.CFrame -= origin
					elseif copy:IsA("Model") then
						copy:PivotTo(copy:GetPivot() - origin)
					end
					(copy :: Instance).Parent = decor
				end
			end
		end
	end
	visit(folder)
	local layout, errors, warnings =
		MapMarks.toLayout(folder.Name, attr(folder, "Title") or folder.Name, marks)
	local theme = attr(folder, "Theme")
	if theme and MapThemes.exists(theme) then
		layout.theme = theme
	elseif theme then
		table.insert(
			warnings,
			"Unknown Theme " .. theme .. " (themes: " .. table.concat(MapThemes.NAMES, ", ") .. ")"
		)
	end
	layout.roofs = folder:GetAttribute("Roofs") == true
	return if #errors == 0 then layout else nil, errors, warnings, decor
end

-- Loading at game start -----------------------------------------------------------------------

local decorByMap: { [string]: Model } = {}

local function rootFolder(): Instance?
	return workspace:FindFirstChild(FOLDER) or ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(FOLDER)
end

local function isMap(folder: Instance): boolean
	return (folder:IsA("Folder") or folder:IsA("Model")) and string.sub(folder.Name, 1, 1) ~= "_"
end

-- Reads every map folder and adds the good ones to MapLayout. Call once,
-- before the first map is built. Returns the names loaded.
function MapStudio.loadAll(): { string }
	local root = rootFolder()
	if not root then
		return {}
	end
	root.Parent = ServerStorage -- the editable copies stay out of the game world
	local loaded = {}
	for _, folder in root:GetChildren() do
		if not isMap(folder) or folder:GetAttribute("Enabled") == false then
			continue
		end
		local ok, layout, errors, warnings, decor = pcall(MapStudio.read, folder)
		if not ok then
			warn(string.format("[Maps] %s couldn't be read: %s", folder.Name, tostring(layout)))
			continue
		end
		for _, text in warnings do
			warn(string.format("[Maps] %s: %s", folder.Name, text))
		end
		if layout then
			MapLayout.register(layout)
			if #decor:GetChildren() > 0 then
				decorByMap[layout.name] = decor
			end
			table.insert(loaded, layout.name)
			print(string.format("[Maps] loaded your map %s", folder.Name))
		else
			for _, text in errors do
				warn(string.format("[Maps] %s can't be played: %s", folder.Name, text))
			end
		end
	end
	return loaded
end

-- The scenery of a map built in Studio (for MapBuilder).
function MapStudio.decor(name: string): Instance?
	return decorByMap[name]
end

-- Making parts (Command Bar helpers) ---------------------------------------------------------

local function editing(): boolean
	if RunService:IsRunning() then
		warn("[Maps] Stop the game first: map helpers work while editing.")
		return false
	end
	return true
end

local function label(part: BasePart, text: string)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "Label"
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(12, 3) -- studs
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	textLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	textLabel.Text = text
	textLabel.TextScaled = true
	textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	textLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	textLabel.Parent = gui
	gui.Parent = part
end

local function groupFolder(map: Instance, name: string): Instance
	local found = map:FindFirstChild(name)
	if found then
		return found
	end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = name
	folder.Parent = map
	return folder
end

local function makeMark(m: Mark, origin: Vector3, parent: Instance, palette: { [string]: string }): Instance
	if MapMarks.isFurniture(m.kind) then
		local model = FurnitureBuilder.preview(
			{ kind = m.kind, x = origin.X + m.x, z = origin.Z + m.z, rot = m.rot, house = "" },
			parent
		)
		model:PivotTo(model:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, origin.Y, 0))
		return model
	end
	local look = LOOKS[m.kind]
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = m.kind
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	local color = palette[look.color] or look.color
	if m.kind == "Floor" then
		local floor = FLOOR_LOOKS[m.floor or "Wood"] or FLOOR_LOOKS.Wood
		color = palette[floor.color] or floor.color
		part.Material = floor.material
		part:SetAttribute("Floor", m.floor or "Wood")
	elseif m.kind == "House" then
		color = if m.outline == "Orange" then palette.OutlineOrange else palette.OutlineBlue
		part:SetAttribute("Outline", m.outline or "Blue")
		if m.color then
			part:SetAttribute("WallColor", m.color) -- hex, e.g. corn maze walls
		end
	elseif m.kind == "Bush" then
		color = if m.color == "Cobweb"
			then "C3C9CF"
			elseif m.color == "Orange" then palette.BushOrange
			else palette.BushGreen
		part:SetAttribute("Color", m.color or "Green")
	end
	if m.id then
		part:SetAttribute("Id", m.id)
	end
	part.Color = Color3.fromHex(color)
	part.Transparency = look.transparency or 0
	local center = Vector3.new(origin.X + m.x, origin.Y + look.top - look.height / 2, origin.Z + m.z)
	if look.disc then
		local diameter = math.max(m.w, m.d, 1)
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		part.Size = Vector3.new(look.height, diameter, diameter)
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(center) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	else
		part.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(m.w, 0.2), look.height, math.max(m.d, 0.2))
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(center)
	end
	if look.label then
		label(part, m.kind)
	end
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

local function ensureRoot(): Instance
	local root = rootFolder()
	if root then
		if root.Parent ~= workspace then
			root.Parent = workspace
		end
		return root
	end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = FOLDER
	folder.Parent = workspace
	return folder
end

-- Where a new map (or the palette) goes: just right of everything there.
local function freeOrigin(root: Instance, bounds: Rect): Vector3
	local right = -math.huge
	for _, child in root:GetChildren() do
		local b = child:FindFirstChild("Bounds", true)
		if b and b:IsA("BasePart") then
			local w = extents(b.CFrame, b.Size)
			right = math.max(right, b.Position.X + w / 2)
		elseif child.Name == "_Palette" and child:IsA("Folder") then
			for _, d in child:GetDescendants() do
				if d:IsA("BasePart") then
					right = math.max(right, d.Position.X + d.Size.Magnitude / 2)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	-- Lifted a stud so it never flickers against a Baseplate.
	if right == -math.huge then
		return Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	end
	return Vector3.new(right + 60 - bounds.x1, 1, 0)
end

local function show(folder: Instance, origin: Vector3, bounds: Rect)
	pcall(function()
		game:GetService("Selection"):Set({ folder })
	end)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera then
		local center = origin + Vector3.new((bounds.x1 + bounds.x2) / 2, 0, (bounds.z1 + bounds.z2) / 2)
		local size = math.max(bounds.x2 - bounds.x1, bounds.z2 - bounds.z1)
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(center + Vector3.new(0, size * 0.9, size * 0.45), center)
		camera.Focus = CFrame.new(center)
	end
	pcall(function()
		game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService"):SetWaypoint("Brain Tag map")
	end)
end

local function place(name: string, title: string, marks: { Mark }, theme: string, roofs: boolean): Instance?
	if not editing() then
		return nil
	end
	local root = ensureRoot()
	if root:FindFirstChild(name) then
		warn(
			string.format(
				"[Maps] BrainTagMaps already has %s. Pick another name, or delete that folder first.",
				name
			)
		)
		return nil
	end
	local bounds: Rect = { x1 = -100, z1 = -100, x2 = 100, z2 = 100 }
	for _, m in marks do
		if m.kind == "Bounds" then
			bounds = { x1 = m.x - m.w / 2, z1 = m.z - m.d / 2, x2 = m.x + m.w / 2, z2 = m.z + m.d / 2 }
		end
	end
	local origin = freeOrigin(root, bounds)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = name
	folder:SetAttribute("Title", title)
	folder:SetAttribute("Enabled", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("Theme", theme)
	folder:SetAttribute("Roofs", roofs)
	local palette = MapThemes.palette(theme) :: any
	for _, m in marks do
		local group = if MapMarks.isFurniture(m.kind) then "Furniture" else LOOKS[m.kind].group
		makeMark(m, origin, groupFolder(folder, group), palette)
	end
	folder.Parent = root
	show(folder, origin, bounds)
	print(
		string.format(
			"[Maps] Made %s in Workspace.BrainTagMaps. Edit it, then press Play: it plays first.",
			name
		)
	)
	return folder
end

-- A built-in map as parts. Keep its name to change that map, or give a
-- new name to start a new map from it.
function MapStudio.copy(name: string, newName: string?): Instance?
	local layout = MapLayout.get(name)
	if not layout then
		warn(
			"[Maps] No map called "
				.. tostring(name)
				.. ". Built-in maps: "
				.. table.concat(MapLayout.names, ", ")
		)
		return nil
	end
	local title = if newName then newName else layout.title
	return place(newName or name, title, MapMarks.fromLayout(layout), layout.theme, layout.roofs)
end

-- A small map to build on, in a theme (Classic if none).
function MapStudio.new(name: string?, theme: string?): Instance?
	local mapName = name or "MyMap"
	local themeName = theme or "Classic"
	if not MapThemes.exists(themeName) then
		warn("[Maps] No theme called " .. themeName .. ". Themes: " .. table.concat(MapThemes.NAMES, ", "))
		return nil
	end
	-- Dark maps get roofs (rooms stay pitch black until you walk in).
	local dark = MapThemes.get(themeName).dark == true
	return place(mapName, mapName, MapMarks.starter(), themeName, dark)
end

local function mapFolder(name: string): Instance?
	local root = rootFolder()
	local folder = root and root:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not folder then
		warn("[Maps] No map called " .. name .. " in Workspace.BrainTagMaps")
	end
	return folder
end

-- Makes a map's play area (its Bounds part) this many studs wide (X) and
-- deep (Z), keeping its middle where it is.
function MapStudio.resize(name: string, width: number, depth: number)
	if not editing() then
		return
	end
	local folder = mapFolder(name)
	local bounds = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Bounds", true)
	if not (bounds and bounds:IsA("BasePart")) then
		warn("[Maps] " .. name .. " has no Bounds part")
		return
	end
	bounds.Locked = false
	bounds.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(40, width), bounds.Size.Y, math.max(40, depth))
	pcall(function()
		game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService"):SetWaypoint("Resize map")
	end)
	print(
		string.format(
			"[Maps] %s is now %d x %d studs.",
			name,
			math.round(bounds.Size.X),
			math.round(bounds.Size.Z)
		)
	)
end

-- Unlocks every part in your maps (older versions locked the ground and
-- house plates, so Studio's tools couldn't move or scale them).
function MapStudio.unlock()
	local root = rootFolder()
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local count = 0
	for _, part in root:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Locked then
			part.Locked = false
			count += 1
		end
	end
	print(string.format("[Maps] Unlocked %d parts.", count))
end

-- One of every part (and every furniture piece) beside your maps, to copy
-- (Ctrl+D) into a map folder.
function MapStudio.palette(): Instance?
	if not editing() then
		return nil
	end
	local root = ensureRoot()
	local old = root:FindFirstChild("_Palette")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local samples: { Mark } = {}
	local function sample(kind: string, w: number, d: number, extra: { [string]: string }?): Mark
		local m: Mark = { kind = kind, x = 0, z = 0, w = w, d = d, rot = 0 }
		if extra then
			m.floor, m.color, m.outline = extra.floor, extra.color, extra.outline
		end
		table.insert(samples, m)
		return m
	end
	sample("Wall", 20, 3)
	sample("Door", 8, 3)
	sample("Window", 10, 3)
	sample("SecretWall", 8, 3)
	for _, floor in MapMarks.FLOORS do
		sample("Floor", 16, 16, { floor = floor })
	end
	sample("House", 16, 16, { outline = "Blue" })
	sample("House", 16, 16, { outline = "Orange" })
	for _, kind in { "HumanSpawn", "ZombieSpawn", "Start", "ItemSpot", "WizardSpot" } do
		sample(kind, 4, 4)
	end
	sample("Bush", 9, 9, { color = "Green" })
	sample("Bush", 9, 9, { color = "Orange" })
	sample("Bush", 6, 6, { color = "Cobweb" })
	sample("Road", 16, 16)
	sample("Sidewalk", 16, 8)
	sample("CenterLine", 16, 1)
	sample("EdgeLine", 16, 1)
	sample("Path", 16, 6)
	sample("Patio", 14, 14)
	sample("Pool", 16, 10)
	sample("IslandWalk", 16, 12)
	sample("IslandGrass", 12, 8)
	local kinds = {}
	for kind in FurnitureSpecs.specs do
		table.insert(kinds, kind)
	end
	table.sort(kinds)
	for _, kind in kinds do
		local spec = FurnitureSpecs.get(kind)
		sample(kind, spec.w, spec.d)
	end

	-- A grid of 26-stud cells, 8 across.
	local cell, across = 26, 8
	local rows = math.ceil(#samples / across)
	local bounds: Rect = { x1 = 0, z1 = 0, x2 = cell * across, z2 = cell * rows }
	local origin = freeOrigin(root, bounds)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "_Palette"
	for i, m in samples do
		local col, row = (i - 1) % across, (i - 1) // across
		m.x, m.z = (col + 0.5) * cell, (row + 0.5) * cell
		local made = makeMark(m, origin, folder, MapThemes.palette("Classic") :: any)
		local part = if made:IsA("Model") then made.PrimaryPart else made :: BasePart
		if part and not part:FindFirstChild("Label") then
			label(part, m.kind)
		end
	end
	folder.Parent = root
	show(folder, origin, bounds)
	print("[Maps] Palette ready: select a piece, Ctrl+D to copy it, then drag it into your map's folder.")
	return folder
end

-- What each map folder (or just `name`) has, and anything wrong with it.
function MapStudio.check(name: string?)
	local root = rootFolder()
	if not root then
		print('[Maps] No maps yet. Try: require(game.ServerScriptService.Server.MapStudio).new("MyMap")')
		return
	end
	for _, folder in root:GetChildren() do
		if not isMap(folder) or (name and folder.Name ~= name) then
			continue
		end
		local layout, errors, warnings = MapStudio.read(folder)
		if layout then
			local doors, windows = 0, 0
			for _, w in layout.walls do
				doors += #w.gaps
				windows += #w.windows
			end
			print(
				string.format(
					"[Maps] %s%s (theme %s): %d walls, %d doors, %d windows, %d rooms, %d furniture, %d human spawns, %d zombie spawns, %d item spots, %d bushes",
					folder.Name,
					if folder:GetAttribute("Enabled") == false then " (turned off)" else "",
					layout.theme,
					#layout.walls,
					doors,
					windows,
					#layout.rooms,
					#layout.furniture,
					#layout.humanSpawns,
					#layout.zombieSpawns,
					#layout.itemSpots,
					#layout.bushes
				)
			)
		end
		for _, text in errors do
			warn(string.format("[Maps] %s can't be played: %s", folder.Name, text))
		end
		for _, text in warnings do
			warn(string.format("[Maps] %s: %s", folder.Name, text))
		end
		if layout and #warnings == 0 then
			print(string.format("[Maps] %s is ready to play.", folder.Name))
		end
	end
end

return MapStudio

scripts.name: MonetizationService
scripts.source:
-- Robux purchases: game passes (permanent perks) and developer products
-- (one-off items, boosts and skins). Ids live in Config.MONETIZATION; any id
-- left at 0 is simply ignored.
--
-- ProcessReceipt follows Roblox's recommended pattern: a purchase is granted
-- once, recorded in the buyer's saved profile by its PurchaseId, and only
-- reported as granted after that profile is saved. If anything fails, Roblox
-- retries later and the receipt log prevents a double grant.

local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Announcer = require(script.Parent.Announcer)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local ItemService = require(script.Parent.ItemService)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Skins = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Skins)
local ShopService = require(script.Parent.ShopService)

type Participant = Participants.Participant

local MonetizationService = {}

local money = Config.MONETIZATION

local function keyFor(map: { [string]: number }, id: number): string?
	for key, value in map do
		if value ~= 0 and value == id then
			return key
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Game passes ----------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Which configured passes this player owns (yields; call before spawning).
function MonetizationService.ownedPasses(player: Player): { [string]: boolean }
	local owned: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for key, id in money.GamePasses do
		if id ~= 0 then
			local ok, has = pcall(function()
				return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, id)
			end)
			if ok and has then
				owned[key :: string] = true
			end
		end
	end
	return owned
end

local function applyPasses(p: Participant)
	-- Pass skins unlock automatically.
	for _, skin in Skins.list do
		if skin.pass and p.passes[skin.pass] then
			ShopService.grantSkin(p, skin.id)
		end
	end
	Participants.publish(p)
	CharacterService.refreshNameTag(p)
end

function MonetizationService.applyPasses(p: Participant)
	applyPasses(p)
end

-- Developer products -----------------------------------------------------------------

local function giveOrQueue(p: Participant, itemId: string)
	if p.team == "Human" and Participants.body(p) then
		ItemService.give(p, itemId)
		if p.player then
			Announcer.toast(p.player, "Delivered! It's in your inventory.", Config.COLORS.Good)
		end
	elseif p.profile then
		table.insert(p.profile.PendingItems, itemId)
		if p.player then
			Announcer.toast(p.player, "Saved for you: you'll get it next round.", Config.COLORS.Good)
		end
	end
end

type Handler = (p: Participant) -> ()

local HANDLERS: { [string]: Handler } = {
	InstantBat = function(p)
		giveOrQueue(p, "Bat")
	end,
	InstantSpear = function(p)
		giveOrQueue(p, "Spear")
	end,
	InstantShotgun = function(p)
		giveOrQueue(p, "Shotgun")
	end,
	InstantAncientSpear = function(p)
		giveOrQueue(p, "AncientSpear")
	end,
	ImmunityShot = function(p)
		Participants.setImmunity(p, p.immunity + money.IMMUNITY_SHOT_AMOUNT)
		if p.player then
			Announcer.toast(p.player, "Immunity boosted!", Config.COLORS.Good)
		end
	end,
	ScoreBoost30 = function(p)
		local now = os.time()
		p.boostEndsAt = math.max(now, p.boostEndsAt) + money.SCORE_BOOST_SECONDS
		if p.profile then
			p.profile.BoostEndsAt = p.boostEndsAt
		end
		p.state:SetAttribute("BoostEndsAt", p.boostEndsAt)
		if p.player then
			Announcer.toast(p.player, "2x score is active!", Config.COLORS.Good)
		end
	end,
}

-- Every skin sold as a product gets a handler that unlocks and equips it.
for _, skin in Skins.list do
	if skin.product then
		HANDLERS[skin.product] = function(p)
			ShopService.grantSkin(p, skin.id)
			ShopService.equipSkin(p, skin)
			if p.player then
				Announcer.toast(p.player, "Unlocked " .. skin.name .. "!", Config.COLORS.Good)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function processReceipt(receipt: { [string]: any }): Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receipt.PlayerId)
	if not player then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet -- retried when they rejoin
	end
	local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
	local profile = DataService.get(player)
	if not p or not profile then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	local key = keyFor(money.Products, receipt.ProductId)
	local handler = key and HANDLERS[key]
	if not handler then
		warn(
			"[Shop] Unknown product id "
				.. tostring(receipt.ProductId)
				.. "; add it to Config.MONETIZATION.Products"
		)
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	local receiptId = tostring(receipt.PurchaseId)
	if not profile.Receipts[receiptId] then
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			(handler :: Handler)(p)
			return true
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[Shop] Grant failed: " .. tostring(err))
			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
		end
		profile.Receipts[receiptId] = os.time()
	end

	if DataService.isSaved(player) then
		if DataService.save(player) then
			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	-- Studio test purchases are free; with saving off, grant for this session.
	if RunService:IsStudio() then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	end
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
end

function MonetizationService.init()
	MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = processReceipt

	MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, purchased)
		if not purchased then
			return
		end
		local key = keyFor(money.GamePasses, passId)
		local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
		if key and p then
			p.passes[key] = true
			applyPasses(p)
			Announcer.toast(player, "Thanks! Your pass is active.", Config.COLORS.Good)
		end
	end)
end

return MonetizationService

scripts.name: Participants
scripts.source:
-- Everyone taking part in rounds: real players and Studio test bots, behind
-- one interface. Each participant is mirrored into a Configuration under
-- ReplicatedStorage.BrainTagState.Participants so every client's HUD can read
-- teams, scores and held items.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Skins = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Skins)

export type Team = "Human" | "Zombie"

export type Slot = { id: string, charges: number? }

export type Participant = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	player: Player?,
	isBot: boolean,
	character: Model?,
	team: Team,
	score: number,
	immunity: number,
	scale: number,
	heldItem: string?, -- the item in the active slot (in your hand)
	slots: { [number]: Slot }, -- inventory: slot number -> item (missing = empty)
	slot: number, -- active slot
	humanSkin: string,
	zombieSkin: string,
	ownedSkins: { [string]: boolean },
	passes: { [string]: boolean },
	boostEndsAt: number,
	-- runtime only
	itemReadyAt: number,
	returnReadyAt: number,
	stunUntil: number,
	streaming: boolean, -- holding the button with a water gun / leaf blower
	nextStreamTick: number,
	heldCharges: number?, -- uses left (banana peels)
	boostUntil: number, -- energy drink
	boostFactor: number,
	slowUntil: number, -- snowball freeze
	adminSpeed: number, -- speed multiplier set from the admin panel (1 = normal)
	alpha: boolean, -- one of this round's first zombies (special look)
	turning: boolean, -- picked to be a first zombie: red name, slowed, until the outbreak
	knockedUntil: number, -- a real hit's shove lasts until then (see Combat.knockback)
	pressedUntil: number, -- bots: being held off someone's weapon (ItemService.shaftStep)
	slowFactor: number,
	spawning: boolean,
	aim: Vector3,
	profile: any?, -- saved data table for players (DataService)
	state: Configuration,
}

local Participants = {}

local byId: { [string]: Participant } = {}
local order: { Participant } = {}
-- Plain callback lists, not BindableEvents: a BindableEvent hands listeners a
-- COPY of any table it carries, and every service must share the same
-- participant table.
local addedCallbacks: { (Participant) -> () } = {}
local removingCallbacks: { (Participant) -> () } = {}

-- Runs `callback(p)` in its own thread for every participant added from now on.
function Participants.onAdded(callback: (Participant) -> ())
	table.insert(addedCallbacks, callback)
end

-- Runs `callback(p)` just before a participant is removed.
function Participants.onRemoving(callback: (Participant) -> ())
	table.insert(removingCallbacks, callback)
end

local function stateFolder(): Folder
	return ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BrainTagState"):WaitForChild("Participants") :: Folder
end

local function csv(set: { [string]: boolean }): string
	local list = {}
	for key, on in set do
		if on then
			table.insert(list, key)
		end
	end
	table.sort(list)
	return table.concat(list, ",")
end

-- Writes every replicated field. Cheap enough to call after any change.
function Participants.publish(p: Participant)
	local s = p.state
	s:SetAttribute("DisplayName", p.name)
	s:SetAttribute("UserId", if p.player then p.player.UserId else 0)
	s:SetAttribute("IsBot", p.isBot)
	s:SetAttribute("Team", p.team)
	s:SetAttribute("Score", math.floor(p.score))
	s:SetAttribute("Immunity", p.immunity)
	s:SetAttribute("Scale", p.scale)
	s:SetAttribute("HeldItem", p.heldItem or "")
	s:SetAttribute("HeldCharges", p.heldCharges or 0)
	s:SetAttribute("HumanSkin", p.humanSkin)
	s:SetAttribute("ZombieSkin", p.zombieSkin)
	s:SetAttribute("OwnedSkins", csv(p.ownedSkins))
	s:SetAttribute("Passes", csv(p.passes))
	s:SetAttribute("VIP", p.passes.VIP == true)
	s:SetAttribute("BoostEndsAt", p.boostEndsAt)
	if p.profile then
		s:SetAttribute("Wins", p.profile.Wins or 0)
		s:SetAttribute("Infections", p.profile.Infections or 0)
		s:SetAttribute("RoundsPlayed", p.profile.RoundsPlayed or 0)
		s:SetAttribute("BestScore", p.profile.BestScore or 0)
		s:SetAttribute("SeenTutorial", p.profile.SeenTutorial == true)
	end
end

export type NewParticipant = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	player: Player?,
	isBot: boolean,
	profile: any?,
	passes: { [string]: boolean }?,
}

function Participants.add(info: NewParticipant): Participant
	local state = Instance.new("Configuration")
	state.Name = info.id
	local profile = info.profile
	local owned = {}
	if profile and profile.OwnedSkins then
		for id, on in profile.OwnedSkins do
			owned[id] = on == true
		end
	end
	owned[Skins.DEFAULT_HUMAN] = true
	owned[Skins.DEFAULT_ZOMBIE] = true

	local p: Participant = {
		id = info.id,
		name = info.name,
		player = info.player,
		isBot = info.isBot,
		character = nil,
		team = "Human",
		-- Saved points, minus a little for having left.
		score = if profile then math.floor((profile.Score or 0) * Config.REJOIN_KEEP) else 0,
		immunity = 0,
		scale = 1,
		heldItem = nil,
		slots = {},
		slot = 1,
		humanSkin = if profile then profile.HumanSkin or Skins.DEFAULT_HUMAN else Skins.DEFAULT_HUMAN,
		zombieSkin = if profile then profile.ZombieSkin or Skins.DEFAULT_ZOMBIE else Skins.DEFAULT_ZOMBIE,
		ownedSkins = owned,
		passes = info.passes or {},
		boostEndsAt = if profile then profile.BoostEndsAt or 0 else 0,
		itemReadyAt = 0,
		returnReadyAt = 0,
		stunUntil = 0,
		streaming = false,
		nextStreamTick = 0,
		heldCharges = nil,
		boostUntil = 0,
		boostFactor = 1,
		slowUntil = 0,
		adminSpeed = 1,
		alpha = false,
		turning = false,
		knockedUntil = 0,
		pressedUntil = 0,
		slowFactor = 1,
		spawning = false,
		aim = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
		profile = profile,
		state = state,
	}
	byId[p.id] = p
	table.insert(order, p)
	Participants.publish(p)
	state.Parent = stateFolder()
	for _, callback in addedCallbacks do
		task.spawn(callback, p)
	end
	return p
end

function Participants.remove(p: Participant)
	if byId[p.id] ~= p then
		return
	end
	for _, callback in removingCallbacks do
		task.spawn(callback, p)
	end
	byId[p.id] = nil
	local index = table.find(order, p)
	if index then
		table.remove(order, index)
	end
	p.state:Destroy()
end

function Participants.get(id: string): Participant?
	return byId[id]
end

function Participants.playerId(player: Player): string
	return "P" .. player.UserId
end

function Participants.fromPlayer(player: Player): Participant?
	return byId[Participants.playerId(player)]
end

function Participants.fromCharacter(model: Instance?): Participant?
	if not model then
		return nil
	end
	local id = model:GetAttribute("ParticipantId")
	if typeof(id) == "string" then
		return byId[id]
	end
	return nil
end

-- Finds the participant whose character contains `part`.
function Participants.fromPart(part: Instance): Participant?
	local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	while model do
		local p = Participants.fromCharacter(model)
		if p then
			return p
		end
		model = model:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	end
	return nil
end

function Participants.all(): { Participant }
	return table.clone(order)
end

function Participants.count(): number
	return #order
end

function Participants.onTeam(team: Team): { Participant }
	local list = {}
	for _, p in order do
		if p.team == team then
			table.insert(list, p)
		end
	end
	return list
end

-- Root and humanoid of a participant whose character is alive, else nil.
function Participants.body(p: Participant): (BasePart?, Humanoid?)
	local character = p.character
	if not character or character.Parent == nil then
		return nil, nil
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return nil, nil
	end
	return root, humanoid
end

function Participants.setScore(p: Participant, value: number)
	p.score = math.max(0, math.floor(value))
	if p.profile then
		p.profile.Score = p.score
		if p.score > p.profile.BestScore then
			p.profile.BestScore = p.score
			p.state:SetAttribute("BestScore", p.score)
		end
	end
	p.state:SetAttribute("Score", p.score)
end

function Participants.addScore(p: Participant, amount: number)
	Participants.setScore(p, p.score + amount)
end

function Participants.setImmunity(p: Participant, value: number)
	p.immunity = math.clamp(value, 0, 100)
	p.state:SetAttribute("Immunity", p.immunity)
end

return Participants

scripts.name: Projectiles
scripts.source:
-- Everything that flies: potatoes, pebbles, snowballs, bubbles and rubber
-- ducks. Simulated on the server with sphere casts so hits are decided in
-- one place. Shots pass through bushes and stop at the first person (zombie
-- or human, never the shooter), wall or piece of furniture, then apply their
-- effect (shove, freeze, bubble trap or explosion).

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Announcer = require(script.Parent.Announcer)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local Combat = require(script.Parent.Combat)
local FurnitureService = require(script.Parent.FurnitureService)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local Parts = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Parts)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

type Participant = Participants.Participant

local Projectiles = {}

type Shot = {
	model: Model,
	position: Vector3,
	direction: Vector3,
	traveled: number,
	item: Items.Item,
	params: RaycastParams,
	ignored: { Instance },
}

local shots: { Shot } = {}
local folder: Folder

local function ball(model: Model, diameter: number, offset: Vector3, color: string, transparency: number?)
	local part = Parts.make({
		name = "Ball",
		shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
		size = Vector3.one * diameter,
		cframe = CFrame.new(offset),
		color = color,
		transparency = transparency,
		canCollide = false,
		canQuery = false,
		parent = model,
	})
	if not model.PrimaryPart then
		model.PrimaryPart = part
	end
end

-- The flying object, built at the origin facing -Z.
local function buildLook(item: Items.Item): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = item.projectile or "Potato"
	local d = (item.projectileRadius or 0.6) * 2
	local look = item.projectile
	if look == "Pebble" then
		ball(model, d, Vector3.zero, "8C8C8C")
	elseif look == "Snowball" then
		ball(model, d, Vector3.zero, "FFFFFF")
		ball(model, d * 0.5, Vector3.new(0.2, 0.25, -0.1), "E8F6FF")
	elseif look == "Bubble" then
		ball(model, d, Vector3.zero, "BFE9FF", 0.55)
		ball(model, d * 0.25, Vector3.new(-d * 0.2, d * 0.3, -d * 0.15), "FFFFFF", 0.2) -- shine
	elseif look == "Duck" then
		ball(model, d, Vector3.zero, "FFD93B")
		ball(model, d * 0.6, Vector3.new(0, d * 0.35, -d * 0.35), "FFD93B")
		Parts.make({
			name = "Beak",
			size = Vector3.new(0.35, 0.15, 0.4) * d,
			cframe = CFrame.new(0, d * 0.32, -d * 0.7),
			color = "F28C1C",
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = model,
		})
	elseif look == "Ice" then
		ball(model, d, Vector3.zero, "BFF0FF", 0.15)
		local shard = Parts.make({
			name = "Shard",
			size = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.45, 1.2) * d,
			cframe = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)),
			color = "E8FBFF",
			material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = model,
		})
		shard.Transparency = 0.2
	elseif look == "Bullet" then
		local bullet = Parts.make({
			name = "Bullet",
			size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 1.4) * d,
			cframe = CFrame.identity,
			color = "D4A84B",
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = model,
		})
		model.PrimaryPart = bullet
	elseif look == "Arrow" then
		local shaft = Parts.make({
			name = "Shaft",
			size = Vector3.new(0.14, 0.14, 2.6),
			cframe = CFrame.identity,
			color = "D9C29A",
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = model,
		})
		model.PrimaryPart = shaft
		Parts.make({
			name = "Tip",
			size = Vector3.new(0.35, 0.12, 0.35),
			cframe = CFrame.new(0, 0, -1.35) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0),
			color = "9AA3AD",
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = model,
		})
		Parts.make({
			name = "Fletching",
			size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.06, 0.5),
			cframe = CFrame.new(0, 0, 1.15),
			color = "8E44AD",
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = model,
		})
	elseif look == "Dynamite" then
		local stick = Parts.make({
			name = "Stick",
			shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
			size = Vector3.new(1.8, 0.55, 0.55),
			cframe = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0),
			color = "C0392B",
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = model,
		})
		model.PrimaryPart = stick
		Parts.make({
			name = "Spark",
			shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
			size = Vector3.one * 0.35,
			cframe = CFrame.new(0, 0, 1.15),
			color = "FFC21A",
			material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = model,
		})
	elseif look == "Grenade" then
		ball(model, d, Vector3.zero, "4E6B3A")
		ball(model, d * 0.35, Vector3.new(0, d * 0.45, 0), "5A5A5A")
	else
		ball(model, d, Vector3.zero, if item.isRare then "B98A4E" else "C9A66B")
		ball(model, d * 0.25, Vector3.new(d * 0.2, d * 0.3, 0), "8B6A43")
	end
	return model
end

local function impact(shot: Shot, at: Vector3, target: Participant?, hitPart: Instance)
	local item = shot.item
	local dir = shot.direction
	if item.effect == "Explode" then
		Combat.explode(at, item.radius or 10, item.knockback or 100, item.stun or 0.5)
		for _, body in
			FurnitureService.findInBox(
				CFrame.new(at),
				Vector3.new(1, 0, 1) * (item.radius or 10) * 1.6 + Vector3.yAxis * 6
			)
		do
			local away = Util.flatUnit(body.Position - at) or dir
			FurnitureService.shove(body, away * 18, 0.35)
		end
		Announcer.fx("Boom", { position = at, look = item.projectile, radius = item.radius })
		return
	end
	if target then
		if item.knockback and item.knockback > 0 then
			Combat.knockback(target, dir * item.knockback, item.stun or 0.3)
		else
			Combat.knockback(target, Vector3.zero, item.stun or 0.3)
		end
		if item.effect == "Freeze" then
			CharacterService.speedEffect(target, item.slowFactor or 0.4, item.effectSeconds or 2.5)
			Announcer.fx("Frozen", { character = target.character, seconds = item.effectSeconds or 2.5 })
		elseif item.effect == "Bubble" then
			Announcer.fx("Bubbled", { character = target.character, seconds = item.effectSeconds or 2 })
		end
	elseif hitPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		local weight = FurnitureService.weightOf(hitPart)
		if weight == "Light" or (weight == "Medium" and (item.knockback or 0) >= 80) then
			FurnitureService.shove(hitPart, dir * 12, 0.25)
		end
	end
	Announcer.fx("Splat", { position = at, look = item.projectile })
end

local function finish(shot: Shot)
	shot.model:Destroy()
	local index = table.find(shots, shot)
	if index then
		table.remove(shots, index)
	end
end

local function step(dt: number)
	for i = #shots, 1, -1 do
		local shot = shots[i]
		local item = shot.item
		local distance = (item.projectileSpeed or 90) * dt
		local radius = item.projectileRadius or 0.6
		local done = false
		-- A Spherecast ignores parts already overlapping its starting sphere,
		-- so each cast starts a little behind the shot. Otherwise a zombie
		-- walking into it between frames would be missed.
		local back = radius + 1
		local origin = shot.position - shot.direction * back
		for _ = 1, 4 do
			local result =
				workspace:Spherecast(origin, radius, shot.direction * (distance + back), shot.params)
			if not result then
				break
			end
			local target = Participants.fromPart(result.Instance)
			impact(shot, result.Position, target, result.Instance)
			finish(shot)
			done = true
			break
		end
		if not done then
			shot.position += shot.direction * distance
			shot.traveled += distance
			if shot.traveled >= (item.projectileRange or 100) then
				if item.effect == "Explode" then
					impact(shot, shot.position, nil, workspace) -- ducks go off at the end of their flight
				end
				finish(shot)
			else
				-- Ducks and potatoes tumble a little as they fly; arrows,
				-- bullets and ice bolts fly straight.
				local look = item.projectile
				local straight = look == "Arrow" or look == "Bullet" or look == "Ice"
				local spin = if straight then CFrame.identity else CFrame.Angles(0, shot.traveled * 0.15, 0)
				shot.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(shot.position, shot.position + shot.direction) * spin)
			end
		end
	end
end

function Projectiles.fire(shooter: Participant, item: Items.Item, aim: Vector3)
	local root = Participants.body(shooter)
	if not root or not shooter.character then
		return
	end
	local radius = item.projectileRadius or 0.6
	local origin = root.Position + aim * (root.Size.X / 2 + radius + 0.4)
	local model = buildLook(item)
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + aim))
	model.Parent = folder
	local ignored: { Instance } = {
		shooter.character,
		folder,
		workspace:WaitForChild("GroundItems"),
		workspace:WaitForChild("Traps"),
		workspace:WaitForChild("Effects"),
	}
	local map = workspace:WaitForChild("Map")
	-- Shots stop at the boundary wall, but fly over the ground, under roofs
	-- and through non-solid scenery.
	for _, name in { "Ground", "Road", "Floors", "Roofs", "Custom" } do
		local child = map:FindFirstChild(name)
		if child then
			table.insert(ignored, child)
		end
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
	table.insert(shots, {
		model = model,
		position = origin,
		direction = aim,
		traveled = 0,
		item = item,
		params = params,
		ignored = ignored,
	})
end

function Projectiles.clear()
	for i = #shots, 1, -1 do
		finish(shots[i])
	end
end

function Projectiles.init()
	folder = workspace:WaitForChild("Projectiles") :: Folder
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step)
end

return Projectiles

scripts.name: RoundManager
scripts.source:
-- The round loop: Waiting -> Prep -> Outbreak -> Infection -> End -> (reset) -> Prep.
--
-- Prep: everyone is human; the banner counts down "Outbreak happening in N
-- seconds"; humans shop and barricade. Outbreak: first zombies are picked,
-- weighted by immunity. Infection: a zombie touching a human converts them.
-- Zombies win when no humans remain; survivors win if anyone lasts the timer.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Announcer = require(script.Parent.Announcer)
local CharacterLook = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.CharacterLook)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local Combat = require(script.Parent.Combat)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local FurnitureService = require(script.Parent.FurnitureService)
local ItemService = require(script.Parent.ItemService)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local MapBuilder = require(script.Parent.MapBuilder)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Projectiles = require(script.Parent.Projectiles)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local Traps = require(script.Parent.Traps)
local RoundRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RoundRules)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)
local Wizard = require(script.Parent.Wizard)

type Participant = Participants.Participant
type Phase = "Waiting" | "Prep" | "Infection" | "End"
type Winner = RoundRules.Winner

local RoundManager = {}

local state: Folder
local phase: Phase = "Waiting"
local rng = Random.new()

-- Spawning ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function spawnFrame(team: string, scale: number): CFrame
	local layout = MapLayout.current()
	local list = if team == "Zombie" then layout.zombieSpawns else layout.humanSpawns
	local spot = list[rng:NextInteger(1, #list)]
	local jitter = if team == "Zombie" then 3 else 5
	local x = spot.x + rng:NextNumber(-jitter, jitter)
	local z = spot.z + rng:NextNumber(-jitter, jitter)
	local y = MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor
		+ Config.CHARACTER.HipHeight
		+ Config.CHARACTER.RootHeight / 2 * scale
		+ 0.3
	return CFrame.new(x, y, z)
end

-- Every human starts the round at the map's start spot, packed into a
-- little crowd around it (a sunflower spiral, so nobody lands on anyone).
local crowd = 0

local function startFrame(scale: number): CFrame
	local spot = MapLayout.current().start
	crowd += 1
	local radius = 2.4 * math.sqrt(crowd - 1) * math.max(1, scale)
	local angle = crowd * 2.39996
	local y = MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor
		+ Config.CHARACTER.HipHeight
		+ Config.CHARACTER.RootHeight / 2 * scale
		+ 0.3
	return CFrame.new(spot.x + math.cos(angle) * radius, y, spot.z + math.sin(angle) * radius)
end

local function recount()
	state:SetAttribute("Survivors", #Participants.onTeam("Human"))
	state:SetAttribute("Zombies", #Participants.onTeam("Zombie"))
end

function RoundManager.phase(): Phase
	return phase
end

local function setPhase(name: Phase, seconds: number)
	phase = name
	state:SetAttribute("Phase", name)
	state:SetAttribute("PhaseEndsAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + seconds)
end

local function secondsLeft(): number
	return (state:GetAttribute("PhaseEndsAt") :: number) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
end

function RoundManager.secondsLeft(): number
	return secondsLeft()
end

-- Teams --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function RoundManager.setTeam(p: Participant, team: Participants.Team)
	if p.team == team then
		return
	end
	p.team = team
	p.state:SetAttribute("Team", team)
	p.boostUntil, p.slowUntil = 0, 0 -- drinks and freezes don't carry across teams
	if team == "Human" then
		p.alpha = false
	end
	if team == "Zombie" then
		ItemService.onInfected(p)
	end
	CharacterService.applyLook(p)
	CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	ItemService.refreshHand(p)
	recount()
end

local function bonusesFor(p: Participant, includeDrumstick: boolean): RoundRules.RewardBonuses
	-- A drumstick anywhere in your inventory counts (the best one).
	local drumstick: number? = nil
	for _, slot in p.slots do
		local item = Items.get(slot.id)
		if item and item.kind == "Passive" and item.rewardBonus then
			drumstick = math.max(drumstick or 0, item.rewardBonus)
		end
	end
	return {
		drumstick = if includeDrumstick then drumstick else nil,
		vip = p.passes.VIP == true,
		doubleScore = p.passes.DoubleScore == true,
		boosted = os.time() < p.boostEndsAt,
	}
end

local function award(p: Participant, base: number, includeDrumstick: boolean, reason: string)
	local amount = RoundRules.reward(base, bonusesFor(p, includeDrumstick))
	Participants.addScore(p, amount)
	CharacterService.refreshSize(p)
	CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	if p.player then
		Announcer.toast(
			p.player,
			string.format("+%s score  %s", Util.commas(amount), reason),
			Config.COLORS.Good
		)
	end
end

-- Every few seconds of the outbreak: a little score for every human still
-- standing, and every zombie loses a little (it has to eat to stay big).
local function payStanding()
	for _, p in Participants.all() do
		if not Participants.body(p) then
			continue
		end
		if p.team == "Human" then
			Participants.addScore(p, RoundRules.reward(Config.SURVIVAL_POINTS, bonusesFor(p, false)))
		elseif p.score > 0 then
			local loss = math.max(Config.ZOMBIE_DECAY_MIN, math.floor(p.score * Config.ZOMBIE_DECAY_FRACTION))
			Participants.addScore(p, -loss)
		end
		CharacterService.refreshSize(p)
		CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	end
end

local function infect(zombie: Participant, human: Participant)
	local root = Participants.body(human)
	-- The zombie eats a share of the human's points: the human shrinks and
	-- slows, the zombie grows and speeds up.
	local stolen = math.floor(human.score * Config.INFECT_STEAL_FRACTION)
	if stolen > 0 then
		Participants.addScore(human, -stolen)
		Participants.addScore(zombie, stolen)
		human.scale = RoundRules.scaleForScore(human.score)
		human.state:SetAttribute("Scale", human.scale)
		if human.player then
			Announcer.toast(
				human.player,
				string.format("-%s points: %s ate them!", Util.commas(stolen), zombie.name),
				Config.COLORS.ZombieText
			)
		end
		if zombie.player then
			Announcer.toast(
				zombie.player,
				string.format("+%s points eaten from %s", Util.commas(stolen), human.name),
				Config.COLORS.Good
			)
		end
	end
	RoundManager.setTeam(human, "Zombie") -- rebuilds the look at the new size
	CharacterService.refreshSpeed(human)
	award(zombie, Config.INFECT_REWARD, false, "infection")
	if zombie.profile then
		zombie.profile.Infections = (zombie.profile.Infections or 0) + 1
		zombie.state:SetAttribute("Infections", zombie.profile.Infections)
	end
	if root then
		Announcer.fx("Infect", { position = root.Position })
	end
	Announcer.chat(string.format("%s infected %s!", zombie.name, human.name), "9BE22D")
end

-- Does any part of the zombie touch the human? Its body, or the arms
-- reaching out in front of it (the box they sweep, in the zombie's own
-- frame), against the human's body circle.
local ARM_REACH = CharacterLook.ZOMBIE_ARM_REACH
local ARM_SPAN = CharacterLook.ZOMBIE_ARM_SPAN

local function touching(zRoot: BasePart, zScale: number, hRoot: BasePart, hScale: number): boolean
	local shell = Config.CHARACTER.ShellDiameter / 2
	local hr = shell * hScale + 0.25
	local offset = Util.flat(hRoot.Position - zRoot.Position)
	if offset.Magnitude <= hr + shell * zScale then
		return true
	end
	if offset.Magnitude > hr + (ARM_REACH + ARM_SPAN) * zScale then
		return false
	end
	local rel = zRoot.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(offset)
	local x = math.clamp(rel.X, -ARM_SPAN * zScale, ARM_SPAN * zScale)
	local z = math.clamp(rel.Z, -ARM_REACH * zScale, 0)
	local dx, dz = rel.X - x, rel.Z - z
	return dx * dx + dz * dz <= hr * hr
end

-- Every frame of the infection phase: a single touch from any part of a
-- zombie (with no wall or furniture between them) converts the human.
local function infectionStep()
	if phase ~= "Infection" then
		return
	end
	local zombies = Participants.onTeam("Zombie")
	local humans = Participants.onTeam("Human")
	for _, human in humans do
		local hRoot = Participants.body(human)
		if hRoot and human.team == "Human" then
			for _, zombie in zombies do
				local zRoot = Participants.body(zombie)
				if zRoot and zombie.team == "Zombie" then
					if
						touching(zRoot, zombie.scale, hRoot, human.scale)
						and Combat.clearPath(zRoot.Position, hRoot.Position)
					then
						infect(zombie, human)
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- World reset ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function grantRoundStartItems(p: Participant)
	if not ItemService.hasFreeSlot(p) then
		return
	end
	local profile = p.profile
	if profile and profile.PendingItems and #profile.PendingItems > 0 then
		local itemId = table.remove(profile.PendingItems, 1)
		if typeof(itemId) == "string" and Items.get(itemId) then
			ItemService.give(p, itemId)
			if p.player then
				Announcer.toast(
					p.player,
					"Your " .. (Items.get(itemId) :: Items.Item).name .. " is ready!",
					Config.COLORS.Good
				)
			end
			return
		end
	end
	if p.passes.StarterKit and not ItemService.carries(p, "Bat") then
		ItemService.give(p, "Bat")
	end
end

-- Everyone back to human at a yard spawn, furniture and walls restored.
local function resetWorld()
	Wizard.leave()
	Projectiles.clear()
	Traps.clear()
	ItemService.clearGround()
	FurnitureService.resetAll()
	MapBuilder.restoreWalls()
	crowd = 0
	for _, p in Participants.all() do
		p.team = "Human"
		p.stunUntil = 0
		p.boostUntil, p.slowUntil = 0, 0
		p.alpha = false
		p.turning = false
		p.state:SetAttribute("Turning", false)
		p.scale = RoundRules.scaleForScore(p.score) -- you grow as your score grows
		p.state:SetAttribute("Team", "Human")
		p.state:SetAttribute("Scale", p.scale)
		CharacterService.place(p, startFrame(p.scale))
		CharacterService.applyLook(p)
		CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
		grantRoundStartItems(p)
		ItemService.refreshHand(p)
	end
	recount()
end

-- Phases ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function enoughPlayers(): boolean
	return Participants.count() >= Config.MIN_PLAYERS
end

local function waitForPlayers()
	if enoughPlayers() then
		return
	end
	setPhase("Waiting", 0)
	resetWorld()
	while not enoughPlayers() do
		state:SetAttribute("Needed", Config.MIN_PLAYERS)
		task.wait(1)
	end
end

-- An admin ended the round: it stops with no winner and the next one starts.
local endRequested = false

local function pickFirstZombies(): { Participant }
	local candidates = {}
	for _, p in Participants.onTeam("Human") do
		if Participants.body(p) then
			table.insert(candidates, p)
		end
	end
	local count = RoundRules.firstZombieCount(#candidates)
	return RoundRules.weightedPick(
		candidates,
		function(p: Participant)
			return RoundRules.zombieWeight(p.immunity)
		end,
		count,
		function()
			return rng:NextNumber()
		end
	)
end

-- The first zombies-to-be, picked TURNING_SECONDS before the outbreak.
local turning: { Participant } = {}

local function setTurning(p: Participant, on: boolean)
	p.turning = on
	p.state:SetAttribute("Turning", on)
	CharacterService.refreshNameTag(p)
	CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
end

local function clearTurning()
	for _, p in turning do
		if Participants.get(p.id) == p then
			setTurning(p, false)
		end
	end
	table.clear(turning)
end

-- Waits out the prep timer; TURNING_SECONDS before the end it picks the
-- first zombies, turns their names red and slows them down. Returns false
-- if players dropped below the minimum or an admin ended the round.
local function waitPrep(): boolean
	local picked = false
	while secondsLeft() > 0 do
		if not enoughPlayers() or endRequested then
			clearTurning()
			return false
		end
		if not picked and secondsLeft() <= Config.TURNING_SECONDS then
			picked = true
			clearTurning()
			for _, p in pickFirstZombies() do
				table.insert(turning, p)
				setTurning(p, true)
				if p.player then
					Announcer.toast(
						p.player,
						string.format("You're turning into a zombie in %d seconds!", Config.TURNING_SECONDS),
						Config.COLORS.ZombieText
					)
				end
			end
			local names = {}
			for _, p in turning do
				table.insert(names, p.name)
			end
			if #names > 0 then
				Announcer.chat(
					"* "
						.. table.concat(names, ", ")
						.. (if #names == 1 then " is" else " are")
						.. " turning into a zombie... run! *",
					"E0303A"
				)
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
	return not endRequested
end

local function turnFirstZombie(p: Participant)
	p.alpha = true -- the alpha look (see Skins "Alpha")
	RoundManager.setTeam(p, "Zombie")
	Participants.setImmunity(p, 0)
	if Config.FIRST_ZOMBIES_TO_SPAWN then
		CharacterService.place(p, spawnFrame("Zombie", p.scale))
	end
	p.returnReadyAt = os.clock() + 1
end

local function outbreak()
	Wizard.leave()
	-- The ones turning since the countdown (if they're still here); a fresh
	-- pick if nobody is (an admin skipped ahead, or they all left).
	local picked = {}
	for _, p in turning do
		if Participants.get(p.id) == p and p.team == "Human" and Participants.body(p) then
			table.insert(picked, p)
		end
	end
	clearTurning()
	if #picked == 0 then
		picked = pickFirstZombies()
	end
	local names = {}
	for _, p in picked do
		turnFirstZombie(p)
		table.insert(names, p.name)
	end
	Announcer.chat(
		"* OUTBREAK! "
			.. table.concat(names, ", ")
			.. (if #names == 1 then " is" else " are")
			.. " a zombie! *",
		"E0303A"
	)
	Announcer.fx("Outbreak", {})
end

local function finishRound(winner: Winner)
	setPhase("End", Config.END_SCREEN_SECONDS)
	state:SetAttribute("Winner", winner)
	for _, p in Participants.all() do
		if p.profile then
			p.profile.RoundsPlayed = (p.profile.RoundsPlayed or 0) + 1
			p.state:SetAttribute("RoundsPlayed", p.profile.RoundsPlayed)
		end
		if winner == "Survivors" and p.team == "Human" then
			award(p, Config.SURVIVOR_WIN_REWARD, true, "survived!")
			if p.profile then
				p.profile.Wins = (p.profile.Wins or 0) + 1
				p.state:SetAttribute("Wins", p.profile.Wins)
			end
		elseif winner == "Zombies" and p.team == "Zombie" then
			award(p, Config.ZOMBIE_WIN_REWARD, false, "zombies win")
		end
	end
	Announcer.chat(if winner == "Survivors" then "Survivors Win!!!" else "Zombies Win!!!")
	Announcer.fx("RoundEnd", { winner = winner })
	task.wait(Config.END_SCREEN_SECONDS)
	state:SetAttribute("Winner", "")
end

local function runInfection(): Winner?
	setPhase("Infection", Config.ROUND_SECONDS)
	local nextPay = os.clock() + Config.SURVIVAL_POINTS_SECONDS
	while true do
		task.wait(0.1)
		if endRequested then
			return nil
		end
		if os.clock() >= nextPay then
			nextPay += Config.SURVIVAL_POINTS_SECONDS
			payStanding()
		end
		local humans = Participants.onTeam("Human")
		local zombies = Participants.onTeam("Zombie")
		local result = RoundRules.outcome(#humans, secondsLeft())
		if result then
			return result :: Winner
		end
		if #zombies == 0 then
			-- Every zombie left the game: pick a new one, or let the humans win.
			if #humans >= 2 then
				local replacement = pickFirstZombies()[1]
				if replacement then
					turnFirstZombie(replacement)
					Announcer.chat("* The zombies fled... " .. replacement.name .. " turned! *", "E0303A")
				end
			else
				return "Survivors" :: Winner
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Map rotation ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local rotation: { string } = {} -- built-in maps plus yours (MapLayout.rotation)
local mapIndex = 1
local roundsOnMap = 0
local pendingMap: string? = nil -- an admin picked the next map

local function loadMap(name: string)
	local layout = MapLayout.use(name)
	ItemService.clearGround()
	MapBuilder.build(layout)
	FurnitureService.build(layout)
	state:SetAttribute("Map", layout.title)
	Announcer.chat("* Next map: " .. layout.title .. " *")
end

local function nextMapIfDue()
	local picked = pendingMap
	if picked then
		pendingMap = nil
		roundsOnMap = 0
		mapIndex = table.find(rotation, picked) or mapIndex
		loadMap(picked)
	elseif roundsOnMap >= Config.ROUNDS_PER_MAP and #rotation > 1 then
		roundsOnMap = 0
		mapIndex = mapIndex % #rotation + 1
		loadMap(rotation[mapIndex])
	end
	roundsOnMap += 1
end

local function runRound()
	endRequested = false
	waitForPlayers()

	nextMapIfDue()
	resetWorld()
	local round = state:GetAttribute("Round")
	state:SetAttribute("Round", (if typeof(round) == "number" then round else 0) + 1)
	ItemService.scatter()
	setPhase("Prep", Config.PREP_SECONDS)
	Wizard.schedule()
	Announcer.chat(
		MapLayout.current().title
			.. ": outbreak in "
			.. Config.PREP_SECONDS
			.. " seconds. Barricade a room and grab items!"
	)
	if waitPrep() then
		outbreak()
		local winner = runInfection()
		if winner then
			finishRound(winner :: Winner)
		end
	end
end

local function loop()
	while true do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			runRound()
			return true
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[Rounds] round failed, starting a new one: " .. tostring(err))
			state:SetAttribute("Winner", "")
			task.wait(2)
		end
	end
end

-- Joining, leaving, respawning ----------------------------------------------------------------

local function spawnNew(p: Participant)
	p.scale = RoundRules.scaleForScore(p.score)
	p.state:SetAttribute("Scale", p.scale)
	-- Late joiners become zombies once the outbreak has happened.
	if phase == "Infection" then
		p.team = "Zombie"
		p.state:SetAttribute("Team", "Zombie")
	end
	-- Humans joining before the outbreak start with everyone else.
	CharacterService.spawn(p, if p.team == "Human" then startFrame(p.scale) else spawnFrame(p.team, p.scale))
	if p.team == "Human" then
		grantRoundStartItems(p)
	end
	ItemService.refreshHand(p)
	recount()
end

-- "Z": back to the zombie spawn, with a whoosh where you left.
local function warp(p: Participant)
	local root = Participants.body(p)
	if root then
		Announcer.fx("Warp", { position = root.Position })
	end
	CharacterService.place(p, spawnFrame("Zombie", p.scale))
end

local function onZombieReturn(player: Player)
	local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
	if not p or p.team ~= "Zombie" or phase ~= "Infection" then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < p.returnReadyAt then
		return
	end
	p.returnReadyAt = now + Config.ZOMBIE_RETURN_COOLDOWN
	warp(p)
end

function RoundManager.roundNumber(): number
	local round = state:GetAttribute("Round")
	return if typeof(round) == "number" then round else 0
end

-- Admin controls -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Ends the current phase now (prep -> outbreak, infection -> survivors win).
function RoundManager.skipPhase(): boolean
	if phase == "Waiting" or phase == "End" then
		return false
	end
	state:SetAttribute("PhaseEndsAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
	return true
end

-- Ends the whole round now (no winner, no rewards); the next round starts
-- right away, on the map an admin queued if any.
function RoundManager.endRound(): boolean
	if phase == "Waiting" then
		return false
	end
	endRequested = true
	Announcer.chat("* An admin ended the round *")
	return true
end

-- The maps in the rotation, in order (built-in and Studio-made).
function RoundManager.mapNames(): { string }
	return rotation
end

function RoundManager.addTime(seconds: number): boolean
	local endsAt = state:GetAttribute("PhaseEndsAt")
	if typeof(endsAt) ~= "number" or phase == "Waiting" or phase == "End" then
		return false
	end
	state:SetAttribute("PhaseEndsAt", endsAt + seconds)
	return true
end

-- The next round starts on the next map in the rotation.
function RoundManager.queueNextMap(): boolean
	if #rotation < 2 then
		return false
	end
	pendingMap = nil
	roundsOnMap = Config.ROUNDS_PER_MAP
	return true
end

-- The next round starts on this map.
function RoundManager.queueMap(name: string): boolean
	if not MapLayout.get(name) then
		return false
	end
	pendingMap = name
	return true
end

function RoundManager.respawn(p: Participant)
	CharacterService.spawn(p, spawnFrame(p.team, p.scale))
	ItemService.refreshHand(p)
end

-- Lets bots press Z too.
function RoundManager.zombieReturn(p: Participant)
	if p.team == "Zombie" and phase == "Infection" and os.clock() >= p.returnReadyAt then
		p.returnReadyAt = os.clock() + Config.ZOMBIE_RETURN_COOLDOWN
		warp(p)
	end
end

function RoundManager.start()
	state = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BrainTagState") :: Folder
	state:SetAttribute("Map", MapLayout.current().title)
	rotation = MapLayout.rotation(Config.MAP_ROTATION)
	mapIndex = table.find(rotation, MapLayout.current().name) or 1
	state:SetAttribute("Maps", table.concat(rotation, "|")) -- for the admin panel

	CharacterService.onNeedRespawn = function(p)
		CharacterService.spawn(p, spawnFrame(p.team, p.scale))
		ItemService.refreshHand(p)
	end

	Participants.onAdded(spawnNew)
	Participants.onRemoving(function(p)
		if p.isBot and p.character then
			p.character:Destroy()
		end
		task.defer(recount)
	end)

	Remotes.event("ZombieReturn").OnServerEvent:Connect(onZombieReturn)
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(infectionStep)
	task.spawn(loop)
end

return RoundManager

scripts.name: ShopService
scripts.source:
-- Score shop (B), the wizard's shop, skins and the first-join tutorial flag.
-- Clients only ask; every price, distance and balance is checked here.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Announcer = require(script.Parent.Announcer)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local ItemService = require(script.Parent.ItemService)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local Skins = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Skins)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)
local Wizard = require(script.Parent.Wizard)

type Participant = Participants.Participant

local ShopService = {}

local rng = Random.new()

function ShopService.rareChance(p: Participant): number
	if p.passes.Lucky then
		return Config.MONETIZATION.LUCKY_RARE_CHANCE
	end
	return Config.RARE_CHANCE
end

local function buyItem(player: Player, itemId: unknown, fromWizard: unknown): (boolean, string)
	if typeof(itemId) ~= "string" then
		return false, "Unknown item"
	end
	local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
	local item = Items.get(itemId)
	if not p or not item then
		return false, "Unknown item"
	end
	if p.team ~= "Human" then
		return false, "Zombies can't shop!"
	end
	local root = Participants.body(p)
	if not root then
		return false, "Wait until you spawn"
	end

	local price: number
	if fromWizard == true then
		if not item.wizardPrice then
			return false, "The wizard doesn't sell that"
		end
		if not Wizard.isNear(root.Position) then
			return false, "Walk closer to the wizard"
		end
		price = item.wizardPrice
	else
		if not item.price then
			return false, "That isn't sold here"
		end
		price = item.price
	end
	if p.score < price then
		return false, "You need " .. Util.commas(price) .. " score"
	end

	Participants.addScore(p, -price)
	CharacterService.refreshSize(p) -- points are size and speed
	CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)

	local finalId = item.id
	if item.rare and rng:NextNumber() < ShopService.rareChance(p) then
		finalId = item.rare
	end
	ItemService.give(p, finalId)
	local final = Items.get(finalId) :: Items.Item
	if finalId ~= item.id then
		Announcer.chat(string.format("* %s rolled a %s! *", p.name, final.name), "F5C542")
		return true, "RARE! You got a " .. final.name .. "!"
	end
	return true, "Bought " .. final.name
end

-- Marks a skin owned (in the session and the saved profile).
function ShopService.grantSkin(p: Participant, skinId: string)
	p.ownedSkins[skinId] = true
	if p.profile then
		p.profile.OwnedSkins[skinId] = true
	end
	Participants.publish(p)
end

function ShopService.equipSkin(p: Participant, skin: Skins.Skin)
	if skin.team == "Zombie" then
		p.zombieSkin = skin.id
		if p.profile then
			p.profile.ZombieSkin = skin.id
		end
	else
		p.humanSkin = skin.id
		if p.profile then
			p.profile.HumanSkin = skin.id
		end
	end
	Participants.publish(p)
	if p.team == skin.team then
		CharacterService.applyLook(p)
		ItemService.refreshHand(p)
	end
end

-- Returns a status the client acts on:
--   "equipped" | "bought" | "prompt" (Robux product) | "promptPass" | "error"
local function buySkin(player: Player, skinId: unknown): (string, string)
	if typeof(skinId) ~= "string" then
		return "error", "Unknown skin"
	end
	local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
	local skin = Skins.get(skinId)
	if not p or not skin then
		return "error", "Unknown skin"
	end
	if skin.pass and p.passes[skin.pass] then
		ShopService.grantSkin(p, skin.id)
	end
	if p.ownedSkins[skin.id] then
		ShopService.equipSkin(p, skin)
		return "equipped", skin.name .. " equipped"
	end
	if skin.scorePrice then
		if p.score < skin.scorePrice then
			return "error", "You need " .. Util.commas(skin.scorePrice) .. " score"
		end
		Participants.addScore(p, -skin.scorePrice)
		CharacterService.refreshSize(p) -- points are size and speed
		CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
		CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
		ShopService.grantSkin(p, skin.id)
		ShopService.equipSkin(p, skin)
		return "bought", "Unlocked " .. skin.name .. "!"
	end
	if skin.product then
		return "prompt", skin.product
	end
	if skin.pass then
		return "promptPass", skin.pass
	end
	return "error", "Not available"
end

function ShopService.init()
	Remotes.func("BuyItem").OnServerInvoke = buyItem
	Remotes.func("BuySkin").OnServerInvoke = buySkin
	Remotes.event("TutorialDone").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
		if p and p.profile then
			p.profile.SeenTutorial = true
			p.state:SetAttribute("SeenTutorial", true)
		end
	end)
end

return ShopService
