scripts.source:
-- All-time top 10 (across servers) for the trophy panel, refreshed every
-- couple of minutes from the OrderedDataStore that DataService updates.

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)

local TopScores = {}

local names: { [number]: string } = {}

local function nameOf(userId: number): string
	if names[userId] then
		return names[userId]
	end
	local ok, name = pcall(function()
		return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(userId)
	end)
	if ok and name then
		names[userId] = name
		return name
	end
	return "Player " .. userId
end

local function refresh()
	local rows = {}
	for _, entry in DataService.topScores(10) do
		table.insert(rows, { name = nameOf(entry.userId), score = entry.score })
	end
	local state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BrainTagState")
	if state then
		state:SetAttribute("TopScores", HttpService:JSONEncode(rows))
	end
end

function TopScores.start()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			if DataService.isAvailable() then
				refresh()
			end
			task.wait(Config.TOP_SCORES_REFRESH_SECONDS)
		end
	end)
end

return TopScores

scripts.name: Traps
scripts.source:
-- Banana peels: dropped by humans, slippery for everyone (the dropper gets
-- a moment to walk off it). Whoever steps on one slips: a shove in the way
-- they were walking and a long daze.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Announcer = require(script.Parent.Announcer)
local Combat = require(script.Parent.Combat)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Parts = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Parts)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

local Traps = {}

type Trap = { model: Model, position: Vector3, item: Items.Item, owner: Participant?, safeUntil: number }
type Participant = Participants.Participant

local traps: { Trap } = {}
local folder: Folder
local MAX_TRAPS = 30

local function buildPeel(at: Vector3, spin: number): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "BananaPeel"
	local y = MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor + 0.12
	local center = CFrame.new(at.X, y, at.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, spin, 0)
	for i = 0, 2 do
		local arm = center * CFrame.Angles(0, i * math.pi * 2 / 3, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.6)
		Parts.make({
			name = "Peel",
			size = Vector3.new(0.55, 0.12, 1.3),
			cframe = arm,
			color = "F7DC6F",
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = model,
		})
		Parts.make({
			name = "PeelInside",
			size = Vector3.new(0.35, 0.13, 1.0),
			cframe = arm * CFrame.new(0, 0.005, 0.05),
			color = "FFF6C7",
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = model,
		})
	end
	Parts.disc("Stem", center.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0), 0.5, 0.2, "8B5A2B", model).CanCollide =
		false
	return model
end

function Traps.place(position: Vector3, item: Items.Item, owner: Participant?)
	if #traps >= MAX_TRAPS then
		local oldest = table.remove(traps, 1)
		if oldest then
			oldest.model:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local model = buildPeel(position, math.random() * math.pi * 2)
	model.Parent = folder
	table.insert(traps, {
		model = model,
		position = Vector3.new(position.X, 0, position.Z),
		item = item,
		owner = owner,
		safeUntil = os.clock() + 1.5,
	})
end

function Traps.clear()
	for _, trap in traps do
		trap.model:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(traps)
end

local function step()
	if #traps == 0 then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, person in Participants.all() do
		local root, humanoid = Participants.body(person)
		if root and humanoid then
			for i = #traps, 1, -1 do
				local trap = traps[i]
				local safe = person == trap.owner and now < trap.safeUntil
				if not safe and Util.flatDistance(root.Position, trap.position) <= 1.4 + root.Size.X / 2 then
					local move = Util.flatUnit(humanoid.MoveDirection)
						or Util.flatUnit(root.CFrame.LookVector)
						or Vector3.xAxis
					Combat.knockback(person, move * (trap.item.knockback or 45), trap.item.stun or 1.2)
					Announcer.fx("Slip", { position = trap.position, character = person.character })
					trap.model:Destroy()
					table.remove(traps, i)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function Traps.init()
	folder = workspace:WaitForChild("Traps") :: Folder
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step)
end

return Traps

scripts.name: Wizard
scripts.source:
-- The wizard: shows up at a random moment during the prep phase in one of the
-- yards, sells rare items to humans standing within reach (press B near
-- him), and leaves when the outbreak starts.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Announcer = require(script.Parent.Announcer)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Parts = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Parts)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

local Wizard = {}

local model: Model? = nil
local scheduleToken = 0
local rng = Random.new()

local function build(at: Vector3): Model
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = "Wizard"
	local function disc(name: string, offset: Vector3, diameter: number, height: number, color: string): Part
		return Parts.disc(name, at + offset, diameter, height, color, m)
	end
	-- Like the original: a blue robe, a big brown pointy hat, a grey beard.
	disc("RobeOutline", Vector3.new(0, 1.95, 0), 4.3, 3.9, "2C5866")
	local robe = disc("Robe", Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), 3.9, 4, "4F8FA3")
	disc("RobeTrim", Vector3.new(0, 4.03, 0), 3.1, 0.06, "6FB0C2")
	disc("HatBrimOutline", Vector3.new(0, 4.55, 0), 3.7, 0.3, "4A2C17")
	disc("HatBrim", Vector3.new(0, 4.6, 0), 3.4, 0.3, "6B4226")
	disc("HatMid", Vector3.new(0, 5.1, 0), 2.2, 0.7, "8B5A2B")
	disc("HatTip", Vector3.new(0, 5.6, 0), 0.9, 0.3, "A0703F")
	disc("Star", Vector3.new(0.5, 5.5, 0.3), 0.5, 0.25, "FFD54A")
	disc("Beard", Vector3.new(0, 4.3, -1.6), 1.4, 0.3, "B8BEC4")
	-- Staff with a glowing orb.
	Parts.make({
		name = "Staff",
		size = Vector3.new(0.35, 0.35, 4.5),
		cframe = CFrame.new(at + Vector3.new(1.9, 4.4, -0.6)),
		color = "8B5A2B",
		canCollide = false,
		parent = m,
	})
	local orb = Parts.make({
		name = "Orb",
		shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
		size = Vector3.one * 1.1,
		cframe = CFrame.new(at + Vector3.new(1.9, 4.7, -3.0)),
		color = "7FE7FF",
		material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		canCollide = false,
		parent = m,
	})
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = Color3.fromHex("7FE7FF")
	light.Range = 10
	light.Brightness = 2
	light.Parent = orb
	m.PrimaryPart = robe

	local tag = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	tag.Name = "NameTag"
	tag.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 44)
	tag.AlwaysOnTop = true
	tag.LightInfluence = 0
	tag.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 2, -4.2)
	tag.Adornee = robe
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSansExtraBold
	label.TextSize = 18
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHex("D7B8FF")
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
	label.Text = "Wizard\n[B] special items"
	label.Parent = tag
	tag.Parent = robe
	return m
end

function Wizard.arrive()
	if model then
		return
	end
	local spots = MapLayout.current().wizardSpots
	local spot = spots[rng:NextInteger(1, #spots)]
	local m = build(Vector3.new(spot.x, 0, spot.z))
	m.Parent = workspace
	model = m
	local state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BrainTagState")
	if state then
		state:SetAttribute("WizardHere", true)
	end
	Announcer.chat("* The wizard has arrived! Press [B] at wizard to buy special items! *")
	Announcer.fx("Wizard", { position = Vector3.new(spot.x, 2, spot.z) })
end

function Wizard.leave()
	scheduleToken += 1
	if model then
		model:Destroy()
		model = nil
		Announcer.chat("* The wizard vanished in a puff of smoke. *")
	end
	local state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BrainTagState")
	if state then
		state:SetAttribute("WizardHere", false)
	end
end

-- Arrives after a random delay inside the configured window, unless leave()
-- is called first.
function Wizard.schedule()
	scheduleToken += 1
	local token = scheduleToken
	task.delay(rng:NextNumber(Config.WIZARD_ARRIVE_MIN, Config.WIZARD_ARRIVE_MAX), function()
		if token == scheduleToken then
			Wizard.arrive()
		end
	end)
end

function Wizard.isNear(position: Vector3): boolean
	local current = model
	if not current or not current.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	return Util.flatDistance(current.PrimaryPart.Position, position) <= Config.WIZARD_SHOP_RADIUS
end

return Wizard

scripts.name: WorldSetup
scripts.source:
-- One-time world settings: flat lighting, collision groups, the folders other
-- services fill, and the replicated state folder the HUD reads.

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local WorldSetup = {}

WorldSetup.GROUPS = {
	Characters = "Characters",
	Furniture = "Furniture",
	Shells = "CharacterShells", -- body-sized cylinders that hit each other
	Bumpers = "Bumpers", -- wider cylinders that only furniture hits
	SecretWalls = "SecretWalls", -- fake walls: stop furniture, let people through
}

local function folder(name: string, parent: Instance): Folder
	local existing = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing:IsA("Folder") then
		return existing
	end
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = name
	f.Parent = parent
	return f
end

function WorldSetup.run()
	Players.CharacterAutoLoads = false

	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.Brightness = 1
	Lighting.ClockTime = 12
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190)
	Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0
	Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
	for _, child in Lighting:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Atmosphere") or child:IsA("BloomEffect") or child:IsA("SunRaysEffect") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local groups = WorldSetup.GROUPS
	PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(groups.Characters)
	PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(groups.Furniture)
	PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(groups.Shells)
	PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(groups.Bumpers)
	PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(groups.SecretWalls)
	-- Root boxes never hit each other; the shells do the bumping with each
	-- other, and the wider bumpers keep furniture a little way off (so a body
	-- never sinks into a couch). Neither hits walls, so a big player's wide
	-- shell never snags a doorway.
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(groups.Characters, groups.Characters, false)
	for _, other in { "Default", groups.Characters, groups.Furniture } do
		PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(groups.Shells, other, false)
	end
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(groups.Shells, groups.Shells, Config.PLAYERS_COLLIDE)
	for _, other in { "Default", groups.Characters, groups.Shells, groups.Bumpers, groups.SecretWalls } do
		PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(groups.Bumpers, other, false)
	end
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(groups.Bumpers, groups.Furniture, true)
	for _, other in { "Default", groups.Characters, groups.Shells } do
		PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(groups.SecretWalls, other, false)
	end

	for _, name in { "Map", "Furniture", "GroundItems", "Projectiles", "Traps", "Effects", "Bots" } do
		folder(name, workspace)
	end

	local state = folder("BrainTagState", ReplicatedStorage)
	folder("Participants", state)
	state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Waiting")
	state:SetAttribute("PhaseEndsAt", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("Survivors", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("Zombies", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("Winner", "")
	state:SetAttribute("Round", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("Needed", Config.MIN_PLAYERS)
	state:SetAttribute("WizardHere", false)
	state:SetAttribute("TopScores", "[]")
end

function WorldSetup.state(): Folder
	return ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BrainTagState") :: Folder
end

return WorldSetup

scripts.name: BushController
scripts.source:
-- Hiding in bushes, on your screen: the bush you stand in fades so you can
-- see yourself (and anyone hiding with you), and the name tags of players
-- hiding in other bushes disappear. On dark maps, name tags also show only
-- for people close enough to see (DarknessController), and on roofed maps
-- only for people in the same room as you (Roofs). Someone wearing the Magic
-- Cloak fades away (you see yourself as a ghost) and loses their name tag.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Bushes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Bushes)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local DarknessController = require(script.Parent.DarknessController)
local Roofs = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Roofs)

local BushController = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local INTERVAL = 0.1

local faded: Model? = nil
local ghosts: { [Model]: boolean } = {}
local OTHERS_FADE = 0.93
local SELF_FADE = 0.55

local function cloaked(model: Instance): boolean
	local untilTime = model:GetAttribute(Bushes.CLOAK_ATTRIBUTE)
	return typeof(untilTime) == "number" and untilTime > workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
end

-- Fade a whole character (and what it holds) in or out.
local function ghost(model: Model, amount: number)
	for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = amount
		end
	end
end

local function fade(bush: Model?, amount: number)
	if not bush then
		return
	end
	for _, part in bush:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = amount
		end
	end
end

local function characters(): { Instance }
	local list = workspace:GetChildren()
	local bots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Bots")
	if bots then
		for _, bot in bots:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(list, bot)
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function rootOf(model: Instance): BasePart?
	return model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
end

local function step()
	local me = player.Character
	local myRoot = me and rootOf(me)
	local mine = if myRoot then Bushes.coverAt(myRoot.Position) else nil
	if mine ~= faded then
		fade(faded, 0)
		fade(mine, Config.BUSH_SEE_THROUGH)
		faded = mine
	end

	for model in ghosts do
		if not model.Parent or not cloaked(model) then
			ghost(model, 0)
			ghosts[model] = nil
		end
	end
	for _, model in characters() do
		if model:IsA("Model") and model:GetAttribute("ParticipantId") and cloaked(model) then
			ghost(model, if model == me then SELF_FADE else OTHERS_FADE)
			ghosts[model] = true
		end
	end

	for _, model in characters() do
		if model:IsA("Model") and model:GetAttribute("ParticipantId") and model ~= me then
			local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local tag = head and head:FindFirstChild("NameTag")
			local root = rootOf(model)
			if tag and tag:IsA("BillboardGui") and root then
				local theirs = Bushes.coverAt(root.Position)
				local show = (theirs == nil or theirs == mine)
					and not ghosts[model]
					and DarknessController.sees(root.Position)
					and (myRoot == nil or Roofs.canSee(myRoot.Position, root.Position))
				if tag.Enabled ~= show then
					tag.Enabled = show
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function BushController.start()
	local elapsed = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		elapsed += dt
		if elapsed < INTERVAL then
			return
		end
		elapsed = 0
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			step()
			return true
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[Bushes] " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end)
end

return BushController

scripts.name: CameraController
scripts.source:
-- Straight-down camera that follows your character. A narrow field of view
-- from high up gives the flat, near-orthographic 2D look. Screen up is world
-- -Z. No zoom or rotation (the Settings panel offers three fixed heights).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.ClientState)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local CameraController = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local height = Config.CAMERA_HEIGHT
local focus: Vector3? = nil
local SCREEN_UP = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)

function CameraController.setHeight(newHeight: number)
	height = newHeight
end

function CameraController.height(): number
	return height
end

local function update(dt: number)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return
	end
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	camera.FieldOfView = Config.CAMERA_FOV

	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if root then
		local target = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, 0, root.Position.Z)
		if not focus or Config.CAMERA_SMOOTHING <= 0 or (focus - target).Magnitude > 60 then
			focus = target -- locked on (and snaps after spawns and teleports)
		else
			focus = focus:Lerp(target, 1 - math.exp(-Config.CAMERA_SMOOTHING * dt))
		end
	end
	if focus then
		-- Bigger players see more around them: the camera rises, up to
		-- CAMERA_MAX_EYE, then widens its view instead (same ground covered).
		local scale = ClientState.my("Scale") or 1
		local wanted = height * Config.viewGrowth(scale)
		local eye = math.min(wanted, math.max(height, Config.CAMERA_MAX_EYE))
		local half = math.tan(math.rad(Config.CAMERA_FOV / 2)) * wanted / eye
		camera.FieldOfView = math.deg(math.atan(half)) * 2
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(focus + Vector3.new(0, eye, 0), focus, SCREEN_UP)
		-- Lighting (your lantern) is drawn around the camera's focus: you.
		camera.Focus = CFrame.new(focus)
	end
end

function CameraController.start()
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("BrainTagCamera", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, update)
end

return CameraController

scripts.name: ChatSetup
scripts.source:
-- TextChatService setup: chat window at the bottom-right (bottom-left and
-- hidden until opened on phones) with channel tabs,
-- yellow system announcements from the server, and a gold [VIP] tag.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.ClientState)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)

local ChatSetup = {}

local function escape(text: string): string
	return (string.gsub(string.gsub(string.gsub(text, "&", "&"), "<", "<"), ">", ">"))
end

function ChatSetup.setVisible(visible: boolean)
	local window = TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatWindowConfiguration")
	local input = TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatInputBarConfiguration")
	if window then
		window.Enabled = visible
	end
	if input then
		input.Enabled = visible
	end
end

function ChatSetup.isVisible(): boolean
	local window = TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatWindowConfiguration")
	return window == nil or window.Enabled
end

function ChatSetup.start()
	local touch = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
	task.spawn(function()
		local window = TextChatService:WaitForChild("ChatWindowConfiguration", 10) :: ChatWindowConfiguration?
		if window then
			-- Desktop: bottom-right (points sit bottom-left). Phones keep the
			-- touch buttons bottom-right, so chat stays left and starts hidden
			-- (the chat button top-left shows it).
			window.HorizontalAlignment = if touch
				then Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left
				else Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
			window.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
			if touch then
				ChatSetup.setVisible(false)
			end
		end
		local tabs = TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChannelTabsConfiguration")
		if tabs then
			tabs.Enabled = true
		end
	end)

	TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage = function(message: TextChatMessage)
		local properties = Instance.new("TextChatMessageProperties")
		local source = message.TextSource
		if source then
			local entry = ClientState.participants:FindFirstChild("P" .. source.UserId)
			if entry and entry:GetAttribute("VIP") then
				properties.PrefixText = string.format(
					'<font color="#%s">[VIP]</font> %s',
					Config.COLORS.VipName,
					message.PrefixText
				)
			end
		end
		return properties
	end

	local general: TextChannel? = nil
	task.spawn(function()
		local channels = TextChatService:WaitForChild("TextChannels", 20)
		general = channels and channels:WaitForChild("RBXGeneral", 20) :: TextChannel?
	end)

	Remotes.event("Announce").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(text: string, hex: string?)
		if typeof(text) ~= "string" then
			return
		end
		local channel = general
		if channel then
			channel:DisplaySystemMessage(
				string.format('<font color="#%s">%s</font>', hex or Config.COLORS.SystemMessage, escape(text))
			)
		end
	end)
end

return ChatSetup

scripts.name: ClientState
scripts.source:
-- Read-only view of the replicated game state for client code: the round
-- phase and timer, and every participant's public info.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ClientState = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local folder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BrainTagState") :: Folder
local participants = folder:WaitForChild("Participants") :: Folder

ClientState.folder = folder
ClientState.participants = participants

function ClientState.phase(): string
	return (folder:GetAttribute("Phase") :: string?) or "Waiting"
end

function ClientState.secondsLeft(): number
	local endsAt = folder:GetAttribute("PhaseEndsAt")
	if typeof(endsAt) ~= "number" then
		return 0
	end
	return math.max(0, endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
end

function ClientState.attr(name: string): any
	return folder:GetAttribute(name)
end

function ClientState.myId(): string
	return "P" .. player.UserId
end

-- This player's replicated entry (nil until the server finished loading them).
function ClientState.me(): Configuration?
	return participants:FindFirstChild(ClientState.myId()) :: Configuration?
end

function ClientState.my(name: string): any
	local me = ClientState.me()
	return me and me:GetAttribute(name)
end

function ClientState.isZombie(): boolean
	return ClientState.my("Team") == "Zombie"
end

function ClientState.myCharacter(): (Model?, BasePart?, Humanoid?)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return character, root, humanoid
end

function ClientState.owns(listAttr: string, key: string): boolean
	local raw = ClientState.my(listAttr)
	if typeof(raw) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end
	for entry in string.gmatch(raw, "[^,]+") do
		if entry == key then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

export type Row = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	score: number,
	team: string,
	isMe: boolean,
	isBot: boolean,
	vip: boolean,
}

function ClientState.rows(): { Row }
	local rows = {}
	local myId = ClientState.myId()
	for _, entry in participants:GetChildren() do
		table.insert(rows, {
			id = entry.Name,
			name = (entry:GetAttribute("DisplayName") :: string?) or entry.Name,
			score = (entry:GetAttribute("Score") :: number?) or 0,
			team = (entry:GetAttribute("Team") :: string?) or "Human",
			isMe = entry.Name == myId,
			isBot = entry:GetAttribute("IsBot") == true,
			vip = entry:GetAttribute("VIP") == true,
		})
	end
	table.sort(rows, function(a, b)
		if a.score == b.score then
			return a.name < b.name
		end
		return a.score > b.score
	end)
	return rows
end

return ClientState

scripts.name: DarknessController
scripts.source:
-- Dark maps (MapThemes with dark = true, like the haunted house): a lantern
-- follows your own character, lit only on your screen, so you see what's
-- near you and little beyond. Other people's name tags show only within the
-- theme's sight (BushController asks `sees`).
--
-- The lantern is a light on an attachment in Terrain, not on a part: there
-- is nothing around it that could block it, nothing a respawn, a new look
-- or a new map can destroy, and it casts no shadows. Every frame it reads
-- the map's theme again and moves to you, so it can't get stuck off.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local MapThemes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapThemes)

local DarknessController = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local theme = MapThemes.get("Classic")

local function myRoot(): BasePart?
	local character = player.Character
	return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
end

local holder: Attachment? = nil
local light: PointLight? = nil

local function lantern(): (Attachment, PointLight)
	local at, lamp = holder, light
	if at and lamp and at.Parent == workspace.Terrain and lamp.Parent == at then
		return at, lamp
	end
	if at then
		at:Destroy()
	end
	local made = Instance.new("Attachment")
	made.Name = "MyLantern"
	local madeLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
	madeLight.Shadows = false
	madeLight.Parent = made
	made.Parent = workspace.Terrain
	holder, light = made, madeLight
	return made, madeLight
end

local function currentTheme(): MapThemes.Theme
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local name = map and map:GetAttribute("Theme")
	return MapThemes.get(if typeof(name) == "string" then name else nil)
end

local function updateLantern()
	theme = currentTheme()
	local at, lamp = lantern()
	local settings = theme.lantern
	local root = myRoot()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	-- No character for a moment (respawning)? Light where the camera looks.
	local center = if root then root.Position elseif camera then camera.Focus.Position else nil
	if theme.dark and settings and center then
		-- Above your head however big you are, and reaching as far as your
		-- (wider) view: big players see more, on dark maps too.
		local scale = if root then math.max(1, root.Size.Y / 2) else 1
		at.WorldPosition = center + Vector3.new(0, 2 + scale * 1.2, 0)
		lamp.Range = math.min(60, settings.range * Config.viewGrowth(scale) + scale)
		lamp.Brightness = settings.brightness * math.min(1.6, Config.viewGrowth(scale) ^ 0.5)
		lamp.Color = Color3.fromHex(settings.color)
		lamp.Enabled = true
	else
		lamp.Enabled = false
	end
end

function DarknessController.isDark(): boolean
	return theme.dark == true
end

-- Can you see someone standing at `position`?
function DarknessController.sees(position: Vector3): boolean
	if not theme.dark then
		return true
	end
	local root = myRoot()
	if not root then
		return true
	end
	local offset = position - root.Position
	local scale = math.max(1, root.Size.Y / 2)
	return Vector3.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Z).Magnitude <= (theme.sight or 40) * Config.viewGrowth(scale)
end

function DarknessController.start()
	updateLantern()
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(updateLantern)
end

return DarknessController

scripts.name: Effects
scripts.source:
-- Plays what the server announces: your own knockback, item swings, potato
-- splats, shotgun blasts, wall debris, infection bursts and sounds.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.ClientState)
local Knockback = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Knockback)
local Parts = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Parts)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local Sounds = require(script.Parent.Sounds)

local Effects = {}

local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local ItemModels = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.ItemModels)

-- Plays an item's sound style (a SoundBank name) if it has one.
local function playStyle(style: string?, position: Vector3?): boolean
	if style and Sounds.has(style) then
		Sounds.play(style, position)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local effectsFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("Effects")

local baseGrip: { [Weld]: CFrame } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any

local function fadeAndRemove(part: BasePart, seconds: number, grow: Vector3?)
	local goal: { [string]: any } = { Transparency = 1 }
	if grow then
		goal.Size = grow
	end
	local tween = TweenService:Create(
		part,
		TweenInfo.new(seconds, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		goal
	)
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Once(function()
		part:Destroy()
	end)
end

local function flatPart(position: Vector3, diameter: number, color: string): Part
	local part = Parts.disc("Fx", position, diameter, 0.1, color, effectsFolder)
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	return part
end

-- Swings the held item around its grip (or thrusts a spear).
local function swing(character: Model?, itemId: string)
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local held = character:FindFirstChild("HeldItem")
	local handle = held and held:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	local weld = handle and handle:FindFirstChild("GripWeld") :: Weld?
	if not weld then
		return
	end
	local base = baseGrip[weld] or weld.C0
	baseGrip[weld] = base
	local thrust = itemId == "Spear" or itemId == "AncientSpear"
	local started = os.clock()
	local duration = if thrust then 0.22 else 0.28
	local connection: RBXScriptConnection
	connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local t = (os.clock() - started) / duration
		if t >= 1 or weld.Parent == nil then
			connection:Disconnect()
			if weld.Parent then
				weld.C0 = base
			end
			return
		end
		if thrust then
			local push = math.sin(t * math.pi) * 2.2
			weld.C0 = base * CFrame.new(0, 0, -push)
		else
			-- Sweep from the right side across to the left, then settle.
			local angle = if t < 0.6
				then math.rad(70) - (t / 0.6) * math.rad(130)
				else math.rad(-60) * (1 - (t - 0.6) / 0.4)
			weld.C0 = base * CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0)
		end
	end)
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local item = Items.get(itemId)
	if not playStyle(item and item.sound, root and root.Position) then
		Sounds.play(if thrust then "Lunge" else "Whoosh", root and root.Position)
	end
end

-- Little bits flying out from a point and fading (stars, feathers, crumbs...).
local BITS: { [string]: { colors: { string }, size: number, count: number, shape: Enum.PartType } } = {
	Stars = { colors = { "FFE14D", "FFFFFF", "FFC21A" }, size = 0.5, count = 6, shape = Enum.PartType.Block },
	Puff = { colors = { "FFFFFF", "EDEDED" }, size = 0.45, count = 4, shape = Enum.PartType.Ball },
	Feathers = {
		colors = { "FFFFFF", "FFF3B0", "FFE14D" },
		size = 0.45,
		count = 8,
		shape = Enum.PartType.Block,
	},
	Crumbs = { colors = { "D9A15C", "B5783A", "E8C28A" }, size = 0.3, count = 10, shape = Enum.PartType.Ball },
	Sparkle = {
		colors = { "FF5FA2", "7FD3FF", "FFFFFF", "FFE14D" },
		size = 0.35,
		count = 8,
		shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
	},
	Confetti = {
		colors = { "E5484D", "F1C40F", "2ECC71", "3498DB", "9B59B6", "FF5FA2" },
		size = 0.35,
		count = 30,
		shape = Enum.PartType.Block,
	},
	Snow = { colors = { "FFFFFF", "E8F6FF" }, size = 0.35, count = 10, shape = Enum.PartType.Ball },
	Peel = { colors = { "F7DC6F", "FFFFFF", "FFE14D" }, size = 0.4, count = 7, shape = Enum.PartType.Block },
	Smoke = { colors = { "5A5A5A", "8C8C8C", "3A3A3A" }, size = 0.8, count = 12, shape = Enum.PartType.Ball },
	Blood = {
		colors = { "B3122A", "6E0F1C", "FF3B4F" },
		size = 0.45,
		count = 12,
		shape = Enum.PartType.Block,
	},
	Magic = { colors = { "9B59B6", "D6B4FC", "FFFFFF" }, size = 0.4, count = 14, shape = Enum.PartType.Ball },
	Fart = { colors = { "9ACD32", "C5E384", "6B8E23" }, size = 0.7, count = 6, shape = Enum.PartType.Ball },
}

local function bits(kind: string, position: Vector3, direction: Vector3?, spread: number?)
	local spec = BITS[kind]
	if not spec then
		return
	end
	local rng = Random.new()
	for i = 1, spec.count do
		local part = Parts.make({
			name = "Bit",
			shape = spec.shape,
			size = Vector3.new(spec.size, 0.08, spec.size)
				* (if spec.shape == Enum.PartType.Ball then 1 else 1),
			cframe = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
				* CFrame.Angles(0, rng:NextNumber(0, 6.28), 0),
			color = spec.colors[(i - 1) % #spec.colors + 1],
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = effectsFolder,
		})
		if spec.shape == Enum.PartType.Ball then
			part.Size = Vector3.one * spec.size
		end
		local dir: Vector3
		if direction then
			local cone = spread or 0.6
			dir = (CFrame.Angles(0, rng:NextNumber(-cone, cone), 0) * direction) * rng:NextNumber(14, 34)
		else
			local a = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
			dir = Vector3.new(math.cos(a), 0, math.sin(a)) * rng:NextNumber(6, 14)
		end
		local finish = position + Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z) * 0.35
		local info = TweenInfo.new(rng:NextNumber(0.4, 0.8), Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		local tween = TweenService:Create(part, info, {
			CFrame = CFrame.new(finish + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, rng:NextNumber(0, 6.28), 0),
			Transparency = 1,
		})
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Once(function()
			part:Destroy()
		end)
	end
end

-- A temporary visual stuck to a character (plunger, bubble, ice).
local function stickTo(character: Model?, seconds: number, build: (root: BasePart) -> { BasePart })
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local parts = build(root)
	for _, part in parts do
		part.Anchored = false
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.Massless = true
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = root
		weld.Part1 = part
		weld.Parent = part
		part.Parent = character
	end
	task.delay(seconds, function()
		for _, part in parts do
			part:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

local function bodyScale(root: BasePart): number
	return root.Size.X / 2.2
end

-- Spray particles on everyone currently holding a water gun / leaf blower.
local SPRAY_COLORS = {
	WaterGun = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromHex("8FD3F5"), Color3.fromHex("E8F6FF")),
	LeafBlower = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromHex("6BBF4E")),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromHex("E8913A")),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromHex("C0392B")),
	}),
	FartGun = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromHex("9ACD32"), Color3.fromHex("C5E384")),
}
local SPRAY_SPREAD = { LeafBlower = 18, FartGun = 26 }
local SPRAY_SIZE = { LeafBlower = 0.9, FartGun = 1.4 }

local function characters(): { Instance }
	local list = workspace:GetChildren()
	local bots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Bots")
	if bots then
		for _, bot in bots:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(list, bot)
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function updateSprays()
	for _, character in characters() do
		if character:IsA("Model") and character:GetAttribute("ParticipantId") then
			local spraying = character:GetAttribute("Spraying")
			local held = character:FindFirstChild("HeldItem")
			local handle = held and held:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			if handle then
				local emitter = handle:FindFirstChild("Spray", true) :: ParticleEmitter?
				if spraying and not emitter then
					local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
					attachment.Name = "SprayAt"
					attachment.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0, -4.3)
					attachment.Parent = handle
					local created = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
					created.Name = "Spray"
					created.Color = SPRAY_COLORS[spraying] or SPRAY_COLORS.WaterGun
					created.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front
					created.Speed = NumberRange.new(28, 40)
					created.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(SPRAY_SPREAD[spraying] or 6, 4)
					created.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.5)
					created.Rate = 70
					created.Size = NumberSequence.new(SPRAY_SIZE[spraying] or 0.6, 0.2)
					created.LightEmission = 0.2
					created.Parent = attachment
					emitter = created
				end
				if emitter then
					emitter.Enabled = spraying ~= nil
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function blast(origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3, reach: number)
	for _, angle in { -0.3, -0.15, 0, 0.15, 0.3 } do
		local dir = CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0) * direction
		local mid = origin + dir * (reach / 2)
		local tracer = Parts.make({
			name = "Pellet",
			size = Vector3.new(0.25, 0.25, reach),
			cframe = CFrame.lookAt(mid, mid + dir),
			color = "FFE36E",
			material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = effectsFolder,
		})
		fadeAndRemove(tracer, 0.18)
	end
	local flash = flatPart(origin + direction * 2 + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), 3, "FFF3B0")
	flash.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	fadeAndRemove(flash, 0.15, flash.Size * 1.6)
	Sounds.play("Shotgun", origin, 0.8)
end

local function debris(cframe: CFrame, size: Vector3)
	local rng = Random.new()
	for _ = 1, 8 do
		local offset = Vector3.new(
			rng:NextNumber(-size.X / 2, size.X / 2),
			rng:NextNumber(-1, 3),
			rng:NextNumber(-size.Z / 2, size.Z / 2)
		)
		local chunk = Parts.make({
			name = "Debris",
			size = Vector3.one * rng:NextNumber(0.8, 1.8),
			cframe = cframe * CFrame.new(offset),
			color = "4A4A4A",
			anchored = false,
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = effectsFolder,
		})
		chunk.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
			Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-25, 25), rng:NextNumber(20, 40), rng:NextNumber(-25, 25))
		task.delay(1.2, function()
			chunk:Destroy()
		end)
	end
end

local function burst(position: Vector3, color: string, size: number)
	local ring = flatPart(Vector3.new(position.X, 0.6, position.Z), 2, color)
	ring.Transparency = 0.2
	fadeAndRemove(ring, 0.45, Vector3.new(0.1, size, size))
end

local HANDLERS: { [string]: (data: { [string]: any }) -> () } = {
	Swing = function(data)
		swing(data.character, data.item)
	end,
	Shoot = function(data)
		local character = data.character :: Model?
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		Sounds.play("Shoot", root and root.Position)
	end,
	Splat = function(data)
		local look = data.look
		if look == "Snowball" then
			bits("Snow", data.position)
		elseif look == "Bubble" then
			burst(data.position, "BFE9FF", 5)
			playStyle("Pop", data.position)
		elseif look == "Pebble" or look == "Bullet" or look == "Arrow" then
			burst(data.position, "8C8C8C", 2.5)
		elseif look == "Ice" then
			bits("Snow", data.position)
			burst(data.position, "BFF0FF", 4)
		else
			burst(data.position, "C9A66B", 4)
			Sounds.play("Splat", data.position)
		end
	end,
	Blast = function(data)
		if data.item == "ConfettiCannon" then
			bits("Confetti", data.origin, data.direction, 0.6)
			playStyle("Pop", data.origin)
			playStyle("Squeak", data.origin)
		else
			blast(data.origin, data.direction, data.reach)
		end
	end,
	Hit = function(data)
		bits(data.fx, data.position)
		Sounds.play("Hit", data.position)
	end,
	Plunged = function(data)
		local target = data.character :: Model?
		local hit = target and target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		Sounds.play("Plunge", hit and hit.Position)
		stickTo(data.character, data.seconds, function(root)
			local s = bodyScale(root)
			local plunger = ItemModels.build("Plunger")
			-- Cup on the face, stick pointing straight out the front.
			plunger:PivotTo(
				root.CFrame
					* CFrame.new(0, 1.2 * s, -1.0 * s)
					* CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0)
					* CFrame.new(0, 0, 3.4)
			)
			local parts = {}
			for _, part in plunger:GetDescendants() do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "Handle" then
					for _, weld in part:GetChildren() do
						if weld:IsA("Weld") then
							weld:Destroy()
						end
					end
					table.insert(parts, part)
				end
			end
			return parts
		end)
	end,
	Bubbled = function(data)
		local character = data.character :: Model?
		local inside = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		Sounds.play("Bubble", inside and inside.Position)
		stickTo(character, data.seconds, function(root)
			local s = bodyScale(root)
			local bubble = Parts.make({
				name = "Bubble",
				shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
				size = Vector3.one * 5.2 * s,
				cframe = root.CFrame,
				color = "BFE9FF",
				transparency = 0.6,
			})
			local shine = Parts.make({
				name = "Shine",
				shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
				size = Vector3.one * 1.1 * s,
				cframe = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(-1.2 * s, 1.9 * s, -1.0 * s),
				color = "FFFFFF",
				transparency = 0.3,
			})
			return { bubble, shine }
		end)
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		if root then
			task.delay(data.seconds, function()
				burst(root.Position, "BFE9FF", 7)
				playStyle("Pop", root.Position)
			end)
		end
	end,
	Frozen = function(data)
		local character = data.character :: Model?
		if not character then
			return
		end
		local ice = Instance.new("Highlight")
		ice.FillColor = Color3.fromHex("9FE3FF")
		ice.FillTransparency = 0.45
		ice.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		ice.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
		ice.Parent = character
		task.delay(data.seconds, function()
			ice:Destroy()
		end)
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		if root then
			bits("Snow", root.Position)
			Sounds.play("Freeze", root.Position)
		end
	end,
	Slip = function(data)
		bits("Peel", data.position)
		bits("Stars", data.position)
		playStyle("Slip", data.position)
	end,
	Drop = function(data)
		Sounds.play("Drop", data.position)
	end,
	Gulp = function(data)
		bits("Sparkle", data.position)
		playStyle("Gulp", data.position)
	end,
	Boom = function(data)
		-- Ducks go off in feathers; dynamite and grenades in smoke.
		bits(if data.look == "Duck" then "Feathers" else "Smoke", data.position)
		burst(data.position, if data.look == "Duck" then "FFD93B" else "FF8A3D", (data.radius or 8) * 2)
		Sounds.play("Boom", data.position)
	end,
	Cloak = function(data)
		bits("Magic", data.position)
		bits("Puff", data.position)
		burst(data.position, "9B59B6", 9)
		playStyle("Pop", data.position)
	end,
	Ride = function(data)
		bits("Puff", data.position)
		Sounds.play("Whoosh", data.position)
	end,
	Summon = function(data)
		bits("Blood", data.position)
		burst(data.position, "B3122A", 10)
		Sounds.play("Drop", data.position)
	end,
	WallBreak = function(data)
		debris(data.cframe, data.size)
		Sounds.play("WallBreak", data.cframe.Position)
	end,
	Infect = function(data)
		burst(data.position, "7BC043", 10)
		Sounds.play("Infect", data.position)
		task.delay(0.35, function()
			Sounds.play("Groan", data.position, 0.8)
		end)
	end,
	Eat = function(data)
		burst(data.position, "F4F4F4", 4)
		Sounds.play("Eat", data.position)
	end,
	Pickup = function(data)
		Sounds.play("Pickup", data.position)
	end,
	Outbreak = function()
		Sounds.play("Outbreak")
	end,
	RoundEnd = function(data)
		-- A happy chime if your side won, a sad one if it didn't.
		local zombie = ClientState.isZombie()
		local won = (data.winner == "Survivors" and not zombie) or (data.winner == "Zombies" and zombie)
		Sounds.play(if won then "RoundWin" else "RoundLose")
	end,
	Wizard = function(data)
		bits("Sparkle", data.position)
		Sounds.play("Wizard")
	end,
	Warp = function(data)
		Sounds.play("Warp", data.position)
	end,
}

-- Bumping into another character: a soft thud and a little puff where you
-- touched, so collisions read clearly. Your character's "Shell" is the
-- body-sized cylinder only other characters collide with.
local BUMP_COOLDOWN = 0.4
local lastBump = 0

local function watchShell(character: Model)
	local function hook(shell: Instance)
		if not shell:IsA("BasePart") or shell.Name ~= "Shell" then
			return
		end
		shell.Touched:Connect(function(other)
			if other.Name ~= "Shell" or other:IsDescendantOf(character) then
				return
			end
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - lastBump < BUMP_COOLDOWN then
				return
			end
			lastBump = now
			local between = (shell.Position + other.Position) / 2
			playStyle("Bump", between)
			bits("Puff", between)
		end)
	end
	character.ChildAdded:Connect(hook)
	for _, child in character:GetChildren() do
		hook(child)
	end
end

function Effects.start()
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(watchShell)
	if player.Character then
		watchShell(player.Character)
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.1)
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				updateSprays()
				return true
			end)
			if not ok then
				warn("[Fx] spray: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end)
	Remotes.event("Knockback").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(velocity: Vector3, seconds: number)
		local character = player.Character
		if character and typeof(velocity) == "Vector3" then
			Knockback.apply(character, velocity, seconds)
		end
	end)
	Remotes.event("Fx").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind: string, data: { [string]: any })
		local handler = HANDLERS[kind]
		if handler then
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				handler(data or {})
				return true
			end)
			if not ok then
				warn("[Fx] " .. kind .. ": " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end)
end

return Effects

scripts.name: ForceField
scripts.source:
-- Soft force fields around people and held weapons, felt by YOUR character
-- (worked out on your machine, so it is smooth and instant):
--   * people on your team gently push apart before they overlap
--   * someone else's weapon pushes you off it (firm ones and bigger
--     holders harder)
--   * someone pressing on your own weapon pushes you back (by size)
--   * two weapons pressed together push their holders apart
-- So nobody stacks up and there is always a bit of friction, like the
-- original. Bots get the same push from the server (ItemService.shaftStep).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local CharacterLook = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.CharacterLook)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local FurniturePush = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.FurniturePush)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local RoundRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RoundRules)

local ForceField = {}

local C = Config.CHARACTER
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

type Body = { root: BasePart, scale: number, team: any, item: Items.Item? }

local cached: { Model } = {}
local cachedAt = 0

local function others(): { Model }
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - cachedAt > 0.25 then
		cachedAt = now
		cached = {}
		for _, folder in { workspace, workspace:FindFirstChild("Bots") } do
			if folder then
				for _, child in folder:GetChildren() do
					if
						child:IsA("Model")
						and child:GetAttribute("ParticipantId")
						and child ~= player.Character
					then
						table.insert(cached, child)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return cached
end

local function flat(v: Vector3): Vector3
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
end

-- Closest point to `p` on the segment a-b (all flat).
local function closest(a: Vector3, b: Vector3, p: Vector3): Vector3
	local ab = b - a
	local length2 = ab:Dot(ab)
	if length2 < 1e-6 then
		return a
	end
	local t = math.clamp((p - a):Dot(ab) / length2, 0, 1)
	return a + ab * t
end

-- A held melee weapon's shaft: from the hand along where the holder faces.
local function shaft(root: BasePart, scale: number, item: Items.Item, facing: Vector3): (Vector3, Vector3)
	local hand = flat((root.CFrame * CharacterLook.grip(scale)).Position)
	local reach = (item.reach or 5) * Items.reachScale(scale)
	return hand, hand + facing * reach
end

local furnitureQuery = OverlapParams.new()
furnitureQuery.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

local function solidPieces(center: Vector3, look: Vector3, size: Vector3): { BasePart }
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Furniture")
	if not folder then
		return {}
	end
	furnitureQuery.FilterDescendantsInstances = { folder }
	local found = {}
	local frame = CFrame.lookAt(center, center + look)
	for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(frame, size, furnitureQuery) do
		if part.Name == "Body" and not part.Anchored and part.CanCollide then
			table.insert(found, part)
		end
	end
	return found
end

-- Furniture is solid: your weapon bounces off a piece pushed into it (or one
-- it's pressed into that won't give), and your body is never left inside one.
local function furniturePush(root: BasePart, scale: number, a: Vector3?, b: Vector3?, guard: number): Vector3
	local push = Vector3.zero
	local y = root.Position.Y
	if a and b and (b - a).Magnitude > 0.1 then
		local mid = Vector3.new((a.X + b.X) / 2, y, (a.Z + b.Z) / 2)
		local size = Vector3.new(guard * 2 + 1, root.Size.Y + 2, (b - a).Magnitude + guard * 2 + 1)
		for _, body in solidPieces(mid, (b - a).Unit, size) do
			local model = body.Parent
			if model and model:FindFirstChild("HeldGlow") then
				continue -- the piece you're holding moves with you
			end
			local depth, out = FurniturePush.overlapOut(a, b, guard, body)
			if out then
				push += out * math.min(depth * Config.FIELD_FURNITURE, Config.FIELD_WEAPON_MAX)
			end
		end
	end
	local me = flat(root.Position)
	local radius = Config.rootWidth(scale) / 2 * 0.9
	local around = Vector3.new(radius * 2 + 2, root.Size.Y + 2, radius * 2 + 2)
	for _, body in solidPieces(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, 0, -1), around) do
		local depth, out = FurniturePush.overlapOut(me, me, radius, body)
		if out then
			push += out * math.min(depth * 40, 40)
		end
	end
	return push
end

local function heldMelee(model: Model): Items.Item?
	local held = model:FindFirstChild("HeldItem")
	local id = held and held:GetAttribute("ItemId")
	local item = if typeof(id) == "string" then Items.get(id) else nil
	return if item and item.kind == "Melee" then item else nil
end

-- Extra velocity (studs/second, flat) for your character this frame.
function ForceField.velocity(root: BasePart, aim: Vector3, myItemId: string?, myTeam: any): Vector3
	local myScale = root.Size.Y / C.RootHeight -- (the width stops growing)
	local myRadius = C.ShellDiameter / 2 * myScale
	local me = flat(root.Position)
	local myItem = Items.get(myItemId)
	local myA, myB: Vector3? = nil, nil
	if myItem and myItem.kind == "Melee" then
		myA, myB = shaft(root, myScale, myItem, aim)
	end
	local push = furniturePush(root, myScale, myA, myB, if myItem then myItem.guard or 0.5 else 0.5)

	for _, model in others() do
		local other = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		if not other then
			continue
		end
		local them = flat(other.Position)
		local offset = me - them
		if offset.Magnitude > 40 then
			continue
		end
		local scale = other.Size.Y / C.RootHeight
		local radius = C.ShellDiameter / 2 * scale

		-- Body to body (same team only: a zombie touching you should infect).
		if model:GetAttribute("Team") == myTeam then
			local overlap = myRadius + radius + 0.3 - offset.Magnitude
			if overlap > 0 then
				local away = if offset.Magnitude > 0.01 then offset.Unit else Vector3.xAxis
				push += away * math.min(overlap * Config.FIELD_BODY, Config.FIELD_BODY_MAX)
			end
		end

		-- Their weapon against you.
		local item = heldMelee(model)
		local facing = flat(other.CFrame.LookVector)
		if item and facing.Magnitude > 0.1 then
			local a, b = shaft(other, scale, item, facing.Unit)
			local point = closest(a, b, me)
			local away = me - point
			local overlap = (item.guard or 0.5) + myRadius - away.Magnitude
			if overlap > 0 then
				-- Shared by strength (size squared, times how firm the weapon is):
				-- a much bigger holder holds you off completely.
				local hold = scale * scale * (item.firmness or 1)
				local share = hold / (hold + RoundRules.pushStrength(myScale, myTeam == "Zombie"))
				local dir = if away.Magnitude > 0.01 then away.Unit else facing.Unit
				push += dir * math.min(overlap * Config.FIELD_WEAPON * share * 2, Config.FIELD_WEAPON_MAX)
			end

			-- Weapon against weapon: both holders get pushed apart.
			if myA and myB and myItem then
				local mine = closest(myA, myB, closest(a, b, (myA + myB) / 2))
				local theirs = closest(a, b, mine)
				local gap = mine - theirs
				local touch = (myItem.guard or 0.5) + (item.guard or 0.5) - gap.Magnitude
				if touch > 0 then
					local dir = if gap.Magnitude > 0.01 then gap.Unit else (me - them).Unit
					push += dir * math.min(touch * Config.FIELD_WEAPON, Config.FIELD_WEAPON_MAX) * 0.6
				end
			end
		end

		-- Someone pressing on your weapon pushes you back, by their share of
		-- the strength: an equal zombie walks you backwards, a small one
		-- against a big you barely does.
		if myA and myB and myItem then
			local point = closest(myA, myB, them)
			local overlap = (myItem.guard or 0.5) + radius - (point - them).Magnitude
			if overlap > 0 then
				local back = if offset.Magnitude > 0.01 then offset.Unit else -aim
				local mine = myScale * myScale * (myItem.firmness or 1)
				local theirs = RoundRules.pushStrength(scale, model:GetAttribute("Team") == "Zombie")
				local share = theirs / (mine + theirs)
				push += back * math.min(overlap * Config.FIELD_RECOIL * share * 2, Config.FIELD_WEAPON_MAX)
			end
		end
	end
	return push
end

return ForceField

scripts.name: FurnitureController
scripts.source:
-- Drives the furniture YOU are pushing, on your own machine, so it responds
-- instantly and stops the moment you stop. The server hands you a piece when
-- you claim it and takes it back if someone else pushes it too.
--
-- You move furniture by walking into it, with a zombie's arms, or with a
-- held weapon: its shaft is solid and pushes whatever it touches. Humans can
-- also grab the piece next to them (hold F): it comes with you, pulled or
-- pushed, and heavy pieces slow you down.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CharacterLook = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.CharacterLook)
local ClientState = require(script.Parent.ClientState)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local FurniturePush = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.FurniturePush)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local MovementController = require(script.Parent.MovementController)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local RoundRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RoundRules)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

local FurnitureController = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local OWNER = FurniturePush.OWNER_ATTRIBUTE
local CLAIM_INTERVAL = 0.1

local folder: Instance
local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
local claimRemote: UnreliableRemoteEvent
local owned: { [BasePart]: boolean } = {}
local pendingClaims: { [Instance]: boolean } = {}
local lastClaim = 0
local grabRemote: RemoteEvent
local held: BasePart? = nil -- the piece you're holding
local heldOffset = Vector3.zero -- where it stays, relative to you
local heldGlow: Highlight? = nil

local function track(model: Instance)
	if not model:IsA("Model") then
		return
	end
	local body = model:WaitForChild("Body", 10) :: BasePart?
	if not body then
		return
	end
	local function refresh()
		if model:GetAttribute(OWNER) == player.UserId and model.Parent == folder then
			owned[body] = true
		else
			owned[body] = nil
		end
	end
	model:GetAttributeChangedSignal(OWNER):Connect(refresh)
	model.AncestryChanged:Connect(refresh)
	refresh()
end

local function query(cframe: CFrame, size: Vector3): { BasePart }
	local found = {}
	for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cframe, size, overlap) do
		if part.Name == "Body" and not part.Anchored then
			table.insert(found, part)
		end
	end
	return found
end

-- Your walking speed while dragging (MovementController reads it).
local function setDrag(factor: number?)
	local character = player.Character
	if character and character:GetAttribute("DragFactor") ~= factor then
		character:SetAttribute("DragFactor", factor)
	end
end

function FurnitureController.release()
	local body = held
	if not body then
		return
	end
	held = nil
	if heldGlow then
		heldGlow:Destroy()
		heldGlow = nil
	end
	setDrag(nil)
	if body.Parent then
		grabRemote:FireServer(body.Parent, false)
	end
end

-- Grab the piece next to you (the one you face, if several).
function FurnitureController.grab()
	FurnitureController.release()
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not root or ClientState.isZombie() then
		return
	end
	local scale = ClientState.my("Scale") or 1
	local around = (FurniturePush.bumperRadius(scale) + Config.GRAB_REACH) * 2 + 14
	local body = FurniturePush.pickGrab(
		root,
		scale,
		MovementController.aim(),
		query(CFrame.new(root.Position), Vector3.new(around, root.Size.Y + 4, around))
	)
	local model = body and body.Parent
	if not body or not model then
		return
	end
	held = body
	heldOffset = Vector3.new(body.Position.X - root.Position.X, 0, body.Position.Z - root.Position.Z)
	local glow = Instance.new("Highlight")
	glow.Name = "HeldGlow" -- ForceField skips the piece you hold
	glow.FillTransparency = 1
	glow.OutlineColor = Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.SelfName)
	glow.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
	glow.Adornee = model
	glow.Parent = model
	heldGlow = glow
	grabRemote:FireServer(model, true)
end

local function collect(): FurniturePush.Pushes
	local pushes: FurniturePush.Pushes = {}
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		FurnitureController.release()
		return pushes
	end
	local scale = ClientState.my("Scale") or 1
	local strength = RoundRules.pushStrength(scale, ClientState.isZombie())
	local walk = humanoid.WalkSpeed
	local move = Vector3.new(humanoid.MoveDirection.X, 0, humanoid.MoveDirection.Z)
	local moving = move.Magnitude > 0.1 and walk > 0
	local dir = if moving then move.Unit else Vector3.zero

	-- The piece you're holding comes with you; you let go if it gets stuck.
	local body = held
	if body then
		if body.Parent == nil or ClientState.isZombie() then
			FurnitureController.release()
		else
			local desired, lag = FurniturePush.holdVelocity(root, heldOffset, body)
			if lag > Config.GRAB_BREAK then
				FurnitureController.release()
			else
				FurniturePush.add(pushes, body, desired, strength, nil)
				setDrag(FurniturePush.dragFactor(body, strength))
			end
		end
	end

	-- Walking into furniture.
	if moving then
		local probe, size = FurniturePush.moverProbe(root, dir, scale)
		for _, body in query(probe, size) do
			FurniturePush.add(pushes, body, dir * walk, strength, probe.Position)
		end
	end

	-- A zombie's arms are solid: walking, they push what they touch; standing
	-- or turning, they shove it out of the way.
	if ClientState.isZombie() and walk > 0 then
		local probe, size = FurniturePush.armsProbe(
			root,
			scale,
			CharacterLook.ZOMBIE_ARM_REACH,
			CharacterLook.ZOMBIE_ARM_SPAN
		)
		for _, body in query(probe, size) do
			if not pushes[body] then
				if moving then
					FurniturePush.add(pushes, body, dir * walk, strength, probe.Position)
				else
					local exit = FurniturePush.shaftExit(root.Position, probe.LookVector, body)
					FurniturePush.add(
						pushes,
						body,
						exit * walk * Config.SHAFT_FURNITURE_FACTOR,
						strength,
						nil
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Weapons: the shaft pushes what it touches.
	local item = Items.get(ClientState.my("HeldItem"))
	if item and item.kind == "Melee" and not ClientState.isZombie() then
		local aim = MovementController.aim()
		local reach = (item.reach or 5) * Items.reachScale(scale)
		local grip = CharacterLook.grip(scale)
		local hand = (root.CFrame * grip).Position
		local probe, size = FurniturePush.itemProbe(root, grip, aim, reach, item.guard)
		local touched = query(probe, size)
		local firm = strength * (item.firmness or 1) -- a stiff bat shoves harder than a noodle
		-- The shaft is solid: what it overlaps moves out of the way.
		if walk > 0 then
			for _, body in touched do
				if not pushes[body] then
					if moving then
						FurniturePush.add(pushes, body, dir * walk, firm, body.Position + aim * 0.5)
					else
						local exit = FurniturePush.shaftExit(hand, aim, body)
						FurniturePush.add(
							pushes,
							body,
							exit * walk * Config.SHAFT_FURNITURE_FACTOR,
							firm,
							nil
						)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- A piece you drive pushes whatever it runs into, so you can shove a line.
	for body, push in table.clone(pushes) do
		if owned[body] then
			local velocity = FurniturePush.resolve(body, push)
			local ahead = Util.flatUnit(velocity)
			if ahead and velocity.Magnitude > 0.5 then
				local reachAhead = FurniturePush.extent(body, ahead)
				local center = body.Position + ahead * (reachAhead + 0.6)
				local side = Vector3.new(-ahead.Z, 0, ahead.X)
				local width = FurniturePush.extent(body, side) * 2 * 0.9
				local probe = CFrame.lookAt(center, center + ahead)
				for _, other in query(probe, Vector3.new(width, 2, 1.2)) do
					if other ~= body and not pushes[other] then
						FurniturePush.add(pushes, other, velocity, push.strength, center)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return pushes
end

local function step()
	local pushes = collect()

	-- Ask the server for anything we're pushing.
	for body in pushes do
		local model = body.Parent
		if model then
			pendingClaims[model] = true
		end
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if next(pendingClaims) and now - lastClaim >= CLAIM_INTERVAL then
		local list = {}
		for model in pendingClaims do
			table.insert(list, model)
			if #list >= 16 then
				break
			end
		end
		table.clear(pendingClaims)
		lastClaim = now
		claimRemote:FireServer(list)
	end

	-- Drive the pieces the server gave us. Unpushed ones stand still.
	for body in owned do
		if body.Parent == nil then
			owned[body] = nil
			continue
		end
		local v = body.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local push = pushes[body]
		if push then
			local velocity, spin = FurniturePush.resolve(body, push)
			body.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, math.min(v.Y, 0), velocity.Z)
			body.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, spin, 0)
		elseif math.abs(v.X) + math.abs(v.Z) > 0.02 or body.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > 0.02 then
			body.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.min(v.Y, 0), 0)
			body.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
	end
end

function FurnitureController.start()
	folder = workspace:WaitForChild("Furniture")
	overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = { folder }
	claimRemote = Remotes.unreliable("PushClaim")
	grabRemote = Remotes.event("Grab")
	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		task.spawn(track, child)
	end)
	for _, child in folder:GetChildren() do
		task.spawn(track, child)
	end
	-- Before physics, so the velocities we set are used this very frame.
	RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(step)
end

return FurnitureController

scripts.name: InputController
scripts.source:
-- Keyboard, mouse and gamepad actions. Touch buttons call the same functions.
--   Left click / R2: use item (hold to keep spraying)
--   E / X: pick up      G / B: drop      B / Y: shop      Z / L1: zombie return
--   1 2 3 / D-pad: switch inventory slot
--   F / L2 (hold): grab the furniture next to you and drag it along

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local FurnitureController = require(script.Parent.FurnitureController)
local MovementController = require(script.Parent.MovementController)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)

local InputController = {}

local useRemote = Remotes.event("UseItem")
local pickRemote = Remotes.event("PickUp")
local dropRemote = Remotes.event("DropItem")
local returnRemote = Remotes.event("ZombieReturn")
local slotRemote = Remotes.event("SelectSlot")

-- Set by the HUD.
InputController.onShop = function() end
InputController.isMenuOpen = function(): boolean
	return false
end

local using = false

function InputController.useStart()
	using = true
	useRemote:FireServer("start", MovementController.aim())
end

-- True while the use button is held (hooking furniture with a weapon).
function InputController.isUsing(): boolean
	return using
end

function InputController.useStop()
	if using then
		using = false
		useRemote:FireServer("stop", MovementController.aim())
	end
end

function InputController.pickUp()
	pickRemote:FireServer()
end

function InputController.drop()
	dropRemote:FireServer()
end

function InputController.selectSlot(slot: number)
	slotRemote:FireServer(slot)
end

function InputController.zombieReturn()
	returnRemote:FireServer()
end

function InputController.shop()
	InputController.onShop()
end

function InputController.grabStart()
	FurnitureController.grab()
end

function InputController.grabStop()
	FurnitureController.release()
end

local BEGIN: { [Enum.KeyCode]: () -> () } = {
	[Enum.KeyCode.E] = InputController.pickUp,
	[Enum.KeyCode.G] = InputController.drop,
	[Enum.KeyCode.B] = InputController.shop,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Z] = InputController.zombieReturn,
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX] = InputController.pickUp,
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB] = InputController.drop,
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY] = InputController.shop,
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1] = InputController.zombieReturn,
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2] = InputController.useStart,
	[Enum.KeyCode.F] = InputController.grabStart,
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL2] = InputController.grabStart,
	[Enum.KeyCode.One] = function()
		InputController.selectSlot(1)
	end,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Two] = function()
		InputController.selectSlot(2)
	end,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Three] = function()
		InputController.selectSlot(3)
	end,
	[Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft] = function()
		InputController.selectSlot(1)
	end,
	[Enum.KeyCode.DPadUp] = function()
		InputController.selectSlot(2)
	end,
	[Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight] = function()
		InputController.selectSlot(3)
	end,
}

function InputController.start()
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if processed then
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			if not InputController.isMenuOpen() then
				InputController.useStart()
			end
			return
		end
		local action = BEGIN[input.KeyCode]
		if action then
			action()
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2
		then
			InputController.useStop()
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL2 then
			InputController.grabStop()
		end
	end)
end

return InputController

scripts.name: MovementController
scripts.source:
-- Moves the character in SCREEN directions (W = up the screen = world -Z)
-- and turns it to face the mouse. On touch screens and gamepads, where there
-- is no mouse, the character faces the way it walks instead.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.ClientState)
local ForceField = require(script.Parent.ForceField)

local MovementController = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local aim = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
local usingMouse = not UserInputService.TouchEnabled or UserInputService.MouseEnabled
local controls: any = nil
local aimRemote: UnreliableRemoteEvent? = nil
local lastAimSent = 0
local lastAimSentValue = Vector3.zero

local KEYS: { [Enum.KeyCode]: Vector3 } = {
	[Enum.KeyCode.W] = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
	[Enum.KeyCode.Up] = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
	[Enum.KeyCode.S] = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1),
	[Enum.KeyCode.Down] = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1),
	[Enum.KeyCode.A] = Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0),
	[Enum.KeyCode.Left] = Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0),
	[Enum.KeyCode.D] = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0),
	[Enum.KeyCode.Right] = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0),
}

local MOUSE_INPUTS = {
	[Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement] = true,
	[Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1] = true,
	[Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2] = true,
	[Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel] = true,
	[Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard] = true,
}

function MovementController.aim(): Vector3
	return aim
end

function MovementController.usingMouse(): boolean
	return usingMouse
end

local function rawMove(): Vector3
	local v = Vector3.zero
	-- Thumbsticks and gamepads come from Roblox's PlayerModule. Its vector is
	-- already in screen terms: -Z means "up the screen".
	if controls then
		local ok, mv = pcall(function()
			return controls:GetMoveVector()
		end)
		if ok and typeof(mv) == "Vector3" then
			v += mv
		end
	end
	if not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
		-- Read keys directly too, so arrows always work. Counting a key twice
		-- is harmless because the result is normalized below.
		for key, direction in KEYS do
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(key) then
				v += direction
			end
		end
	end
	v = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
	if v.Magnitude > 1 then
		v = v.Unit
	end
	return v
end

local function step()
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false

	local move = rawMove()
	humanoid:Move(move, false) -- false = world space, not camera space

	-- Sharp, like the original: full speed the instant a key goes down, a dead
	-- stop the instant it comes up (a Humanoid alone eases in and out). Left
	-- alone while a knockback shove is playing.
	-- Soft force fields from people and weapons nearby are added on top, so
	-- nobody stacks and pushing always meets a little resistance.
	if not root:FindFirstChild("KnockbackForce") then
		local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		-- Dragging a heavy piece slows you down (FurnitureController).
		local drag = character:GetAttribute("DragFactor")
		local speed = humanoid.WalkSpeed * (if typeof(drag) == "number" then drag else 1)
		local field =
			ForceField.velocity(root, aim, ClientState.my("HeldItem"), character:GetAttribute("Team"))
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(move.X * speed + field.X, v.Y, move.Z * speed + field.Z)
	end

	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if usingMouse and camera then
		local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(mouse.X, mouse.Y)
		if math.abs(ray.Direction.Y) > 1e-3 then
			local t = (root.Position.Y - ray.Origin.Y) / ray.Direction.Y
			local point = ray.Origin + ray.Direction * t
			local flat = Vector3.new(point.X - root.Position.X, 0, point.Z - root.Position.Z)
			if flat.Magnitude > 0.5 then
				aim = flat.Unit
			end
		end
	elseif move.Magnitude > 0.1 then
		aim = move.Unit
	end
	root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + aim)

	-- Keep the server's idea of your aim fresh (weapon pushes use it).
	local now = os.clock()
	if aimRemote and now - lastAimSent > 0.1 and aim:Dot(lastAimSentValue) < 0.995 then
		lastAimSent, lastAimSentValue = now, aim
		aimRemote:FireServer(aim)
	end
end

local function onCharacter(character: Model)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10) :: Humanoid?
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	for _, state in
		{
			Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping,
			Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing,
			Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown,
			Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll,
			Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated,
			Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming,
		}
	do
		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(state, false)
	end
end

function MovementController.start()
	task.spawn(function()
		local Remotes = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Remotes)
		aimRemote = Remotes.unreliable("Aim")
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, module = pcall(function()
			return require(
					player:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("PlayerModule") :: ModuleScript
				) :: any
		end)
		if ok and module then
			controls = module:GetControls()
		else
			warn("[Movement] PlayerModule unavailable; keyboard only")
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(function(inputType)
		if MOUSE_INPUTS[inputType] then
			usingMouse = true
		elseif inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or string.find(inputType.Name, "Gamepad") then
			usingMouse = false
		end
	end)

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(onCharacter, player.Character)
	end

	-- Runs right after Roblox's own control script (priority Input), so our
	-- world-space move wins.
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("BrainTagMove", Enum.RenderPriority.Input.Value + 1, step)
end

return MovementController

scripts.name: RoofController
scripts.source:
-- Roofed maps (the haunted house): every room is covered by a pitch black
-- roof, so from outside you can't see who or what is in there. The roof of
-- the room you stand in disappears on your screen, so you see that room
-- only. Doorways are open: walk straight in.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Roofs = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Roofs)

local RoofController = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local open: BasePart? = nil

local function step()
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local mine = if root then Roofs.over(root.Position) else nil
	if mine == open then
		return
	end
	if open and open.Parent then
		open.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
	end
	if mine then
		mine.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
	end
	open = mine
end

function RoofController.start()
	local elapsed = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		elapsed += dt
		if elapsed >= 0.05 then
			elapsed = 0
			step()
		end
	end)
end

return RoofController

scripts.name: SoundBank
scripts.source:
-- Every sound in the game, built from the few sound files that ship inside
-- the Roblox client (so they always load, in any experience, with no
-- uploads). Each recipe picks a file and shapes it: pitch, volume, a slice of
-- the file, audio effects, or a short sequence of notes.
--
-- To use your own uploaded sound instead, put its id in
-- Config.SOUND_OVERRIDES, e.g. Squeak = "rbxassetid://1234567890".

export type Note = {
	file: string, -- key of FILES
	pitch: number?,
	volume: number?,
	from: number?, -- play only this slice of the file (seconds)
	to: number?,
	effects: { string }?, -- Echo, Distort, Tremolo, Flange, Reverb, Muffle, Thin
	delay: number?, -- seconds after the first note (sequences)
}

export type Recipe = { Note }

local FILES: { [string]: string } = {
	Fall = "rbxasset://sounds/action_falling.ogg", -- rushing air
	Steps = "rbxasset://sounds/action_footsteps_plastic.mp3",
	GetUp = "rbxasset://sounds/action_get_up.mp3",
	Jump = "rbxasset://sounds/action_jump.mp3",
	Land = "rbxasset://sounds/action_jump_land.mp3", -- thud
	Swim = "rbxasset://sounds/action_swim.mp3",
	Explosion = "rbxasset://sounds/impact_explosion_03.mp3",
	Splash = "rbxasset://sounds/impact_water.mp3",
	Oof = "rbxasset://sounds/oof.ogg",
	Ouch = "rbxasset://sounds/ouch.ogg",
	Click = "rbxasset://sounds/volume_slider.ogg",
}

local function note(file: string, pitch: number, volume: number, extra: { [string]: any }?): Note
	local n: Note = { file = file, pitch = pitch, volume = volume }
	if extra then
		n.from = extra.from
		n.to = extra.to
		n.effects = extra.effects
		n.delay = extra.delay
	end
	return n
end

local function chime(pitches: { number }, gap: number, volume: number, effects: { string }?): Recipe
	local notes = {}
	for i, pitch in pitches do
		table.insert(notes, note("Click", pitch, volume, { delay = (i - 1) * gap, effects = effects }))
	end
	return notes
end

local RECIPES: { [string]: Recipe } = {
	-- Weapons
	Whoosh = { note("Fall", 2.4, 0.35, { from = 0.2, to = 0.5 }) },
	Lunge = { note("Jump", 1.6, 0.45) },
	Swish = { note("Fall", 1.6, 0.35, { from = 0.1, to = 0.45, effects = { "Flange" } }) },
	Hit = { note("Land", 1.5, 0.7) },
	Clang = {
		note("Land", 2.6, 0.75, { effects = { "Echo", "Thin" } }),
		note("Click", 0.7, 0.5, { effects = { "Echo" } }),
	},
	Squeak = { note("Oof", 2.4, 0.55) },
	Boing = { note("Jump", 0.55, 0.7, { effects = { "Tremolo", "Flange" } }) },
	Pop = { note("Click", 0.55, 1) },
	Twang = { note("Jump", 2.2, 0.5, { effects = { "Tremolo" } }) },
	Gulp = { note("Splash", 2.2, 0.45, { to = 0.35 }) },
	Slip = { note("Fall", 1.8, 0.4, { to = 0.4 }), note("Oof", 1.4, 0.6, { delay = 0.25 }) },
	Shoot = { note("Explosion", 2.8, 0.25, { to = 0.25 }) },
	Shotgun = { note("Explosion", 1.5, 0.55, { to = 0.6 }) },
	Boom = { note("Explosion", 1, 0.7), note("Oof", 2.4, 0.4, { delay = 0.1 }) },
	Splat = { note("Splash", 1.6, 0.35, { to = 0.3 }), note("Land", 1.2, 0.3) },
	Plunge = { note("Land", 0.8, 0.6), note("Splash", 2.5, 0.35, { to = 0.2 }) },
	Freeze = {
		note("Splash", 0.6, 0.35, { to = 0.5, effects = { "Echo" } }),
		note("Click", 2.8, 0.5, { delay = 0.05 }),
	},
	Bubble = { note("Swim", 2, 0.35, { to = 0.4 }) },
	WallBreak = { note("Explosion", 1.2, 0.6, { to = 0.8 }), note("Land", 0.7, 0.7) },

	-- People
	Bump = { note("Land", 1.9, 0.3) },
	Infect = { note("Oof", 1, 0.9) }, -- the classic
	Groan = { note("Ouch", 0.5, 0.55, { effects = { "Distort", "Reverb" } }) },
	Pickup = { note("GetUp", 1.7, 0.45), note("Click", 1.6, 0.4, { delay = 0.06 }) },
	Drop = { note("Land", 1.1, 0.35) },
	Eat = { note("Click", 1.2, 0.5), note("GetUp", 2, 0.4, { delay = 0.05 }) },
	Warp = { note("Fall", 0.8, 0.45, { to = 0.6, effects = { "Reverb" } }) },

	-- Round and UI
	Outbreak = {
		note("Explosion", 0.45, 0.6),
		note("Ouch", 0.45, 0.6, { delay = 0.2, effects = { "Distort", "Reverb" } }),
	},
	RoundWin = chime({ 1, 1.26, 1.5, 2 }, 0.12, 0.7, { "Reverb" }),
	RoundLose = {
		note("Ouch", 0.45, 0.6, { effects = { "Distort" } }),
		note("Click", 1, 0.6, { delay = 0.15 }),
		note("Click", 0.84, 0.6, { delay = 0.3 }),

	},
	Tick = { note("Click", 1.3, 0.5) },

	Wizard = chime({ 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3 }, 0.07, 0.5, { "Echo" }),

	-- Loops (started and stopped by SoundController)
	Spray = { note("Swim", 1.5, 0.3) },
	Blower = { note("Fall", 1.3, 0.3) },
	Scrape = { note("Steps", 0.45, 0.25, { effects = { "Muffle" } }) },

}

return {
