	RECIPES = RECIPES,
}

scripts.name: SoundController
scripts.source:
-- Sounds that follow what's going on rather than one-off events: countdown
-- ticks in the last 10 seconds of prep and of the round, your footsteps,
-- water guns and leaf blowers spraying, furniture scraping, and zombies
-- groaning near you.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.ClientState)
local Sounds = require(script.Parent.Sounds)

local SoundController = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local HEARING = 90
local INTERVAL = 0.1
local rng = Random.new()

local function characters(): { Instance }
	local list = workspace:GetChildren()
	local bots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Bots")
	if bots then
		for _, bot in bots:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(list, bot)
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function rootOf(model: Instance): BasePart?
	return model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
end

local function setPlaying(sound: Sound?, on: boolean)
	if not sound then
		return
	end
	if on and not sound.IsPlaying then
		sound:Play()
	elseif not on and sound.IsPlaying then
		sound:Stop()
	end
end

function SoundController.start()
	local footsteps = Sounds.loop("Footsteps")
	local footstepsPitch = if footsteps then footsteps.PlaybackSpeed else 1
	local scrape = Sounds.loop("Scrape")
	local sprays: { [Instance]: { sound: Sound, volume: number } } = {}
	local lastTick = -1
	local nextGroan = os.clock() + 5
	local furniture = workspace:WaitForChild("Furniture")

	local elapsed = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		elapsed += dt
		if elapsed < INTERVAL then
			return
		end
		elapsed = 0
		local on = Sounds.enabled()
		local character = player.Character
		local me = character and rootOf(character)
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		-- Countdown ticks.
		local phase = ClientState.phase()
		local left = ClientState.secondsLeft()
		if (phase == "Prep" or phase == "Infection") and left > 0 and left <= 10 then
			local second = math.ceil(left)
			if second ~= lastTick then
				lastTick = second
				Sounds.play(if second <= 3 then "TickFinal" else "Tick")
			end
		else
			lastTick = -1
		end

		-- Your footsteps, faster when you're faster.
		local walking = on
			and humanoid ~= nil
			and humanoid.Health > 0
			and humanoid.WalkSpeed > 0
			and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1
		if footsteps and humanoid then
			footsteps.PlaybackSpeed = footstepsPitch * math.clamp(humanoid.WalkSpeed / 16, 0.8, 1.5)
		end
		setPlaying(footsteps, walking)

		-- Furniture scraping along the floor near you.
		local scraping = false
		if on and me then
			for _, model in furniture:GetChildren() do
				local body = model:FindFirstChild("Body") :: BasePart?
				if body and not body.Anchored and body.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 2 then
					if (body.Position - me.Position).Magnitude < 40 then
						scraping = true
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
		setPlaying(scrape, scraping)

		-- Water guns and leaf blowers, louder the closer they are.
		local seen: { [Instance]: boolean } = {}
		for _, model in characters() do
			local kind = model:GetAttribute("Spraying")
			local root = rootOf(model)
			if on and typeof(kind) == "string" and root then
				seen[model] = true
				local entry = sprays[model]
				if not entry then
					local sound = Sounds.loop(if kind == "LeafBlower" then "Blower" else "Spray")
					if sound then
						entry = { sound = sound, volume = sound.Volume }
						sprays[model] = entry
						sound:Play()
					end
				end
				if entry then
					local distance = if me then (root.Position - me.Position).Magnitude else 0
					entry.sound.Volume = entry.volume * math.clamp(1 - distance / HEARING, 0, 1)
				end
			end
		end
		for model, entry in sprays do
			if not seen[model] then
				entry.sound:Destroy()
				sprays[model] = nil
			end
		end

		-- Now and then a zombie near you groans.
		local now = os.clock()
		if on and me and now >= nextGroan then
			nextGroan = now + rng:NextNumber(4, 8)
			local nearby = {}
			for _, model in characters() do
				local root = rootOf(model)
				if model ~= character and root and model:GetAttribute("Team") == "Zombie" then
					if (root.Position - me.Position).Magnitude < 70 then
						table.insert(nearby, root)
					end
				end
			end
			if #nearby > 0 then
				local root = nearby[rng:NextInteger(1, #nearby)]
				Sounds.play("Groan", root.Position, 0.6, rng:NextNumber(0.9, 1.15))
			end
		end
	end)
end

return SoundController

scripts.name: Sounds
scripts.source:
-- Plays the game's sounds (recipes in SoundBank), quieter the farther they
-- happen from you (the camera is far overhead, so normal 3D falloff would
-- make everything silent). A sound named in Config.SOUND_OVERRIDES plays that
-- uploaded sound instead.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local SoundBank = require(script.Parent.SoundBank)

local Sounds = {}

local enabled = true
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local HEARING = 90
local rng = Random.new()

function Sounds.setEnabled(on: boolean)
	enabled = on
end

function Sounds.enabled(): boolean
	return enabled
end

function Sounds.has(name: string?): boolean
	return name ~= nil
		and (SoundBank.RECIPES[name] ~= nil or (Config.SOUND_OVERRIDES :: { [string]: string })[name] ~= nil)
end

local function listener(): Vector3?
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	return root and root.Position
end

local EFFECTS: { [string]: () -> SoundEffect } = {
	Echo = function()
		local e = Instance.new("EchoSoundEffect")
		e.Delay = 0.07
		e.Feedback = 0.35
		e.WetLevel = -4
		return e
	end,
	Distort = function()
		local e = Instance.new("DistortionSoundEffect")
		e.Level = 0.55
		return e
	end,
	Tremolo = function()
		local e = Instance.new("TremoloSoundEffect")
		e.Frequency = 14
		e.Depth = 0.8
		return e
	end,
	Flange = function()
		local e = Instance.new("FlangeSoundEffect")
		e.Mix = 0.8
		e.Rate = 5
		e.Depth = 0.6
		return e
	end,
	Reverb = function()
		local e = Instance.new("ReverbSoundEffect")
		e.DecayTime = 0.9
		e.WetLevel = -6
		return e
	end,
	Muffle = function()
		local e = Instance.new("EqualizerSoundEffect")
		e.HighGain = -25
		e.MidGain = -6
		e.LowGain = 4
		return e
	end,
	Thin = function()
		local e = Instance.new("EqualizerSoundEffect")
		e.LowGain = -20
		e.MidGain = 2
		e.HighGain = 4
		return e
	end,
}

-- Builds (but doesn't play) one note.
local function make(note: SoundBank.Note, volume: number, pitch: number): Sound
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.SoundId = SoundBank.FILES[note.file] or ""
	sound.Volume = (note.volume or 0.6) * volume
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = (note.pitch or 1) * pitch
	if note.from or note.to then
		sound.PlaybackRegionsEnabled = true
		sound.PlaybackRegion = NumberRange.new(note.from or 0, note.to or 60)
	end
	local effects: { string } = note.effects or {}
	for _, name in effects do
		local build = EFFECTS[name]
		if build then
			build().Parent = sound
		end
	end
	sound.Parent = SoundService
	return sound
end

local function playOnce(sound: Sound)
	sound:Play()
	sound.Ended:Once(function()
		sound:Destroy()
	end)
	task.delay(8, function()
		if sound.Parent then
			sound:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

-- `volume` and `pitch` scale the recipe's own values.
function Sounds.play(name: string, position: Vector3?, volume: number?, pitch: number?)
	if not enabled then
		return
	end
	local v = volume or 1
	if position then
		local here = listener()
		if here then
			local dx, dz = position.X - here.X, position.Z - here.Z
			v *= math.clamp(1 - math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) / HEARING, 0, 1)
		end
		if v < 0.03 then
			return
		end
	end
	local p = (pitch or 1) * rng:NextNumber(0.96, 1.04) -- a little variety
	local override = (Config.SOUND_OVERRIDES :: { [string]: string })[name]
	if override and override ~= "" then
		local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
		sound.SoundId = override
		sound.Volume = 0.6 * v
		sound.PlaybackSpeed = p
		sound.Parent = SoundService
		playOnce(sound)
		return
	end
	local recipe = SoundBank.RECIPES[name]
	if not recipe then
		return
	end
	for _, n in recipe do
		if n.delay and n.delay > 0 then
			task.delay(n.delay, function()
				if enabled then
					playOnce(make(n, v, p))
				end
			end)
		else
			playOnce(make(n, v, p))
		end
	end
end

-- A looping sound you switch on and off (sprays, scraping, footsteps). Uses
-- the first note of the recipe.
function Sounds.loop(name: string): Sound?
	local override = (Config.SOUND_OVERRIDES :: { [string]: string })[name]
	local recipe = SoundBank.RECIPES[name]
	local sound: Sound
	if override and override ~= "" then
		sound = Instance.new("Sound")
		sound.SoundId = override
		sound.Parent = SoundService
	elseif recipe and recipe[1] then
		sound = make(recipe[1], 1, 1)
	else
		return nil
	end
	sound.Looped = true
	return sound
end

return Sounds

scripts.name: AdminPanel
scripts.source:
-- The admin panel (F2, or the ADMIN button on the left). Only shown to
-- admins; the server checks every request again (see AdminService).
--   Target: one player or everyone
--   Bots:   add Mario Clones, remove them, and a live list of every bot
--           (team, role and what it is doing; click one to target it)
--   Items:  give any item (or drop it in front of you)
--   Speed, points, immunity, team, bring / go to / respawn
--   Round:  skip phase, add time, next map, reset furniture, clear items
--   Maps:   pick the map for the next round (yours from Studio too)

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local Skins = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Skins)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)

local AdminPanel = {}

local GRAY = Color3.fromRGB(70, 72, 78)
local ADMIN_RED = Color3.fromRGB(196, 54, 54)

export type Panel = {
	open: () -> (),
	close: () -> (),
	isOpen: () -> boolean,
	update: () -> (),
}

-- Every item: the shop's order, then the wizard's, then anything else.
local function itemIds(): { string }
	local list, seen = {}, {}
	for _, group in { Items.shopOrder, Items.wizardOrder } do
		for _, id in group do
			if not seen[id] and Items.get(id) then
				seen[id] = true
				table.insert(list, id)
			end
		end
	end
	local rest = {}
	for id in Items.all do
		if not seen[id] then
			table.insert(rest, id)
		end
	end
	table.sort(rest)
	for _, id in rest do
		table.insert(list, id)
	end
	return list
end

function AdminPanel.build(parent: Instance, toast: (string, string?) -> ()): Panel
	local remote = Remotes.func("Admin")
	local window, content = UIKit.modal(parent, "Admin", 660, 600, function() end)

	local scroll = UIKit.new("ScrollingFrame", {
		Name = "Scroll",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -28),
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		ScrollBarThickness = 6,
		ZIndex = 21,
		Parent = content,
	}, { UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 6) })
	local status = UIKit.label({
		Name = "Status",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),
		TextSize = 16,
		TextColor3 = UIKit.MUTED,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Text = "Pick a target, then a command.",
		ZIndex = 21,
		Parent = content,
	})

	local order = 0
	local function nextOrder(): number
		order += 1
		return order
	end

	local function heading(text: string)
		UIKit.label({
			Text = text,
			LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
			TextSize = 18,
			Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
			TextColor3 = UIKit.GOLD,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			ZIndex = 21,
			Parent = scroll,
		})
	end

	-- A wrapping row of buttons.
	local function row(height: number?): Frame
		return UIKit.new("Frame", {
			LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			ZIndex = 21,
			Parent = scroll,
		}, {
			UIKit.new("UIGridLayout", {
				CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(118, height or 32),
				CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6),
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			}),
		})
	end

	local function button(parentRow: Frame, text: string, color: Color3?, onClick: () -> ()): TextButton
		return UIKit.button({
			Text = text,
			TextSize = 15,
			TextWrapped = true,
			BackgroundColor3 = color or UIKit.ACCENT,
			ZIndex = 22,
			Parent = parentRow,
		}, onClick)
	end

	-- Target picker --------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local target = ClientState.myId()
	local targetRow: Frame
	local function send(action: string, data: { [string]: any }?)
		local args: { [string]: any } = data or {}
		args.target = target
		status.Text = "..."
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, success, message = pcall(function()
				return remote:InvokeServer(action, args)
			end)
			local text = if ok then tostring(message) else "Couldn't reach the server"
			status.Text = text
			status.TextColor3 = if ok and success then UIKit.GOOD else UIKit.RED
			if ok and success then
				toast(text)
			end
		end)
	end

	heading("Target")
	targetRow = row(30)
	local function refreshTargets()
		for _, child in targetRow:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("TextButton") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local entries = { { id = "*", name = "Everyone" } }
		for _, r in ClientState.rows() do
			table.insert(entries, { id = r.id, name = (if r.isMe then "Me: " else "") .. r.name })
		end
		local stillThere = false
		for _, entry in entries do
			stillThere = stillThere or entry.id == target
		end
		if not stillThere then
			target = ClientState.myId()
		end
		for i, entry in entries do
			local b = button(
				targetRow,
				entry.name,
				if entry.id == target then UIKit.GOOD else GRAY,
				function()
					target = entry.id
					refreshTargets()
				end
			)
			b.LayoutOrder = i
		end
	end

	-- Bots ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	heading("Bots: add Mario Clones (as smart as Mario Robles). Click a bot to target it")
	local botSummary = UIKit.label({
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 20),
		TextSize = 15,
		TextColor3 = UIKit.MUTED,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		ZIndex = 21,
		Parent = scroll,
	})
	local botRow = row()
	for _, n in { 1, 5, 10 } do
		button(botRow, "+" .. n .. " Mario Clone" .. (if n > 1 then "s" else ""), nil, function()
			send("addBots", { count = n })
		end)
	end
	button(botRow, "Remove last clone", GRAY, function()
		send("removeBots", { count = 1 })
	end)
	button(botRow, "Remove all clones", ADMIN_RED, function()
		send("removeBots")
	end)
	button(botRow, "Remove target bot", ADMIN_RED, function()
		send("removeBot")
	end)
	local botList = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		ZIndex = 21,
		Parent = scroll,
	}, { UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 2) })

	local TEAM_COLORS = { Human = Color3.fromRGB(110, 170, 255), Zombie = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 90) }
	type BotLine = { frame: TextButton, cells: { TextLabel } }
	local botLines: { [string]: BotLine } = {}
	local function cell(line: TextButton, x: number, width: number, align: Enum.TextXAlignment?): TextLabel
		return UIKit.label({
			Position = UDim2.new(x, 6, 0, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(width, -8, 1, 0),
			TextSize = 14,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			TextXAlignment = align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			ZIndex = 23,
			Parent = line,
		})
	end
	local function refreshBots()
		local bots = {}
		for _, entry in ClientState.participants:GetChildren() do
			if entry:GetAttribute("IsBot") == true then
				table.insert(bots, entry)
			end
		end
		-- Humans first, then zombies; by name within a team.
		table.sort(bots, function(a, b)
			local ta, tb = a:GetAttribute("Team") == "Zombie", b:GetAttribute("Team") == "Zombie"
			if ta ~= tb then
				return tb
			end
			return tostring(a:GetAttribute("DisplayName")) < tostring(b:GetAttribute("DisplayName"))
		end)
		local zombies, clones = 0, 0
		local seen = {}
		for i, entry in bots do
			local id = entry.Name
			seen[id] = true
			local line = botLines[id]
			if not line then
				local frame = UIKit.new("TextButton", {
					Text = "",
					AutoButtonColor = true,
					BackgroundColor3 = GRAY,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),
					ZIndex = 22,
					Parent = botList,
				})
				UIKit.corner(6).Parent = frame
				local made: BotLine = {
					frame = frame,
					cells = {
						cell(frame, 0, 0.3),
						cell(frame, 0.3, 0.12),
						cell(frame, 0.42, 0.12),
						cell(frame, 0.54, 0.34),
						cell(frame, 0.88, 0.12, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right),
					},
				}
				frame.Activated:Connect(function()
					target = id
					refreshTargets()
					status.Text = "Target: " .. tostring(entry:GetAttribute("DisplayName"))
					status.TextColor3 = UIKit.MUTED
				end)
				botLines[id] = made
				line = made
			end
			local name = tostring(entry:GetAttribute("DisplayName") or id)
			local team = tostring(entry:GetAttribute("Team") or "Human")
			if team == "Zombie" then
				zombies += 1
			end
			if string.sub(name, 1, 12) == "Mario Clone " then
				clones += 1
			end
			local level = entry:GetAttribute("BotLevel")
			local role = if team == "Zombie" then "-" else tostring(entry:GetAttribute("BotRole") or "-")
			local cells = line.cells
			cells[1].Text = name .. (if level then " (Lv " .. tostring(level) .. ")" else "")
			cells[2].Text = team
			cells[2].TextColor3 = TEAM_COLORS[team] or UIKit.WHITE
			cells[3].Text = role
			cells[4].Text = tostring(entry:GetAttribute("BotDoing") or "")
			cells[5].Text = tostring(entry:GetAttribute("Score") or 0)
			line.frame.LayoutOrder = i
			line.frame.BackgroundColor3 = if id == target then Color3.fromRGB(60, 120, 70) else GRAY
		end
		for id, line in botLines do
			if not seen[id] then
				line.frame:Destroy()
				botLines[id] = nil
			end
		end
		botSummary.Text = string.format(
			"%d bots: %d human, %d zombie. %d Mario Clone%s.  (Chat: /addbot 5, /removebots, /bots)",
			#bots,
			#bots - zombies,
			zombies,
			clones,
			if clones == 1 then "" else "s"
		)
	end

	-- Items -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	heading("Give item (click)")
	local toGround = false
	local modeRow = row(30)
	local modeButton: TextButton
	modeButton = button(modeRow, "To: their hand", GRAY, function()
		toGround = not toGround
		modeButton.Text = if toGround then "To: ground near me" else "To: their hand"
	end)
	local itemRow = row(30)
	for i, id in itemIds() do
		local item = Items.get(id)
		if item then
			local b = button(itemRow, item.name, nil, function()
				send("give", { item = id, ground = toGround })
			end)
			b.LayoutOrder = i
		end
	end

	-- Skins ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	heading("Give skin (they keep it, and wear it now)")
	local skinRow = row(30)
	for i, skin in Skins.list do
		local label = skin.name .. (if skin.team == "Zombie" then " (Z)" else "")
		local b = button(
			skinRow,
			label,
			if skin.team == "Zombie" then Color3.fromRGB(70, 120, 60) else nil,
			function()
				send("skin", { skin = skin.id })
			end
		)
		b.LayoutOrder = i
	end

	-- Speed ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	heading("Speed")
	local speedRow = row()
	for _, factor in { 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3 } do
		local label = if factor == 0 then "Freeze" elseif factor == 1 then "Normal (1x)" else factor .. "x"
		button(speedRow, label, if factor < 1 then GRAY else nil, function()
			send("speed", { factor = factor })
		end)
	end

	-- Points --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	heading("Points (size and speed follow points)")
	local pointsRow = row()
	for _, amount in { 1000, 10000, 100000, -1000 } do
		button(pointsRow, string.format("%+d", amount), if amount < 0 then GRAY else nil, function()
			send("points", { add = amount })
		end)
	end
	button(pointsRow, "Set to 0", ADMIN_RED, function()
		send("points", { set = 0 })
	end)

	-- Player --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	heading("Player")
	local playerRow = row()
	button(playerRow, "Make human", nil, function()
		send("team", { team = "Human" })
	end)
	button(playerRow, "Make zombie", ADMIN_RED, function()
		send("team", { team = "Zombie" })
	end)
	button(playerRow, "Immunity 100", nil, function()
		send("immunity", { value = 100 })
	end)
	button(playerRow, "Bring to me", nil, function()
		send("bring")
	end)
	button(playerRow, "Go to", nil, function()
		send("goTo")
	end)
	button(playerRow, "Respawn", GRAY, function()
		send("respawn")
	end)

	-- Round ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	heading("Round")
	local roundRow = row()
	button(roundRow, "END ROUND NOW (next round)", ADMIN_RED, function()
		send("endRound")
	end)
	button(roundRow, "Skip phase", nil, function()
		send("skip")
	end)
	button(roundRow, "+60 seconds", nil, function()
		send("time", { seconds = 60 })
	end)
	button(roundRow, "-30 seconds", GRAY, function()
		send("time", { seconds = -30 })
	end)
	button(roundRow, "Next map (next round)", nil, function()
		send("nextMap")
	end)
	button(roundRow, "Reset furniture", GRAY, function()
		send("resetFurniture")
	end)
	button(roundRow, "Clear ground items", GRAY, function()
		send("clearItems")
	end)

	-- Maps --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	heading("Maps: Next = after this round, Now = end this round and go")
	local mapRow = row(30)
	local shownMaps = ""
	local function refreshMaps()
		local state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BrainTagState")
		local raw = state and state:GetAttribute("Maps")
		local list = if typeof(raw) == "string" then raw else ""
		if list == shownMaps then
			return
		end
		shownMaps = list
		for _, child in mapRow:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("TextButton") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		for i, name in string.split(list, "|") do
			if name ~= "" then
				button(mapRow, "Next: " .. name, nil, function()
					send("map", { map = name })
				end).LayoutOrder = i
						* 2
					- 1
				button(mapRow, "Now: " .. name, ADMIN_RED, function()
					send("map", { map = name, now = true })
				end).LayoutOrder = i
					* 2
			end
		end
	end

	-- Open button (admins only) ----------------------------------------------------------------
	local openButton = UIKit.button({
		Name = "AdminButton",
		Text = "ADMIN\n(F2)",
		TextSize = 13,
		-- Under the left side bar's buttons.
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 10 + 5 * (66 + 8)),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 46),
		BackgroundColor3 = ADMIN_RED,
		Visible = false,
		Parent = parent,
	})

	local function isAdmin(): boolean
		return ClientState.my("Admin") == true
	end

	local lastCount = -1
	local botsAt = 0
	local panel: Panel = {
		open = function()
			if isAdmin() then
				lastCount = #ClientState.rows()
				refreshTargets()
				refreshMaps()
				refreshBots()
				botsAt = os.clock()
				window.Visible = true
			end
		end,
		close = function()
			window.Visible = false
		end,
		isOpen = function()
			return window.Visible
		end,
		update = function()
			openButton.Visible = isAdmin()
			if window.Visible then
				local count = #ClientState.rows()
				if count ~= lastCount then
					lastCount = count
					refreshTargets()
				end
				if os.clock() - botsAt > 0.4 then
					botsAt = os.clock()
					refreshBots()
				end
			end
		end,
	}
	local function toggle()
		if window.Visible then
			panel.close()
		else
			panel.open()
		end
	end
	openButton.Activated:Connect(toggle)
	local close = window:FindFirstChild("Close")
	if close and close:IsA("TextButton") then
		close.Activated:Connect(panel.close)
	end
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F2 then
			toggle()
		end
	end)
	return panel
end

return AdminPanel

scripts.name: Banner
scripts.source:
-- Top-center countdown banner: "Outbreak happening in N seconds", the
-- survival timer, or "Waiting for players".

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)
local Util = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Util)

local Banner = {}

function Banner.build(parent: Instance): () -> ()
	local frame = UIKit.panel({
		Name = "Banner",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 8),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 42),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		Parent = parent,
	}, { UIKit.padding(18, 0) })
	local label = UIKit.label({
		Name = "Text",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		TextSize = 22,
		Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
		Parent = frame,
	})

	return function()
		local phase = ClientState.phase()
		local left = ClientState.secondsLeft()
		local text
		if phase == "Waiting" then
			local count = #ClientState.participants:GetChildren()
			local needed = ClientState.attr("Needed") or 2
			text = string.format("Waiting for players (%d/%d)", count, needed)
		elseif phase == "Prep" and ClientState.my("Turning") == true then
			text = string.format("You turn into a zombie in %d seconds!", math.ceil(left))
		elseif phase == "Prep" then
			text = string.format("Outbreak happening in %d seconds", math.ceil(left))
		elseif phase == "Infection" then
			if ClientState.isZombie() then
				text = "Infect them all!  " .. Util.clock(left)
			else
				text = "Survive!  " .. Util.clock(left) .. " left"
			end
		else
			text = "Next round starting..."
		end
		label.Text = text
		label.TextColor3 = if (phase == "Infection" and left <= 10)
				or ClientState.my("Turning") == true
			then UIKit.RED
			else UIKit.WHITE
	end
end

return Banner

scripts.name: BottomCenter
scripts.source:
-- Bottom-center: a context hint ("Press E to pick up Bat"), the inventory
-- (3 slots with 3D previews; the gold one is in your hand), and the
-- "Immunity 0/100" bar.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local InputController = require(script.Parent.Parent.InputController)
local ItemModels = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.ItemModels)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

local BottomCenter = {}

-- " x3" for peels, " 60%" for a water tank, "" for everything else.
local function chargeText(item: Items.Item, charges: any): string
	if typeof(charges) ~= "number" or charges <= 0 or not item.charges then
		return ""
	end
	if item.kind == "Stream" then
		return string.format(" %d%%", math.ceil(charges / item.charges * 100))
	end
	return " x" .. charges
end

local function nearestGroundItem(position: Vector3): string?
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("GroundItems")
	if not folder then
		return nil
	end
	local best: string? = nil
	local bestDistance = Config.PICKUP_RADIUS
	for _, model in folder:GetChildren() do
		local x, z = model:GetAttribute("SpotX"), model:GetAttribute("SpotZ")
		if typeof(x) == "number" and typeof(z) == "number" then
			local d = Util.flatDistance(Vector3.new(x, 0, z), position)
			if d <= bestDistance then
				best, bestDistance = model:GetAttribute("ItemId") :: string?, d
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

function BottomCenter.wizardNear(position: Vector3): boolean
	local wizard = workspace:FindFirstChild("Wizard")
	local robe = wizard and wizard:FindFirstChild("Robe") :: BasePart?
	return robe ~= nil and Util.flatDistance(robe.Position, position) <= Config.WIZARD_SHOP_RADIUS
end

function BottomCenter.build(parent: Instance, touchMode: boolean): () -> ()
	local column = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "BottomCenter",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -10),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 150),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = parent,
	}, {
		UIKit.list(
			Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
			6,
			Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
			Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
		),
	})

	local hint = UIKit.label({
		Name = "Hint",
		LayoutOrder = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 22),
		TextSize = 17,
		Parent = column,
	})
	UIKit.textStroke(1.5).Parent = hint

	-- The inventory: one box per slot, the one in your hand outlined in gold.
	-- Click a box (or press 1-3) to switch.
	local row = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "Inventory",
		LayoutOrder = 2,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Config.INVENTORY_SLOTS * 80, 72),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = column,
	}, { UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 8, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center) })
	type SlotView = { box: Frame, stroke: UIStroke, name: TextLabel, shown: string?, preview: ViewportFrame? }
	local views: { SlotView } = {}
	for i = 1, Config.INVENTORY_SLOTS do
		local stroke = UIKit.stroke(UIKit.WHITE, 2) :: UIStroke
		local box = UIKit.new("Frame", {
			Name = "Slot" .. i,
			LayoutOrder = i,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 72),
			BackgroundColor3 = UIKit.PANEL,
			BackgroundTransparency = UIKit.PANEL_TRANSPARENCY,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Parent = row,
		}, { UIKit.corner(10), stroke })
		local number = UIKit.label({
			Name = "Number",
			Text = tostring(i),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 2),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
			TextSize = 13,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			ZIndex = 4,
			Parent = box,
		})
		UIKit.textStroke(1).Parent = number
		local name = UIKit.label({
			Name = "ItemName",
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -2),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 14),
			TextSize = 11,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			ZIndex = 3,
			Parent = box,
		})
		UIKit.textStroke(1).Parent = name
		UIKit.new("TextButton", {
			Name = "Pick",
			Text = "",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			ZIndex = 5,
			Parent = box,
		}).Activated
			:Connect(function()
				InputController.selectSlot(i)
			end)
		table.insert(views, { box = box, stroke = stroke, name = name, shown = nil, preview = nil })
	end

	local bar = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "Immunity",
		LayoutOrder = 3,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 18),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 44),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Parent = column,
	}, { UIKit.corner(9) })
	local fill = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "Fill",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(94, 196, 255),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Parent = bar,
	}, { UIKit.corner(9) })
	local barText = UIKit.label({
		Name = "Text",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		TextSize = 13,
		ZIndex = 2,
		Parent = bar,
	})
	UIKit.textStroke(1).Parent = barText

	return function()
		local active = ClientState.my("ActiveSlot") or 1
		for i, view in views do
			local raw = ClientState.my("Slot" .. i)
			local id = if typeof(raw) == "string" and raw ~= "" then raw else nil
			if id ~= view.shown then
				view.shown = id
				if view.preview then
					view.preview:Destroy()
					view.preview = nil
				end
				if id then
					view.preview = UIKit.viewport(view.box, ItemModels.build(id), { ZIndex = 2 })
				end
			end
			local slotItem = Items.get(id)
			view.name.Text = if slotItem
				then slotItem.name .. chargeText(slotItem, ClientState.my("Slot" .. i .. "Charges"))
				else ""
			local isActive = i == active
			view.stroke.Color = if isActive then UIKit.GOLD else UIKit.WHITE
			view.stroke.Thickness = if isActive then 3 else 1.5
			view.stroke.Transparency = if isActive then 0 else 0.5
		end
		local held = ClientState.my("HeldItem")
		local item = Items.get(if typeof(held) == "string" and held ~= "" then held else nil)

		local immunity = ClientState.my("Immunity") or 0
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(immunity / Config.IMMUNITY_MAX, 0, 1), 1)
		barText.Text = string.format("Immunity  %d/%d", immunity, Config.IMMUNITY_MAX)

		local _, root = ClientState.myCharacter()
		local text = ""
		local keys = not touchMode
		if root then
			if ClientState.isZombie() then
				if ClientState.phase() == "Infection" then
					text = if keys then "[Z] back to spawn" else ""
				end
			else
				local ground = nearestGroundItem(root.Position)
				local groundItem = Items.get(ground)
				if BottomCenter.wizardNear(root.Position) then
					text = if keys
						then "Press [B] to trade with the wizard"
						else "Tap SHOP to trade with the wizard"
				elseif groundItem then
					text = (if keys then "Press [E] to pick up " else "Tap PICK UP: ") .. groundItem.name
				elseif item and keys then
					local verb = if item.kind == "Stream"
						then "[Hold click] spray"
						elseif item.kind == "Trap" then "[Click] drop one"
						elseif item.kind == "Melee" and item.hits then "[Click] swing  - hold it out to block"
						elseif item.kind == "Melee" then "Hold it toward zombies to keep them back"
						elseif item.kind == "Summon" then "[Click] summon a Blood Box"
						elseif item.kind == "Projectile" and item.effect == "Explode" then "[Click] throw"
						elseif item.kind == "Projectile" then "[Click] shoot"
						elseif item.reusable then "[Click] use (again after a rest)"
						else "[Click] use"
					text = verb .. "   [F] grab   [G] drop   [1-3] switch"
				end
			end
		end
		hint.Text = text
	end
end

return BottomCenter

scripts.name: BottomLeft
scripts.source:
-- Bottom-left: your points, the speed boost and size they give you, and
-- anything changing your speed right now (energy drink, freeze, stun).
-- Plus a 2x score timer when one is running.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local RoundRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RoundRules)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

local BottomLeft = {}

local ICE = Color3.fromHex("8FD3FF")

function BottomLeft.build(parent: Instance): () -> ()
	local box = UIKit.panel({
		Name = "ScoreBox",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -12),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		Parent = parent,
	}, { UIKit.padding(12, 8), UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 2) })
	local function line(name: string, order: number, height: number, props: { [string]: any }?): TextLabel
		local label = UIKit.label({
			Name = name,
			LayoutOrder = order,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
			TextSize = height - 2,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			Parent = box,
		})
		local extra: { [string]: any } = props or {}
		for key, value in extra do
			(label :: any)[key] = value
		end
		return label
	end
	local points = line("Points", 1, 24, { Font = UIKit.HEAVY })
	local speed = line("Speed", 2, 18)
	local size = line("Size", 3, 18)
	local effect = line("Effect", 4, 16, { Visible = false })
	local boost = line("Boost", 5, 16, { TextColor3 = UIKit.GOLD, Visible = false })

	return function()
		local value = ClientState.my("Score") or 0
		points.Text = "Points: " .. Util.commas(value)
		local multiplier = Config.SPEED_MULTIPLIER(value)
		speed.Text = string.format("Speed boost: +%d%%", math.floor((multiplier - 1) * 100 + 0.5))
		size.Text = string.format("Size: %.2fx", ClientState.my("Scale") or 1)

		-- Compare your real walk speed with what your points alone give you.
		local _, _, humanoid = ClientState.myCharacter()
		local expected = RoundRules.walkSpeed(value, ClientState.isZombie())
		local ratio = if humanoid and expected > 0 then humanoid.WalkSpeed / expected else 1
		effect.Visible = math.abs(ratio - 1) > 0.03
		if ratio < 0.01 then
			effect.Text = "Stunned!"
			effect.TextColor3 = ICE
		elseif ratio > 1 then
			effect.Text = string.format("Speed right now: x%.2f", ratio)
			effect.TextColor3 = UIKit.GOLD
		else
			effect.Text = string.format("Slowed: x%.2f", ratio)
			effect.TextColor3 = ICE
		end

		local endsAt = ClientState.my("BoostEndsAt")
		local left = if typeof(endsAt) == "number" then endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow() else 0
		boost.Visible = left > 0
		if left > 0 then
			boost.Text = "2x score  " .. Util.clock(left)
		end
	end
end

return BottomLeft

scripts.name: Center
scripts.source:
-- Center screen: the big "Survivors Win!!!" / "Zombies Win!!!" text, plus
-- short toasts under the banner.

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)

local Center = {}

function Center.buildWinText(parent: Instance): () -> ()
	local label = UIKit.label({
		Name = "WinText",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.42),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.2),
		TextScaled = true,
		Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
		Visible = false,
		ZIndex = 10,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	UIKit.new("UITextSizeConstraint", { MaxTextSize = 96, Parent = label })
	UIKit.textStroke(4).Parent = label
	local scale = UIKit.new("UIScale", { Scale = 1, Parent = label })

	local shown = ""
	return function()
		local winner = ClientState.attr("Winner")
		local text = if winner == "Survivors"
			then "Survivors Win!!!"
			elseif winner == "Zombies" then "Zombies Win!!!"
			else ""
		if text ~= shown then
			shown = text
			label.Visible = text ~= ""
			label.Text = text
			if text ~= "" then
				scale.Scale = 0.4
				TweenService:Create(
					scale,
					TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{ Scale = 1 }
				):Play()
			end
		end
	end
end

function Center.buildToasts(parent: Instance): (text: string, hex: string?) -> ()
	local stack = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "Toasts",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 58),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 120),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = parent,
	}, { UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 4, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center) })

	local order = 0
	return function(text: string, hex: string?)
		order += 1
		local toast = UIKit.panel({
			Name = "Toast",
			LayoutOrder = order,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
			Parent = stack,
		}, { UIKit.padding(14, 0) })
		local label = UIKit.label({
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
			TextSize = 17,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = if hex then Color3.fromHex(hex) else UIKit.WHITE,
			Parent = toast,
		})
		local toasts = stack:GetChildren()
		local count = 0
		for _, child in toasts do
			if child:IsA("Frame") then
				count += 1
			end
		end
		if count > 3 then
			local oldest: Frame? = nil
			for _, child in toasts do
				if child:IsA("Frame") and (not oldest or child.LayoutOrder < oldest.LayoutOrder) then
					oldest = child
				end
			end
			if oldest then
				oldest:Destroy()
			end
		end
		task.delay(3, function()
			if toast.Parent then
				local info = TweenInfo.new(0.4)
				TweenService:Create(toast, info, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
				TweenService:Create(label, info, { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
				task.wait(0.45)
				toast:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end
end

return Center

scripts.name: Hud
scripts.source:
-- Builds the whole HUD in code and keeps it up to date.
--   left side: buttons       top-center: countdown      top-right: counts + leaderboard
--   bottom-left: points      bottom-center: item slot   bottom-right: chat
--   center: win text, toasts, shop / settings / trophy / quick start windows
--   over your character: "+10" when your points change

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local AdminPanel = require(script.Parent.AdminPanel)
local Banner = require(script.Parent.Banner)
local BottomCenter = require(script.Parent.BottomCenter)
local BottomLeft = require(script.Parent.BottomLeft)
local Center = require(script.Parent.Center)
local ChatSetup = require(script.Parent.Parent.ChatSetup)
local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local InputController = require(script.Parent.Parent.InputController)
local MobileButtons = require(script.Parent.MobileButtons)
local QuickStart = require(script.Parent.QuickStart)
local ScorePopups = require(script.Parent.ScorePopups)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local ShopPanel = require(script.Parent.ShopPanel)
local SidePanels = require(script.Parent.SidePanels)
local TopLeft = require(script.Parent.TopLeft)
local TopRight = require(script.Parent.TopRight)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)

local Hud = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function hideDefaultGui()
	for _, kind in { Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, Enum.CoreGuiType.Health } do
		for _ = 1, 10 do
			local ok = pcall(function()
				StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(kind, false)
			end)
			if ok then
				break
			end
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end
end

function Hud.start()
	task.spawn(hideDefaultGui)

	local gui = UIKit.new("ScreenGui", {
		Name = "BrainTagHud",
		ResetOnSpawn = false,
		IgnoreGuiInset = false,
		ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.CoreUISafeInsets,
		ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
		Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"),
	})
	local uiScale = UIKit.new("UIScale", { Parent = gui })
	local function rescale()
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if camera then
			uiScale.Scale = math.clamp(camera.ViewportSize.Y / 760, 0.62, 1)
		end
	end
	rescale()
	if workspace.CurrentCamera then
		workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(rescale)
	end

	local touchMode = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled

	local toast = Center.buildToasts(gui)
	ScorePopups.start()
	ShopPanel.build(gui, toast)
	local openQuick, quickOpen = QuickStart.build(gui, touchMode, function()
		Remotes.event("TutorialDone"):FireServer()
	end)
	local settings = SidePanels.buildSettings(gui, openQuick)
	local trophy = SidePanels.buildTrophy(gui)
	local admin = AdminPanel.build(gui, toast)

	local function closeAll()
		ShopPanel.close()
		settings.close()
		trophy.close()
		admin.close()
	end

	local function toggleShop()
		if ShopPanel.isOpen() then
			ShopPanel.close()
			return
		end
		if ClientState.isZombie() then
			toast("Zombies can't shop!", Config.COLORS.ZombieText)
			return
		end
		closeAll()
		local _, root = ClientState.myCharacter()
		local atWizard = root ~= nil and BottomCenter.wizardNear(root.Position)
		ShopPanel.open(if atWizard then "Wizard" else "Items")
	end

	TopLeft.build(gui, {
		menu = function()
			closeAll()
			openQuick()
		end,
		shop = toggleShop,
		settings = function()
			local wasOpen = settings.isOpen()
			closeAll()
			if not wasOpen then
				settings.open()
			end
		end,
		trophy = function()
			local wasOpen = trophy.isOpen()
			closeAll()
			if not wasOpen then
				trophy.open()
			end
		end,
		chat = function()
			ChatSetup.setVisible(not ChatSetup.isVisible())
		end,
	})

	local updaters = {
		Banner.build(gui),
		TopRight.build(gui),
		BottomCenter.build(gui, touchMode),
		BottomLeft.build(gui),
		Center.buildWinText(gui),
	}
	if touchMode then
		table.insert(updaters, MobileButtons.build(gui))
	end

	InputController.onShop = toggleShop
	InputController.isMenuOpen = function()
		return ShopPanel.isOpen() or settings.isOpen() or trophy.isOpen() or quickOpen() or admin.isOpen()
	end

	Remotes.event("Toast").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(text: string, hex: string?)
		if typeof(text) == "string" then
			toast(text, hex)
		end
	end)

	-- First visit: show the quick start once the server has loaded our data.
	task.spawn(function()
		local me = ClientState.participants:WaitForChild(ClientState.myId(), 60)
		if me and me:GetAttribute("SeenTutorial") ~= true then
			openQuick()
		end
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			for _, update in updaters do
				local ok, err = pcall(function()
					update()
					return true
				end)
				if not ok then
					warn("[Hud] " .. tostring(err))
				end
			end
			ShopPanel.update()
			trophy.update()
			admin.update()

			-- Close the shop if you turned into a zombie or walked away from the wizard.
			if ShopPanel.isOpen() then
				local _, root = ClientState.myCharacter()
				if ClientState.isZombie() then
					ShopPanel.close()
				elseif
					ShopPanel.mode() == "Wizard" and (not root or not BottomCenter.wizardNear(root.Position))
				then
					ShopPanel.close()
				end
			end

			-- Your own name tag is lime green (only on your screen), red while
			-- you're turning into a zombie.
			local character = player.Character
			local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local tag = head and head:FindFirstChild("NameTag")
			local label = tag and tag:FindFirstChild("Label") :: TextLabel?
			if label then
				label.TextColor3 = if ClientState.my("Turning") == true then UIKit.RED else UIKit.LIME
			end

			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end)
end

return Hud

scripts.name: MobileButtons
scripts.source:
-- On-screen buttons for phones and tablets: USE (hold), GRAB (hold), PICK
-- UP, DROP, SHOP, and RETURN for zombies. Placed bottom-right.

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local InputController = require(script.Parent.Parent.InputController)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)

local MobileButtons = {}

local function round(parent: Instance, text: string, size: number, position: UDim2, color: Color3): TextButton
	local button = UIKit.button({
		Text = text,
		TextSize = if size > 70 then 22 else 14,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = position,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
		BackgroundColor3 = color,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	local corner = button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if corner then
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0) -- full circle
	end
	return button
end

function MobileButtons.build(parent: Instance): () -> ()
	local cluster = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "MobileButtons",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -100),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 200),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = parent,
	})

	local use = round(cluster, "USE", 86, UDim2.fromOffset(140, 140), UIKit.ACCENT)
	use.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		then
			InputController.useStart()
		end
	end)
	use.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		then
			InputController.useStop()
		end
	end)

	local grab = round(cluster, "GRAB", 58, UDim2.fromOffset(28, 66), UIKit.GOOD)
	grab.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		then
			InputController.grabStart()
		end
	end)
	grab.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		then
			InputController.grabStop()
		end
	end)

	local pick = round(cluster, "PICK\nUP", 56, UDim2.fromOffset(52, 150), UIKit.PANEL)
	pick.Activated:Connect(InputController.pickUp)
	local drop = round(cluster, "DROP", 50, UDim2.fromOffset(78, 92), UIKit.PANEL)
	drop.Activated:Connect(InputController.drop)
	local shop = round(cluster, "SHOP", 50, UDim2.fromOffset(140, 66), UIKit.PANEL)
	shop.Activated:Connect(InputController.shop)
	local back = round(cluster, "RETURN", 70, UDim2.fromOffset(140, 140), UIKit.RED)
	back.Activated:Connect(InputController.zombieReturn)

	return function()
		local zombie = ClientState.isZombie()
		use.Visible = not zombie
		grab.Visible = not zombie
		pick.Visible = not zombie
		drop.Visible = not zombie
		shop.Visible = not zombie
		back.Visible = zombie and ClientState.phase() == "Infection"
	end
end

return MobileButtons

scripts.name: ScorePopups
scripts.source:
-- Little "+10" numbers that float up from your character whenever your
-- points change (survival points every few seconds, eating someone,
-- rewards), only on your screen. Losses float up in red.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

local ScorePopups = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local RISE = TweenInfo.new(1.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local FADE = TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In, 0, false, 0.8)
local LOSS = Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.ZombieText)

local random = Random.new()

local function pop(amount: number)
	local _, root = ClientState.myCharacter()
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local board = UIKit.new("BillboardGui", {
		Name = "ScorePopup",
		Adornee = root,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 120),
		AlwaysOnTop = true,
		LightInfluence = 0,
		ResetOnSpawn = false,
		Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"),
	})
	local x = random:NextInteger(-18, 18)
	local label = UIKit.label({
		Text = (if amount > 0 then "+" else "-") .. Util.commas(math.abs(amount)),
		Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
		TextSize = if math.abs(amount) >= 100 then 30 else 24,
		TextColor3 = if amount > 0 then UIKit.LIME else LOSS,
		TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x, 0.5, -14),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
		Parent = board,
	})
	TweenService:Create(label, RISE, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x, 0, 32) }):Play()
	TweenService:Create(label, FADE, { TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1 }):Play()
	task.delay(1.5, function()
		board:Destroy()
	end)
end

function ScorePopups.start()
	task.spawn(function()
		local me = ClientState.participants:WaitForChild(ClientState.myId(), 120)
		if not me then
			return
		end
		local last = (me:GetAttribute("Score") :: number?) or 0
		local pending = 0
		me:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Score"):Connect(function()
			local value = (me:GetAttribute("Score") :: number?) or 0
			local change = value - last
			last = value
			if change == 0 then
				return
			end
			-- Changes in the same moment (a reward and its bonus) show as one.
			if pending == 0 then
				task.delay(0.05, function()
					local total = pending
					pending = 0
					if total ~= 0 then
						pop(total)
					end
				end)
			end
			pending += change
		end)
	end)
end

return ScorePopups

-- The shop window. Tabs: Items (spend score), Skins (score, Robux or VIP) and
-- Robux (game passes and developer products). Opened next to the wizard, it
-- shows his rare stock instead. The server validates every purchase.

local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CharacterLook = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.CharacterLook)
local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local ItemModels = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.ItemModels)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local Skins = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Skins)
local Sounds = require(script.Parent.Parent.Sounds)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

type Mode = "Items" | "Wizard" | "Skins" | "Robux"

-- Filled in by build().
local ShopPanel = {
	open = function(_mode: Mode) end,
	close = function() end,
	isOpen = function(): boolean
		return false
	end,
	update = function() end,
	mode = function(): Mode
		return "Items"
	end,
}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local money = Config.MONETIZATION
local buyItemRemote = Remotes.func("BuyItem")
local buySkinRemote = Remotes.func("BuySkin")

local PASSES = {
	{
		key = "VIP",
		name = "VIP",

		preview = "skin:Royal",
	},

}

		preview = "item:Drumstick",
	},
}

local prices: { [string]: number } = {}

local function fetchPrice(kind: "Product" | "GamePass", id: number, onDone: () -> ())
	local cacheKey = kind .. id
	if prices[cacheKey] or id == 0 then
		return
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, info = pcall(function()
			return MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo(
				id,
				if kind == "GamePass" then Enum.InfoType.GamePass else Enum.InfoType.Product
			)
		end)
		if ok and info and typeof(info.PriceInRobux) == "number" then
			prices[cacheKey] = info.PriceInRobux
			onDone()
		end
	end)
end

local function priceText(kind: "Product" | "GamePass", id: number): string
	local price = prices[kind .. id]
	return if price then "R$ " .. price else "Robux"
end

local function buildPreview(spec: string): Model?
	local kind, id = string.match(spec, "^(%a+):(%w+)$")
	if kind == "item" and id then
		return ItemModels.build(id)
	elseif kind == "skin" and id then
		local skin = Skins.get(id)
		if skin then
			return CharacterLook.preview(skin.id, skin.team)
		end
	end
	return nil

		Font = UIKit.FONT,
		TextSize = 18,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
		ZIndex = 41,
		Parent = tip,
	})
	local tipHead = UIKit.label({
		LayoutOrder = 2,
		Text = "Price:",
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30),
		Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
		TextSize = 18,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Bottom,
		ZIndex = 41,
		Parent = tip,
	})
	local tipPrice = UIKit.label({
		LayoutOrder = 3,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
		Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
		TextSize = 22,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		ZIndex = 41,
		Parent = tip,
	})
	local tipOwner: GuiObject? = nil
	local function hideTip(owner: GuiObject?)
		if owner == nil or owner == tipOwner then
			tipOwner = nil
			tip.Visible = false
			tipArrow.Visible = false
		end
	end
	local function showTip(owner: GuiObject, text: string, price: string, priceColor: Color3)
		tipOwner = owner
		tipText.Text = text
		tipHead.Visible = price ~= ""
		tipPrice.Visible = price ~= ""
		tipPrice.Text = price
		tipPrice.TextColor3 = priceColor
		-- Screen pixels -> this window's units (the HUD's UIScale).
		local uiScale = parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		local scale = if uiScale then (uiScale :: UIScale).Scale else 1
		local rel = (owner.AbsolutePosition - window.AbsolutePosition) / scale
		local size = owner.AbsoluteSize / scale
		local x = rel.X + size.X / 2
		if rel.Y > 230 then
			tip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
			tip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, rel.Y - 14)
			tipArrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, rel.Y - 14)
		else
			tip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
			tip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, rel.Y + size.Y + 14)
			tipArrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, rel.Y + size.Y + 14)
		end
		tip.Visible = true
		tipArrow.Visible = true
	end
	local PRICE_GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)

	local tabBar = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "Tabs",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34),
		ZIndex = 21,
		Parent = content,
	}, { UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 8) })

	local body = UIKit.new("ScrollingFrame", {
		Name = "Body",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 42),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -42),
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		ScrollBarThickness = 6,
		ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
		ZIndex = 21,
		Parent = content,
	})

	local tabButtons: { [string]: TextButton } = {}
	local function tab(name: string, order: number, onClick: () -> ()): TextButton
		local button = UIKit.button({
			Name = name,
			Text = name,
			LayoutOrder = order,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(104, 32),
			TextSize = 17,
			ZIndex = 22,
			Parent = tabBar,
		}, onClick)
		tabButtons[name] = button
		return button
	end
	for i, name in { "Items", "Skins", "Robux" } do
		tab(name, i, function()
			mode = name :: Mode
			render()
		end)
	end

	body:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(function()
		hideTip(nil)
	end)

	local function clearBody()
		hideTip(nil)
		for _, child in body:GetChildren() do
			child:Destroy()
		end
		UIKit.new("UIGridLayout", {
			CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 222),
			CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			Parent = body,
		})
	end

	type CardSpec = {
		order: number,
		title: string,
		price: string,
		priceColor: Color3?,
		description: string,
		tip: string?, -- the hover tooltip's text (the description if nil)
		tipPrice: string?, -- the price as the tooltip shows it (the price if nil)
		affordable: boolean?, -- tooltip price in green (red if false)
		preview: Model?,
		button: string,
		buttonColor: Color3?,
		enabled: boolean,
		onClick: (() -> ())?,
	}

	local CARD = Color3.fromRGB(44, 46, 52)
	local CARD_HOVER = Color3.fromRGB(58, 61, 69)
	local function card(spec: CardSpec)
		local outline = UIKit.stroke(Color3.fromRGB(215, 219, 226), 2, 1)
		local frame = UIKit.new("Frame", {
			LayoutOrder = spec.order,
			BackgroundColor3 = CARD,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			ZIndex = 22,
			Parent = body,
		}, { UIKit.corner(10), outline })
		-- Hover: the card lights up and the tooltip shows.
		frame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			frame.BackgroundColor3 = CARD_HOVER;
			(outline :: UIStroke).Transparency = 0.1
			showTip(
				frame,
				spec.tip or spec.description,
				spec.tipPrice or spec.price,
				if spec.affordable == false then UIKit.RED else PRICE_GREEN
			)
		end)
		frame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			frame.BackgroundColor3 = CARD;
			(outline :: UIStroke).Transparency = 1
			hideTip(frame)
		end)
		local previewBox = UIKit.new("Frame", {
			Name = "Preview",
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 63, 70),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 86),
			ZIndex = 22,
			Parent = frame,
		}, { UIKit.corner(8) })
		if spec.preview then
			-- Skins (CharacterLook previews) are shown from above, like in game.
			UIKit.viewport(previewBox, spec.preview, { ZIndex = 23 }, spec.preview.Name == "Preview")
		end
		UIKit.label({
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 98),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20),
			Text = spec.title,
			TextSize = 17,
			Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			ZIndex = 23,
			Parent = frame,
		})
		UIKit.label({
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 118),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16),
			Text = spec.price,
			TextSize = 15,
			TextColor3 = spec.priceColor or UIKit.GOLD,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			ZIndex = 23,
			Parent = frame,
		})
		UIKit.label({
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 136),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 42),
			Text = spec.description,
			TextSize = 13,
			Font = UIKit.FONT,
			TextColor3 = UIKit.MUTED,
			TextWrapped = true,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
			ZIndex = 23,
			Parent = frame,
		})
		UIKit.button({
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -8),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 32),
			Text = spec.button,
			TextSize = 16,
			BackgroundColor3 = if spec.enabled
				then (spec.buttonColor or UIKit.GOOD)
				else Color3.fromRGB(80, 82, 88),
			AutoButtonColor = spec.enabled,
			ZIndex = 23,
			Parent = frame,
		}, function()
			if spec.enabled and spec.onClick then
				spec.onClick()
			end
		end)
	end

	local function renderItems(fromWizard: boolean)
		local score = ClientState.my("Score") or 0
		local order: { string } = if fromWizard then Items.wizardOrder else Items.shopOrder
		for i, id in order do
			local item = Items.get(id) :: Items.Item
			local price = (if fromWizard then item.wizardPrice else item.price) or 0
			local affordable = score >= price
			card({
				order = i,
				title = item.name,
				price = Util.commas(price) .. " score",
				priceColor = if affordable then UIKit.GOLD else UIKit.RED,
				description = item.description .. (if item.rare then "  (5% chance: rare!)" else ""),
				tip = item.description .. (if item.rare
					then string.format(
						"\n• %d%% chance to be rare",
						math.floor(Config.RARE_CHANCE * 100 + 0.5)
					)
					else ""),
				tipPrice = Util.commas(price) .. " Score",
				affordable = affordable,
				preview = ItemModels.build(id),
				button = "Buy",
				enabled = affordable,
				onClick = function()
					local ok, okResult, message = pcall(function()
						return buyItemRemote:InvokeServer(id, fromWizard)
					end)
					if ok then
						Sounds.play(if okResult then "Buy" else "Error")
						toast(
							tostring(message),
							if okResult then Config.COLORS.Good else Config.COLORS.ZombieText
						)
					end
					task.delay(0.2, render)
				end,
			})
		end
	end

	local function prompt(kind: "Product" | "GamePass", key: string)
		local id = if kind == "GamePass" then money.GamePasses[key] else money.Products[key]
		if not id or id == 0 then
			toast("Not set up yet: add its id to Config.MONETIZATION", Config.COLORS.ZombieText)
			return
		end
		if kind == "GamePass" then
			MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(player, id)
		else
			MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, id)
		end
	end

	local function renderSkins()
		local equipped = ClientState.my("HumanSkin")
		local score = ClientState.my("Score") or 0
		for i, skin in Skins.forTeam("Human") do
			local owned = ClientState.owns("OwnedSkins", skin.id)
				or skin.default == true
				or (skin.pass ~= nil and ClientState.owns("Passes", skin.pass))
			local price, button, enabled = "", "", true
			if equipped == skin.id then
				price, button, enabled = "Owned", "Equipped", false
			elseif owned then
				price, button = "Owned", "Equip"
			elseif skin.scorePrice then
				price = Util.commas(skin.scorePrice) .. " score"
				button = "Unlock"
				enabled = score >= skin.scorePrice
			elseif skin.product then
				local id = money.Products[skin.product] or 0
				fetchPrice("Product", id, render)
				price, button = priceText("Product", id), "Buy"
			elseif skin.pass then
				price, button = "VIP pass", "Get VIP"
			end
			card({
				order = i,
				title = skin.name,
				price = price,
				priceColor = if owned then UIKit.LIME else UIKit.GOLD,
				description = if skin.team == "Zombie" then "Zombie skin" else "Human skin",
				affordable = owned or enabled,
				preview = CharacterLook.preview(skin.id, skin.team),
				button = button,
				buttonColor = if skin.product or skin.pass then UIKit.ACCENT else UIKit.GOOD,
				enabled = enabled,
				onClick = function()
					local ok, status, message = pcall(function()
						return buySkinRemote:InvokeServer(skin.id)
					end)
					if not ok then
						return
					end
					if status == "prompt" then
						prompt("Product", message)
					elseif status == "promptPass" then
						prompt("GamePass", message)
					else
						Sounds.play(if status == "error" then "Error" else "Buy")
						toast(
							tostring(message),
							if status == "error" then Config.COLORS.ZombieText else Config.COLORS.Good
						)
					end
					task.delay(0.3, render)
				end,
			})
		end
	end

	local function renderRobux()
		local shown = 0
		local studio = RunService:IsStudio()
		local order = 0
		local function addCard(
			kind: "Product" | "GamePass",
			entry: { key: string, name: string, description: string, preview: string }
		)
			local id = (if kind == "GamePass" then money.GamePasses[entry.key] else money.Products[entry.key])
				or 0
			if id == 0 and not studio then
				return
			end
			order += 1
			shown += 1
			local owned = kind == "GamePass" and ClientState.owns("Passes", entry.key)
			fetchPrice(kind, id, render)
			card({
				order = order,
				title = entry.name,
				price = if owned then "Owned" elseif id == 0 then "Not set up" else priceText(kind, id),
				priceColor = if owned then UIKit.LIME else UIKit.GOLD,
				description = entry.description .. (if kind == "GamePass" then "  (permanent)" else ""),
				preview = buildPreview(entry.preview),
				button = if owned then "Owned" elseif id == 0 then "Needs an id (README)" else "Buy",
				buttonColor = UIKit.ACCENT,
				enabled = not owned and id ~= 0,
				onClick = function()
					prompt(kind, entry.key)
				end,
			})
		end
		for _, entry in PASSES do
			addCard("GamePass", entry)
		end
		for _, entry in PRODUCTS do
			addCard("Product", entry)
		end
		if shown == 0 then
			UIKit.label({
				Text = "Coming soon!",
				TextSize = 22,
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 222),
				ZIndex = 22,
				Parent = body,
			})
		end
	end

	render = function()
		if not window.Visible then
			return
		end
		clearBody()
		local wizard = mode == "Wizard"
		heading.Text = if wizard then "Wizard's Wares" else "Shop"
		tabBar.Visible = not wizard
		body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, if wizard then 0 else 42)
		body.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, if wizard then 0 else -42)
		for name, button in tabButtons do
			local selected = name == mode
			button.BackgroundColor3 = if selected then UIKit.ACCENT else Color3.fromRGB(70, 72, 78)
		end
		if mode == "Items" then
			renderItems(false)
		elseif mode == "Wizard" then
			renderItems(true)
		elseif mode == "Skins" then
			renderSkins()
		else
			renderRobux()
		end
	end

	local lastScore = -1
	ShopPanel.update = function()
		if not window.Visible then
			return
		end
		local score = ClientState.my("Score") or 0
		scoreLabel.Text = "Score: " .. Util.commas(score)
		if score ~= lastScore then
			lastScore = score
			render()
		end
	end

	ShopPanel.open = function(newMode: Mode)
		mode = newMode
		window.Visible = true
		lastScore = -1
		render()
	end

	ShopPanel.close = function()
		hideTip(nil)
		window.Visible = false
	end

	ShopPanel.isOpen = function(): boolean
		return window.Visible
	end

	ShopPanel.mode = function(): Mode
		return mode
	end

	MarketplaceService.PromptProductPurchaseFinished:Connect(function()
		task.delay(1, render)
	end)
	MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function()
		task.delay(1, render)
	end)
end

return ShopPanel
