scripts.source: -- The settings window (sound, camera height, ping/fps line) and the trophy -- window (your stats and the all-time top 10). local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local CameraController = require(script.Parent.Parent.CameraController) local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState) local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config) local Sounds = require(script.Parent.Parent.Sounds) local TopRight = require(script.Parent.TopRight) local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit) local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util) local SidePanels = {} export type Panel = { open: () -> (), close: () -> (), isOpen: () -> boolean, update: () -> () } local function row(parent: Instance, order: number, title: string): Frame local frame = UIKit.new("Frame", { LayoutOrder = order, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), ZIndex = 21, Parent = parent, }) UIKit.label({ Text = title, TextSize = 18, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Size = UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 22, Parent = frame, }) local options = UIKit.new("Frame", { Name = "Options", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 22, Parent = frame, }, { UIKit.list( Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 6, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center ), }) return options end -- A row of mutually exclusive choices. local function choices(parent: Instance, labels: { string }, current: () -> string, pick: (string) -> ()) local buttons: { [string]: TextButton } = {} local function refresh() for label, button in buttons do button.BackgroundColor3 = if label == current() then UIKit.ACCENT else Color3.fromRGB(70, 72, 78) end end for i, label in labels do buttons[label] = UIKit.button({ Text = label, LayoutOrder = i, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(78, 32), TextSize = 15, ZIndex = 23, Parent = parent, }, function() pick(label) refresh() end) end refresh() end function SidePanels.buildSettings(parent: Instance, openHelp: () -> ()): Panel local panel: Panel local window, content = UIKit.modal(parent, "Settings", 440, 330, function() panel.close() end) UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 8).Parent = content choices(row(content, 1, "Sound effects"), { "On", "Off" }, function() return if Sounds.enabled() then "On" else "Off" end, function(choice) Sounds.setEnabled(choice == "On") end) choices(row(content, 2, "Camera"), { "Close", "Normal", "Far" }, function() for name, height in Config.CAMERA_ZOOMS do if height == CameraController.height() then return name :: string end end return "Normal" end, function(choice) CameraController.setHeight((Config.CAMERA_ZOOMS :: { [string]: number })[choice]) end) choices(row(content, 3, "Ping / FPS"), { "On", "Off" }, function() return if TopRight.statsVisible() then "On" else "Off" end, function(choice) TopRight.setStatsVisible(choice == "On") end) UIKit.button({ LayoutOrder = 4, Text = "How to play", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 36), ZIndex = 22, Parent = content, }, function() panel.close() openHelp() end) panel = { open = function() window.Visible = true end, close = function() window.Visible = false end, isOpen = function() return window.Visible end, update = function() end, } return panel end function SidePanels.buildTrophy(parent: Instance): Panel local panel: Panel local window, content = UIKit.modal(parent, "Trophies", 520, 500, function() panel.close() end) UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 6).Parent = content local stats = UIKit.label({ LayoutOrder = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, TextSize = 18, RichText = true, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 22, Parent = content, }) UIKit.label({ LayoutOrder = 2, Text = "All-time best scores", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), TextSize = 22, Font = UIKit.HEAVY, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 22, Parent = content, }) local board = UIKit.label({ LayoutOrder = 3, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, TextSize = 17, Font = UIKit.FONT, RichText = true, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = 22, Parent = content, }) panel = { open = function() window.Visible = true end, close = function() window.Visible = false end, isOpen = function() return window.Visible end, update = function() if not window.Visible then return end stats.Text = string.format( "Best %s Wins %d Infections %d Rounds %d", Util.commas(ClientState.my("BestScore") or 0), ClientState.my("Wins") or 0, ClientState.my("Infections") or 0, ClientState.my("RoundsPlayed") or 0 ) local ok, rows = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(ClientState.attr("TopScores") or "[]") end) if ok and typeof(rows) == "table" and #rows > 0 then local lines = {} for i, entry in rows do table.insert( lines, string.format( "%d. %s %s", i, tostring(entry.name), Util.commas(tonumber(entry.score) or 0) ) ) end board.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n") else board.Text = "No best scores saved yet. (Saving needs a published place with API access.)" end end, } return panel end return SidePanels

scripts.name: TopLeft
scripts.source:
-- Left side bar: five big square icon buttons stacked down the left edge
-- (info, shop, settings, trophy, chat).

local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)

local TopLeft = {}

TopLeft.BUTTON = 66 -- button size (pixels before UI scaling)
TopLeft.GAP = 8

export type Actions = {
	menu: () -> (),
	shop: () -> (),
	settings: () -> (),
	trophy: () -> (),
	chat: () -> (),
}

function TopLeft.build(parent: Instance, actions: Actions)
	local bar = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "SideBar",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 10),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(TopLeft.BUTTON, 5 * (TopLeft.BUTTON + TopLeft.GAP)),
		Parent = parent,
	}, { UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, TopLeft.GAP) })

	local buttons: { { icon: string, action: () -> (), accent: boolean?, name: string } } = {
		{ icon = "i", action = actions.menu, accent = true, name = "Info" }, -- how to play
		{ icon = "🛒", action = actions.shop, name = "Shop" },
		{ icon = "⚙", action = actions.settings, name = "Settings" },
		{ icon = "🏆", action = actions.trophy, name = "Trophy" },
		{ icon = "💬", action = actions.chat, name = "Chat" },
	}
	for i, b in buttons do
		UIKit.button({
			Name = b.name,
			Text = b.icon,
			TextSize = if b.name == "Info" then 44 else 34,
			Font = if b.name == "Info" then Enum.Font.GothamBlack else UIKit.BOLD,
			LayoutOrder = i,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(TopLeft.BUTTON, TopLeft.BUTTON),
			BackgroundColor3 = if b.accent then UIKit.ACCENT else UIKit.PANEL,
			BackgroundTransparency = if b.accent then 0 else UIKit.PANEL_TRANSPARENCY,
			Parent = bar,
		}, b.action)
	end
end

return TopLeft

scripts.name: TopRight
scripts.source:
-- Top-right: ping/fps, "N Survivors" (white) over "N Zombies" (red), and a
-- collapsible top-10 leaderboard with your own name in lime green.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)
local Util = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Util)

local TopRight = {}

local ROWS = 10
local HUMAN_DOT = Color3.fromHex("F2C79A")
local ZOMBIE_DOT = Color3.fromHex("7BC043")

local showStats = true

function TopRight.setStatsVisible(on: boolean)
	showStats = on
end

function TopRight.statsVisible(): boolean
	return showStats
end

function TopRight.build(parent: Instance): () -> ()
	local column = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "TopRight",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 6),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 400),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = parent,
	}, { UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 2, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right) })

	local stats = UIKit.label({
		Name = "Stats",
		LayoutOrder = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 16),
		TextSize = 13,
		Font = UIKit.FONT,
		TextColor3 = UIKit.MUTED,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		Parent = column,
	})
	local survivors = UIKit.label({
		Name = "Survivors",
		LayoutOrder = 2,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 32),
		TextSize = 30,
		Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		Parent = column,
	})
	UIKit.textStroke(1.5).Parent = survivors
	local zombies = UIKit.label({
		Name = "Zombies",
		LayoutOrder = 3,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 32),
		TextSize = 30,
		Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
		TextColor3 = UIKit.RED,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		Parent = column,
	})
	UIKit.textStroke(1.5).Parent = zombies

	local expanded = true
	local toggle = UIKit.button({
		Name = "LeaderboardToggle",
		LayoutOrder = 4,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 26),
		Text = "^  Leaderboard",
		TextSize = 16,
		BackgroundColor3 = UIKit.PANEL,
		BackgroundTransparency = UIKit.PANEL_TRANSPARENCY,
		Parent = column,
	})
	local board = UIKit.panel({
		Name = "Leaderboard",
		LayoutOrder = 5,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		Parent = column,
	}, { UIKit.padding(8, 6), UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 2) })

	toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
		expanded = not expanded
		board.Visible = expanded
		toggle.Text = (if expanded then "^" else "v") .. "  Leaderboard"
	end)

	local rows = {}
	for i = 1, ROWS do
		local row = UIKit.new("Frame", {
			Name = "Row" .. i,
			LayoutOrder = i,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
			Visible = false,
			Parent = board,
		})
		local dot = UIKit.new("Frame", {
			Name = "Dot",
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Parent = row,
		}, { UIKit.corner(4) })
		local name = UIKit.label({
			Name = "Name",
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -84, 1, 0),
			TextSize = 15,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			Parent = row,
		})
		local score = UIKit.label({
			Name = "Score",
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 1, 0),
			TextSize = 15,
			Font = UIKit.FONT,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
			Parent = row,
		})
		rows[i] = { frame = row, dot = dot, name = name, score = score }
	end

	local frames, fps = 0, 60
	local windowStart = os.clock()
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		frames += 1
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - windowStart >= 1 then
			fps = frames / (now - windowStart)
			frames, windowStart = 0, now
		end
	end)

	return function()
		stats.Visible = showStats
		if showStats then
			local ping = math.floor(Players.LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() * 1000)
			stats.Text = string.format("ping %d ms  |  %d fps", ping, math.floor(fps + 0.5))
		end
		local s = ClientState.attr("Survivors") or 0
		local z = ClientState.attr("Zombies") or 0
		survivors.Text = string.format("%d %s", s, if s == 1 then "Survivor" else "Survivors")
		zombies.Text = string.format("%d %s", z, if z == 1 then "Zombie" else "Zombies")

		local list = ClientState.rows()
		for i, row in rows do
			local entry = list[i]
			row.frame.Visible = entry ~= nil
			if entry then
				row.name.Text = entry.name
				row.name.TextColor3 = if entry.isMe
					then UIKit.LIME
					elseif entry.vip then UIKit.GOLD
					else UIKit.WHITE
				row.score.Text = Util.commas(entry.score)
				row.score.TextColor3 = if entry.isMe then UIKit.LIME else UIKit.WHITE
				row.dot.BackgroundColor3 = if entry.team == "Zombie" then ZOMBIE_DOT else HUMAN_DOT
			end
		end
	end
end

return TopRight

scripts.name: UIKit
scripts.source:
-- Tiny UI toolkit: every HUD element is built in code with these helpers.
-- Style: BuilderSans, white text, dark translucent rounded panels.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Sounds = require(script.Parent.Parent.Sounds)

local UIKit = {}

UIKit.FONT = Enum.Font.BuilderSans
UIKit.BOLD = Enum.Font.BuilderSansBold
UIKit.HEAVY = Enum.Font.BuilderSansExtraBold
UIKit.PANEL = Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.Panel)
UIKit.PANEL_TRANSPARENCY = 0.25
UIKit.WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
UIKit.MUTED = Color3.fromRGB(190, 194, 200)
UIKit.LIME = Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.SelfName)
UIKit.RED = Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.ZombieText)
UIKit.GOLD = Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.VipName)
UIKit.ACCENT = Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.Accent)
UIKit.GOOD = Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.Good)

type Props = { [string]: any }

-- Creates an instance, applies properties (Parent last) and adds children.
function UIKit.new(className: string, props: Props?, children: { any }?): any
	local instance = Instance.new(className) :: any
	local parent = nil
	local given: Props = props or {}
	local kids: { any } = children or {}
	for key, value in given do
		if key == "Parent" then
			parent = value
		else
			instance[key] = value
		end
	end
	for _, child in kids do
		child.Parent = instance
	end
	if parent then
		instance.Parent = parent
	end
	return instance
end

function UIKit.corner(radius: number?): Instance
	return UIKit.new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 8) })
end

function UIKit.stroke(color: Color3?, thickness: number?, transparency: number?): Instance
	return UIKit.new("UIStroke", {
		Color = color or UIKit.WHITE,
		Thickness = thickness or 2,
		Transparency = transparency or 0,
		ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
	})
end

function UIKit.textStroke(thickness: number?): Instance
	return UIKit.new("UIStroke", {
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 18),
		Thickness = thickness or 2,
		ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual,
	})
end

function UIKit.padding(px: number, vertical: number?): Instance
	local v = vertical or px
	return UIKit.new("UIPadding", {
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, px),
		PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, px),
		PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, v),
		PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, v),
	})
end

function UIKit.list(
	direction: Enum.FillDirection?,
	padding: number?,
	hAlign: Enum.HorizontalAlignment?,
	vAlign: Enum.VerticalAlignment?
): Instance
	return UIKit.new("UIListLayout", {
		FillDirection = direction or Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
		Padding = UDim.new(0, padding or 6),
		HorizontalAlignment = hAlign or Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
		VerticalAlignment = vAlign or Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	})
end

function UIKit.panel(props: Props, children: { any }?): Frame
	local merged: Props = {
		BackgroundColor3 = UIKit.PANEL,
		BackgroundTransparency = UIKit.PANEL_TRANSPARENCY,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}
	for key, value in props do
		merged[key] = value
	end
	local frame = UIKit.new("Frame", merged, children)
	UIKit.corner(8).Parent = frame
	return frame
end

function UIKit.label(props: Props): TextLabel
	local merged: Props = {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Font = UIKit.BOLD,
		TextColor3 = UIKit.WHITE,
		TextSize = 18,
		Text = "",
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}
	for key, value in props do
		merged[key] = value
	end
	return UIKit.new("TextLabel", merged)
end

function UIKit.button(props: Props, onClick: (() -> ())?): TextButton
	local merged: Props = {
		BackgroundColor3 = UIKit.ACCENT,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
		TextColor3 = UIKit.WHITE,
		TextSize = 18,
		AutoButtonColor = true,
	}
	for key, value in props do
		merged[key] = value
	end
	local button = UIKit.new("TextButton", merged)
	UIKit.corner(8).Parent = button
	button.Activated:Connect(function()
		Sounds.play("UiClick")
	end)
	if onClick then
		button.Activated:Connect(onClick)
	end
	return button
end

-- A centered modal window with a title bar and a close button. Returns the
-- window and its content frame.
function UIKit.modal(
	parent: Instance,
	title: string,
	width: number,
	height: number,
	onClose: () -> ()
): (Frame, Frame, TextLabel)
	local window = UIKit.panel({
		Name = title,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.94, 0, 0.86, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.08,
		Visible = false,
		ZIndex = 20,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	UIKit.new("UISizeConstraint", { MaxSize = Vector2.new(width, height), Parent = window })
	local heading = UIKit.label({
		Name = "Title",
		Text = title,
		TextSize = 26,
		Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 8),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 36),
		ZIndex = 21,
		Parent = window,
	})
	UIKit.button({
		Name = "Close",
		Text = "X",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 10),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 72, 78),
		ZIndex = 22,
		Parent = window,
	}, onClose)
	local content = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "Content",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 52),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -64),
		ZIndex = 21,
		Parent = window,
	})
	return window, content, heading
end

-- Renders a 3D model inside a ViewportFrame, framed from above at an angle.
-- `fromAbove` looks straight down with the front up, like the game camera.
function UIKit.viewport(parent: Instance, model: Model, props: Props?, fromAbove: boolean?): ViewportFrame
	local merged: Props = {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 205),
		LightColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.3, -1, -0.4),
	}
	local given: Props = props or {}
	for key, value in given do
		merged[key] = value
	end
	local frame = UIKit.new("ViewportFrame", merged)
	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	camera.FieldOfView = 30
	camera.Parent = frame
	frame.CurrentCamera = camera
	model.Parent = frame
	local cf, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local radius = math.max(size.Magnitude / 2, 0.5)
	local distance = radius / math.tan(math.rad(camera.FieldOfView / 2)) * 1.08
	if fromAbove then
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + Vector3.yAxis * distance, cf.Position, -Vector3.zAxis)
	else
		local from = cf.Position + Vector3.new(0.45, 1, 0.75).Unit * distance
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(from, cf.Position)
	end
	frame.Parent = parent
	return frame
end

return UIKit
